verses.sa: मा चिदन्यद्वि शंसत सखायो मा रिषण्यत । इन्द्रमित्स्तोता वृषणं सचा सुते मुहुरुक्था च शंसत॥
verses.tr: mā cidanyadvi śaṃsata sakhāyo mā riṣaṇyata indramitstotā vṛṣaṇaṃ sacā sute muhurukthā ca śaṃsata
verses.en: Glorify naught besides, O friends; so shall no sorrow trouble you. Praise only mighty Indra when the juice is shed, and say your lauds repeatedly:

verses.sa: अवक्रक्षिणं वृषभं यथाजुरं गां न चर्षणीसहम् । विद्वेषणं संवननोभयंकरं मंहिष्ठमुभयाविनम्॥
verses.tr: avakrakṣiṇaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ yathājuraṃ gāṃ na carṣaṇīsaham vidveṣaṇaṃ saṃvananobhayaṃkaraṃ maṃhiṣṭhamubhayāvinam
verses.en: Even him, eternal, like a bull who rushes down, men's Conqueror, bounteous like a cow; Him who is cause of both, of enmity and peace, to both sides most munificent.

verses.sa: यच्चिद्धि त्वा जना इमे नाना हवन्त ऊतये । अस्माकं ब्रह्मेदमिन्द्र भूतु तेऽहा विश्वा च वर्धनम्॥
verses.tr: yacciddhi tvā janā ime nānā havanta ūtaye asmākaṃ brahmedamindra bhūtu te'hā viśvā ca vardhanam
verses.en: Although these men in sundry ways invoke thee to obtain thine aid, Be this our prayer, addressed, O Indra, unto thee, thine exaltation every day.

verses.sa: वि तर्तूर्यन्ते मघवन्विपश्चितोऽर्यो विपो जनानाम् । उप क्रमस्व पुरुरूपमा भर वाजं नेदिष्ठमूतये॥
verses.tr: vi tartūryante maghavanvipaścito'ryo vipo janānām upa kramasva pururūpamā bhara vājaṃ nediṣṭhamūtaye
verses.en: Those skilled in song, O Maghavan among these men o'ercome with might the foeman's songs. Come hither, bring us strength in many a varied form most near that it may succour us.

verses.sa: महे चन त्वामद्रिवः परा शुल्काय देयाम् । न सहस्राय नायुताय वज्रिवो न शताय शतामघ॥
verses.tr: mahe cana tvāmadrivaḥ parā śulkāya deyām na sahasrāya nāyutāya vajrivo na śatāya śatāmagha
verses.en: O Caster of the Stone, I would not sell thee for a mighty price, Not for a thousand, Thunderer! nor ten thousand, nor a hundred, Lord of countless wealth!

verses.sa: वस्याँ इन्द्रासि मे पितुरुत भ्रातुरभुञ्जतः । माता च मे छदयथः समा वसो वसुत्वनाय राधसे॥
verses.tr: vasyāṃ indrāsi me pituruta bhrāturabhuñjataḥ mātā ca me chadayathaḥ samā vaso vasutvanāya rādhase
verses.en: O Indra, thou art more to me than sire or niggard brother is. Thou and my mother, O Good Lord, appear alike, to give me wealth abundantly.

verses.sa: क्वेयथ क्वेदसि पुरुत्रा चिद्धि ते मनः । अलर्षि युध्म खजकृत्पुरंदर प्र गायत्रा अगासिषुः॥
verses.tr: kveyatha kvedasi purutrā ciddhi te manaḥ alarṣi yudhma khajakṛtpuraṃdara pra gāyatrā agāsiṣuḥ
verses.en: Where art thou? Whither art thou gone? For many a place attracts thy mind. Haste, Warrior, Fort-destroyer, Lord of battle's din, haste, holy songs have sounded forth.

verses.sa: प्रास्मै गायत्रमर्चत वावातुर्यः पुरंदरः । याभिः काण्वस्योप बर्हिरासदं यासद्वज्री भिनत्पुरः॥
verses.tr: prāsmai gāyatramarcata vāvāturyaḥ puraṃdaraḥ yābhiḥ kāṇvasyopa barhirāsadaṃ yāsadvajrī bhinatpuraḥ
verses.en: Sing out the psalm to him who breaks down castles for his faithful friend, Verses to bring the Thunderer to destroy the forts and sit on Kanva's sacred grass.

verses.sa: ये ते सन्ति दशग्विनः शतिनो ये सहस्रिणः । अश्वासो ये ते वृषणो रघुद्रुवस्तेभिर्नस्तूयमा गहि॥
verses.tr: ye te santi daśagvinaḥ śatino ye sahasriṇaḥ aśvāso ye te vṛṣaṇo raghudruvastebhirnastūyamā gahi
verses.en: The Horses which are thine in tens, in hundreds, yea, in thousands thine, Even those vigorous Steeds, fleet-footed in the course, with those come quickly near to us.

verses.sa: आ त्व१द्य सबर्दुघां हुवे गायत्रवेपसम् । इन्द्रं धेनुं सुदुघामन्यामिषमुरुधारामरंकृतम्॥
verses.tr: ā tva1dya sabardughāṃ huve gāyatravepasam indraṃ dhenuṃ sudughāmanyāmiṣamurudhārāmaraṃkṛtam
verses.en: This day I call Sabardugiha who animates the holy song, Indra the richly-yielding Milch-cow who provides unfailing food in ample stream.

verses.sa: यत्तुदत्सूर एतशं वङ्कू वातस्य पर्णिना । वहत्कुत्समार्जुनेयं शतक्रतुः त्सरद्गन्धर्वमस्तृतम्॥
verses.tr: yattudatsūra etaśaṃ vaṅkū vātasya parṇinā vahatkutsamārjuneyaṃ śatakratuḥ tsaradgandharvamastṛtam
verses.en: When Sura wounded Etasa, with Vata's rolling winged car. Indra bore Kutsa Arjuneya off, and mocked Gandharva. the unconquered One.

verses.sa: य ऋते चिदभिश्रिषः पुरा जत्रुभ्य आतृदः । संधाता संधिं मघवा पुरूवसुरिष्कर्ता विह्रुतं पुनः॥
verses.tr: ya ṛte cidabhiśriṣaḥ purā jatrubhya ātṛdaḥ saṃdhātā saṃdhiṃ maghavā purūvasuriṣkartā vihrutaṃ punaḥ
verses.en: He without ligature, before making incision in the neck, Closed up the wound again, most wealthy Maghavan, who maketh whole the injured part.

verses.sa: मा भूम निष्ट्या इवेन्द्र त्वदरणा इव । वनानि न प्रजहितान्यद्रिवो दुरोषासो अमन्महि॥
verses.tr: mā bhūma niṣṭyā ivendra tvadaraṇā iva vanāni na prajahitānyadrivo duroṣāso amanmahi
verses.en: May we be never cast aside, and strangers, as it were, to thee. We, Thunder-wielding Indra, count ourselves as trees rejected and unfit to burn.

verses.sa: अमन्महीदनाशवोऽनुग्रासश्च वृत्रहन् । सकृत्सु ते महता शूर राधसा ऽनु स्तोमं मुदीमहि॥
verses.tr: amanmahīdanāśavo'nugrāsaśca vṛtrahan sakṛtsu te mahatā śūra rādhasā 'nu stomaṃ mudīmahi
verses.en: O Vrtra-slayer, we were thought slow and unready for the fray. Yet once in thy great bounty may we have delight, O Hero, after praising thee.

verses.sa: यदि स्तोमं मम श्रवदस्माकमिन्द्रमिन्दवः । तिरः पवित्रं ससृवांस आशवो मन्दन्तु तुग्र्यावृधः॥
verses.tr: yadi stomaṃ mama śravadasmākamindramindavaḥ tiraḥ pavitraṃ sasṛvāṃsa āśavo mandantu tugryāvṛdhaḥ
verses.en: If he will listen to my laud, then may out Soma-drops that flow Rapidly through the strainer gladden Indra, drops due to the Tugryas' Strengthener.

verses.sa: आ त्व१द्य सधस्तुतिं वावातुः सख्युरा गहि । उपस्तुतिर्मघोनां प्र त्वावत्वधा ते वश्मि सुष्टुतिम्॥
verses.tr: ā tva1dya sadhastutiṃ vāvātuḥ sakhyurā gahi upastutirmaghonāṃ pra tvāvatvadhā te vaśmi suṣṭutim
verses.en: Come now unto the common laud of thee and of thy faithful friend. So may our wealthy nobles' praise give joy to thee. Fain would I sing thine eulogy.

verses.sa: सोता हि सोममद्रिभिरेमेनमप्सु धावत । गव्या वस्त्रेव वासयन्त इन्नरो निर्धुक्षन्वक्षणाभ्यः॥
verses.tr: sotā hi somamadribhiremenamapsu dhāvata gavyā vastreva vāsayanta innaro nirdhukṣanvakṣaṇābhyaḥ
verses.en: Press out the Soma with the stones, and in the waters wash it clean. The men investing it with raiment made of milk shall milk it forth from out the stems.

verses.sa: अध ज्मो अध वा दिवो बृहतो रोचनादधि । अया वर्धस्व तन्वा गिरा ममा ऽऽजाता सुक्रतो पृण॥
verses.tr: adha jmo adha vā divo bṛhato rocanādadhi ayā vardhasva tanvā girā mamā ''jātā sukrato pṛṇa
verses.en: Whether thou come from earth or from the lustre of the lofty heaven, Wax stronger in thy body through my song of praise: fill full all creatures, O most Wise.

verses.sa: इन्द्राय सु मदिन्तमं सोमं सोता वरेण्यम् । शक्र एणं पीपयद्विश्वया धिया हिन्वानं न वाजयुम्॥
verses.tr: indrāya su madintamaṃ somaṃ sotā vareṇyam śakra eṇaṃ pīpayadviśvayā dhiyā hinvānaṃ na vājayum
verses.en: For India press the Soma out, most gladdening and most excellent. May Sakra make it swell sent forth with every prayer and asking, as it were, for strength.

verses.sa: मा त्वा सोमस्य गल्दया सदा याचन्नहं गिरा । भूर्णिं मृगं न सवनेषु चुक्रुधं क ईशानं न याचिषत्॥
verses.tr: mā tvā somasya galdayā sadā yācannahaṃ girā bhūrṇiṃ mṛgaṃ na savaneṣu cukrudhaṃ ka īśānaṃ na yāciṣat
verses.en: Let me not, still beseeching thee with earnest song at Soma rites, Anger thee like soma wild beast. Who would not beseech him who hath power to grant his prayer?

verses.sa: मदेनेषितं मदमुग्रमुग्रेण शवसा । विश्वेषां तरुतारं मदच्युतं मदे हि ष्मा ददाति नः॥
verses.tr: madeneṣitaṃ madamugramugreṇa śavasā viśveṣāṃ tarutāraṃ madacyutaṃ made hi ṣmā dadāti naḥ
verses.en: The draught made swift with rapturous joy, effectual with its mighty strength, All-conquering, distilling transport, let him drink: for he in ecstasy gives us gifts.

verses.sa: शेवारे वार्या पुरु देवो मर्ताय दाशुषे । स सुन्वते च स्तुवते च रासते विश्वगूर्तो अरिष्टुतः॥
verses.tr: śevāre vāryā puru devo martāya dāśuṣe sa sunvate ca stuvate ca rāsate viśvagūrto ariṣṭutaḥ
verses.en: Where bliss is not, may he, All-praised, God whom the pious glorify, Bestow great wealth upon the mortal worshipper who sheds the juice and praises him.

verses.sa: एन्द्र याहि मत्स्व चित्रेण देव राधसा । सरो न प्रास्युदरं सपीतिभिरा सोमेभिरुरु स्फिरम्॥
verses.tr: endra yāhi matsva citreṇa deva rādhasā saro na prāsyudaraṃ sapītibhirā somebhiruru sphiram
verses.en: Come, Indra, and rejoice thyself, O God, in manifold affluence. Thou fillest like a lake thy vast capacious bulk with Soma and with draughts besides.

verses.sa: आ त्वा सहस्रमा शतं युक्ता रथे हिरण्यये । ब्रह्मयुजो हरय इन्द्र केशिनो वहन्तु सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: ā tvā sahasramā śataṃ yuktā rathe hiraṇyaye brahmayujo haraya indra keśino vahantu somapītaye
verses.en: A thousand and a hundred Steeds are harnessed to thy golden car. So may the long-maned Bays, yoked by devotion, bring Indra to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa: आ त्वा रथे हिरण्यये हरी मयूरशेप्या । शितिपृष्ठा वहतां मध्वो अन्धसो विवक्षणस्य पीतये॥
verses.tr: ā tvā rathe hiraṇyaye harī mayūraśepyā śitipṛṣṭhā vahatāṃ madhvo andhaso vivakṣaṇasya pītaye
verses.en: Yoked to thy chariot wrought of gold, may thy two Bays with peacock tails, Convey thee hither, Steeds with their white backs, to quaff sweet juice that makes us eloquent.

verses.sa: पिबा त्व१स्य गिर्वणः सुतस्य पूर्वपा इव । परिष्कृतस्य रसिन इयमासुतिश्चारुर्मदाय पत्यते॥
verses.tr: pibā tva1sya girvaṇaḥ sutasya pūrvapā iva pariṣkṛtasya rasina iyamāsutiścārurmadāya patyate
verses.en: So drink, thou Lover of the Song, as the first drinker, of this juice. This the outpouring of the savoury sap prepared is good and meet to gladden thee.

verses.sa: य एको अस्ति दंसना महाँ उग्रो अभि व्रतैः । गमत्स शिप्री न स योषदा गमद्धवं न परि वर्जति॥
verses.tr: ya eko asti daṃsanā mahāṃ ugro abhi vrataiḥ gamatsa śiprī na sa yoṣadā gamaddhavaṃ na pari varjati
verses.en: He who alone by wondrous deed is Mighty, Strong by holy works, May he come, fair of cheek; may he not stay afar, but come and turn not from our call.

verses.sa: त्वं पुरं चरिष्ण्वं वधैः शुष्णस्य सं पिणक् । त्वं भा अनु चरो अध द्विता यदिन्द्र हव्यो भुवः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ puraṃ cariṣṇvaṃ vadhaiḥ śuṣṇasya saṃ piṇak tvaṃ bhā anu caro adha dvitā yadindra havyo bhuvaḥ
verses.en: Susna's quick moving castle thou hast crushed to pieces with thy bolts. Thou, Indra, from of old, hast followed after light, since we have had thee to invoke.

verses.sa: मम त्वा सूर उदिते मम मध्यंदिने दिवः । मम प्रपित्वे अपिशर्वरे वसवा स्तोमासो अवृत्सत॥
verses.tr: mama tvā sūra udite mama madhyaṃdine divaḥ mama prapitve apiśarvare vasavā stomāso avṛtsata
verses.en: My praises when the Sun hath risen, my praises at the time of noon, My praises at the coming of the gloom of night, O Vasu, have gone forth to thee.

verses.sa: स्तुहि स्तुहीदेते घा ते मंहिष्ठासो मघोनाम् । निन्दिताश्वः प्रपथी परमज्या मघस्य मेध्यातिथे॥
verses.tr: stuhi stuhīdete ghā te maṃhiṣṭhāso maghonām ninditāśvaḥ prapathī paramajyā maghasya medhyātithe
verses.en: Praise yea, praise him. Of princes these are the most liberal of their gifts, These, Paramajya, Ninditasva, Prapathi, most bounteous, O Medhyatithi.

verses.sa: आ यदश्वान्वनन्वतः श्रद्धयाहं रथे रुहम् । उत वामस्य वसुनश्चिकेतति यो अस्ति याद्वः पशुः ॥३॥
verses.tr: ā yadaśvānvananvataḥ śraddhayāhaṃ rathe ruham uta vāmasya vasunaściketati yo asti yādvaḥ paśuḥ 3
verses.en: When to the car, by faith, I yoked the horses longing for the way- For skilled is Yadu's son in dealing precious wealth, he who is rich in herds of kine.

verses.sa: य ऋज्रा मह्यं मामहे सह त्वचा हिरण्यया । एष विश्वान्यभ्यस्तु सौभगाऽऽसङ्गस्य स्वनद्रथः ॥३॥
verses.tr: ya ṛjrā mahyaṃ māmahe saha tvacā hiraṇyayā eṣa viśvānyabhyastu saubhagā''saṅgasya svanadrathaḥ 3
verses.en: May he who gave me two brown steeds together with their cloths of gold, May he, Asanga's son Svanadratha, obtain all joy and high felicities.

verses.sa: अध प्लायोगिरति दासदन्यानासङ्गो अग्ने दशभिः सहस्रैः । अधोक्षणो दश मह्यं रुशन्तो नळा इव सरसो निरतिष्ठन् ॥३॥
verses.tr: adha plāyogirati dāsadanyānāsaṅgo agne daśabhiḥ sahasraiḥ adhokṣaṇo daśa mahyaṃ ruśanto naḻā iva saraso niratiṣṭhan 3
verses.en: Playoga's son Asanga, by ten thousand, O Agni, hath surpassed the rest in giving. For me ten bright-hued oxen have come forward like lotus-stalks from out a lake upstanding.

verses.sa: अन्वस्य स्थूरं ददृशे पुरस्तादनस्थ ऊरुरवरम्बमाणः । शश्वती नार्यभिचक्ष्याह सुभद्रमर्य भोजनं बिभर्षि॥
verses.tr: anvasya sthūraṃ dadṛśe purastādanastha ūruravarambamāṇaḥ śaśvatī nāryabhicakṣyāha subhadramarya bhojanaṃ bibharṣi
verses.en: What time her husband's perfect restoration to his lost strength and manhood was apparent, His consort Sasvati with joy addressed him, Now art thou well, my lord, and shalt be happy.

verses.sa: इदं वसो सुतमन्धः पिबा सुपूर्णमुदरम् । अनाभयिन्ररिमा ते॥
verses.tr: idaṃ vaso sutamandhaḥ pibā supūrṇamudaram anābhayinrarimā te
verses.en: Here is the Soma juice expressed; O Vasu, drink till thou art full: Undaunted God, we give it thee.

verses.sa: नृभिर्धूतः सुतो अश्नैरव्यो वारैः परिपूतः । अश्वो न निक्तो नदीषु॥
verses.tr: nṛbhirdhūtaḥ suto aśnairavyo vāraiḥ paripūtaḥ aśvo na nikto nadīṣu
verses.en: Washed by the men, pressed out with stones, strained through the filter made of wool, 'Tis like a courser bathed in stream.

verses.sa: तं ते यवं यथा गोभिः स्वादुमकर्म श्रीणन्तः । इन्द्र त्वास्मिन्त्सधमादे॥
verses.tr: taṃ te yavaṃ yathā gobhiḥ svādumakarma śrīṇantaḥ indra tvāsmintsadhamāde
verses.en: This juice have we made sweet for thee like barley, blending it with milk. Indra, I call thee to our feast.

verses.sa: इन्द्र इत्सोमपा एक इन्द्रः सुतपा विश्वायुः । अन्तर्देवान्मर्त्याँश्च॥
verses.tr: indra itsomapā eka indraḥ sutapā viśvāyuḥ antardevānmartyāṃśca
verses.en: Beloved of all, Indra alone drinks up the flowing Soma juice Among the Gods and mortal men.

verses.sa: न यं शुक्रो न दुराशीर्न तृप्रा उरुव्यचसम् । अपस्पृण्वते सुहार्दम्॥
verses.tr: na yaṃ śukro na durāśīrna tṛprā uruvyacasam apaspṛṇvate suhārdam
verses.en: The Friend, whom not the brilliant-hued, the badly-mixt or bitter draught, Repels, the far-extending God;

verses.sa: गोभिर्यदीमन्ये अस्मन्मृगं न व्रा मृगयन्ते । अभित्सरन्ति धेनुभिः॥
verses.tr: gobhiryadīmanye asmanmṛgaṃ na vrā mṛgayante abhitsaranti dhenubhiḥ
verses.en: While other men than we with milk chase him as hunters chase a deer, And with their kine inveigle him.

verses.sa: त्रय इन्द्रस्य सोमाः सुतासः सन्तु देवस्य । स्वे क्षये सुतपाव्नः॥
verses.tr: traya indrasya somāḥ sutāsaḥ santu devasya sve kṣaye sutapāvnaḥ
verses.en: For him, for Indra, for the God, be pressed three draughts of Soma juice In the juice-drinker's own abode.

verses.sa: त्रयः कोशासः श्चोतन्ति तिस्रश्चम्व१ः सुपूर्णाः । समाने अधि भार्मन्॥
verses.tr: trayaḥ kośāsaḥ ścotanti tisraścamva1ḥ supūrṇāḥ samāne adhi bhārman
verses.en: Three reservoirs exude their drops, filled are three beakers to the brim, All for one offering to the God.

verses.sa: शुचिरसि पुरुनिःष्ठाः क्षीरैर्मध्यत आशीर्तः । दध्ना मन्दिष्ठः शूरस्य॥
verses.tr: śucirasi puruniḥṣṭhāḥ kṣīrairmadhyata āśīrtaḥ dadhnā mandiṣṭhaḥ śūrasya
verses.en: Pure art thou, set in many a place, and blended in the midst with milk And curd, to cheer the Hero best.

verses.sa: इमे त इन्द्र सोमास्तीव्रा अस्मे सुतासः । शुक्रा आशिरं याचन्ते॥
verses.tr: ime ta indra somāstīvrā asme sutāsaḥ śukrā āśiraṃ yācante
verses.en: Here, Indra, are thy Soma-draughts pressed out by us, the strong, the pure: They crave admixture of the milk.

verses.sa: ताँ आशिरं पुरोळाशमिन्द्रेमं सोमं श्रीणीहि । रेवन्तं हि त्वा शृणोमि॥
verses.tr: tāṃ āśiraṃ puroḻāśamindremaṃ somaṃ śrīṇīhi revantaṃ hi tvā śṛṇomi
verses.en: O Indra, pour in milk, prepare the cake, and mix the Soma-draught. I hear them say that thou art rich.

verses.sa: हृत्सु पीतासो युध्यन्ते दुर्मदासो न सुरायाम् । ऊधर्न नग्ना जरन्ते॥
verses.tr: hṛtsu pītāso yudhyante durmadāso na surāyām ūdharna nagnā jarante
verses.en: Quaffed juices fight within the breast. The drunken praise not by their wine, The naked praise not when it rains.

verses.sa: रेवाँ इद्रेवतः स्तोता स्यात्त्वावतो मघोनः । प्रेदु हरिवः श्रुतस्य॥
verses.tr: revāṃ idrevataḥ stotā syāttvāvato maghonaḥ predu harivaḥ śrutasya
verses.en: Rich be the praiser of one rich, munificent and famed like thee: High rank be his, O Lord of Bays.

verses.sa: उक्थं चन शस्यमानमगोररिरा चिकेत । न गायत्रं गीयमानं॥
verses.tr: ukthaṃ cana śasyamānamagorarirā ciketa na gāyatraṃ gīyamānaṃ
verses.en: Foe of the man who adds no milk, he heeds not any chanted hymn Or holy psalm that may he sung.

verses.sa: मा न इन्द्र पीयत्नवे मा शर्धते परा दाः । शिक्षा शचीवः शचीभिः॥
verses.tr: mā na indra pīyatnave mā śardhate parā dāḥ śikṣā śacīvaḥ śacībhiḥ
verses.en: Give us not, Indra, as a prey unto the scornful or the proud: Help, Mighty One, with power and might.

verses.sa: वयमु त्वा तदिदर्था इन्द्र त्वायन्तः सखायः । कण्वा उक्थेभिर्जरन्ते॥
verses.tr: vayamu tvā tadidarthā indra tvāyantaḥ sakhāyaḥ kaṇvā ukthebhirjarante
verses.en: This, even this, O Indra, we implore. as thy devoted friends, The Kanvas praise thee with their hymns.

verses.sa: न घेमन्यदा पपन वज्रिन्नपसो नविष्टौ । तवेदु स्तोमं चिकेत॥
verses.tr: na ghemanyadā papana vajrinnapaso naviṣṭau tavedu stomaṃ ciketa
verses.en: Naught else, O Thunderer, have I praised in the skilled singer's eulogy: On thy land only have I thought.

verses.sa: इच्छन्ति देवाः सुन्वन्तं न स्वप्नाय स्पृहयन्ति । यन्ति प्रमादमतन्द्राः॥
verses.tr: icchanti devāḥ sunvantaṃ na svapnāya spṛhayanti yanti pramādamatandrāḥ
verses.en: The Gods seek him who presses out the Soma; they desire not sleep They punish sloth unweariedly.

verses.sa: ओ षु प्र याहि वाजेभिर्मा हृणीथा अभ्य१स्मान् । महाँ इव युवजानिः॥
verses.tr: o ṣu pra yāhi vājebhirmā hṛṇīthā abhya1smān mahāṃ iva yuvajāniḥ
verses.en: Come hither swift with gifts of wealth - be not thou angry with us-like A great man with a youthful bride.

verses.sa: मो ष्व१द्य दुर्हणावान्त्सायं करदारे अस्मत् । अश्रीर इव जामाता॥
verses.tr: mo ṣva1dya durhaṇāvāntsāyaṃ karadāre asmat aśrīra iva jāmātā
verses.en: Let him not, wrathful with us, spend the evening far from us to-day, Like some unpleasant son-in-law.

verses.sa: विद्मा ह्यस्य वीरस्य भूरिदावरीं सुमतिम् । त्रिषु जातस्य मनांसि॥
verses.tr: vidmā hyasya vīrasya bhūridāvarīṃ sumatim triṣu jātasya manāṃsi
verses.en: For well we know this Hero's love, most liberal of the boons he gives, His plans whom the three worlds display.

verses.sa: आ तू षिञ्च कण्वमन्तं न घा विद्म शवसानात् । यशस्तरं शतमूतेः॥
verses.tr: ā tū ṣiñca kaṇvamantaṃ na ghā vidma śavasānāt yaśastaraṃ śatamūteḥ
verses.en: Pour forth the gift which Kanvas bring, for none more glorious do we know Than the Strong Lord with countless aids.

verses.sa: ज्येष्ठेन सोतरिन्द्राय सोमं वीराय शक्राय । भरा पिबन्नर्याय॥
verses.tr: jyeṣṭhena sotarindrāya somaṃ vīrāya śakrāya bharā pibannaryāya
verses.en: O presser, offer Soma first to Indra, Hero, Sakra, him The Friend of man, that he may drink;

verses.sa: यो वेदिष्ठो अव्यथिष्वश्वावन्तं जरितृभ्यः । वाजं स्तोतृभ्यो गोमन्तम्॥
verses.tr: yo vediṣṭho avyathiṣvaśvāvantaṃ jaritṛbhyaḥ vājaṃ stotṛbhyo gomantam
verses.en: Who, in untroubled ways, is best provider, for his worshippers. Of strength in horses and in kine.

verses.sa: पन्यम्पन्यमित्सोतार आ धावत मद्याय । सोमं वीराय शूराय॥
verses.tr: panyampanyamitsotāra ā dhāvata madyāya somaṃ vīrāya śūrāya
verses.en: Pressers, for him blend Soma juice, each draught most excellent, for him The Brave, the Hero, for his joy.

verses.sa: पाता वृत्रहा सुतमा घा गमन्नारे अस्मत् । नि यमते शतमूतिः॥
verses.tr: pātā vṛtrahā sutamā ghā gamannāre asmat ni yamate śatamūtiḥ
verses.en: The Vrtra-slayer drinks the juice. May he who gives a hundred aids Approach, nor stay afar from us.

verses.sa: एह हरी ब्रह्मयुजा शग्मा वक्षतः सखायम् । गीर्भिः श्रुतं गिर्वणसम्॥
verses.tr: eha harī brahmayujā śagmā vakṣataḥ sakhāyam gīrbhiḥ śrutaṃ girvaṇasam
verses.en: May the strong Bay Steeds, yoked by prayer, bring hither unto us our Friend, Lover of Song, renowned by songs.

verses.sa: स्वादवः सोमा आ याहि श्रीताः सोमा आ याहि । शिप्रिन्नृषीवः शचीवो नायमच्छा सधमादम्॥
verses.tr: svādavaḥ somā ā yāhi śrītāḥ somā ā yāhi śiprinnṛṣīvaḥ śacīvo nāyamacchā sadhamādam
verses.en: Sweet are the Soma juices, come! Blent are the Soma juices, come! Rsi-like, mighty, fair of cheek, come hither quickly to the feast.

verses.sa: स्तुतश्च यास्त्वा वर्धन्ति महे राधसे नृम्णाय । इन्द्र कारिणं वृधन्तः॥
verses.tr: stutaśca yāstvā vardhanti mahe rādhase nṛmṇāya indra kāriṇaṃ vṛdhantaḥ
verses.en: And lauds which strengthen thee for great bounty and valour, and exalt Indra who doeth glorious deeds,

verses.sa: गिरश्च यास्ते गिर्वाह उक्था च तुभ्यं तानि । सत्रा दधिरे शवांसि॥
verses.tr: giraśca yāste girvāha ukthā ca tubhyaṃ tāni satrā dadhire śavāṃsi
verses.en: And songs to thee who lovest song, and all those hymns addressed to thee- These evermore confirm thy might.

verses.sa: एवेदेष तुविकूर्मिर्वाजाँ एको वज्रहस्तः । सनादमृक्तो दयते॥
verses.tr: evedeṣa tuvikūrmirvājāṃ eko vajrahastaḥ sanādamṛkto dayate
verses.en: Thus he, sole doer of great deeds whose hand holds thunder, gives us strength, He who hath never been subdued.

verses.sa: हन्ता वृत्रं दक्षिणेनेन्द्रः पुरू पुरुहूतः । महान्महीभिः शचीभिः॥
verses.tr: hantā vṛtraṃ dakṣiṇenendraḥ purū puruhūtaḥ mahānmahībhiḥ śacībhiḥ
verses.en: Vrtra he slays with his right hand, even Indra, great with mighty power, And much-invoked in many a place.

verses.sa: यस्मिन्विश्वाश्चर्षणय उत च्यौत्ना ज्रयांसि च । अनु घेन्मन्दी मघोनः॥
verses.tr: yasminviśvāścarṣaṇaya uta cyautnā jrayāṃsi ca anu ghenmandī maghonaḥ
verses.en: He upon whom all men depend, all regions, all achievements, he Takes pleasure in our wealthy chiefs.

verses.sa: एष एतानि चकारेन्द्रो विश्वा योऽति शृण्वे । वाजदावा मघोनाम्॥
verses.tr: eṣa etāni cakārendro viśvā yo'ti śṛṇve vājadāvā maghonām
verses.en: All this hath he accomplished, yea, Indra, most gloriously renowned, Who gives our wealthy princes strength.

verses.sa: प्रभर्ता रथं गव्यन्तमपाकाच्चिद्यमवति । इनो वसु स हि वोळ्हा॥
verses.tr: prabhartā rathaṃ gavyantamapākāccidyamavati ino vasu sa hi voḻhā
verses.en: Who drives his chariot seeking spoil, from afar, to him he loves: For swift is he to bring men wealth.

verses.sa: सनिता विप्रो अर्वद्भिर्हन्ता वृत्रं नृभिः शूरः । सत्योऽविता विधन्तम्॥
verses.tr: sanitā vipro arvadbhirhantā vṛtraṃ nṛbhiḥ śūraḥ satyo'vitā vidhantam
verses.en: The Sage who, winning spoil with steeds, slays Vrtra, Hero with the men, His servant's faithful succourer.

verses.sa: यजध्वैनं प्रियमेधा इन्द्रं सत्राचा मनसा । यो भूत्सोमैः सत्यमद्वा॥
verses.tr: yajadhvainaṃ priyamedhā indraṃ satrācā manasā yo bhūtsomaiḥ satyamadvā
verses.en: O Priyamedhas, worship with collected mind this Indra whom The Soma hath full well inspired.

verses.sa: गाथश्रवसं सत्पतिं श्रवस्कामं पुरुत्मानम् । कण्वासो गात वाजिनम्॥
verses.tr: gāthaśravasaṃ satpatiṃ śravaskāmaṃ purutmānam kaṇvāso gāta vājinam
verses.en: Ye Kanvas, sing the Mighty One, Lord of the Brave, who loves renown, All-present, glorified by song.

verses.sa: य ऋते चिद्गास्पदेभ्यो दात्सखा नृभ्यः शचीवान् । ये अस्मिन्काममश्रियन्॥
verses.tr: ya ṛte cidgāspadebhyo dātsakhā nṛbhyaḥ śacīvān ye asminkāmamaśriyan
verses.en: Strong Friend, who, with no trace of feet, restores the cattle to the men, Who rest their wish and hope on him.

verses.sa: इत्था धीवन्तमद्रिवः काण्वं मेध्यातिथिम् । मेषो भूतो३ऽभि यन्नयः॥
verses.tr: itthā dhīvantamadrivaḥ kāṇvaṃ medhyātithim meṣo bhūto3'bhi yannayaḥ
verses.en: Shaped as a Ram, Stone-hurler I once thou camest hither to the son Of Kanva, wise Medhyatithi.

verses.sa: शिक्षा विभिन्दो अस्मै चत्वार्ययुता ददत् । अष्टा परः सहस्रा॥
verses.tr: śikṣā vibhindo asmai catvāryayutā dadat aṣṭā paraḥ sahasrā
verses.en: Vibhindu, thou hast helped this man, giving him thousands four times ten, And afterward eight thousand more.

verses.sa: उत सु त्ये पयोवृधा माकी रणस्य नप्त्या । जनित्वनाय मामहे॥
verses.tr: uta su tye payovṛdhā mākī raṇasya naptyā janitvanāya māmahe
verses.en: And these twain pouring streams of milk, creative, daughters of delight, For wedlock sake I glorify.

verses.sa: पिबा सुतस्य रसिनो मत्स्वा न इन्द्र गोमतः । आपिर्नो बोधि सधमाद्यो वृधे३ऽस्माँ अवन्तु ते धियः॥
verses.tr: pibā sutasya rasino matsvā na indra gomataḥ āpirno bodhi sadhamādyo vṛdhe3'smāṃ avantu te dhiyaḥ
verses.en: Drink, Indra, of the savoury juice, and cheer thee with our milky draught. Be, for our weal, our Friend and sharer of the feast, and let thy wisdom guard us well.

verses.sa: भूयाम ते सुमतौ वाजिनो वयं मा नः स्तरभिमातये । अस्माञ्चित्राभिरवतादभिष्टिभिरा नः सुम्नेषु यामय॥
verses.tr: bhūyāma te sumatau vājino vayaṃ mā naḥ starabhimātaye asmāñcitrābhiravatādabhiṣṭibhirā naḥ sumneṣu yāmaya
verses.en: In thy kind grace and favour may we still be strong: expose us not to foe's attack. With manifold assistance guard and succour us, and bring us to felicity.

verses.sa: इमा उ त्वा पुरूवसो गिरो वर्धन्तु या मम । पावकवर्णाः शुचयो विपश्चितोऽभि स्तोमैरनूषत॥
verses.tr: imā u tvā purūvaso giro vardhantu yā mama pāvakavarṇāḥ śucayo vipaścito'bhi stomairanūṣata
verses.en: May these my songs of praise exalt thee, Lord, who hast abundant wealth. Men skilled in holy hymns, pure, with the hues of fire, have sung them with their lauds to thee.

verses.sa: अयं सहस्रमृषिभिः सहस्कृतः समुद्र इव पप्रथे । सत्यः सो अस्य महिमा गृणे शवो यज्ञेषु विप्रराज्ये॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ sahasramṛṣibhiḥ sahaskṛtaḥ samudra iva paprathe satyaḥ so asya mahimā gṛṇe śavo yajñeṣu viprarājye
verses.en: He, with his might enhanced by Rsis thousand fold, hath like an ocean spread himself. His majesty is praised as true at solemn rites, his power where holy singers rule.

verses.sa: इन्द्रमिद्देवतातय इन्द्रं प्रयत्यध्वरे । इन्द्रं समीके वनिनो हवामह इन्द्रं धनस्य सातये॥
verses.tr: indramiddevatātaya indraṃ prayatyadhvare indraṃ samīke vanino havāmaha indraṃ dhanasya sātaye
verses.en: Indra for worship of the Gods, Indra while sacrifice proceeds, Indra, as worshippers in battle-shock, we call, Indra that we may win the spoil.

verses.sa: इन्द्रो मह्ना रोदसी पप्रथच्छव इन्द्रः सूर्यमरोचयत् । इन्द्रे ह विश्वा भुवनानि येमिर इन्द्रे सुवानास इन्दवः॥
verses.tr: indro mahnā rodasī paprathacchava indraḥ sūryamarocayat indre ha viśvā bhuvanāni yemira indre suvānāsa indavaḥ
verses.en: With might hath Indra spread out heaven and earth, with power hath Indra lighted up the Sun. In Indra are all creatures closely held; in him meet the distilling Soma-drops.

verses.sa: अभि त्वा पूर्वपीतय इन्द्र स्तोमेभिरायवः । समीचीनास ऋभवः समस्वरन्रुद्रा गृणन्त पूर्व्यम्॥
verses.tr: abhi tvā pūrvapītaya indra stomebhirāyavaḥ samīcīnāsa ṛbhavaḥ samasvaranrudrā gṛṇanta pūrvyam
verses.en: Men with their lauds are urging thee, Indra, to drink the Soma first. The Rbhus in accord have lifted up their voice, and Rudras sung thee as the first.

verses.sa: अस्येदिन्द्रो वावृधे वृष्ण्यं शवो मदे सुतस्य विष्णवि । अद्या तमस्य महिमानमायवोऽनु ष्टुवन्ति पूर्वथा॥
verses.tr: asyedindro vāvṛdhe vṛṣṇyaṃ śavo made sutasya viṣṇavi adyā tamasya mahimānamāyavo'nu ṣṭuvanti pūrvathā
verses.en: Indra increased his manly strength at sacrifice, in the wild rapture of this juice. And living men to-day, even as of old, sing forth their praises to his majesty.

verses.sa: तत्त्वा यामि सुवीर्यं तद्ब्रह्म पूर्वचित्तये । येना यतिभ्यो भृगवे धने हिते येन प्रस्कण्वमाविथ॥
verses.tr: tattvā yāmi suvīryaṃ tadbrahma pūrvacittaye yenā yatibhyo bhṛgave dhane hite yena praskaṇvamāvitha
verses.en: I crave of thee that hero strength, that thou mayst first regard this prayer, Wherewith thou holpest Bhrgu and the Yatis and Praskanva when the prize was staked.

verses.sa: येना समुद्रमसृजो महीरपस्तदिन्द्र वृष्णि ते शवः । सद्यः सो अस्य महिमा न संनशे यं क्षोणीरनुचक्रदे॥
verses.tr: yenā samudramasṛjo mahīrapastadindra vṛṣṇi te śavaḥ sadyaḥ so asya mahimā na saṃnaśe yaṃ kṣoṇīranucakrade
verses.en: Wherewith thou sentest mighty waters to the sea, that, Indra, is thy manly strength. For ever unattainable is this power of him to whom the worlds have cried aloud.

verses.sa: शग्धी न इन्द्र यत्त्वा रयिं यामि सुवीर्यम् । शग्धि वाजाय प्रथमं सिषासते शग्धि स्तोमाय पूर्व्य॥
verses.tr: śagdhī na indra yattvā rayiṃ yāmi suvīryam śagdhi vājāya prathamaṃ siṣāsate śagdhi stomāya pūrvya
verses.en: Help us, O Indra, when we pray to thee for wealth and hero might. First help thou on to strength the man who strives to win, and aid our laud, O Ancient One.

verses.sa:
शग्धी नो अस्य यद्ध पौरमाविथ धिय इन्द्र सिषासतः ।
शग्धि यथा रुशमं श्यावकं कृपमिन्द्र प्रावः स्वर्णरम्॥
verses.tr: śagdhī no asya yaddha pauramāvitha dhiya indra siṣāsataḥ śagdhi yathā ruśamaṃ śyāvakaṃ kṛpamindra prāvaḥ svarṇaram
verses.en: Help for us, Indra, as thou holpest Paura once, this man's devotions bent on gain. Help, as thou gavest Rugama and Syavaka and Svarnara and Krpa aid.

verses.sa: कन्नव्यो अतसीनां तुरो गृणीत मर्त्यः । नही न्वस्य महिमानमिन्द्रियं स्वर्गृणन्त आनशुः॥
verses.tr: kannavyo atasīnāṃ turo gṛṇīta martyaḥ nahī nvasya mahimānamindriyaṃ svargṛṇanta ānaśuḥ
verses.en: What newest of imploring prayers shall, then, the zealous mortal sing? For have not they who laud his might, and Indra-power won for themselves the light of heaven?

verses.sa:
कदु स्तुवन्त ऋतयन्त देवत ऋषिः को विप्र ओहते ।
कदा हवं मघवन्निन्द्र सुन्वतः कदु स्तुवत आ गमः॥
verses.tr: kadu stuvanta ṛtayanta devata ṛṣiḥ ko vipra ohate kadā havaṃ maghavannindra sunvataḥ kadu stuvata ā gamaḥ
verses.en: When shall they keep the Law and praise thee mid the Gods? Who counts as Rsi and as sage? When ever wilt thou, Indra Maghavan, come nigh to presser's or to praiser's call?

verses.sa: उदु त्ये मधुमत्तमा गिरः स्तोमास ईरते । सत्राजितो धनसा अक्षितोतयो वाजयन्तो रथा इव॥
verses.tr: udu tye madhumattamā giraḥ stomāsa īrate satrājito dhanasā akṣitotayo vājayanto rathā iva
verses.en: These songs of ours exceeding sweet, these hymns of praise ascend to thee, Like ever-conquering chariots that display their strength, gain wealth, and give unfailing aid.

verses.sa: कण्वा इव भृगवः सूर्या इव विश्वमिद्धीतमानशुः । इन्द्रं स्तोमेभिर्महयन्त आयवः प्रियमेधासो अस्वरन्॥
verses.tr: kaṇvā iva bhṛgavaḥ sūryā iva viśvamiddhītamānaśuḥ indraṃ stomebhirmahayanta āyavaḥ priyamedhāso asvaran
verses.en: The Bhrgus are like Suns, like Kanvas, and have gained all that their thoughts were bent upon. The living men of Priyamedha's race have sung exalting Indra with their lauds.

verses.sa: युक्ष्वा हि वृत्रहन्तम हरी इन्द्र परावतः । अर्वाचीनो मघवन्त्सोमपीतय उग्र ऋष्वेभिरा गहि॥
verses.tr: yukṣvā hi vṛtrahantama harī indra parāvataḥ arvācīno maghavantsomapītaya ugra ṛṣvebhirā gahi
verses.en: Best slayer of the Vrtras, yoke thy Bay Steeds, Indra, from afar. Come with the High Ones hither, Maghavan, to us, Mighty, to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa: इमे हि ते कारवो वावशुर्धिया विप्रासो मेधसातये । स त्वं नो मघवन्निन्द्र गिर्वणो वेनो न शृणुधी हवम्॥
verses.tr: ime hi te kāravo vāvaśurdhiyā viprāso medhasātaye sa tvaṃ no maghavannindra girvaṇo veno na śṛṇudhī havam
verses.en: For these, the bards and singers, have cried out to thee with prayer, to gain the sacrifice. As such, O Maghavan, Indra, who lovest song, even as a lover bear my call.

verses.sa: निरिन्द्र बृहतीभ्यो वृत्रं धनुभ्यो अस्फुरः । निरर्बुदस्य मृगयस्य मायिनो निः पर्वतस्य गा आजः॥
verses.tr: nirindra bṛhatībhyo vṛtraṃ dhanubhyo asphuraḥ nirarbudasya mṛgayasya māyino niḥ parvatasya gā ājaḥ
verses.en: Thou from the lofty plains above, O Indra, hurledst Vrtra down. Thou dravest forth the kine of guileful Mrgaya and Arbuda from the mountain's hold.

verses.sa: निरग्नयो रुरुचुर्निरु सूर्यो निः सोम इन्द्रियो रसः । निरन्तरिक्षादधमो महामहिं कृषे तदिन्द्र पौंस्यम्॥
verses.tr: niragnayo rurucurniru sūryo niḥ soma indriyo rasaḥ nirantarikṣādadhamo mahāmahiṃ kṛṣe tadindra pauṃsyam
verses.en: Bright were the flaming fires, the Sun gave forth his shine, and Soma, Indra's juice, shone clear. Indra, thou blewest the great Dragon from the air -. men must regard that valorous deed.

verses.sa: यं मे दुरिन्द्रो मरुतः पाकस्थामा कौरयाणः । विश्वेषां त्मना शोभिष्ठमुपेव दिवि धावमानम्॥
verses.tr: yaṃ me durindro marutaḥ pākasthāmā kaurayāṇaḥ viśveṣāṃ tmanā śobhiṣṭhamupeva divi dhāvamānam
verses.en: The fairest courser of them all, who runneth on as 'twere to heaven. Which Indra and the Maruts gave, and Pakasthaman Kaurayan.

verses.sa: रोहितं मे पाकस्थामा सुधुरं कक्ष्यप्राम् । अदाद्रायो विबोधनम्॥
verses.tr: rohitaṃ me pākasthāmā sudhuraṃ kakṣyaprām adādrāyo vibodhanam
verses.en: To me hath Pakasthaman given, a ruddy horse, good at the pole, Filling is girth and rousing wealth;

verses.sa: यस्मा अन्ये दश प्रति धुरं वहन्ति वह्नयः । अस्तं वयो न तुग्र्यम्॥
verses.tr: yasmā anye daśa prati dhuraṃ vahanti vahnayaḥ astaṃ vayo na tugryam
verses.en: Compared with whom no other ten strong coursers, harnessed to the pole, Bear Tugrya to his dwelling place.

verses.sa:
आत्मा पितुस्तनूर्वास ओजोदा अभ्यञ्जनम् ।
तुरीयमिद्रोहितस्य पाकस्थामानं भोजं दातारमब्रवम्॥
verses.tr: ātmā pitustanūrvāsa ojodā abhyañjanam turīyamidrohitasya pākasthāmānaṃ bhojaṃ dātāramabravam
verses.en: Raiment is body, food is life, and healing ointment giveth strength. As the free-handed giver of the ruddy steed, I have named Pakasthaman fourth.

verses.sa: यदिन्द्र प्रागपागुदङ्न्यग्वा हूयसे नृभिः । सिमा पुरू नृषूतो अस्यानवेऽसि प्रशर्ध तुर्वशे॥
verses.tr: yadindra prāgapāgudaṅnyagvā hūyase nṛbhiḥ simā purū nṛṣūto asyānave'si praśardha turvaśe
verses.en: Though, Indra, thou art called by men eastward and westward, north and south, Thou chiefly art with Anava and Turvasa, brave Champion I urged by men to Come.

verses.sa:
यद्वा रुमे रुशमे श्यावके कृप इन्द्र मादयसे सचा ।
कण्वासस्त्वा ब्रह्मभिः स्तोमवाहस इन्द्रा यच्छन्त्या गहि॥
verses.tr: yadvā rume ruśame śyāvake kṛpa indra mādayase sacā kaṇvāsastvā brahmabhiḥ stomavāhasa indrā yacchantyā gahi
verses.en: Or, Indra, when with Ruma, Rusama, Syavaka, and Krpa thou rejoicest thee, Still do the Kanvas, bringing praises, with their prayers, O Indra, draw thee hither: come.

verses.sa: यथा गौरो अपा कृतं तृष्यन्नेत्यवेरिणम् । आपित्वे नः प्रपित्वे तूयमा गहि कण्वेषु सु सचा पिब॥
verses.tr: yathā gauro apā kṛtaṃ tṛṣyannetyaveriṇam āpitve naḥ prapitve tūyamā gahi kaṇveṣu su sacā piba
verses.en: Even as the wild-bull, when he thirsts, goes to the desert's watery pool, Come hither quickly both at morning and at eve, and with the Kanvas drink thy fill.

verses.sa: मन्दन्तु त्वा मघवन्निन्द्रेन्दवो राधोदेयाय सुन्वते । आमुष्या सोममपिबश्चमू सुतं ज्येष्ठं तद्दधिषे सहः॥
verses.tr: mandantu tvā maghavannindrendavo rādhodeyāya sunvate āmuṣyā somamapibaścamū sutaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ taddadhiṣe sahaḥ
verses.en: May the drops gladden thee, rich Indra, and obtain bounty for him who pours the juice. Soma pressed in the mortar didst thou take and drink, and hence hast won surpassing might.

verses.sa: प्र चक्रे सहसा सहो बभञ्ज मन्युमोजसा । विश्वे त इन्द्र पृतनायवो यहो नि वृक्षा इव येमिरे॥
verses.tr: pra cakre sahasā saho babhañja manyumojasā viśve ta indra pṛtanāyavo yaho ni vṛkṣā iva yemire
verses.en: With mightier strength he conquered strength, with energy he crushed their wrath. O Indra, Strong in youth, all those who sought the fray bent and bowed down to thee like trees.

verses.sa: सहस्रेणेव सचते यवीयुधा यस्त आनळुपस्तुतिम् । पुत्रं प्रावर्गं कृणुते सुवीर्ये दाश्नोति नमउक्तिभिः॥
verses.tr: sahasreṇeva sacate yavīyudhā yasta ānaḻupastutim putraṃ prāvargaṃ kṛṇute suvīrye dāśnoti namauktibhiḥ
verses.en: He who wins promise of thine aid goes girt as with a thousand mighty men of war. He makes his son preeminent in hero might - he serves with reverential prayer.

verses.sa: मा भेम मा श्रमिष्मोग्रस्य सख्ये तव । महत्ते वृष्णो अभिचक्ष्यं कृतं पश्येम तुर्वशं यदुम्॥
verses.tr: mā bhema mā śramiṣmograsya sakhye tava mahatte vṛṣṇo abhicakṣyaṃ kṛtaṃ paśyema turvaśaṃ yadum
verses.en: With thee, the Mighty, for our Friend, we will riot fear or feel fatigue. May we see Turvasa and Yadu: thy great deed, O Hero, must be glorified.

verses.sa: सव्यामनु स्फिग्यं वावसे वृषा न दानो अस्य रोषति । मध्वा सम्पृक्ताः सारघेण धेनवस्तूयमेहि द्रवा पिब॥
verses.tr: savyāmanu sphigyaṃ vāvase vṛṣā na dāno asya roṣati madhvā sampṛktāḥ sāragheṇa dhenavastūyamehi dravā piba
verses.en: On his left hip the Hero hath reclined himself: the proffered feast offends him not. The milk is blended with the honey of the bee: quickly come hither, baste, and drink.

verses.sa: अश्वी रथी सुरूप इद्गोमाँ इदिन्द्र ते सखा । श्वात्रभाजा वयसा सचते सदा चन्द्रो याति सभामुप॥
verses.tr: aśvī rathī surūpa idgomāṃ idindra te sakhā śvātrabhājā vayasā sacate sadā candro yāti sabhāmupa
verses.en: Indra, thy friend is fair of form and rich in horses, cars, and kine. He evermore hath food accompanied by wealth, and radiant joins the company.

verses.sa: ऋश्यो न तृष्यन्नवपानमा गहि पिबा सोमं वशाँ अनु । निमेघमानो मघवन्दिवेदिव ओजिष्ठं दधिषे सहः॥
verses.tr: ṛśyo na tṛṣyannavapānamā gahi pibā somaṃ vaśāṃ anu nimeghamāno maghavandivediva ojiṣṭhaṃ dadhiṣe sahaḥ
verses.en: Come like a thirsty antelope to the drinking-place: drink Soma to thy heart's desire. Raining it down, O Maghavan, day after day, thou gainest thy surpassing might.

verses.sa: अध्वर्यो द्रावया त्वं सोममिन्द्रः पिपासति । उप नूनं युयुजे वृषणा हरी आ च जगाम वृत्रहा॥
verses.tr: adhvaryo drāvayā tvaṃ somamindraḥ pipāsati upa nūnaṃ yuyuje vṛṣaṇā harī ā ca jagāma vṛtrahā
verses.en: Priest, let the Soma juice flow forth, for Indra longs to drink thereof. He even now hath yoked his vigorous Bay Steeds: the Vrtra-slayer hath come near.

verses.sa:
स्वयं चित्स मन्यते दाशुरिर्जनो यत्रा सोमस्य तृम्पसि ।
इदं ते अन्नं युज्यं समुक्षितं तस्येहि प्र द्रवा पिब॥
verses.tr: svayaṃ citsa manyate dāśurirjano yatrā somasya tṛmpasi idaṃ te annaṃ yujyaṃ samukṣitaṃ tasyehi pra dravā piba
verses.en: The man with whom thou fillest thee with Soma deems himself a pious worshipper. This thine appropriate food is here poured out for thee: come, hasten forward. drink of it,

verses.sa: रथेष्ठायाध्वर्यवः सोममिन्द्राय सोतन । अधि ब्रध्नस्याद्रयो वि चक्षते सुन्वन्तो दाश्वध्वरम्॥
verses.tr: ratheṣṭhāyādhvaryavaḥ somamindrāya sotana adhi bradhnasyādrayo vi cakṣate sunvanto dāśvadhvaram
verses.en: Press out the Soma juice, ye priests, for Indra borne upon his car. The pressing-stones speak loud of Indra, while they shed the juice which, offered, honours him.

verses.sa: उप ब्रध्नं वावाता वृषणा हरी इन्द्रमपसु वक्षतः । अर्वाञ्चं त्वा सप्तयोऽध्वरश्रियो वहन्तु सवनेदुप॥
verses.tr: upa bradhnaṃ vāvātā vṛṣaṇā harī indramapasu vakṣataḥ arvāñcaṃ tvā saptayo'dhvaraśriyo vahantu savanedupa
verses.en: To the brown juice may his dear vigorous Bay Steeds bring Indra, to our holy task. Hither let thy Car-steeds who seek the sacrifice bring thee to our drink-offerings.

verses.sa: प्र पूषणं वृणीमहे युज्याय पुरूवसुम् । स शक्र शिक्ष पुरुहूत नो धिया तुजे राये विमोचन॥
verses.tr: pra pūṣaṇaṃ vṛṇīmahe yujyāya purūvasum sa śakra śikṣa puruhūta no dhiyā tuje rāye vimocana
verses.en: Pusan, the Lord of ample wealth, for firm alliance we elect. May he with wisdom, Sakra! Looser! Much-invoked! aid us to riches and to seed.

verses.sa: सं नः शिशीहि भुरिजोरिव क्षुरं रास्व रायो विमोचन । त्वे तन्नः सुवेदमुस्रियं वसु यं त्वं हिनोषि मर्त्यम्॥
verses.tr: saṃ naḥ śiśīhi bhurijoriva kṣuraṃ rāsva rāyo vimocana tve tannaḥ suvedamusriyaṃ vasu yaṃ tvaṃ hinoṣi martyam
verses.en: Sharpen us like a razor in the barber's hands: send riches thou who settest free. Easy to find with thee are treasures of the Dawn for mortal man whom thou dost speed.

verses.sa: वेमि त्वा पूषन्नृञ्जसे वेमि स्तोतव आघृणे । न तस्य वेम्यरणं हि तद्वसो स्तुषे पज्राय साम्ने॥
verses.tr: vemi tvā pūṣannṛñjase vemi stotava āghṛṇe na tasya vemyaraṇaṃ hi tadvaso stuṣe pajrāya sāmne
verses.en: Pusan, I long to win thy love, I long to praise thee, Radiant God. Excellent Lord, 'tis strange tome, no wish have I to sing the psalm that Pajra sings.

verses.sa: परा गावो यवसं कच्चिदाघृणे नित्यं रेक्णो अमर्त्य । अस्माकं पूषन्नविता शिवो भव मंहिष्ठो वाजसातये॥
verses.tr: parā gāvo yavasaṃ kaccidāghṛṇe nityaṃ rekṇo amartya asmākaṃ pūṣannavitā śivo bhava maṃhiṣṭho vājasātaye
verses.en: My kine, O Radiant God, seek pasture where they will, my during wealth, Immortal One. Be our protector, Pusan! be, most liberal Lord, propitious to our gathering strength.

verses.sa: स्थूरं राधः शताश्वं कुरुङ्गस्य दिविष्टिषु । राज्ञस्त्वेषस्य सुभगस्य रातिषु तुर्वशेष्वमन्महि॥
verses.tr: sthūraṃ rādhaḥ śatāśvaṃ kuruṅgasya diviṣṭiṣu rājñastveṣasya subhagasya rātiṣu turvaśeṣvamanmahi
verses.en: Rich was the gift Kurunga gave, a hundred steeds at morning rites. Among the gifts of Turvasas we thought of him, the opulent, the splendid King.

verses.sa: धीभिः सातानि काण्वस्य वाजिनः प्रियमेधैरभिद्युभिः । षष्टिं सहस्रानु निर्मजामजे निर्यूथानि गवामृषिः॥
verses.tr: dhībhiḥ sātāni kāṇvasya vājinaḥ priyamedhairabhidyubhiḥ ṣaṣṭiṃ sahasrānu nirmajāmaje niryūthāni gavāmṛṣiḥ
verses.en: What by his morning songs Kanva, the powerful, hath, with the Priyamedhas, gained- The herds of sixty thousand pure and spotless kine, have I, the Rsi, driven away.

verses.sa: वृक्षाश्चिन्मे अभिपित्वे अरारणुः । गां भजन्त मेहनाऽश्वं भजन्त मेहना॥
verses.tr: vṛkṣāścinme abhipitve arāraṇuḥ gāṃ bhajanta mehanā'śvaṃ bhajanta mehanā
verses.en: The very trees were joyful at my coming: kine they obtained in plenty, steeds in plenty.

verses.sa: दूरादिहेव यत्सत्यरुणप्सुरशिश्वितत् । वि भानुं विश्वधातनत्॥
verses.tr: dūrādiheva yatsatyaruṇapsuraśiśvitat vi bhānuṃ viśvadhātanat
verses.en: When, even as she were present here, red Dawn hath shone from far away, She spreadeth light on every side.

verses.sa: नृवद्दस्रा मनोयुजा रथेन पृथुपाजसा । सचेथे अश्विनोषसम्॥
verses.tr: nṛvaddasrā manoyujā rathena pṛthupājasā sacethe aśvinoṣasam
verses.en: Like Heroes on your will-yoked car far shining, Wonder-Workers! ye Attend, O Asvins, on the Dawn.

verses.sa: युवाभ्यां वाजिनीवसू प्रति स्तोमा अदृक्षत । वाचं दूतो यथोहिषे॥
verses.tr: yuvābhyāṃ vājinīvasū prati stomā adṛkṣata vācaṃ dūto yathohiṣe
verses.en: By you, O Lords of ample wealth our songs of praise have been observed: As envoy have I brought the prayer.

verses.sa: पुरुप्रिया ण ऊतये पुरुमन्द्रा पुरूवसू । स्तुषे कण्वासो अश्विना॥
verses.tr: purupriyā ṇa ūtaye purumandrā purūvasū stuṣe kaṇvāso aśvinā
verses.en: Kanvas must praise the Asvins dear to many, making many glad, Most rich, that they may succour us.

verses.sa: मंहिष्ठा वाजसातमेषयन्ता शुभस्पती । गन्तारा दाशुषो गृहम्॥
verses.tr: maṃhiṣṭhā vājasātameṣayantā śubhaspatī gantārā dāśuṣo gṛham
verses.en: Most liberal, best at winning strength, inciters, Lords of splendour who Visit the worshipper's abode.

verses.sa: ता सुदेवाय दाशुषे सुमेधामवितारिणीम् । घृतैर्गव्यूतिमुक्षतम्॥
verses.tr: tā sudevāya dāśuṣe sumedhāmavitāriṇīm ghṛtairgavyūtimukṣatam
verses.en: So for devout Sudeva dew with fatness his unfailing mead, And make it rich for sacrifice.

verses.sa: आ नः स्तोममुप द्रवत्तूयं श्येनेभिराशुभिः । यातमश्वेभिरश्विना॥
verses.tr: ā naḥ stomamupa dravattūyaṃ śyenebhirāśubhiḥ yātamaśvebhiraśvinā
verses.en: Hitherward running speedily with horses, as with rapid hawks, Come, Asvins, to our song of praise

verses.sa: येभिस्तिस्रः परावतो दिवो विश्वानि रोचना । त्रीँरक्तून्परिदीयथः॥
verses.tr: yebhistisraḥ parāvato divo viśvāni rocanā trīṃraktūnparidīyathaḥ
verses.en: Wherewith the three wide distances, and all the lights that are in heaven. Ye traverse, and three times of night.

verses.sa: उत नो गोमतीरिष उत सातीरहर्विदा । वि पथः सातये सितम्॥
verses.tr: uta no gomatīriṣa uta sātīraharvidā vi pathaḥ sātaye sitam
verses.en: O Finders of the Day, that we may win us food of kine and wealth, Open the paths for us to tread.

verses.sa: आ नो गोमन्तमश्विना सुवीरं सुरथं रयिम् । वोळ्हमश्वावतीरिषः॥
verses.tr: ā no gomantamaśvinā suvīraṃ surathaṃ rayim voḻhamaśvāvatīriṣaḥ
verses.en: O Asvins, bring us wealth in kine, in noble heroes, and in cars: Bring us the strength that horses give.

verses.sa: वावृधाना शुभस्पती दस्रा हिरण्यवर्तनी । पिबतं सोम्यं मधु॥
verses.tr: vāvṛdhānā śubhaspatī dasrā hiraṇyavartanī pibataṃ somyaṃ madhu
verses.en: Ye Lords of splendour, glorified, ye Wonder-Workers borne on paths Of gold, drink sweets with Soma juice.

verses.sa: अस्मभ्यं वाजिनीवसू मघवद्भ्यश्च सप्रथः । छर्दिर्यन्तमदाभ्यम्॥
verses.tr: asmabhyaṃ vājinīvasū maghavadbhyaśca saprathaḥ chardiryantamadābhyam
verses.en: To us, ye Lords of ample wealth, and to our wealth chiefs extend Wide shelter, ne'er to be assailed.

verses.sa: नि षु ब्रह्म जनानां याविष्टं तूयमा गतम् । मो ष्व१न्याँ उपारतम्॥
verses.tr: ni ṣu brahma janānāṃ yāviṣṭaṃ tūyamā gatam mo ṣva1nyāṃ upāratam
verses.en: Come quickly downward to the prayer of people whom ye favour most: Approach not unto other folk.

verses.sa: अस्य पिबतमश्विना युवं मदस्य चारुणः । मध्वो रातस्य धिष्ण्या॥
verses.tr: asya pibatamaśvinā yuvaṃ madasya cāruṇaḥ madhvo rātasya dhiṣṇyā
verses.en: Ye Asvins whom our minds perceive, drink of this lovely gladdening draught, The meath which we present to you.

verses.sa: अस्मे आ वहतं रयिं शतवन्तं सहस्रिणम् । पुरुक्षुं विश्वधायसम्॥
verses.tr: asme ā vahataṃ rayiṃ śatavantaṃ sahasriṇam purukṣuṃ viśvadhāyasam
verses.en: Bring riches hither unto us in hundreds and in thousands, source Of plenteous food, sustaining all.

verses.sa: पुरुत्रा चिद्धि वां नरा विह्वयन्ते मनीषिणः । वाघद्भिरश्विना गतम्॥
verses.tr: purutrā ciddhi vāṃ narā vihvayante manīṣiṇaḥ vāghadbhiraśvinā gatam
verses.en: Verily sages call on you, ye Heroes, in full many a place. Moved by the priests, O Asvins, conic.

verses.sa: जनासो वृक्तबर्हिषो हविष्मन्तो अरंकृतः । युवां हवन्ते अश्विना॥
verses.tr: janāso vṛktabarhiṣo haviṣmanto araṃkṛtaḥ yuvāṃ havante aśvinā
verses.en: Men who have trimmed the sacred grass, bringing oblations and prepared, O Asvins, are invoking you.

verses.sa: अस्माकमद्य वामयं स्तोमो वाहिष्ठो अन्तमः । युवाभ्यां भूत्वश्विना॥
verses.tr: asmākamadya vāmayaṃ stomo vāhiṣṭho antamaḥ yuvābhyāṃ bhūtvaśvinā
verses.en: May this our hymn of praise to-day, most powerful to bring you, be, O Asvins, nearest to your hearts.

verses.sa: यो ह वां मधुनो दृतिराहितो रथचर्षणे । ततः पिबतमश्विना॥
verses.tr: yo ha vāṃ madhuno dṛtirāhito rathacarṣaṇe tataḥ pibatamaśvinā
verses.en: The skin filled full of savoury meath, laid in the pathway of your car- O Asvins, drink ye both therefrom.

verses.sa: तेन नो वाजिनीवसू पश्वे तोकाय शं गवे । वहतं पीवरीरिषः॥
verses.tr: tena no vājinīvasū paśve tokāya śaṃ gave vahataṃ pīvarīriṣaḥ
verses.en: For this, ye Lords of ample wealth, bring blessing for our herd, our kine, Our progeny, and plenteous food.

verses.sa: उत नो दिव्या इष उत सिन्धूँरहर्विदा । अप द्वारेव वर्षथः॥
verses.tr: uta no divyā iṣa uta sindhūṃraharvidā apa dvāreva varṣathaḥ
verses.en: Ye too unclose to us like doors the strengthening waters of the sky, And rivers, ye who find the day.

verses.sa: कदा वां तौग्र्यो विधत्समुद्रे जहितो नरा । यद्वां रथो विभिष्पतात्॥
verses.tr: kadā vāṃ taugryo vidhatsamudre jahito narā yadvāṃ ratho vibhiṣpatāt
verses.en: When did the son of' Tugra serve you, Men? Abandoned in the sea, That with winged steeds your car might fly.

verses.sa: युवं कण्वाय नासत्या ऽपिरिप्ताय हर्म्ये । शश्वदूतीर्दशस्यथः॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ kaṇvāya nāsatyā 'piriptāya harmye śaśvadūtīrdaśasyathaḥ
verses.en: Ye, O Nasatyas, ministered to Kanva with repeated aid, When cast into the heated pit.

verses.sa: ताभिरा यातमूतिभिर्नव्यसीभिः सुशस्तिभिः । यद्वां वृषण्वसू हुवे॥
verses.tr: tābhirā yātamūtibhirnavyasībhiḥ suśastibhiḥ yadvāṃ vṛṣaṇvasū huve
verses.en: Come near with those most recent aids of yours which merit eulogy, When I invoke you, Wealthy Gods.

verses.sa: यथा चित्कण्वमावतं प्रियमेधमुपस्तुतम् । अत्रिं शिञ्जारमश्विना॥
verses.tr: yathā citkaṇvamāvataṃ priyamedhamupastutam atriṃ śiñjāramaśvinā
verses.en: As ye protected Kanva erst, Priyamedha and Upastuta, Atri, Sinjara, Asvins Twain

verses.sa: यथोत कृत्व्ये धनेंऽशुं गोष्वगस्त्यम् । यथा वाजेषु सोभरिम्॥
verses.tr: yathota kṛtvye dhaneṃ'śuṃ goṣvagastyam yathā vājeṣu sobharim
verses.en: And Amsu in decisive fight, Agastya in the fray for kine. And, in his battles, Sobhari.

verses.sa: एतावद्वां वृषण्वसू अतो वा भूयो अश्विना । गृणन्तः सुम्नमीमहे॥
verses.tr: etāvadvāṃ vṛṣaṇvasū ato vā bhūyo aśvinā gṛṇantaḥ sumnamīmahe
verses.en: For so much bliss, or even more, O Asvins, Wealthy Gods, than this, We pray white singing hymns to you.

verses.sa: रथं हिरण्यवन्धुरं हिरण्याभीशुमश्विना । आ हि स्थाथो दिविस्पृशम्॥
verses.tr: rathaṃ hiraṇyavandhuraṃ hiraṇyābhīśumaśvinā ā hi sthātho divispṛśam
verses.en: Ascend your car with golden seat, O Asvins, and with reins of gold, That reaches even to the sky.

verses.sa: हिरण्ययी वां रभिरीषा अक्षो हिरण्ययः । उभा चक्रा हिरण्यया॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyayī vāṃ rabhirīṣā akṣo hiraṇyayaḥ ubhā cakrā hiraṇyayā
verses.en: Golden is its supporting shaft, the axle also is of gold, And both the wheels are made of gold.

verses.sa: तेन नो वाजिनीवसू परावतश्चिदा गतम् । उपेमां सुष्टुतिं मम॥
verses.tr: tena no vājinīvasū parāvataścidā gatam upemāṃ suṣṭutiṃ mama
verses.en: Thereon, ye Lords of ample wealth, come to us even from afar, Come ye to this mine eulogy.

verses.sa: आ वहेथे पराकात्पूर्वीरश्नन्तावश्विना । इषो दासीरमर्त्या॥
verses.tr: ā vahethe parākātpūrvīraśnantāvaśvinā iṣo dāsīramartyā
verses.en: From far away ye come to us, Asvins, enjoying plenteous food Of Dasas, O Immortal Ones.

verses.sa: आ नो द्युम्नैरा श्रवोभिरा राया यातमश्विना । पुरुश्चन्द्रा नासत्या॥
verses.tr: ā no dyumnairā śravobhirā rāyā yātamaśvinā puruścandrā nāsatyā
verses.en: With splendour, riches, and renown, O Asvins, hither come to us, Nasatyas, shining brilliantly.

verses.sa: एह वां प्रुषितप्सवो वयो वहन्तु पर्णिनः । अच्छा स्वध्वरं जनम्॥
verses.tr: eha vāṃ pruṣitapsavo vayo vahantu parṇinaḥ acchā svadhvaraṃ janam
verses.en: May dappled horses, steeds who fly with pinions, bring you hitherward To people skilled in sacrifice.

verses.sa: रथं वामनुगायसं य इषा वर्तते सह । न चक्रमभि बाधते॥
verses.tr: rathaṃ vāmanugāyasaṃ ya iṣā vartate saha na cakramabhi bādhate
verses.en: The whcel delayeth not that car of yours accompanied by song, That cometh with a store of food.

verses.sa: हिरण्ययेन रथेन द्रवत्पाणिभिरश्वैः । धीजवना नासत्या॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyayena rathena dravatpāṇibhiraśvaiḥ dhījavanā nāsatyā
verses.en: Borne on that chariot wrought of gold, with coursers very fleet of foot, Come, O Nasatyas, swift as thought.

verses.sa: युवं मृगं जागृवांसं स्वदथो वा वृषण्वसू । ता नः पृङ्क्तमिषा रयिम्॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ mṛgaṃ jāgṛvāṃsaṃ svadatho vā vṛṣaṇvasū tā naḥ pṛṅktamiṣā rayim
verses.en: O Wealthy Gods, ye taste and find the brisk and watchful wild beast good. Associate wealth with food for us.

verses.sa: ता मे अश्विना सनीनां विद्यातं नवानाम् । यथा चिच्चैद्यः कशुः शतमुष्ट्रानां ददत्सहस्रा दश गोनाम्॥
verses.tr: tā me aśvinā sanīnāṃ vidyātaṃ navānām yathā ciccaidyaḥ kaśuḥ śatamuṣṭrānāṃ dadatsahasrā daśa gonām
verses.en: As such, O Asvins, find for me my share of new-presented gifts, As Kasu, Cedi's son, gave me a hundred head of buffaloes, and ten thousand kine.

verses.sa: यो मे हिरण्यसंदृशो दश राज्ञो अमंहत । अधस्पदा इच्चैद्यस्य कृष्टयश्चर्मम्ना अभितो जनाः॥
verses.tr: yo me hiraṇyasaṃdṛśo daśa rājño amaṃhata adhaspadā iccaidyasya kṛṣṭayaścarmamnā abhito janāḥ
verses.en: He who hath given me for mine own ten Kings like gold to look upon. At Caidya's feet are all the people round about, all those who think upon the shield.

verses.sa: माकिरेना पथा गाद्येनेमे यन्ति चेदयः । अन्यो नेत्सूरिरोहते भूरिदावत्तरो जनः॥
verses.tr: mākirenā pathā gādyeneme yanti cedayaḥ anyo netsūrirohate bhūridāvattaro janaḥ
verses.en: No man, not any, goes upon the path on which the Cedis walk. No other prince, no folk is held more liberal of gifts than they.

verses.sa: महाँ इन्द्रो य ओजसा पर्जन्यो वृष्टिमाँ इव । स्तोमैर्वत्सस्य वावृधे॥
verses.tr: mahāṃ indro ya ojasā parjanyo vṛṣṭimāṃ iva stomairvatsasya vāvṛdhe
verses.en: Indra, great in his power and might, and like Parjanya rich in rain, Is magnified by Vatsa's lauds.

verses.sa: प्रजामृतस्य पिप्रतः प्र यद्भरन्त वह्नयः । विप्रा ऋतस्य वाहसा॥
verses.tr: prajāmṛtasya piprataḥ pra yadbharanta vahnayaḥ viprā ṛtasya vāhasā
verses.en: When the priests, strengthening the Son of Holy Law, present their gifts, Singers with Order's hymn of praiser.

verses.sa: कण्वा इन्द्रं यदक्रत स्तोमैर्यज्ञस्य साधनम् । जामि ब्रुवत आयुधम्॥
verses.tr: kaṇvā indraṃ yadakrata stomairyajñasya sādhanam jāmi bruvata āyudham
verses.en: Since Kanvas with their lauds have made Indra complete the sacrifice. Words are their own appropriate arms.

verses.sa: समस्य मन्यवे विशो विश्वा नमन्त कृष्टयः । समुद्रायेव सिन्धवः॥
verses.tr: samasya manyave viśo viśvā namanta kṛṣṭayaḥ samudrāyeva sindhavaḥ
verses.en: Before his hot displeasure all the peoples, all the men, bow down, As rivers bow them to the sea.

verses.sa: ओजस्तदस्य तित्विष उभे यत्समवर्तयत् । इन्द्रश्चर्मेव रोदसी॥
verses.tr: ojastadasya titviṣa ubhe yatsamavartayat indraścarmeva rodasī
verses.en: This power of his shone brightly forth when Indra brought together, like A skin, the worlds of heaven and earth.

verses.sa: वि चिद्वृत्रस्य दोधतो वज्रेण शतपर्वणा । शिरो बिभेद वृष्णिना॥
verses.tr: vi cidvṛtrasya dodhato vajreṇa śataparvaṇā śiro bibheda vṛṣṇinā
verses.en: The fiercely-moving Vrtra's head he severed with his thunderbolt, His mighty hundred-knotted bolt.

verses.sa: इमा अभि प्र णोनुमो विपामग्रेषु धीतयः । अग्नेः शोचिर्न दिद्युतः॥
verses.tr: imā abhi pra ṇonumo vipāmagreṣu dhītayaḥ agneḥ śocirna didyutaḥ
verses.en: Here are-we sing them loudly forth-our thoughts among-the best of songs. Even lightnings like the blaze of fire.

verses.sa: गुहा सतीरुप त्मना प्र यच्छोचन्त धीतयः । कण्वा ऋतस्य धारया॥
verses.tr: guhā satīrupa tmanā pra yacchocanta dhītayaḥ kaṇvā ṛtasya dhārayā
verses.en: When bidden thoughts, spontaneously advancing, glow, and with the stream Of sacrifice the Kanvas shine.

verses.sa: प्र तमिन्द्र नशीमहि रयिं गोमन्तमश्विनम् । प्र ब्रह्म पूर्वचित्तये॥
verses.tr: pra tamindra naśīmahi rayiṃ gomantamaśvinam pra brahma pūrvacittaye
verses.en: Indra, may we obtain that wealth in horses and in herds of cows, And prayer that may be noticed first.

verses.sa: अहमिद्धि पितुष्परि मेधामृतस्य जग्रभ । अहं सूर्य इवाजनि॥
verses.tr: ahamiddhi pituṣpari medhāmṛtasya jagrabha ahaṃ sūrya ivājani
verses.en: I from my Father have received deep knowledge of the Holy Law I was born like unto the Sun.

verses.sa: अहं प्रत्नेन मन्मना गिरः शुम्भामि कण्ववत् । येनेन्द्रः शुष्ममिद्दधे॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ pratnena manmanā giraḥ śumbhāmi kaṇvavat yenendraḥ śuṣmamiddadhe
verses.en: After the lore of ancient time I make, like Kanva, beauteous songs, And Indra's self gains strength thereby.

verses.sa: ये त्वामिन्द्र न तुष्टुवुॠषयो ये च तुष्टुवुः । ममेद्वर्धस्व सुष्टुतः॥
verses.tr: ye tvāmindra na tuṣṭuvuṝṣayo ye ca tuṣṭuvuḥ mamedvardhasva suṣṭutaḥ
verses.en: Whatever Rsis have not praised thee, Indra, or have lauded thee, By me exalted wax thou strong.

verses.sa: यदस्य मन्युरध्वनीद्वि वृत्रं पर्वशो रुजन् । अपः समुद्रमैरयत्॥
verses.tr: yadasya manyuradhvanīdvi vṛtraṃ parvaśo rujan apaḥ samudramairayat
verses.en: When his wrath thundered, when he rent Vrtra to pieces, limb by limb, He sent the waters to the sea.

verses.sa: नि शुष्ण इन्द्र धर्णसिं वज्रं जघन्थ दस्यवि । वृषा ह्युग्र शृण्विषे॥
verses.tr: ni śuṣṇa indra dharṇasiṃ vajraṃ jaghantha dasyavi vṛṣā hyugra śṛṇviṣe
verses.en: Against the Dasyu Susna thou, Indra, didst hurl thy during bolt: Thou, Dread one, hast a hero's fame.

verses.sa: न द्याव इन्द्रमोजसा नान्तरिक्षाणि वज्रिणम् । न विव्यचन्त भूमयः॥
verses.tr: na dyāva indramojasā nāntarikṣāṇi vajriṇam na vivyacanta bhūmayaḥ
verses.en: Neither the heavens nor firmaments nor regions of the earth contain Indra, the Thunderer with his might.

verses.sa: यस्त इन्द्र महीरपः स्तभूयमान आशयत् । नि तं पद्यासु शिश्नथः॥
verses.tr: yasta indra mahīrapaḥ stabhūyamāna āśayat ni taṃ padyāsu śiśnathaḥ
verses.en: O Indra him who lay at length staying thy copious waters thou, In his own footsteps, smotest down

verses.sa: य इमे रोदसी मही समीची समजग्रभीत् । तमोभिरिन्द्र तं गुहः॥
verses.tr: ya ime rodasī mahī samīcī samajagrabhīt tamobhirindra taṃ guhaḥ
verses.en: Thou hiddest deep in darkness within, O Indra, who had set his grasp On spacious heaven and earth conjoined.

verses.sa: य इन्द्र यतयस्त्वा भृगवो ये च तुष्टुवुः । ममेदुग्र श्रुधी हवम्॥
verses.tr: ya indra yatayastvā bhṛgavo ye ca tuṣṭuvuḥ mamedugra śrudhī havam
verses.en: Indra, whatever Yatis and Bhrgus have offered praise to thee, Listen, thou Mighty, to my call.

verses.sa: इमास्त इन्द्र पृश्नयो घृतं दुहत आशिरम् । एनामृतस्य पिप्युषीः॥
verses.tr: imāsta indra pṛśnayo ghṛtaṃ duhata āśiram enāmṛtasya pipyuṣīḥ
verses.en: Indra, these spotted cows yield thee their butter and the milky draught; Aiders, thereby, of sacrifice;

verses.sa: या इन्द्र प्रस्वस्त्वाऽऽसा गर्भमचक्रिरन् । परि धर्मेव सूर्यम्॥
verses.tr: yā indra prasvastvā''sā garbhamacakriran pari dharmeva sūryam
verses.en: Which, teeming, have received thee as a life-germ, Indra, with their mouth, Like Surya who sustaineth all.

verses.sa: त्वामिच्छवसस्पते कण्वा उक्थेन वावृधुः । त्वां सुतास इन्दवः॥
verses.tr: tvāmicchavasaspate kaṇvā ukthena vāvṛdhuḥ tvāṃ sutāsa indavaḥ
verses.en: O Lord of Might, with hymns of praise the Kanvas have increased thy power, The drops poured forth have strengthened thee.

verses.sa: तवेदिन्द्र प्रणीतिषूत प्रशस्तिरद्रिवः । यज्ञो वितन्तसाय्यः॥
verses.tr: tavedindra praṇītiṣūta praśastiradrivaḥ yajño vitantasāyyaḥ
verses.en: Under thy guidance, Indra, mid thy praises, Lord of Thunder, shall The sacrifice be soon performed.

verses.sa: आ न इन्द्र महीमिषं पुरं न दर्षि गोमतीम् । उत प्रजां सुवीर्यम्॥
verses.tr: ā na indra mahīmiṣaṃ puraṃ na darṣi gomatīm uta prajāṃ suvīryam
verses.en: Indra, disclose much food for us, like a stronghold with store of kine: Give progeny and heroic strength.

verses.sa: उत त्यदाश्वश्व्यं यदिन्द्र नाहुषीष्वा । अग्रे विक्षु प्रदीदयत्॥
verses.tr: uta tyadāśvaśvyaṃ yadindra nāhuṣīṣvā agre vikṣu pradīdayat
verses.en: And, Indra, grant us all that wealth of fleet steeds which shone bright of old Among the tribes of Nahusas.

verses.sa: अभि व्रजं न तत्निषे सूर उपाकचक्षसम् । यदिन्द्र मृळयासि नः॥
verses.tr: abhi vrajaṃ na tatniṣe sūra upākacakṣasam yadindra mṛḻayāsi naḥ
verses.en: Hither thou seemest to attract heaven's fold which shines before our eyes, When, Indra, thou art kind to us.

verses.sa: यदङ्ग तविषीयस इन्द्र प्रराजसि क्षितीः । महाँ अपार ओजसा॥
verses.tr: yadaṅga taviṣīyasa indra prarājasi kṣitīḥ mahāṃ apāra ojasā
verses.en: Yea, when thou puttest forth thy power, Indra, thou governest the folk. Mighty, unlimited in strength.

verses.sa: तं त्वा हविष्मतीर्विश उप ब्रुवत ऊतये । उरुज्रयसमिन्दुभिः॥
verses.tr: taṃ tvā haviṣmatīrviśa upa bruvata ūtaye urujrayasamindubhiḥ
verses.en: The tribes who bring oblations call to thee, to thee to give them help, With drops to thee who spreadest far.

verses.sa: उपह्वरे गिरीणां संगथे च नदीनाम् । धिया विप्रो अजायत॥
verses.tr: upahvare girīṇāṃ saṃgathe ca nadīnām dhiyā vipro ajāyata
verses.en: There where the mountains downward slope, there by the meeting of the streams The Sage was manifest with song.

verses.sa: अतः समुद्रमुद्वतश्चिकित्वाँ अव पश्यति । यतो विपान एजति॥
verses.tr: ataḥ samudramudvataścikitvāṃ ava paśyati yato vipāna ejati
verses.en: Thence, marking, from his lofty place downward he looks upon the sea, And thence with rapid stir he moves.

verses.sa: आदित्प्रत्नस्य रेतसो ज्योतिष्पश्यन्ति वासरम् । परो यदिध्यते दिवा॥
verses.tr: āditpratnasya retaso jyotiṣpaśyanti vāsaram paro yadidhyate divā
verses.en: Then, verify, they see the light refulgent of primeval seed, Kindled on yonder side of heaven.

verses.sa: कण्वास इन्द्र ते मतिं विश्वे वर्धन्ति पौंस्यम् । उतो शविष्ठ वृष्ण्यम्॥
verses.tr: kaṇvāsa indra te matiṃ viśve vardhanti pauṃsyam uto śaviṣṭha vṛṣṇyam
verses.en: Indra, the Kanvas all exalt thy wisdom and thy manly power, And, Mightiest! thine heroic strength.

verses.sa: इमां म इन्द्र सुष्टुतिं जुषस्व प्र सु मामव । उत प्र वर्धया मतिम्॥
verses.tr: imāṃ ma indra suṣṭutiṃ juṣasva pra su māmava uta pra vardhayā matim
verses.en: Accept this eulogy of mine, Indra, and guard me carefully: Strengthen my thought and prosper it.

verses.sa: उत ब्रह्मण्या वयं तुभ्यं प्रवृद्ध वज्रिवः । विप्रा अतक्ष्म जीवसे॥
verses.tr: uta brahmaṇyā vayaṃ tubhyaṃ pravṛddha vajrivaḥ viprā atakṣma jīvase
verses.en: For thee, O Mighty, Thunder-armed, we singers through devotion have Fashioned the hymn that we may live.

verses.sa: अभि कण्वा अनूषताऽऽपो न प्रवता यतीः । इन्द्रं वनन्वती मतिः॥
verses.tr: abhi kaṇvā anūṣatā''po na pravatā yatīḥ indraṃ vananvatī matiḥ
verses.en: To Indra have the Kanvas sung, like waters speeding down a slope: The song is fain to go to him.

verses.sa: इन्द्रमुक्थानि वावृधुः समुद्रमिव सिन्धवः । अनुत्तमन्युमजरम्॥
verses.tr: indramukthāni vāvṛdhuḥ samudramiva sindhavaḥ anuttamanyumajaram
verses.en: As rivers swell the ocean, so our hymns of praise make Indra strong, Eternal, of resistless wrath.

verses.sa: आ नो याहि परावतो हरिभ्यां हर्यताभ्याम् । इममिन्द्र सुतं पिब॥
verses.tr: ā no yāhi parāvato haribhyāṃ haryatābhyām imamindra sutaṃ piba
verses.en: Come with thy lovely Bay Steeds, come to us from regions far away O Indra, drink this Soma juice.

verses.sa: त्वामिद्वृत्रहन्तम जनासो वृक्तबर्हिषः । हवन्ते वाजसातये॥
verses.tr: tvāmidvṛtrahantama janāso vṛktabarhiṣaḥ havante vājasātaye
verses.en: Best slayer of Vrtras, men whose sacred grass is ready trimmed Invoke thee for the gain of spoil.

verses.sa: अनु त्वा रोदसी उभे चक्रं न वर्त्येतशम् । अनु सुवानास इन्दवः॥
verses.tr: anu tvā rodasī ubhe cakraṃ na vartyetaśam anu suvānāsa indavaḥ
verses.en: The heavens and earth come after thee as the wheel follows Etasa: To thee flow Soma-drops effused.

verses.sa: मन्दस्वा सु स्वर्णर उतेन्द्र शर्यणावति । मत्स्वा विवस्वतो मती॥
verses.tr: mandasvā su svarṇara utendra śaryaṇāvati matsvā vivasvato matī
verses.en: Rejoice, O Indra, in the light, rejoice in Saryandyan, Be Glad in the sacrificer's hymn.

verses.sa: वावृधान उप द्यवि वृषा वज्र्यरोरवीत् । वृत्रहा सोमपातमः॥
verses.tr: vāvṛdhāna upa dyavi vṛṣā vajryaroravīt vṛtrahā somapātamaḥ
verses.en: Grown strong in heaven, the Thunder-armed hath bellowed, Vrtra-slayer, Bull, Chief drinker of the Soma juice.

verses.sa: ऋषिर्हि पूर्वजा अस्येक ईशान ओजसा । इन्द्र चोष्कूयसे वसु॥
verses.tr: ṛṣirhi pūrvajā asyeka īśāna ojasā indra coṣkūyase vasu
verses.en: Thou art a Rsi born of old, sole Ruler over all by might: Thou, Indra, guardest well our wealth.

verses.sa: अस्माकं त्वा सुताँ उप वीतपृष्ठा अभि प्रयः । शतं वहन्तु हरयः॥
verses.tr: asmākaṃ tvā sutāṃ upa vītapṛṣṭhā abhi prayaḥ śataṃ vahantu harayaḥ
verses.en: May thy Bay Steeds with beauteous backs, a hundred, bring thee to the feast, Bring thee to these our Soma-draughts.

verses.sa: इमां सु पूर्व्यां धियं मधोर्घृतस्य पिप्युषीम् । कण्वा उक्थेन वावृधुः॥
verses.tr: imāṃ su pūrvyāṃ dhiyaṃ madhorghṛtasya pipyuṣīm kaṇvā ukthena vāvṛdhuḥ
verses.en: The Kanvas with their hymns of praise have magnified this ancient thought That swells with streams of meath and oil.

verses.sa: इन्द्रमिद्विमहीनां मेधे वृणीत मर्त्यः । इन्द्रं सनिष्युरूतये॥
verses.tr: indramidvimahīnāṃ medhe vṛṇīta martyaḥ indraṃ saniṣyurūtaye
verses.en: Mid mightiest Gods let mortal man choose Indra at the sacrifice, Indra, whoe'er would win, for help.

verses.sa: अर्वाञ्चं त्वा पुरुष्टुत प्रियमेधस्तुता हरी । सोमपेयाय वक्षतः॥
verses.tr: arvāñcaṃ tvā puruṣṭuta priyamedhastutā harī somapeyāya vakṣataḥ
verses.en: Thy steeds, by Priyamedhas praised, shall bring thee, God whom all invoke, Hither to drink the Somajuice.

verses.sa: शतमहं तिरिन्दिरे सहस्रं पर्शावा ददे । राधांसि याद्वानाम्॥
verses.tr: śatamahaṃ tirindire sahasraṃ parśāvā dade rādhāṃsi yādvānām
verses.en: A hundred thousand have I gained from Parsu, from Tirindira, And presents of the Yadavas.

verses.sa: त्रीणि शतान्यर्वतां सहस्रा दश गोनाम् । ददुष्पज्राय साम्ने॥
verses.tr: trīṇi śatānyarvatāṃ sahasrā daśa gonām daduṣpajrāya sāmne
verses.en: Ten thousand head of kine, and steeds three times a hundred they bestowed On Pajra for the Sama-song.

verses.sa: उदानट् ककुहो दिवमुष्ट्राञ्चतुर्युजो ददत् । श्रवसा याद्वं जनम्॥
verses.tr: udānaṭ kakuho divamuṣṭrāñcaturyujo dadat śravasā yādvaṃ janam
verses.en: Kakuha hath reached up to heaven, bestowing buffaloes yoked in fours, And matched in fame the Yadavas.

verses.sa: प्र यद्वस्त्रिष्टुभमिषं मरुतो विप्रो अक्षरत् । वि पर्वतेषु राजथ॥
verses.tr: pra yadvastriṣṭubhamiṣaṃ maruto vipro akṣarat vi parvateṣu rājatha
verses.en: O MARUTS, when the sage hath poured the Trstup forth as food for you, Ye shine amid the mountain-clouds.

verses.sa: यदङ्ग तविषीयवो यामं शुभ्रा अचिध्वम् । नि पर्वता अहासत॥
verses.tr: yadaṅga taviṣīyavo yāmaṃ śubhrā acidhvam ni parvatā ahāsata
verses.en: When, Bright Ones, fain to show your might ye have determined on your course, The mountain-clouds have bent them down.

verses.sa: उदीरयन्त वायुभिर्वाश्रासः पृश्निमातरः । धुक्षन्त पिप्युषीमिषम्॥
verses.tr: udīrayanta vāyubhirvāśrāsaḥ pṛśnimātaraḥ dhukṣanta pipyuṣīmiṣam
verses.en: Loud roaring with the winds the Sons of Prsni have upraised themselves: They have poured out the streaming food.

verses.sa: वपन्ति मरुतो मिहं प्र वेपयन्ति पर्वतान् । यद्यामं यान्ति वायुभिः॥
verses.tr: vapanti maruto mihaṃ pra vepayanti parvatān yadyāmaṃ yānti vāyubhiḥ
verses.en: The Maruts spread the mist abroad and make mountains rock and reel, When with the winds they go their way

verses.sa: नि यद्यामाय वो गिरिर्नि सिन्धवो विधर्मणे । महे शुष्माय येमिरे॥
verses.tr: ni yadyāmāya vo girirni sindhavo vidharmaṇe mahe śuṣmāya yemire
verses.en: What time the rivers and the hills before your coming bowed them down, So to sustain your mighty force.

verses.sa: युष्माँ उ नक्तमूतये युष्मान्दिवा हवामहे । युष्मान्प्रयत्यध्वरे॥
verses.tr: yuṣmāṃ u naktamūtaye yuṣmāndivā havāmahe yuṣmānprayatyadhvare
verses.en: We call on you for aid by night, on you for succour in the day, On you while sacrifice proceeds.

verses.sa: उदु त्ये अरुणप्सवश्चित्रा यामेभिरीरते । वाश्रा अधि ष्णुना दिवः॥
verses.tr: udu tye aruṇapsavaścitrā yāmebhirīrate vāśrā adhi ṣṇunā divaḥ
verses.en: These, verily, wondrous, red of hue, speed on their courses with a roar Over the ridges of the sky.

verses.sa: सृजन्ति रश्मिमोजसा पन्थां सूर्याय यातवे । ते भानुभिर्वि तस्थिरे॥
verses.tr: sṛjanti raśmimojasā panthāṃ sūryāya yātave te bhānubhirvi tasthire
verses.en: With might they drop the loosened rein so that the Sun may run his course, And spread themselves with beams of light.

verses.sa: इमां मे मरुतो गिरमिमं स्तोममृभुक्षणः । इमं मे वनता हवम्॥
verses.tr: imāṃ me maruto giramimaṃ stomamṛbhukṣaṇaḥ imaṃ me vanatā havam
verses.en: Accept, ye Maruts, this my song, accept ye this mine hymn of praise, Accept, Rbhuksans, this my call.

verses.sa: त्रीणि सरांसि पृश्नयो दुदुह्रे वज्रिणे मधु । उत्सं कवन्धमुद्रिणम्॥
verses.tr: trīṇi sarāṃsi pṛśnayo duduhre vajriṇe madhu utsaṃ kavandhamudriṇam
verses.en: The dappled Cows have poured three lakes, meath for the Thunder-wielding God, From the great cask, the watery cloud.

verses.sa: मरुतो यद्ध वो दिवः सुम्नायन्तो हवामहे । आ तू न उप गन्तन॥
verses.tr: maruto yaddha vo divaḥ sumnāyanto havāmahe ā tū na upa gantana
verses.en: O Maruts, quickly come to us when, longing for felicity, We call you hither from the sky.

verses.sa: यूयं हि ष्ठा सुदानवो रुद्रा ऋभुक्षणो दमे । उत प्रचेतसो मदे॥
verses.tr: yūyaṃ hi ṣṭhā sudānavo rudrā ṛbhukṣaṇo dame uta pracetaso made
verses.en: For, Rudras and Rbhuksans, ye, Most Bountiful, are in the house, Wise when the gladdening draught is drunk.

verses.sa: आ नो रयिं मदच्युतं पुरुक्षुं विश्वधायसम् । इयर्ता मरुतो दिवः॥
verses.tr: ā no rayiṃ madacyutaṃ purukṣuṃ viśvadhāyasam iyartā maruto divaḥ
verses.en: O Maruts, send us down from heaven riches distilling rapturous joy, With plenteous food, sustaining all.

verses.sa: अधीव यद्गिरीणां यामं शुभ्रा अचिध्वम् । सुवानैर्मन्दध्व इन्दुभिः॥
verses.tr: adhīva yadgirīṇāṃ yāmaṃ śubhrā acidhvam suvānairmandadhva indubhiḥ
verses.en: When, Bright Ones, hither from the hills ye have resolved to take your way, Ye revel in the drops effused.

verses.sa: एतावतश्चिदेषां सुम्नं भिक्षेत मर्त्यः । अदाभ्यस्य मन्मभिः॥
verses.tr: etāvataścideṣāṃ sumnaṃ bhikṣeta martyaḥ adābhyasya manmabhiḥ
verses.en: Man should solicit with his lauds happiness which belongs to them, So great a band invincible.

verses.sa: ये द्रप्सा इव रोदसी धमन्त्यनु वृष्टिभिः । उत्सं दुहन्तो अक्षितम्॥
verses.tr: ye drapsā iva rodasī dhamantyanu vṛṣṭibhiḥ utsaṃ duhanto akṣitam
verses.en: They who like fiery sparks with showers of rain blow through the heaven and earth, Milking the spring that never fails.

verses.sa: उदु स्वानेभिरीरत उद्रथैरुदु वायुभिः । उत्स्तोमैः पृश्निमातरः॥
verses.tr: udu svānebhirīrata udrathairudu vāyubhiḥ utstomaiḥ pṛśnimātaraḥ
verses.en: With chariots and tumultuous roar, with tempests and with hymns of praise The Sons of Prsni hurry forth.

verses.sa: येनाव तुर्वशं यदुं येन कण्वं धनस्पृतम् । राये सु तस्य धीमहि॥
verses.tr: yenāva turvaśaṃ yaduṃ yena kaṇvaṃ dhanaspṛtam rāye su tasya dhīmahi
verses.en: For wealth, we think of that whereby ye aided Yadu, Turvasa, And KanVa who obtained the spoil.

verses.sa: इमा उ वः सुदानवो घृतं न पिप्युषीरिषः । वर्धान्काण्वस्य मन्मभिः॥
verses.tr: imā u vaḥ sudānavo ghṛtaṃ na pipyuṣīriṣaḥ vardhānkāṇvasya manmabhiḥ
verses.en: May these our viands Bounteous Ones I that flow in streams like holy oil, With Kanva's hymns, increase your might.

verses.sa: क्व नूनं सुदानवो मदथा वृक्तबर्हिषः । ब्रह्मा को वः सपर्यति॥
verses.tr: kva nūnaṃ sudānavo madathā vṛktabarhiṣaḥ brahmā ko vaḥ saparyati
verses.en: Where, Bounteous Lords for whom the grass is trimmed, are ye rejoicing now? What Brahman is adoring you?

verses.sa: नहि ष्म यद्ध वः पुरा स्तोमेभिर्वृक्तबर्हिषः । शर्धाँ ऋतस्य जिन्वथ॥
verses.tr: nahi ṣma yaddha vaḥ purā stomebhirvṛktabarhiṣaḥ śardhāṃ ṛtasya jinvatha
verses.en: Is it not there where ye of old, supplied with sacred grass, for lauds Inspired the strong in sacrifice?

verses.sa: समु त्ये महतीरपः सं क्षोणी समु सूर्यम् । सं वज्रं पर्वशो दधुः॥
verses.tr: samu tye mahatīrapaḥ saṃ kṣoṇī samu sūryam saṃ vajraṃ parvaśo dadhuḥ
verses.en: They brought together both the worlds, the mighty waters, and the Sun, And, joint by joint, the thunderbolt.

verses.sa: वि वृत्रं पर्वशो ययुर्वि पर्वताँ अराजिनः । चक्राणा वृष्णि पौंस्यम्॥
verses.tr: vi vṛtraṃ parvaśo yayurvi parvatāṃ arājinaḥ cakrāṇā vṛṣṇi pauṃsyam
verses.en: They sundered Vrtra limb from limb and split the gloomy mountain-clouds, Performing a heroic deed.

verses.sa: अनु त्रितस्य युध्यतः शुष्ममावन्नुत क्रतुम् । अन्विन्द्रं वृत्रतूर्ये॥
verses.tr: anu tritasya yudhyataḥ śuṣmamāvannuta kratum anvindraṃ vṛtratūrye
verses.en: They reinforced the power and strength of Trita as he fought, and helped Indra in battle with the foe.

verses.sa: विद्युद्धस्ता अभिद्यवः शिप्राः शीर्षन्हिरण्ययीः । शुभ्रा व्यञ्जत श्रिये॥
verses.tr: vidyuddhastā abhidyavaḥ śiprāḥ śīrṣanhiraṇyayīḥ śubhrā vyañjata śriye
verses.en: They deck themselves for glory, bright, celestial, lightning in their hands, And helms of gold upon their heads.

verses.sa: उशना यत्परावत उक्ष्णो रन्ध्रमयातन । द्यौर्न चक्रदद्भिया॥
verses.tr: uśanā yatparāvata ukṣṇo randhramayātana dyaurna cakradadbhiyā
verses.en: When eagerly ye from far away came to the cavern of the Bull, He bellowed in his fear like Heaven.

verses.sa: आ नो मखस्य दावनेऽश्वैर्हिरण्यपाणिभिः । देवास उप गन्तन॥
verses.tr: ā no makhasya dāvane'śvairhiraṇyapāṇibhiḥ devāsa upa gantana
verses.en: Borne by your golden-footed steeds, O Gods, come hither to receive The sacrifice we offer you.

verses.sa: यदेषां पृषती रथे प्रष्टिर्वहति रोहितः । यान्ति शुभ्रा रिणन्नपः॥
verses.tr: yadeṣāṃ pṛṣatī rathe praṣṭirvahati rohitaḥ yānti śubhrā riṇannapaḥ
verses.en: When the red leader draws along their spotted deer yoked to the car. The Bright Ones come, and shed the rain.

verses.sa: सुषोमे शर्यणावत्यार्जीके पस्त्यावति । ययुर्निचक्रया नरः॥
verses.tr: suṣome śaryaṇāvatyārjīke pastyāvati yayurnicakrayā naraḥ
verses.en: Susoma, Saryakiavan, and Arjika full of homes, have they. These Heroes, sought with downward car.

verses.sa: कदा गच्छाथ मरुत इत्था विप्रं हवमानम् । मार्डीकेभिर्नाधमानम्॥
verses.tr: kadā gacchātha maruta itthā vipraṃ havamānam mārḍīkebhirnādhamānam
verses.en: When, Maruts, ye come to him, the singer who invokes you thus, With favours to your suppliant?

verses.sa: कद्ध नूनं कधप्रियो यदिन्द्रमजहातन । को वः सखित्व ओहते॥
verses.tr: kaddha nūnaṃ kadhapriyo yadindramajahātana ko vaḥ sakhitva ohate
verses.en: What now? where have ye still a friend since ye left Indra all alone? Who counteth on your friendship now?

verses.sa: सहो षु णो वज्रहस्तैः कण्वासो अग्निं मरुद्भिः । स्तुषे हिरण्यवाशीभिः॥
verses.tr: saho ṣu ṇo vajrahastaiḥ kaṇvāso agniṃ marudbhiḥ stuṣe hiraṇyavāśībhiḥ
verses.en: The Kanvas sing forth Agni's praise together with our Maruts' who Wield thunder and wear swords of gold.

verses.sa: ओ षु वृष्णः प्रयज्यूना नव्यसे सुविताय । ववृत्यां चित्रवाजान्॥
verses.tr: o ṣu vṛṣṇaḥ prayajyūnā navyase suvitāya vavṛtyāṃ citravājān
verses.en: Hither for new felicity may I attract the Impetuous Ones, The Heroes with their wondrous strength

verses.sa: गिरयश्चिन्नि जिहते पर्शानासो मन्यमानाः । पर्वताश्चिन्नि येमिरे॥
verses.tr: girayaścinni jihate parśānāso manyamānāḥ parvatāścinni yemire
verses.en: Before them sink the very hills deerning themselves abysses: yea, Even the mountains bend them down.

verses.sa: आक्ष्णयावानो वहन्त्यन्तरिक्षेण पततः । धातारः स्तुवते वयः॥
verses.tr: ākṣṇayāvāno vahantyantarikṣeṇa patataḥ dhātāraḥ stuvate vayaḥ
verses.en: Steeds flying on their tortuous path through mid-air carry them, and give The man who lauds them strength and life.

verses.sa: अग्निर्हि जानि पूर्व्यश्छन्दो न सूरो अर्चिषा । ते भानुभिर्वि तस्थिरे॥
verses.tr: agnirhi jāni pūrvyaśchando na sūro arciṣā te bhānubhirvi tasthire
verses.en: Agni was born the first of all, like Surya lovely with his light: With lustre these have spread abroad.

verses.sa: आ नो विश्वाभिरूतिभिरश्विना गच्छतं युवम् । दस्रा हिरण्यवर्तनी पिबतं सोम्यं मधु॥
verses.tr: ā no viśvābhirūtibhiraśvinā gacchataṃ yuvam dasrā hiraṇyavartanī pibataṃ somyaṃ madhu
verses.en: With all the succours that are yours, O Asvins, hither come to us: Wonderful, borne on paths of gold, drink ye the meath with Soma juice.

verses.sa: आ नूनं यातमश्विना रथेन सूर्यत्वचा । भुजी हिरण्यपेशसा कवी गम्भीरचेतसा॥
verses.tr: ā nūnaṃ yātamaśvinā rathena sūryatvacā bhujī hiraṇyapeśasā kavī gambhīracetasā
verses.en: Come now, ye Asvins, on your car decked with a sun-bright canopy, Bountiful, with your golden forms, Sages with depth of intellect.

verses.sa: आ यातं नहुषस्पर्याऽऽन्तरिक्षात्सुवृक्तिभिः । पिबाथो अश्विना मधु कण्वानां सवने सुतम्॥
verses.tr: ā yātaṃ nahuṣasparyā''ntarikṣātsuvṛktibhiḥ pibātho aśvinā madhu kaṇvānāṃ savane sutam
verses.en: Come hither from the Nahusas, come, drawn by pure hymns, from mid-air. O Asvins, drink the savoury juice shed in the Kanvas' sacrifice.

verses.sa: आ नो यातं दिवस्पर्याऽन्तरिक्षादधप्रिया । पुत्रः कण्वस्य वामिह सुषाव सोम्यं मधु॥
verses.tr: ā no yātaṃ divasparyā'ntarikṣādadhapriyā putraḥ kaṇvasya vāmiha suṣāva somyaṃ madhu
verses.en: Come to us hither from the heavens, come from mid-air, well-loved by us: Here Kanva's son hath pressed for you the pleasant meath of Soma juice.

verses.sa: आ नो यातमुपश्रुत्यश्विना सोमपीतये । स्वाहा स्तोमस्य वर्धना प्र कवी धीतिभिर्नरा॥
verses.tr: ā no yātamupaśrutyaśvinā somapītaye svāhā stomasya vardhanā pra kavī dhītibhirnarā
verses.en: Come, Asvins, to give car to us, to drink the Soma, Asvins, come. Hail, Strengtheners of the praise-song speed onward, ye Heroes, with your thoughts.

verses.sa: यच्चिद्धि वां पुर ऋषयो जुहूरेऽवसे नरा । आ यातमश्विना गतमुपेमां सुष्टुतिं मम॥
verses.tr: yacciddhi vāṃ pura ṛṣayo juhūre'vase narā ā yātamaśvinā gatamupemāṃ suṣṭutiṃ mama
verses.en: As, Heroes, in the olden time the Rsis called you to their aid, So now, O Asvins, come to us, come near to this mine eulogy.

verses.sa: दिवश्चिद्रोचनादध्या नो गन्तं स्वर्विदा । धीभिर्वत्सप्रचेतसा स्तोमेभिर्हवनश्रुता॥
verses.tr: divaścidrocanādadhyā no gantaṃ svarvidā dhībhirvatsapracetasā stomebhirhavanaśrutā
verses.en: Even from the luminous sphere of heaven come to us, ye who find the light, Carers for Vatsa, through our prayers and lauds, O ye who hear our call.

verses.sa: किमन्ये पर्यासतेऽस्मत्स्तोमेभिरश्विना । पुत्रः कण्वस्य वामृषिर्गीर्भिर्वत्सो अवीवृधत्॥
verses.tr: kimanye paryāsate'smatstomebhiraśvinā putraḥ kaṇvasya vāmṛṣirgīrbhirvatso avīvṛdhat
verses.en: Do others more than we adore the Asvins with their hymns of praise? The Rsi Vatsa, Kanva's son, hath magnified you with his songs.

verses.sa: आ वां विप्र इहावसेऽह्वत्स्तोमेभिरश्विना । अरिप्रा वृत्रहन्तमा ता नो भूतं मयोभुवा॥
verses.tr: ā vāṃ vipra ihāvase'hvatstomebhiraśvinā ariprā vṛtrahantamā tā no bhūtaṃ mayobhuvā
verses.en: The holy singer with his hymns hath called you, Asvins, hither-ward; Best Vrtra-slayers, free from stain, as such bring us felicity.

verses.sa: आ यद्वां योषणा रथमतिष्ठद्वाजिनीवसू । विश्वान्यश्विना युवं प्र धीतान्यगच्छतम्॥
verses.tr: ā yadvāṃ yoṣaṇā rathamatiṣṭhadvājinīvasū viśvānyaśvinā yuvaṃ pra dhītānyagacchatam
verses.en: What time, ye Lords of ample wealth, the Lady mounted on your car, Then, O ye Asvins, ye attained all wishes that your hearts desired.

verses.sa: अतः सहस्रनिर्णिजा रथेना यातमश्विना । वत्सो वां मधुमद्वचोऽशंसीत्काव्यः कविः॥
verses.tr: ataḥ sahasranirṇijā rathenā yātamaśvinā vatso vāṃ madhumadvaco'śaṃsītkāvyaḥ kaviḥ
verses.en: Come thence, O Asvins, on your car that hath a thousand ornaments: Vatsa the sage, the sage's son, hath sung a song of sweets to you.

verses.sa: पुरुमन्द्रा पुरूवसू मनोतरा रयीणाम् । स्तोमं मे अश्विनाविममभि वह्नी अनूषाताम्॥
verses.tr: purumandrā purūvasū manotarā rayīṇām stomaṃ me aśvināvimamabhi vahnī anūṣātām
verses.en: Cheerers of many, rich in goods, discoverers of opulence, The Asvins, Riders through the sky, have welcomed this my song of praise.

verses.sa: आ नो विश्वान्यश्विना धत्तं राधांस्यह्रया । कृतं न ऋत्वियावतो मा नो रीरधतं निदे॥
verses.tr: ā no viśvānyaśvinā dhattaṃ rādhāṃsyahrayā kṛtaṃ na ṛtviyāvato mā no rīradhataṃ nide
verses.en: O Asvins, grant us all rich gifts wherewith no man may interfere. Make us observe the stated times: give us not over to reproach.

verses.sa: यन्नासत्या परावति यद्वा स्थो अध्यम्बरे । अतः सहस्रनिर्णिजा रथेना यातमश्विना॥
verses.tr: yannāsatyā parāvati yadvā stho adhyambare ataḥ sahasranirṇijā rathenā yātamaśvinā
verses.en: Whether, Nasatyas, ye be nigh, or whether ye be far away, Come thence, O Asvins, on your car that hath a thousand ornaments.

verses.sa: यो वां नासत्यावृषिर्गीर्भिर्वत्सो अवीवृधत् । तस्मै सहस्रनिर्णिजमिषं धत्तं घृतश्चुतम्॥
verses.tr: yo vāṃ nāsatyāvṛṣirgīrbhirvatso avīvṛdhat tasmai sahasranirṇijamiṣaṃ dhattaṃ ghṛtaścutam
verses.en: Vatsa the Rsi with his songs, Nasatyas, hath exalted you: Grant him rich food distilling oil, graced with a thousand ornaments.

verses.sa: प्रास्मा ऊर्जं घृतश्चुतमश्विना यच्छतं युवम् । यो वां सुम्नाय तुष्टवद्वसूयाद्दानुनस्पती॥
verses.tr: prāsmā ūrjaṃ ghṛtaścutamaśvinā yacchataṃ yuvam yo vāṃ sumnāya tuṣṭavadvasūyāddānunaspatī
verses.en: Bestow on him, O Asvins, food that strengthens, and that drops with oil, On him who praises you for bliss, and, Lords of bounty, prays for wealth.

verses.sa: आ नो गन्तं रिशादसेमं स्तोमं पुरुभुजा । कृतं नः सुश्रियो नरेमा दातमभिष्टये॥
verses.tr: ā no gantaṃ riśādasemaṃ stomaṃ purubhujā kṛtaṃ naḥ suśriyo naremā dātamabhiṣṭaye
verses.en: Come to us, ye who slay the foe, Lords of rich treasure, to this hymn. O Heroes, give us high renown and these good things of earth for help.

verses.sa: आ वां विश्वाभिरूतिभिः प्रियमेधा अहूषत । राजन्तावध्वराणामश्विना यामहूतिषु॥
verses.tr: ā vāṃ viśvābhirūtibhiḥ priyamedhā ahūṣata rājantāvadhvarāṇāmaśvinā yāmahūtiṣu
verses.en: The Priyamedhas have invoked you with all succours that are yours, You, Asvins, Lords of solemn rites, with calls entreating you to come.

verses.sa: आ नो गन्तं मयोभुवाऽश्विना शम्भुवा युवम् । यो वां विपन्यू धीतिभिर्गीर्भिर्वत्सो अवीवृधत्॥
verses.tr: ā no gantaṃ mayobhuvā'śvinā śambhuvā yuvam yo vāṃ vipanyū dhītibhirgīrbhirvatso avīvṛdhat
