verses.en: Come to us, Asvins, ye Who bring felicity, auspicious Ones, To Vatsa who with prayer and hymn, lovers of song, hath honoured you.

verses.sa: याभिः कण्वं मेधातिथिं याभिर्वशं दशव्रजम् । याभिर्गोशर्यमावतं ताभिर्नोऽवतं नरा॥
verses.tr: yābhiḥ kaṇvaṃ medhātithiṃ yābhirvaśaṃ daśavrajam yābhirgośaryamāvataṃ tābhirno'vataṃ narā
verses.en: Aid us, O Heroes, for those hymns for which ye helped Go Sarya erst, Gave Vasa, Dasavraja aid, and Kanva and Medhatithi:

verses.sa: याभिर्नरा त्रसदस्युमावतं कृत्व्ये धने । ताभिः ष्व१स्माँ अश्विना प्रावतं वाजसातये॥
verses.tr: yābhirnarā trasadasyumāvataṃ kṛtvye dhane tābhiḥ ṣva1smāṃ aśvinā prāvataṃ vājasātaye
verses.en: And favoured Trasadasyu, ye Heroes, in spoil-deciding fray: For these, O Asvins, graciously assist us in acquiring strength.

verses.sa: प्र वां स्तोमाः सुवृक्तयो गिरो वर्धन्त्वश्विना । पुरुत्रा वृत्रहन्तमा ता नो भूतं पुरुस्पृहा॥
verses.tr: pra vāṃ stomāḥ suvṛktayo giro vardhantvaśvinā purutrā vṛtrahantamā tā no bhūtaṃ puruspṛhā
verses.en: O Asvins, may pure hymns of ours, and songs and praises, honour you: Best slayers everywhere of foes, as such we fondly yearn for you.

verses.sa: त्रीणि पदान्यश्विनोराविः सान्ति गुहा परः । कवी ऋतस्य पत्मभिरर्वाग्जीवेभ्यस्परि॥
verses.tr: trīṇi padānyaśvinorāviḥ sānti guhā paraḥ kavī ṛtasya patmabhirarvāgjīvebhyaspari
verses.en: Three places of the Asvins, erst concealed, are made apparent now. Both Sages, with the flight of Law come hither unto those who live.

verses.sa: आ नूनमश्विना युवं वत्सस्य गन्तमवसे । प्रास्मै यच्छतमवृकं पृथु च्छर्दिर्युयुतं या अरातयः॥
verses.tr: ā nūnamaśvinā yuvaṃ vatsasya gantamavase prāsmai yacchatamavṛkaṃ pṛthu cchardiryuyutaṃ yā arātayaḥ
verses.en: To help and favour Vatsa now, O Asvins, come ye hitherward. Bestow on him a dwelling spacious and secure, and keep malignities away.

verses.sa: यदन्तरिक्षे यद्दिवि यत्पञ्च मानुषाँ अनु । नृम्णं तद्धत्तमश्विना॥
verses.tr: yadantarikṣe yaddivi yatpañca mānuṣāṃ anu nṛmṇaṃ taddhattamaśvinā
verses.en: All manliness that is in heaven, with the Five Tribes, or in mid-air, Bestow, ye Asvins, upon us.

verses.sa: ये वां दंसांस्यश्विना विप्रासः परिमामृशुः । एवेत्काण्वस्य बोधतम्॥
verses.tr: ye vāṃ daṃsāṃsyaśvinā viprāsaḥ parimāmṛśuḥ evetkāṇvasya bodhatam
verses.en: Remember Kanva first of all among the singers, Asvins, who Have thought upon your wondrous deeds.

verses.sa: अयं वां घर्मो अश्विना स्तोमेन परि षिच्यते । अयं सोमो मधुमान्वाजिनीवसू येन वृत्रं चिकेतथः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ vāṃ gharmo aśvinā stomena pari ṣicyate ayaṃ somo madhumānvājinīvasū yena vṛtraṃ ciketathaḥ
verses.en: Asvins, for you with song of praise this hot oblation is effused, This your sweet Soma juice, ye Lords of ample wealth, through which ye think upon the foe.

verses.sa: यदप्सु यद्वनस्पतौ यदोषधीषु पुरुदंससा कृतम् । तेन माविष्टमश्विना॥
verses.tr: yadapsu yadvanaspatau yadoṣadhīṣu purudaṃsasā kṛtam tena māviṣṭamaśvinā
verses.en: Whatever ye have done in floods, in the tree, Wonder-Workers, and in growing plants, Therewith, O Asvins, succour me.

verses.sa: यन्नासत्या भुरण्यथो यद्वा देव भिषज्यथः । अयं वां वत्सो मतिभिर्न विन्धते हविष्मन्तं हि गच्छथः॥
verses.tr: yannāsatyā bhuraṇyatho yadvā deva bhiṣajyathaḥ ayaṃ vāṃ vatso matibhirna vindhate haviṣmantaṃ hi gacchathaḥ
verses.en: What force, Nasatyas, ye exert, whatever, Gods, ye tend and heal, This your own Vatsa gains not by his hymns alone: ye visit him who offers gifts.

verses.sa: आ नूनमश्विनोॠषिः स्तोमं चिकेत वामया । आ सोमं मधुमत्तमं घर्मं सिञ्चादथर्वणि॥
verses.tr: ā nūnamaśvinoṝṣiḥ stomaṃ ciketa vāmayā ā somaṃ madhumattamaṃ gharmaṃ siñcādatharvaṇi
verses.en: Now hath the Rsi splendidly thought out the Asvins' hymn of praise. Let the Atharvan pour the warm oblation forth, and Soma very rich in sweets.

verses.sa: आ नूनं रघुवर्तनिं रथं तिष्ठाथो अश्विना । आ वां स्तोमा इमे मम नभो न चुच्यवीरत॥
verses.tr: ā nūnaṃ raghuvartaniṃ rathaṃ tiṣṭhātho aśvinā ā vāṃ stomā ime mama nabho na cucyavīrata
verses.en: Ye Asvins, now ascend your car that lightly rolls upon its way. May these my praises make you speed hitherward like a cloud of heaven.

verses.sa: यदद्य वां नासत्योक्थैराचुच्युवीमहि । यद्वा वाणीभिरश्विनेवेत्काण्वस्य बोधतम्॥
verses.tr: yadadya vāṃ nāsatyokthairācucyuvīmahi yadvā vāṇībhiraśvinevetkāṇvasya bodhatam
verses.en: When, O Nasatyas, we this day make you speed hither with our hymns, Or, Asvins, with our songs of praise, remember Kanya specially.

verses.sa:
यद्वां कक्षीवाँ उत यद्व्यश्व ऋषिर्यद्वां दीर्घतमा जुहाव ।
पृथी यद्वां वैन्यः सादनेष्वेवेदतो अश्विना चेतयेथाम्॥
verses.tr: yadvāṃ kakṣīvāṃ uta yadvyaśva ṛṣiryadvāṃ dīrghatamā juhāva pṛthī yadvāṃ vainyaḥ sādaneṣvevedato aśvinā cetayethām
verses.en: As erst Kaksivan and the Rsi Vyasva, as erst Dirghatamas invoked your presence, Or, in the sacrificial chambers, Vainya Prthi, so be ye mindful of us here, O Asvins.

verses.sa: यातं छर्दिष्पा उत नः परस्पा भूतं जगत्पा उत नस्तनूपा । वर्तिस्तोकाय तनयाय यातम्॥
verses.tr: yātaṃ chardiṣpā uta naḥ paraspā bhūtaṃ jagatpā uta nastanūpā vartistokāya tanayāya yātam
verses.en: Come as home-guardians, saving us from foemen, guarding our living creatures and our bodies, Come to the house to give us seed and offspring,

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्रेण सरथं याथो अश्विना यद्वा वायुना भवथः समोकसा ।
यदादित्येभिॠभुभिः सजोषसा यद्वा विष्णोर्विक्रमणेषु तिष्ठथः॥
verses.tr: yadindreṇa sarathaṃ yātho aśvinā yadvā vāyunā bhavathaḥ samokasā yadādityebhiṝbhubhiḥ sajoṣasā yadvā viṣṇorvikramaṇeṣu tiṣṭhathaḥ
verses.en: Whether with Indra ye be faring, Asvins, or resting in one dwelling-place with Vayu, In concord with the Rbhus or Adityas, or standing still in Visnu's striding-places.

verses.sa: यदद्याश्विनावहं हुवेय वाजसातये । यत्पृत्सु तुर्वणे सहस्तच्छ्रेष्ठमश्विनोरवः॥
verses.tr: yadadyāśvināvahaṃ huveya vājasātaye yatpṛtsu turvaṇe sahastacchreṣṭhamaśvinoravaḥ
verses.en: When I, O Asvins, call on you to-day that I may gather strength, Or as all-conquering might in war, be that the Asvins' noblest grace.

verses.sa: आ नूनं यातमश्विनेमा हव्यानि वां हिता । इमे सोमासो अधि तुर्वशे यदाविमे कण्वेषु वामथ॥
verses.tr: ā nūnaṃ yātamaśvinemā havyāni vāṃ hitā ime somāso adhi turvaśe yadāvime kaṇveṣu vāmatha
verses.en: Now come, ye Asvins, hitherward: here are oblations set for you; These Soma-draughts to aid Yadu and Turvasa, these offered you mid Kanva's Sons.

verses.sa: यन्नासत्या पराके अर्वाके अस्ति भेषजम् । तेन नूनं विमदाय प्रचेतसा छर्दिर्वत्साय यच्छतम्॥
verses.tr: yannāsatyā parāke arvāke asti bheṣajam tena nūnaṃ vimadāya pracetasā chardirvatsāya yacchatam
verses.en: Whatever healing balm is yours, Nisatyas, near or far away, Therewith, great Sages, grant a home to Vatsa and to Vimada.

verses.sa: अभुत्स्यु प्र देव्या साकं वाचाहमश्विनोः । व्यावर्देव्या मतिं वि रातिं मर्त्येभ्यः॥
verses.tr: abhutsyu pra devyā sākaṃ vācāhamaśvinoḥ vyāvardevyā matiṃ vi rātiṃ martyebhyaḥ
verses.en: Together with the Goddess, with the Asvins' Speech have I awoke. Thou, Goddess, hast disclosed the hymn, and holy gift from mortal men.

verses.sa: प्र बोधयोषो अश्विना प्र देवि सूनृते महि । प्र यज्ञहोतरानुषक्प्र मदाय श्रवो बृहत्॥
verses.tr: pra bodhayoṣo aśvinā pra devi sūnṛte mahi pra yajñahotarānuṣakpra madāya śravo bṛhat
verses.en: Awake the Asvins, Goddess Dawn! Up Mighty Lady of sweet strains! Rise, straightway, priest of sacrifice! High glory to the gladdening draught!

verses.sa: यदुषो यासि भानुना सं सूर्येण रोचसे । आ हायमश्विनो रथो वर्तिर्याति नृपाय्यम्॥
verses.tr: yaduṣo yāsi bhānunā saṃ sūryeṇa rocase ā hāyamaśvino ratho vartiryāti nṛpāyyam
verses.en: Thou, Dawn, approaching with thy light shinest together with the Sun, And to this man-protecting home the chariot of the Asvins comes.

verses.sa: यदापीतासो अंशवो गावो न दुह्र ऊधभिः । यद्वा वाणीरनूषत प्र देवयन्तो अश्विना॥
verses.tr: yadāpītāso aṃśavo gāvo na duhra ūdhabhiḥ yadvā vāṇīranūṣata pra devayanto aśvinā
verses.en: When yellow stalks give forth the juice, as cows from udders pour their milk, And voices sound the song of praise, the Asvins' worshippers show first.

verses.sa: प्र द्युम्नाय प्र शवसे प्र नृषाह्याय शर्मणे । प्र दक्षाय प्रचेतसा॥
verses.tr: pra dyumnāya pra śavase pra nṛṣāhyāya śarmaṇe pra dakṣāya pracetasā
verses.en: Forward for glory and for strength, protection that shall conquer men, And power and skill, most sapient Ones!

verses.sa: यन्नूनं धीभिरश्विना पितुर्योना निषीदथः । यद्वा सुम्नेभिरुक्थ्या॥
verses.tr: yannūnaṃ dhībhiraśvinā pituryonā niṣīdathaḥ yadvā sumnebhirukthyā
verses.en: When Asvins, worthy of our lauds, ye seat you in the father's house. With wisdom or the bliss ye bring.

verses.sa: यत्स्थो दीर्घप्रसद्मनि यद्वादो रोचने दिवः । यद्वा समुद्रे अध्याकृते गृहेऽत आ यातमश्विना॥
verses.tr: yatstho dīrghaprasadmani yadvādo rocane divaḥ yadvā samudre adhyākṛte gṛhe'ta ā yātamaśvinā
verses.en: Whether ye travel far away or dwell in yonder light of heaven, Or in a mansion that is built above the sea, come thence, ye Asvins, hitherward.

verses.sa: यद्वा यज्ञं मनवे सम्मिमिक्षथुरेवेत्काण्वस्य बोधतम् । बृहस्पतिं विश्वान्देवाँ अहं हुव इन्द्राविष्णू अश्विनावाशुहेषसा॥
verses.tr: yadvā yajñaṃ manave sammimikṣathurevetkāṇvasya bodhatam bṛhaspatiṃ viśvāndevāṃ ahaṃ huva indrāviṣṇū aśvināvāśuheṣasā
verses.en: Or if for Manu.ye prepared the sacrifice, remember also Kanva's son. I call Brhaspati, Indra, Visnu, all the gods, the Asvins borne by rapid steeds.

verses.sa: त्या न्व१श्विना हुवे सुदंससा गृभे कृता । ययोरस्ति प्र णः सख्यं देवेष्वध्याप्यम्॥
verses.tr: tyā nva1śvinā huve sudaṃsasā gṛbhe kṛtā yayorasti pra ṇaḥ sakhyaṃ deveṣvadhyāpyam
verses.en: Those Asvins I invoke who work marvels, brought hither to receive, With whom our friendship is most famed, and kinship passing that of Gods.

verses.sa: ययोरधि प्र यज्ञा असूरे सन्ति सूरयः । ता यज्ञस्याध्वरस्य प्रचेतसा स्वधाभिर्या पिबतः सोम्यं मधु॥
verses.tr: yayoradhi pra yajñā asūre santi sūrayaḥ tā yajñasyādhvarasya pracetasā svadhābhiryā pibataḥ somyaṃ madhu
verses.en: On whom the solemn rites depend, whose worshippers rise without the Sun: These who foreknow the holy work of sacrifice, and by their Godhead drink the sweets of Soma juice.

verses.sa: यदद्याश्विनावपाग्यत्प्राक्स्थो वाजिनीवसू । यद्द्रुह्यव्यनवि तुर्वशे यदौ हुवे वामथ मा गतम्॥
verses.tr: yadadyāśvināvapāgyatprākstho vājinīvasū yaddruhyavyanavi turvaśe yadau huve vāmatha mā gatam
verses.en: Whether ye, Lords of ample wealth, now linger in the cast or west, With Druhyu, or with Anu, Yadu, Turvaga, I call you hither; come to me.

verses.sa: यदन्तरिक्षे पतथः पुरुभुजा यद्वेमे रोदसी अनु । यद्वा स्वधाभिरधितिष्ठथो रथमत आ यातमश्विना॥
verses.tr: yadantarikṣe patathaḥ purubhujā yadveme rodasī anu yadvā svadhābhiradhitiṣṭhatho rathamata ā yātamaśvinā
verses.en: Lords of great riches, whether through the firmament ye fly or speed through heaven and earth, Or with your Godlike natures stand upon your cars, come thence, O Asvins, hitherward.

verses.sa: त्वमग्ने व्रतपा असि देव आ मर्त्येष्वा । त्वं यज्ञेष्वीड्यः॥
verses.tr: tvamagne vratapā asi deva ā martyeṣvā tvaṃ yajñeṣvīḍyaḥ
verses.en: Thou Agni, God mid mortal men, art guard of sacred rites, thou art To be adored at sacrifice.

verses.sa: त्वमसि प्रशस्यो विदथेषु सहन्त्य । अग्ने रथीरध्वराणाम्॥
verses.tr: tvamasi praśasyo vidatheṣu sahantya agne rathīradhvarāṇām
verses.en: O Mighty Agni, thou must be glorified at our festivals, Bearing our offerings to the Gods.

verses.sa: स त्वमस्मदप द्विषो युयोधि जातवेदः । अदेवीरग्ने अरातीः॥
verses.tr: sa tvamasmadapa dviṣo yuyodhi jātavedaḥ adevīragne arātīḥ
verses.en: O Jatavedas Agni, fight and drive our foes afar from us, Them and their godless enmities.

verses.sa: अन्ति चित्सन्तमह यज्ञं मर्तस्य रिपोः । नोप वेषि जातवेदः॥
verses.tr: anti citsantamaha yajñaṃ martasya ripoḥ nopa veṣi jātavedaḥ
verses.en: Thou, Jatavedas, seekest not the worship of a hostile man, However nigh itbe to thee.

verses.sa: मर्ता अमर्त्यस्य ते भूरि नाम मनामहे । विप्रासो जातवेदसः॥
verses.tr: martā amartyasya te bhūri nāma manāmahe viprāso jātavedasaḥ
verses.en: We sages, mortals as we are, adore the mighty name of thee, Immortal Jatavedas' name.

verses.sa: विप्रं विप्रासोऽवसे देवं मर्तास ऊतये । अग्निं गीर्भिर्हवामहे॥
verses.tr: vipraṃ viprāso'vase devaṃ martāsa ūtaye agniṃ gīrbhirhavāmahe
verses.en: Sages, we call the Sage to help, mortals, we call the God to aid: We call on Agni with our songs.

verses.sa: आ ते वत्सो मनो यमत्परमाच्चित्सधस्थात् । अग्ने त्वांकामया गिरा॥
verses.tr: ā te vatso mano yamatparamāccitsadhasthāt agne tvāṃkāmayā girā
verses.en: May Vatsa draw- thy mind away even from thy loftiest dwelling-place, Agni, with song that yearns for thee.

verses.sa: पुरुत्रा हि सदृङ्ङसि विशो विश्वा अनु प्रभुः । समत्सु त्वा हवामहे॥
verses.tr: purutrā hi sadṛṅṅasi viśo viśvā anu prabhuḥ samatsu tvā havāmahe
verses.en: Thou art the same in many a place: mid all the people thou art Lord. In fray and fight we call on thee.

verses.sa: समत्स्वग्निमवसे वाजयन्तो हवामहे । वाजेषु चित्रराधसम्॥
verses.tr: samatsvagnimavase vājayanto havāmahe vājeṣu citrarādhasam
verses.en: When we are seeking strength we call Agni to help us in the strife, The giver of rich gifts in war.

verses.sa: प्रत्नो हि कमीड्यो अध्वरेषु सनाच्च होता नव्यश्च सत्सि । स्वां चाग्ने तन्वं पिप्रयस्वाऽस्मभ्यं च सौभगमा यजस्व॥
verses.tr: pratno hi kamīḍyo adhvareṣu sanācca hotā navyaśca satsi svāṃ cāgne tanvaṃ piprayasvā'smabhyaṃ ca saubhagamā yajasva
verses.en: Ancient, adorable at sacrifices, Priest from of old, meet for our praise, thou sittest. Fill full and satisfy thy body, Agni, and win us happiness by offering worship.

verses.sa: य इन्द्र सोमपातमो मदः शविष्ठ चेतति । येना हंसि न्य१त्रिणं तमीमहे॥
verses.tr: ya indra somapātamo madaḥ śaviṣṭha cetati yenā haṃsi nya1triṇaṃ tamīmahe
verses.en: Joy, Mightiest Indra, known and marked, sprung most from Soma-draughts, wherewith Thou smitest down the greedy fiend, for that we long.

verses.sa: येना दशग्वमध्रिगुं वेपयन्तं स्वर्णरम् । येना समुद्रमाविथा तमीमहे॥
verses.tr: yenā daśagvamadhriguṃ vepayantaṃ svarṇaram yenā samudramāvithā tamīmahe
verses.en: Wherewith thou bolpest Adhrigu, the great Dasagva, and the God Who stirs the sunlight, and the sea, for that we long.

verses.sa: येन सिन्धुं महीरपो रथाँ इव प्रचोदयः । पन्थामृतस्य यातवे तमीमहे॥
verses.tr: yena sindhuṃ mahīrapo rathāṃ iva pracodayaḥ panthāmṛtasya yātave tamīmahe
verses.en: Wherewith thou dravest forth like cars Sindhu and all the mighty floods To go the way ordained by Law, for that we long.

verses.sa: इमं स्तोममभिष्टये घृतं न पूतमद्रिवः । येना नु सद्य ओजसा ववक्षिथ॥
verses.tr: imaṃ stomamabhiṣṭaye ghṛtaṃ na pūtamadrivaḥ yenā nu sadya ojasā vavakṣitha
verses.en: Accept this laud for aid, made pure like oil, thou Caster of the Stone, Whereby even in a moment thou hast waxen great.

verses.sa: इमं जुषस्व गिर्वणः समुद्र इव पिन्वते । इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिर्ववक्षिथ॥
verses.tr: imaṃ juṣasva girvaṇaḥ samudra iva pinvate indra viśvābhirūtibhirvavakṣitha
verses.en: Be pleased, Song-lover, with this song it flows abundant like the sea. Indra, with all thy succours thou hast waxen great.

verses.sa: यो नो देवः परावतः सखित्वनाय मामहे । दिवो न वृष्टिं प्रथयन्ववक्षिथ॥
verses.tr: yo no devaḥ parāvataḥ sakhitvanāya māmahe divo na vṛṣṭiṃ prathayanvavakṣitha
verses.en: The God who from afar hath sent gifts to maintain our friendship's bond, Thou. spreading them like rain from heaven, hast waxen great.

verses.sa: ववक्षुरस्य केतवो उत वज्रो गभस्त्योः । यत्सूर्यो न रोदसी अवर्धयत्॥
verses.tr: vavakṣurasya ketavo uta vajro gabhastyoḥ yatsūryo na rodasī avardhayat
verses.en: The beams that mark him have grown strong, the thunder rests between his arms, When, like the Sun, he hath increased both Heaven and Earth.

verses.sa: यदि प्रवृद्ध सत्पते सहस्रं महिषाँ अघः । आदित्त इन्द्रियं महि प्र वावृधे॥
verses.tr: yadi pravṛddha satpate sahasraṃ mahiṣāṃ aghaḥ āditta indriyaṃ mahi pra vāvṛdhe
verses.en: When, Mighty Lord of Heroes, thou didst cat a thousand buffaloes, Then grew and waxed exceeding great thine Indra-power.

verses.sa: इन्द्रः सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिर्न्यर्शसानमोषति । अग्निर्वनेव सासहिः प्र वावृधे॥
verses.tr: indraḥ sūryasya raśmibhirnyarśasānamoṣati agnirvaneva sāsahiḥ pra vāvṛdhe
verses.en: Indra consumeth with the rays of Surya the malicious man: Like Agni conquering the woods, he hath grown strong.

verses.sa: इयं त ऋत्वियावती धीतिरेति नवीयसी । सपर्यन्ती पुरुप्रिया मिमीत इत्॥
verses.tr: iyaṃ ta ṛtviyāvatī dhītireti navīyasī saparyantī purupriyā mimīta it
verses.en: This newest thought of ours that suits the time approaches unto thee: Serving, beloved in many a place it metes and marks.

verses.sa: गर्भो यज्ञस्य देवयुः क्रतुं पुनीत आनुषक् । स्तोमैरिन्द्रस्य वावृधे मिमीत इत्॥
verses.tr: garbho yajñasya devayuḥ kratuṃ punīta ānuṣak stomairindrasya vāvṛdhe mimīta it
verses.en: The pious germ of sacrifice directly purifies the soul. By Indra's lauds it waxes great, it metes and marks.

verses.sa: सनिर्मित्रस्य पप्रथ इन्द्रः सोमस्य पीतये । प्राची वाशीव सुन्वते मिमीत इत्॥
verses.tr: sanirmitrasya papratha indraḥ somasya pītaye prācī vāśīva sunvate mimīta it
verses.en: Indra who wins the friend hath spread himself to drink the Soma-draught: Like worshipper's dilating praise; it metes and marks.

verses.sa: यं विप्रा उक्थवाहसोऽभिप्रमन्दुरायवः । घृतं न पिप्य आसन्यृतस्य यत्॥
verses.tr: yaṃ viprā ukthavāhaso'bhipramandurāyavaḥ ghṛtaṃ na pipya āsanyṛtasya yat
verses.en: He whom the sages, living men, have gladdened, offering up their hymns, Hath swelled like oil of sacrifice in Agni's mouth.

verses.sa: उत स्वराजे अदितिः स्तोममिन्द्राय जीजनत् । पुरुप्रशस्तमूतय ऋतस्य यत्॥
verses.tr: uta svarāje aditiḥ stomamindrāya jījanat purupraśastamūtaya ṛtasya yat
verses.en: Aditi also hath brought forth a hymn for Indra, Sovran Lord: The work of sacrifice for help is glorified.

verses.sa: अभि वह्नय ऊतयेऽनूषत प्रशस्तये । न देव विव्रता हरी ऋतस्य यत्॥
verses.tr: abhi vahnaya ūtaye'nūṣata praśastaye na deva vivratā harī ṛtasya yat
verses.en: The ministering priests have sung their songs for aid and eulogy: God, thy Bays turn not from the rite which Law ordains.

verses.sa: यत्सोममिन्द्र विष्णवि यद्वा घ त्रित आप्त्ये । यद्वा मरुत्सु मन्दसे समिन्दुभिः॥
verses.tr: yatsomamindra viṣṇavi yadvā gha trita āptye yadvā marutsu mandase samindubhiḥ
verses.en: If, Indra, thou drink Soma by Visnu's or Trta Aptya's side, Or with the Maruts take delight in flowing drops;

verses.sa: यद्वा शक्र परावति समुद्रे अधि मन्दसे । अस्माकमित्सुते रणा समिन्दुभिः॥
verses.tr: yadvā śakra parāvati samudre adhi mandase asmākamitsute raṇā samindubhiḥ
verses.en: Or, Sakra, if thou gladden thee afar or in the sea of air, Rejoice thee in this juice of ours, in flowing drops.

verses.sa: यद्वासि सुन्वतो वृधो यजमानस्य सत्पते । उक्थे वा यस्य रण्यसि समिन्दुभिः॥
verses.tr: yadvāsi sunvato vṛdho yajamānasya satpate ukthe vā yasya raṇyasi samindubhiḥ
verses.en: Or, Lord of Heroes if thou aid the worshipper who shed; the, juice, Or him whose laud delights thee, and his flowing drops.

verses.sa: देवंदेवं वोऽवस इन्द्रमिन्द्रं गृणीषणि । अधा यज्ञाय तुर्वणे व्यानशुः॥
verses.tr: devaṃdevaṃ vo'vasa indramindraṃ gṛṇīṣaṇi adhā yajñāya turvaṇe vyānaśuḥ
verses.en: To magnify the God, the God, Indra, yea, Indra for your help, And promptly end the sacrifice-this have they gained.

verses.sa: यज्ञेभिर्यज्ञवाहसं सोमेभिः सोमपातमम् । होत्राभिरिन्द्रं वावृधुर्व्यानशुः॥
verses.tr: yajñebhiryajñavāhasaṃ somebhiḥ somapātamam hotrābhirindraṃ vāvṛdhurvyānaśuḥ
verses.en: With worship, him whom men adore, with Soma, him who drinks it most, Indra with lauds have they increased this have they gained.

verses.sa: महीरस्य प्रणीतयः पूर्वीरुत प्रशस्तयः । विश्वा वसूनि दाशुषे व्यानशुः॥
verses.tr: mahīrasya praṇītayaḥ pūrvīruta praśastayaḥ viśvā vasūni dāśuṣe vyānaśuḥ
verses.en: His leadings are with power and might and his instructions manifold: He gives the worshipper all wealth: this have they gained.

verses.sa: इन्द्रं वृत्राय हन्तवे देवासो दधिरे पुरः । इन्द्रं वाणीरनूषता समोजसे॥
verses.tr: indraṃ vṛtrāya hantave devāso dadhire puraḥ indraṃ vāṇīranūṣatā samojase
verses.en: For slaying Vrtra have the Gods set Indra in the foremost place. Indra the choral bands have sung, for vigorous strength.

verses.sa: महान्तं महिना वयं स्तोमेभिर्हवनश्रुतम् । अर्कैरभि प्र णोनुमः समोजसे॥
verses.tr: mahāntaṃ mahinā vayaṃ stomebhirhavanaśrutam arkairabhi pra ṇonumaḥ samojase
verses.en: We to the Mighty with our might, with lauds to him who hears our call, With holy hymns have sung aloud, for vigorous strength.

verses.sa: न यं विविक्तो रोदसी नान्तरिक्षाणि वज्रिणम् । अमादिदस्य तित्विषे समोजसः॥
verses.tr: na yaṃ vivikto rodasī nāntarikṣāṇi vajriṇam amādidasya titviṣe samojasaḥ
verses.en: Not earth, nor heaven, nor firmaments contain the Thunder-wielding God: They shake before his violent rush and vigorous strength.

verses.sa: यदिन्द्र पृतनाज्ये देवास्त्वा दधिरे पुरः । आदित्ते हर्यता हरी ववक्षतुः॥
verses.tr: yadindra pṛtanājye devāstvā dadhire puraḥ āditte haryatā harī vavakṣatuḥ
verses.en: What time the Gods, O Indra, get thee foremost in the furious fight, Then thy two beautiful Bay Steeds carried thee on.

verses.sa: यदा वृत्रं नदीवृतं शवसा वज्रिन्नवधीः । आदित्ते हर्यता हरी ववक्षतुः॥
verses.tr: yadā vṛtraṃ nadīvṛtaṃ śavasā vajrinnavadhīḥ āditte haryatā harī vavakṣatuḥ
verses.en: When Vrtra, stayer of the floods, thou seest, Thunderor with might, Then thy two beautiful Bay Steeds carried thee on.

verses.sa: यदा ते विष्णुरोजसा त्रीणि पदा विचक्रमे । आदित्ते हर्यता हरी ववक्षतुः॥
verses.tr: yadā te viṣṇurojasā trīṇi padā vicakrame āditte haryatā harī vavakṣatuḥ
verses.en: When Visnu, through thine energy, strode wide those three great steps of his, Then thy two beautiful Bay Steeds carried thee on.

verses.sa: यदा ते हर्यता हरी वावृधाते दिवेदिवे । आदित्ते विश्वा भुवनानि येमिरे॥
verses.tr: yadā te haryatā harī vāvṛdhāte divedive āditte viśvā bhuvanāni yemire
verses.en: When thy two beautiful Bay Steeds grew great and greater day by day, Even then all creatures that had life bowed down to thee.

verses.sa: यदा ते मारुतीर्विशस्तुभ्यमिन्द्र नियेमिरे । आदित्ते विश्वा भुवनानि येमिरे॥
verses.tr: yadā te mārutīrviśastubhyamindra niyemire āditte viśvā bhuvanāni yemire
verses.en: When, Indra, all the Marut folk humbly submitted them to thee, Even then all creatures that had life bowed down to thee.

verses.sa: यदा सूर्यममुं दिवि शुक्रं ज्योतिरधारयः । आदित्ते विश्वा भुवनानि येमिरे॥
verses.tr: yadā sūryamamuṃ divi śukraṃ jyotiradhārayaḥ āditte viśvā bhuvanāni yemire
verses.en: When yonder Sun, that brilliant light, thou settest in the heaven above, Even then all creatures that had life bowed down to thee.

verses.sa: इमां त इन्द्र सुष्टुतिं विप्र इयर्ति धीतिभिः । जामिं पदेव पिप्रतीं प्राध्वरे॥
verses.tr: imāṃ ta indra suṣṭutiṃ vipra iyarti dhītibhiḥ jāmiṃ padeva pipratīṃ prādhvare
verses.en: To thee, O Indra, with this thought the sage lifts up this eulogy, Akin and leading as on foot to sacrifice.

verses.sa: यदस्य धामनि प्रिये समीचीनासो अस्वरन् । नाभा यज्ञस्य दोहना प्राध्वरे॥
verses.tr: yadasya dhāmani priye samīcīnāso asvaran nābhā yajñasya dohanā prādhvare
verses.en: When in thine own dear dwelling all gathered have lifted up the voice Milk-streams at worship's central spot, for sacrifice,

verses.sa: सुवीर्यं स्वश्व्यं सुगव्यमिन्द्र दद्धि नः । होतेव पूर्वचित्तये प्राध्वरे॥
verses.tr: suvīryaṃ svaśvyaṃ sugavyamindra daddhi naḥ hoteva pūrvacittaye prādhvare
verses.en: As Priest, O Indra, give us wealth in brave men and good steeds and kine That we may first remember thee for sacrifice.

verses.sa: इन्द्रः सुतेषु सोमेषु क्रतुं पुनीत उक्थ्यम् । विदे वृधस्य दक्षसो महान्हि षः॥
verses.tr: indraḥ suteṣu someṣu kratuṃ punīta ukthyam vide vṛdhasya dakṣaso mahānhi ṣaḥ
verses.en: Indra, when Soma juices flow, makes his mind pure and meet for lauds. He gains the power that brings success, for great is he.

verses.sa: स प्रथमे व्योमनि देवानां सदने वृधः । सुपारः सुश्रवस्तमः समप्सुजित्॥
verses.tr: sa prathame vyomani devānāṃ sadane vṛdhaḥ supāraḥ suśravastamaḥ samapsujit
verses.en: In heaven's first region, in the seat of Gods, is he who brings success, Most glorious, prompt to save, who wins the water-floods.

verses.sa: तमह्वे वाजसातय इन्द्रं भराय शुष्मिणम् । भवा नः सुम्ने अन्तमः सखा वृधे॥
verses.tr: tamahve vājasātaya indraṃ bharāya śuṣmiṇam bhavā naḥ sumne antamaḥ sakhā vṛdhe
verses.en: Him, to win strength, have I invoked, even Indra mighty for the fray. Be thou most near to us for bliss, a Friend to aid.

verses.sa: इयं त इन्द्र गिर्वणो रातिः क्षरति सुन्वतः । मन्दानो अस्य बर्हिषो वि राजसि॥
verses.tr: iyaṃ ta indra girvaṇo rātiḥ kṣarati sunvataḥ mandāno asya barhiṣo vi rājasi
verses.en: Indra, Song -lover, here for thee the worshipper's libation flows. Rejoicing in this sacred grass thou shinest forth.

verses.sa: नूनं तदिन्द्र दद्धि नो यत्त्वा सुन्वन्त ईमहे । रयिं नश्चित्रमा भरा स्वर्विदम्॥
verses.tr: nūnaṃ tadindra daddhi no yattvā sunvanta īmahe rayiṃ naścitramā bharā svarvidam
verses.en: Even now, O Indra, give us that which, pressing juice, we crave of thee. Bring us wealth manifold which finds the light of heaven.

verses.sa: स्तोता यत्ते विचर्षणिरतिप्रशर्धयद्गिरः । वया इवानु रोहते जुषन्त यत्॥
verses.tr: stotā yatte vicarṣaṇiratipraśardhayadgiraḥ vayā ivānu rohate juṣanta yat
verses.en: What time the zealous worshipper hath boldly sung his songs to thee, Like branches of a tree up-grows what they desire.

verses.sa: प्रत्नवज्जनया गिरः शृणुधी जरितुर्हवम् । मदेमदे ववक्षिथा सुकृत्वने॥
verses.tr: pratnavajjanayā giraḥ śṛṇudhī jariturhavam mademade vavakṣithā sukṛtvane
verses.en: Generate songs even as of old, give car unto the singer's call. Thou for the pious hast grown great at each carouse.

verses.sa: क्रीळन्त्यस्य सूनृता आपो न प्रवता यतीः । अया धिया य उच्यते पतिर्दिवः॥
verses.tr: krīḻantyasya sūnṛtā āpo na pravatā yatīḥ ayā dhiyā ya ucyate patirdivaḥ
verses.en: Sweet strains that glorify him play like waters speeding down a slope, Yea, him who in this song is called the Lord of Heaven;

verses.sa: उतो पतिर्य उच्यते कृष्टीनामेक इद्वशी । नमोवृधैरवस्युभिः सुते रण॥
verses.tr: uto patirya ucyate kṛṣṭīnāmeka idvaśī namovṛdhairavasyubhiḥ sute raṇa
verses.en: Yea, who alone is called the Lord, the single Ruler of the folk, By worshippers seeking aid: may he joy in the draught.

verses.sa: स्तुहि श्रुतं विपश्चितं हरी यस्य प्रसक्षिणा । गन्तारा दाशुषो गृहं नमस्विनः॥
verses.tr: stuhi śrutaṃ vipaścitaṃ harī yasya prasakṣiṇā gantārā dāśuṣo gṛhaṃ namasvinaḥ
verses.en: Praise him, the Glorious, skilled in song, Lord of the two victorious Bays: They seek the worshipper's abode who bows in prayer.

verses.sa: तूतुजानो महेमतेऽश्वेभिः प्रुषितप्सुभिः । आ याहि यज्ञमाशुभिः शमिद्धि ते॥
verses.tr: tūtujāno mahemate'śvebhiḥ pruṣitapsubhiḥ ā yāhi yajñamāśubhiḥ śamiddhi te
verses.en: Put forth thy strength: with dappled Steeds come, thou of mighty intellect, With swift Steeds to the sacrifice, for 'tis thy joy.

verses.sa: इन्द्र शविष्ठ सत्पते रयिं गृणत्सु धारय । श्रवः सूरिभ्यो अमृतं वसुत्वनम्॥
verses.tr: indra śaviṣṭha satpate rayiṃ gṛṇatsu dhāraya śravaḥ sūribhyo amṛtaṃ vasutvanam
verses.en: Grant wealth to those who praise thee, Lord of Heroes, Mightiest Indra: give Our princes everlasting fame and opulence.

verses.sa: हवे त्वा सूर उदिते हवे मध्यंदिने दिवः । जुषाण इन्द्र सप्तिभिर्न आ गहि॥
verses.tr: have tvā sūra udite have madhyaṃdine divaḥ juṣāṇa indra saptibhirna ā gahi
verses.en: I call thee when the Sun is risen, I call thee at the noon of day: With thy car-horses, Indra, come well pleased to us.

verses.sa: आ तू गहि प्र तु द्रव मत्स्वा सुतस्य गोमतः । तन्तुं तनुष्व पूर्व्यं यथा विदे॥
verses.tr: ā tū gahi pra tu drava matsvā sutasya gomataḥ tantuṃ tanuṣva pūrvyaṃ yathā vide
verses.en: Speed forward hither, come to us, rejoice thee in the milky draught: Spin out the thread of ancient time, as well is known.

verses.sa: यच्छक्रासि परावति यदर्वावति वृत्रहन् । यद्वा समुद्रे अन्धसोऽवितेदसि॥
verses.tr: yacchakrāsi parāvati yadarvāvati vṛtrahan yadvā samudre andhaso'vitedasi
verses.en: If, Sakra, Vrtra-slayer, thou be far away or near to us. Or in the sea, thou art the guard of Soma juice.

verses.sa: इन्द्रं वर्धन्तु नो गिर इन्द्रं सुतास इन्दवः । इन्द्रे हविष्मतीर्विशो अराणिषुः॥
verses.tr: indraṃ vardhantu no gira indraṃ sutāsa indavaḥ indre haviṣmatīrviśo arāṇiṣuḥ
verses.en: Let songs we sing and Soma-drops expressed by us make Indra strong: The tribes who bring oblations find delight in him.

verses.sa: तमिद्विप्रा अवस्यवः प्रवत्वतीभिरूतिभिः । इन्द्रं क्षोणीरवर्धयन्वया इव॥
verses.tr: tamidviprā avasyavaḥ pravatvatībhirūtibhiḥ indraṃ kṣoṇīravardhayanvayā iva
verses.en: Him sages longing for his aid, with offerings brought in eager haste, Him. even as branches, all mankind have made to grow.

verses.sa: त्रिकद्रुकेषु चेतनं देवासो यज्ञमत्नत । तमिद्वर्धन्तु नो गिरः सदावृधम्॥
verses.tr: trikadrukeṣu cetanaṃ devāso yajñamatnata tamidvardhantu no giraḥ sadāvṛdham
verses.en: At the Trkadrukas the Gods span sacrifice that stirred the mind: May our songs strengthen him who still hath strengthened us.

verses.sa: स्तोता यत्ते अनुव्रत उक्थान्यृतुथा दधे । शुचिः पावक उच्यते सो अद्भुतः॥
verses.tr: stotā yatte anuvrata ukthānyṛtuthā dadhe śuciḥ pāvaka ucyate so adbhutaḥ
verses.en: When, true to duty, at due times the worshipper offers lauds to thee, They call him Purifier, Pure, and Wonderful.

verses.sa: तदिद्रुद्रस्य चेतति यह्वं प्रत्नेषु धामसु । मनो यत्रा वि तद्दधुर्विचेतसः॥
verses.tr: tadidrudrasya cetati yahvaṃ pratneṣu dhāmasu mano yatrā vi taddadhurvicetasaḥ
verses.en: That mind of Rudra, fresh and strong, moves conscious in the ancient ways, With reference whereto the wise have ordered this.

verses.sa: यदि मे सख्यमावर इमस्य पाह्यन्धसः । येन विश्वा अति द्विषो अतारिम॥
verses.tr: yadi me sakhyamāvara imasya pāhyandhasaḥ yena viśvā ati dviṣo atārima
verses.en: If thou elect to be my Friend drink of this sacrificial juice, By help whereof we may subdue all enemies.

verses.sa: कदा त इन्द्र गिर्वणः स्तोता भवाति शंतमः । कदा नो गव्ये अश्व्ये वसौ दधः॥
verses.tr: kadā ta indra girvaṇaḥ stotā bhavāti śaṃtamaḥ kadā no gavye aśvye vasau dadhaḥ
verses.en: O Indra, Lover of the song, when shall thy praiser be most blest? When wilt thou grant us wealth in herds of kine and steeds?

verses.sa: उत ते सुष्टुता हरी वृषणा वहतो रथम् । अजुर्यस्य मदिन्तमं यमीमहे॥
verses.tr: uta te suṣṭutā harī vṛṣaṇā vahato ratham ajuryasya madintamaṃ yamīmahe
verses.en: And thy two highly-lauded Bays, strong stallions, draw thy car who art Untouched by age, most gladdening car for which we pray.

verses.sa: तमीमहे पुरुष्टुतं यह्वं प्रत्नाभिरूतिभिः । नि बर्हिषि प्रिये सददध द्विता॥
verses.tr: tamīmahe puruṣṭutaṃ yahvaṃ pratnābhirūtibhiḥ ni barhiṣi priye sadadadha dvitā
verses.en: With ancient offerings we implore the Young and Strong whom many praise. He from of old hath sat upon dear sacred grass.

verses.sa: वर्धस्वा सु पुरुष्टुत ऋषिष्टुताभिरूतिभिः । धुक्षस्व पिप्युषीमिषमवा च नः॥
verses.tr: vardhasvā su puruṣṭuta ṛṣiṣṭutābhirūtibhiḥ dhukṣasva pipyuṣīmiṣamavā ca naḥ
verses.en: Wax mighty, thou whom many laud for aids which Rsis have extolled. Pour down for us abundant food and guard us well.

verses.sa: इन्द्र त्वमवितेदसीत्था स्तुवतो अद्रिवः । ऋतादियर्मि ते धियं मनोयुजम्॥
verses.tr: indra tvamavitedasītthā stuvato adrivaḥ ṛtādiyarmi te dhiyaṃ manoyujam
verses.en: O Indra, Caster of the Stone, thou helpest him who praises thee: From sacrifice I send to thee a mind yoked hymn.

verses.sa: इह त्या सधमाद्या युजानः सोमपीतये । हरी इन्द्र प्रतद्वसू अभि स्वर॥
verses.tr: iha tyā sadhamādyā yujānaḥ somapītaye harī indra pratadvasū abhi svara
verses.en: Here, yoking for the Soma-draught these Horses, sharers of thy feast, Thy Bay Steeds, Indra, fraught with weal to, consent to come.

verses.sa: अभि स्वरन्तु ये तव रुद्रासः सक्षत श्रियम् । उतो मरुत्वतीर्विशो अभि प्रयः॥
verses.tr: abhi svarantu ye tava rudrāsaḥ sakṣata śriyam uto marutvatīrviśo abhi prayaḥ
verses.en: Attendants on thy glory, let the Rudras roar assent to thee, And all the Marut companies come to the feast.

verses.sa: इमा अस्य प्रतूर्तयः पदं जुषन्त यद्दिवि । नाभा यज्ञस्य सं दधुर्यथा विदे॥
verses.tr: imā asya pratūrtayaḥ padaṃ juṣanta yaddivi nābhā yajñasya saṃ dadhuryathā vide
verses.en: These his victorious followers bold in the heavens the place they love, Leagued in the heart of sacrifice, as well we know.

verses.sa: अयं दीर्घाय चक्षसे प्राचि प्रयत्यध्वरे । मिमीते यज्ञमानुषग्विचक्ष्य॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ dīrghāya cakṣase prāci prayatyadhvare mimīte yajñamānuṣagvicakṣya
verses.en: That we may long behold the light, what time the ordered rite proceeds, He duly measures, as he views, the sacrifice.

verses.sa: वृषायमिन्द्र ते रथ उतो ते वृषणा हरी । वृषा त्वं शतक्रतो वृषा हवः॥
verses.tr: vṛṣāyamindra te ratha uto te vṛṣaṇā harī vṛṣā tvaṃ śatakrato vṛṣā havaḥ
verses.en: O Indra, strong is this thy car, and strong are these Bay Steeds of thine: O Satakratu, thou art strong, strong is our call.

verses.sa: वृषा ग्रावा वृषा मदो वृषा सोमो अयं सुतः । वृषा यज्ञो यमिन्वसि वृषा हवः॥
verses.tr: vṛṣā grāvā vṛṣā mado vṛṣā somo ayaṃ sutaḥ vṛṣā yajño yaminvasi vṛṣā havaḥ
verses.en: Strong is the press-stone, strong thy joy, strong is the flowing Soma juice: Strong is the rite thou furtherest, strong is our call.

verses.sa: वृषा त्वा वृषणं हुवे वज्रिञ्चित्राभिरूतिभिः । वावन्थ हि प्रतिष्टुतिं वृषा हवः॥
verses.tr: vṛṣā tvā vṛṣaṇaṃ huve vajriñcitrābhirūtibhiḥ vāvantha hi pratiṣṭutiṃ vṛṣā havaḥ
verses.en: As strong I call on thee the Strong, O Thunderer with thy thousand aids: For thou hast won the hymn of praise. Strong is our call.

verses.sa: यदिन्द्राहं यथा त्वमीशीय वस्व एक इत् । स्तोता मे गोषखा स्यात्॥
verses.tr: yadindrāhaṃ yathā tvamīśīya vasva eka it stotā me goṣakhā syāt
verses.en: If I, O Indra, were, like thee, the single Sovran of all wealth, My worshipper should be rich in kine.

verses.sa: शिक्षेयमस्मै दित्सेयं शचीपते मनीषिणे । यदहं गोपतिः स्याम्॥
verses.tr: śikṣeyamasmai ditseyaṃ śacīpate manīṣiṇe yadahaṃ gopatiḥ syām
verses.en: I should be fain, O Lord of Power, to strengthen and enrich the sage, Were I the Lord of herds of kine.

verses.sa: धेनुष्ट इन्द्र सूनृता यजमानाय सुन्वते । गामश्वं पिप्युषी दुहे॥
verses.tr: dhenuṣṭa indra sūnṛtā yajamānāya sunvate gāmaśvaṃ pipyuṣī duhe
verses.en: To worshippers who press the juice thy goodness, Indra, is a cow Yielding in plenty kine and steeds.

verses.sa: न ते वर्तास्ति राधस इन्द्र देवो न मर्त्यः । यद्दित्ससि स्तुतो मघम्॥
verses.tr: na te vartāsti rādhasa indra devo na martyaḥ yadditsasi stuto magham
verses.en: None is there, Indra, God or man, to hinder thy munificence, The wealth which, lauded, thou wilt give.

verses.sa: यज्ञ इन्द्रमवर्धयद्यद्भूमिं व्यवर्तयत् । चक्राण ओपशं दिवि॥
verses.tr: yajña indramavardhayadyadbhūmiṃ vyavartayat cakrāṇa opaśaṃ divi
verses.en: The sacrifice made Indra strong when he unrolled the earth, and made Himself a diadem in heaven.

verses.sa: वावृधानस्य ते वयं विश्वा धनानि जिग्युषः । ऊतिमिन्द्रा वृणीमहे॥
verses.tr: vāvṛdhānasya te vayaṃ viśvā dhanāni jigyuṣaḥ ūtimindrā vṛṇīmahe
verses.en: Thine aid we claim, O Indra, thine who after thou hast waxen great Hast won all treasures for thine own.

verses.sa: व्य१न्तरिक्षमतिरन्मदे सोमस्य रोचना । इन्द्रो यदभिनद्वलम्॥
verses.tr: vya1ntarikṣamatiranmade somasya rocanā indro yadabhinadvalam
verses.en: In Soma's ecstasy Indra spread the firmament and realms of light, When he cleft Vala limb from limb.

verses.sa: उद्गा आजदङ्गिरोभ्य आविष्कृण्वन्गुहा सतीः । अर्वाञ्चं नुनुदे वलम्॥
verses.tr: udgā ājadaṅgirobhya āviṣkṛṇvanguhā satīḥ arvāñcaṃ nunude valam
verses.en: Showing the hidden he drave forth the cows for the Angirases, And Vala he cast headlong down.

verses.sa: इन्द्रेण रोचना दिवो दृळ्हानि दृंहितानि च । स्थिराणि न पराणुदे॥
verses.tr: indreṇa rocanā divo dṛḻhāni dṛṃhitāni ca sthirāṇi na parāṇude
verses.en: By Indra were the luminous realms of heaven established and secured, Firm and immovable from their place.

verses.sa: अपामूर्मिर्मदन्निव स्तोम इन्द्राजिरायते । वि ते मदा अराजिषुः॥
verses.tr: apāmūrmirmadanniva stoma indrājirāyate vi te madā arājiṣuḥ
verses.en: Indra, thy laud moves quickly like a joyous wave of water-floods: Bright shine the drops that gladden thee.

verses.sa: त्वं हि स्तोमवर्धन इन्द्रास्युक्थवर्धनः । स्तोतॄणामुत भद्रकृत्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ hi stomavardhana indrāsyukthavardhanaḥ stotṝṇāmuta bhadrakṛt
verses.en: For thou, O Indra, art the God whom hymns and praises magnify: Thou blessest those who worship thee.

verses.sa: इन्द्रमित्केशिना हरी सोमपेयाय वक्षतः । उप यज्ञं सुराधसम्॥
verses.tr: indramitkeśinā harī somapeyāya vakṣataḥ upa yajñaṃ surādhasam
verses.en: Let the two long-maned Bay Steeds bring Indra to drink the Soma juice, The Bountiful to our sacrifice.

verses.sa: अपां फेनेन नमुचेः शिर इन्द्रोदवर्तयः । विश्वा यदजयः स्पृधः॥
verses.tr: apāṃ phenena namuceḥ śira indrodavartayaḥ viśvā yadajayaḥ spṛdhaḥ
verses.en: With waters' foam thou torest off, Indra, the head of Namuci, Subduing all contending hosts.

verses.sa: मायाभिरुत्सिसृप्सत इन्द्र द्यामारुरुक्षतः । अव दस्यूँरधूनुथाः॥
verses.tr: māyābhirutsisṛpsata indra dyāmārurukṣataḥ ava dasyūṃradhūnuthāḥ
verses.en: The Dasyus, when they fain would climb by magic arts and mount to heaven, Thou, Indra, castest down to earth.

verses.sa: असुन्वामिन्द्र संसदं विषूचीं व्यनाशयः । सोमपा उत्तरो भवन्॥
verses.tr: asunvāmindra saṃsadaṃ viṣūcīṃ vyanāśayaḥ somapā uttaro bhavan
verses.en: As Soma-drinker conquering all, thou scatteredst to every side Their settlement who poured no gifts.

verses.sa: तम्वभि प्र गायत पुरुहूतं पुरुष्टुतम् । इन्द्रं गीर्भिस्तविषमा विवासत॥
verses.tr: tamvabhi pra gāyata puruhūtaṃ puruṣṭutam indraṃ gīrbhistaviṣamā vivāsata
verses.en: Sing forth to him whom many men invoke, to him whom many laud. Invite the powerful Indra with your songs of praise.

verses.sa: यस्य द्विबर्हसो बृहत्सहो दाधार रोदसी । गिरीँरज्राँ अपः स्वर्वृषत्वना॥
verses.tr: yasya dvibarhaso bṛhatsaho dādhāra rodasī girīṃrajrāṃ apaḥ svarvṛṣatvanā
verses.en: Whose lofty might-for doubly strong is he-supports the heavens and earth, And hills and plains and floods and light with manly power.

verses.sa: स राजसि पुरुष्टुतँ एको वृत्राणि जिघ्नसे । इन्द्र जैत्रा श्रवस्या च यन्तवे॥
verses.tr: sa rājasi puruṣṭutaṃ eko vṛtrāṇi jighnase indra jaitrā śravasyā ca yantave
verses.en: Such, Praised by many! thou art King alone thou smitest Vrtras dead, To gain, O Indra, spoils of war and high renown.

verses.sa: तं ते मदं गृणीमसि वृषणं पृत्सु सासहिम् । उ लोककृत्नुमद्रिवो हरिश्रियम्॥
verses.tr: taṃ te madaṃ gṛṇīmasi vṛṣaṇaṃ pṛtsu sāsahim u lokakṛtnumadrivo hariśriyam
verses.en: We sing this strong and wild delight of thine which conquers in the fray, Which, Caster of the Stone! gives room and shines like gold.

verses.sa: येन ज्योतींष्यायवे मनवे च विवेदिथ । मन्दानो अस्य बर्हिषो वि राजसि॥
verses.tr: yena jyotīṃṣyāyave manave ca viveditha mandāno asya barhiṣo vi rājasi
verses.en: Wherewith thou also foundest lights for Ayu and for Manu's sake: Now joying in this sacred grass thou beamest forth.

verses.sa: तदद्या चित्त उक्थिनोऽनु ष्टुवन्ति पूर्वथा । वृषपत्नीरपो जया दिवेदिवे॥
verses.tr: tadadyā citta ukthino'nu ṣṭuvanti pūrvathā vṛṣapatnīrapo jayā divedive
verses.en: This day too singers of the hymn praise, as of old, this might of thine: Win thou the waters day by day, thralls of the strong.

verses.sa: तव त्यदिन्द्रियं बृहत्तव शुष्ममुत क्रतुम् । वज्रं शिशाति धिषणा वरेण्यम्॥
verses.tr: tava tyadindriyaṃ bṛhattava śuṣmamuta kratum vajraṃ śiśāti dhiṣaṇā vareṇyam
verses.en: That lofty Indra-power of thine, thy strength and thine intelligence, Thy thunderbolt for which we long, the wish makes keen.

verses.sa: तव द्यौरिन्द्र पौंस्यं पृथिवी वर्धति श्रवः । त्वामापः पर्वतासश्च हिन्विरे॥
verses.tr: tava dyaurindra pauṃsyaṃ pṛthivī vardhati śravaḥ tvāmāpaḥ parvatāsaśca hinvire
verses.en: O Indra, Heaven and Earth augment thy manly power and thy renown; The waters and thy mountains stir and urge thee on.

verses.sa: त्वां विष्णुर्बृहन्क्षयो मित्रो गृणाति वरुणः । त्वां शर्धो मदत्यनु मारुतम्॥
verses.tr: tvāṃ viṣṇurbṛhankṣayo mitro gṛṇāti varuṇaḥ tvāṃ śardho madatyanu mārutam
verses.en: Visnu the lofty ruling Power, Varuna, Mitra sing thy praise: In thee the Marut3' company have great delight.

verses.sa: त्वं वृषा जनानां मंहिष्ठ इन्द्र जज्ञिषे । सत्रा विश्वा स्वपत्यानि दधिषे॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ vṛṣā janānāṃ maṃhiṣṭha indra jajñiṣe satrā viśvā svapatyāni dadhiṣe
verses.en: O Indra, thou wast born the Lord of men, most liberal of thy gifts: Excellent deeds for evermore are all thine own.

verses.sa: सत्रा त्वं पुरुष्टुतँ एको वृत्राणि तोशसे । नान्य इन्द्रात्करणं भूय इन्वति॥
verses.tr: satrā tvaṃ puruṣṭutaṃ eko vṛtrāṇi tośase nānya indrātkaraṇaṃ bhūya invati
verses.en: Ever, alone, O highly-praised, thou sendest Vrtras to their rest: None else than Indra executes the mighty deed.

verses.sa: यदिन्द्र मन्मशस्त्वा नाना हवन्त ऊतये । अस्माकेभिर्नृभिरत्रा स्वर्जय॥
verses.tr: yadindra manmaśastvā nānā havanta ūtaye asmākebhirnṛbhiratrā svarjaya
verses.en: Though here and there, in varied hymns, Indra, men call on thee for aid, Still with our heroes fight and win the light of heaven.

verses.sa: अरं क्षयाय नो महे विश्वा रूपाण्याविशन् । इन्द्रं जैत्राय हर्षया शचीपतिम्॥
verses.tr: araṃ kṣayāya no mahe viśvā rūpāṇyāviśan indraṃ jaitrāya harṣayā śacīpatim
verses.en: Already have all forms of him entered our spacious dwelling-place: For victory stir thou Indra, up, the Lord of Might.

verses.sa: प्र सम्राजं चर्षणीनामिन्द्रं स्तोता नव्यं गीर्भिः । नरं नृषाहं मंहिष्ठम्॥
verses.tr: pra samrājaṃ carṣaṇīnāmindraṃ stotā navyaṃ gīrbhiḥ naraṃ nṛṣāhaṃ maṃhiṣṭham
verses.en: Praise Indra whom our songs must laud, sole Sovran of mankind, the Chief Most liberal who controlleth men.

verses.sa: यस्मिन्नुक्थानि रण्यन्ति विश्वानि च श्रवस्या । अपामवो न समुद्रे॥
verses.tr: yasminnukthāni raṇyanti viśvāni ca śravasyā apāmavo na samudre
verses.en: In whom the hymns of praise delight, and all the glory-giving songs. Like the floods' longing for the sea.

verses.sa: तं सुष्टुत्या विवासे ज्येष्ठराजं भरे कृत्नुम् । महो वाजिनं सनिभ्यः॥
verses.tr: taṃ suṣṭutyā vivāse jyeṣṭharājaṃ bhare kṛtnum maho vājinaṃ sanibhyaḥ
verses.en: Him I invite with eulogy, best King, effective in the fight, Strong for the gain of mighty spoil.

verses.sa: यस्यानूना गभीरा मदा उरवस्तरुत्राः । हर्षुमन्तः शूरसातौ॥
verses.tr: yasyānūnā gabhīrā madā uravastarutrāḥ harṣumantaḥ śūrasātau
verses.en: Whose perfect ecstasies are wide, profound, victorious, and give joy in the field where heroes win.

verses.sa: तमिद्धनेषु हितेष्वधिवाकाय हवन्ते । येषामिन्द्रस्ते जयन्ति॥
verses.tr: tamiddhaneṣu hiteṣvadhivākāya havante yeṣāmindraste jayanti
verses.en: Him, when the spoils of war are staked, men call to be their advocate: They who have Indra win the day.

verses.sa: तमिच्च्यौत्नैरार्यन्ति तं कृतेभिश्चर्षणयः । एष इन्द्रो वरिवस्कृत्॥
verses.tr: tamiccyautnairāryanti taṃ kṛtebhiścarṣaṇayaḥ eṣa indro varivaskṛt
verses.en: Men honour him with stirring songs and magnify with solemn rites: Indra is he who giveth case.

verses.sa: इन्द्रो ब्रह्मेन्द्र ऋषिरिन्द्रः पुरू पुरुहूतः । महान्महीभिः शचीभिः॥
verses.tr: indro brahmendra ṛṣirindraḥ purū puruhūtaḥ mahānmahībhiḥ śacībhiḥ
verses.en: 1ndra is priest and Rsi, he is much invoked by many men, And mighty by his mighty powers.

verses.sa: स स्तोम्यः स हव्यः सत्यः सत्वा तुविकूर्मिः । एकश्चित्सन्नभिभूतिः॥
verses.tr: sa stomyaḥ sa havyaḥ satyaḥ satvā tuvikūrmiḥ ekaścitsannabhibhūtiḥ
verses.en: Meet to be lauded and invoked, true Hero with his deeds of might, Victorious even when alone.

verses.sa: तमर्केभिस्तं सामभिस्तं गायत्रैश्चर्षणयः । इन्द्रं वर्धन्ति क्षितयः॥
verses.tr: tamarkebhistaṃ sāmabhistaṃ gāyatraiścarṣaṇayaḥ indraṃ vardhanti kṣitayaḥ
verses.en: The men, the people magnify that Indra with their Slina. songs, With hymns and sacred eulogies

verses.sa: प्रणेतारं वस्यो अच्छा कर्तारं ज्योतिः समत्सु । सासह्वांसं युधामित्रान्॥
verses.tr: praṇetāraṃ vasyo acchā kartāraṃ jyotiḥ samatsu sāsahvāṃsaṃ yudhāmitrān
verses.en: Him who advances them to wealth, sends light to lead them in the war, And quells their foemen in the fray.

verses.sa: स नः पप्रिः पारयाति स्वस्ति नावा पुरुहूतः । इन्द्रो विश्वा अति द्विषः॥
verses.tr: sa naḥ papriḥ pārayāti svasti nāvā puruhūtaḥ indro viśvā ati dviṣaḥ
verses.en: May he, the saviour much-invoked, may Indra bear us in a ship Safely beyond all enemies.

verses.sa: स त्वं न इन्द्र वाजेभिर्दशस्या च गातुया च । अच्छा च नः सुम्नं नेषि॥
verses.tr: sa tvaṃ na indra vājebhirdaśasyā ca gātuyā ca acchā ca naḥ sumnaṃ neṣi
verses.en: As such, O Indra, honour us with gifts of booty, further us, And lead us to felicity.

verses.sa: आ याहि सुषुमा हि त इन्द्र सोमं पिबा इमम् । एदं बर्हिः सदो मम॥
verses.tr: ā yāhi suṣumā hi ta indra somaṃ pibā imam edaṃ barhiḥ sado mama
verses.en: Come, we have pressed the juice for thee; O Indra, drink this Soma here Sit thou on this my sacred grass.

verses.sa: आ त्वा ब्रह्मयुजा हरी वहतामिन्द्र केशिना । उप ब्रह्माणि नः शृणु॥
verses.tr: ā tvā brahmayujā harī vahatāmindra keśinā upa brahmāṇi naḥ śṛṇu
verses.en: O Indra, let thy long-maned Bays, yoked by prayer, bring thee hitherward Give car and listen to our prayers.

verses.sa: ब्रह्माणस्त्वा वयं युजा सोमपामिन्द्र सोमिनः । सुतावन्तो हवामहे॥
verses.tr: brahmāṇastvā vayaṃ yujā somapāmindra sominaḥ sutāvanto havāmahe
verses.en: We Soma-bearing Brahmans call thee Soma-drinker with thy friend, We, Indra, bringing Soma juice.

verses.sa: आ नो याहि सुतावतोऽस्माकं सुष्टुतीरुप । पिबा सु शिप्रिन्नन्धसः॥
verses.tr: ā no yāhi sutāvato'smākaṃ suṣṭutīrupa pibā su śiprinnandhasaḥ
verses.en: Come unto us who bring the juice, come unto this our eulogy, Fair-visored! drink thou of the juice.

verses.sa: आ ते सिञ्चामि कुक्ष्योरनु गात्रा वि धावतु । गृभाय जिह्वया मधु॥
verses.tr: ā te siñcāmi kukṣyoranu gātrā vi dhāvatu gṛbhāya jihvayā madhu
verses.en: I pour it down within thee, so through all thy members let it spread: Take with. thy tongue the pleasant drink.

verses.sa: स्वादुष्टे अस्तु संसुदे मधुमान्तन्वे३ तव । सोमः शमस्तु ते हृदे॥
verses.tr: svāduṣṭe astu saṃsude madhumāntanve3 tava somaḥ śamastu te hṛde
verses.en: Sweet to thy body let it be, delicious be the savoury juice: Sweet be the Soma to thine heart.

verses.sa: अयमु त्वा विचर्षणे जनीरिवाभि संवृतः । प्र सोम इन्द्र सर्पतु॥
verses.tr: ayamu tvā vicarṣaṇe janīrivābhi saṃvṛtaḥ pra soma indra sarpatu
verses.en: Like women, let this Soma-draught, invested with its robe, approach, O active Indra, close to thee.

verses.sa: तुविग्रीवो वपोदरः सुबाहुरन्धसो मदे । इन्द्रो वृत्राणि जिघ्नते॥
verses.tr: tuvigrīvo vapodaraḥ subāhurandhaso made indro vṛtrāṇi jighnate
verses.en: Indra, transported with the juice, vast in his bulk, strong in his neck And stout arms, smites the Vrtras down.

verses.sa: इन्द्र प्रेहि पुरस्त्वं विश्वस्येशान ओजसा । वृत्राणि वृत्रहञ्जहि॥
verses.tr: indra prehi purastvaṃ viśvasyeśāna ojasā vṛtrāṇi vṛtrahañjahi
verses.en: O Indra, go thou forward, thou who rulest over all by might: Thou Vrtra-slayer slay the fiends,

verses.sa: दीर्घस्ते अस्त्वङ्कुशो येना वसु प्रयच्छसि । यजमानाय सुन्वते॥
verses.tr: dīrghaste astvaṅkuśo yenā vasu prayacchasi yajamānāya sunvate
verses.en: Long be thy grasping-hook wherewith thou givest ample wealth to him Who sheds the juice and worships thee.

verses.sa: अयं त इन्द्र सोमो निपूतो अधि बर्हिषि । एहीमस्य द्रवा पिब॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ ta indra somo nipūto adhi barhiṣi ehīmasya dravā piba
verses.en: Here, Indra, is thy Soma-draught, made pure upon the sacred grass: Run hither, come and drink thereof.

verses.sa: शाचिगो शाचिपूजनाऽयं रणाय ते सुतः । आखण्डल प्र हूयसे॥
verses.tr: śācigo śācipūjanā'yaṃ raṇāya te sutaḥ ākhaṇḍala pra hūyase
verses.en: Famed for thy radiance, worshipped well this juice is shed for thy delight Thou art invoked, Âkhaṇḍala!

verses.sa: यस्ते शृङ्गवृषो नपात्प्रणपात्कुण्डपाय्यः । न्यस्मिन्दध्र आ मनः॥
verses.tr: yaste śṛṅgavṛṣo napātpraṇapātkuṇḍapāyyaḥ nyasmindadhra ā manaḥ
verses.en: To Kundapayya, grandson's son, grandson of Ṣringavṛish! to thee, To him have I addressed my thought.

verses.sa: वास्तोष्पते ध्रुवा स्थूणांऽसत्रं सोम्यानाम् । द्रप्सो भेत्ता पुरां शश्वतीनामिन्द्रो मुनीनां सखा॥
verses.tr: vāstoṣpate dhruvā sthūṇāṃ'satraṃ somyānām drapso bhettā purāṃ śaśvatīnāmindro munīnāṃ sakhā
verses.en: Strong pillar thou, Lord of the home armour of Soma-offerers: The drop of Soma breaketh all the strongholds down, and Indra is the Rsis' Friend.

verses.sa: पृदाकुसानुर्यजतो गवेषण एकः सन्नभि भूयसः । भूर्णिमश्वं नयत्तुजा पुरो गृभेन्द्रं सोमस्य पीतये॥
verses.tr: pṛdākusānuryajato gaveṣaṇa ekaḥ sannabhi bhūyasaḥ bhūrṇimaśvaṃ nayattujā puro gṛbhendraṃ somasya pītaye
verses.en: Holy Pṛidâkusânu, winner of the spoil, one eminent o'er many men, Lead on the wild horse Indra with his vigorous grasp forward to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa: इदं ह नूनमेषां सुम्नं भिक्षेत मर्त्यः । आदित्यानामपूर्व्यं सवीमनि॥
verses.tr: idaṃ ha nūnameṣāṃ sumnaṃ bhikṣeta martyaḥ ādityānāmapūrvyaṃ savīmani
verses.en: Now let the mortal offer prayer to win the unexampled grace Of these Adityas and their aid to cherish life.

verses.sa: अनर्वाणो ह्येषां पन्था आदित्यानाम् । अदब्धाः सन्ति पायवः सुगेवृधः॥
verses.tr: anarvāṇo hyeṣāṃ panthā ādityānām adabdhāḥ santi pāyavaḥ sugevṛdhaḥ
verses.en: For not an enemy molests the paths which these Adityas tread: Infallible guards, they strengthen us in happiness.

verses.sa: तत्सु नः सविता भगो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा । शर्म यच्छन्तु सप्रथो यदीमहे॥
verses.tr: tatsu naḥ savitā bhago varuṇo mitro aryamā śarma yacchantu sapratho yadīmahe
verses.en: Now soon may Bhaga, Savitar, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman Give us the shelter widely spread which we implore.

verses.sa: देवेभिर्देव्यदितेऽरिष्टभर्मन्ना गहि । स्मत्सूरिभिः पुरुप्रिये सुशर्मभिः॥
verses.tr: devebhirdevyadite'riṣṭabharmannā gahi smatsūribhiḥ purupriye suśarmabhiḥ
verses.en: With Gods come thou whose fostering care none checks, O Goddesss Aditi: Come, dear to many, with the Lords who guard us well.

verses.sa: ते हि पुत्रासो अदितेर्विदुर्द्वेषांसि योतवे । अंहोश्चिदुरुचक्रयोऽनेहसः॥
verses.tr: te hi putrāso aditervidurdveṣāṃsi yotave aṃhościdurucakrayo'nehasaḥ
verses.en: For well these Sons of Aditi know to keep enmities aloof, Unrivalled, giving ample room, they save from woe.

verses.sa: अदितिर्नो दिवा पशुमदितिर्नक्तमद्वयाः । अदितिः पात्वंहसः सदावृधा॥
verses.tr: aditirno divā paśumaditirnaktamadvayāḥ aditiḥ pātvaṃhasaḥ sadāvṛdhā
verses.en: Aditi guard our herd by day, Aditi, free from guile, by night, Aditi, ever strengthening, save us from grief!

verses.sa: उत स्या नो दिवा मतिरदितिरूत्या गमत् । सा शंताति मयस्करदप स्रिधः॥
verses.tr: uta syā no divā matiraditirūtyā gamat sā śaṃtāti mayaskaradapa sridhaḥ
verses.en: And in the day our hymn is this: May Aditi come nigh to help, With loving-kindness bring us weal and chase our foes.

verses.sa: उत त्या दैव्या भिषजा शं नः करतो अश्विना । युयुयातामितो रपो अप स्रिधः॥
verses.tr: uta tyā daivyā bhiṣajā śaṃ naḥ karato aśvinā yuyuyātāmito rapo apa sridhaḥ
verses.en: And may the Asvins, the divine Pair of Physicians, send us health: May they remove iniquity and chase our foes.

verses.sa: शमग्निरग्निभिः करच्छं नस्तपतु सूर्यः । शं वातो वात्वरपा अप स्रिधः॥
verses.tr: śamagniragnibhiḥ karacchaṃ nastapatu sūryaḥ śaṃ vāto vātvarapā apa sridhaḥ
verses.en: May Agni bless us with his fires, and Surya warm us pleasantly: May the pure Wind breathe sweet on us, and chase our foes.

verses.sa: अपामीवामप स्रिधमप सेधत दुर्मतिम् । आदित्यासो युयोतना नो अंहसः॥
verses.tr: apāmīvāmapa sridhamapa sedhata durmatim ādityāso yuyotanā no aṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Drive ye disease and strife away, drive ye away malignity: Adityas, keep us ever far from sore distress.

verses.sa: युयोता शरुमस्मदाँ आदित्यास उतामतिम् । ऋधग्द्वेषः कृणुत विश्ववेदसः॥
verses.tr: yuyotā śarumasmadāṃ ādityāsa utāmatim ṛdhagdveṣaḥ kṛṇuta viśvavedasaḥ
verses.en: Remove from us the arrow, keep famine, Adityas! far away: Keep enmities afar from us, Lords of all wealth!

verses.sa: तत्सु नः शर्म यच्छताऽऽदित्या यन्मुमोचति । एनस्वन्तं चिदेनसः सुदानवः॥
verses.tr: tatsu naḥ śarma yacchatā''dityā yanmumocati enasvantaṃ cidenasaḥ sudānavaḥ
verses.en: Now, O Adityas, grant to us the shelter that lets man go free, Yea, even the sinner from his sin, ye Bounteous Gods 1

verses.sa: यो नः कश्चिद्रिरिक्षति रक्षस्त्वेन मर्त्यः । स्वैः ष एवै रिरिषीष्ट युर्जनः॥
verses.tr: yo naḥ kaścidririkṣati rakṣastvena martyaḥ svaiḥ ṣa evai ririṣīṣṭa yurjanaḥ
verses.en: Whatever mortal with the powe r of demons fain would injure us, May he, impetuous, suffer harm by his own deeds.

verses.sa: समित्तमघमश्नवद्दुःशंसं मर्त्यं रिपुम् । यो अस्मत्रा दुर्हणावाँ उप द्वयुः॥
verses.tr: samittamaghamaśnavadduḥśaṃsaṃ martyaṃ ripum yo asmatrā durhaṇāvāṃ upa dvayuḥ
verses.en: May sin o'ertake our human foe, the man who speaketh evil thing, Him who would cause our misery, whose heart is false.

verses.sa: पाकत्रा स्थन देवा हृत्सु जानीथ मर्त्यम् । उप द्वयुं चाद्वयुं च वसवः॥
verses.tr: pākatrā sthana devā hṛtsu jānītha martyam upa dvayuṃ cādvayuṃ ca vasavaḥ
verses.en: Gods, ye are with the simple ones, ye know each mortal in your hearts; Ye, Vasus, well discriminate the false and true.

verses.sa: आ शर्म पर्वतानामोतापां वृणीमहे । द्यावाक्षामारे अस्मद्रपस्कृतम्॥
verses.tr: ā śarma parvatānāmotāpāṃ vṛṇīmahe dyāvākṣāmāre asmadrapaskṛtam
verses.en: Fain would we have the sheltering aid of mountains and of water-floods: Keep far from us iniquity, O Heaven and Earth.

verses.sa: ते नो भद्रेण शर्मणा युष्माकं नावा वसवः । अति विश्वानि दुरिता पिपर्तन॥
verses.tr: te no bhadreṇa śarmaṇā yuṣmākaṃ nāvā vasavaḥ ati viśvāni duritā pipartana
verses.en: So with auspicious sheltering aid do ye, O Vasus, carry us Beyond all trouble and distress, borne in your ship.

verses.sa: तुचे तनाय तत्सु नो द्राघीय आयुर्जीवसे । आदित्यासः सुमहसः कृणोतन॥
verses.tr: tuce tanāya tatsu no drāghīya āyurjīvase ādityāsaḥ sumahasaḥ kṛṇotana
verses.en: Adityas, ye Most Mighty Ones, grant to our children and their seed Extended term of life that they may live long days.

verses.sa: यज्ञो हीळो वो अन्तर आदित्या अस्ति मृळत । युष्मे इद्वो अपि ष्मसि सजात्ये॥
verses.tr: yajño hīḻo vo antara ādityā asti mṛḻata yuṣme idvo api ṣmasi sajātye
verses.en: Sacrifice, O Adityas, is your inward monitor: be kind, For in the bond of kindred we are bound to you.

verses.sa: बृहद्वरूथं मरुतां देवं त्रातारमश्विना । मित्रमीमहे वरुणं स्वस्तये॥
verses.tr: bṛhadvarūthaṃ marutāṃ devaṃ trātāramaśvinā mitramīmahe varuṇaṃ svastaye
verses.en: The Maruts' high protecting aid, the Asvins, and the God who saves, Mitra and Varuna for weal we supplicate.

verses.sa: अनेहो मित्रार्यमन्नृवद्वरुण शंस्यम् । त्रिवरूथं मरुतो यन्त नश्छर्दिः॥
verses.tr: aneho mitrāryamannṛvadvaruṇa śaṃsyam trivarūthaṃ maruto yanta naśchardiḥ
verses.en: Grant us a home with triple guard, Aryaman, Mitra, Varuna! Unthreatened, Maruts! meet for praise, and filled with men.

verses.sa: ये चिद्धि मृत्युबन्धव आदित्या मनवः स्मसि । प्र सू न आयुर्जीवसे तिरेतन॥
verses.tr: ye ciddhi mṛtyubandhava ādityā manavaḥ smasi pra sū na āyurjīvase tiretana
verses.en: And as we human beings, O Adityas, are akin to death, Graciously lengthen ye our lives that we may live.

verses.sa: तं गूर्धया स्वर्णरं देवासो देवमरतिं दधन्विरे । देवत्रा हव्यमोहिरे॥
verses.tr: taṃ gūrdhayā svarṇaraṃ devāso devamaratiṃ dadhanvire devatrā havyamohire
verses.en: Sing praise to him, the Lord of Light. The Gods have made the God to be their messenger, And sent oblation to Gods.

verses.sa: विभूतरातिं विप्र चित्रशोचिषमग्निमीळिष्व यन्तुरम् । अस्य मेधस्य सोम्यस्य सोभरे प्रेमध्वराय पूर्व्यम्॥
verses.tr: vibhūtarātiṃ vipra citraśociṣamagnimīḻiṣva yanturam asya medhasya somyasya sobhare premadhvarāya pūrvyam
verses.en: Agni, the Bounteous Giver, bright with varied flames, laud thou, O singer Sobhari- Him who controls this sacred food with Soma blent, who hath first claim to sacrifice.

verses.sa: यजिष्ठं त्वा ववृमहे देवं देवत्रा होतारममर्त्यम् । अस्य यज्ञस्य सुक्रतुम्॥
verses.tr: yajiṣṭhaṃ tvā vavṛmahe devaṃ devatrā hotāramamartyam asya yajñasya sukratum
verses.en: Thee have we chosen skill fullest in sacrifice, Immortal Priest among the Gods, Wise finisher of this holy rite:

verses.sa: ऊर्जो नपातं सुभगं सुदीदितिमग्निं श्रेष्ठशोचिषम् । स नो मित्रस्य वरुणस्य सो अपामा सुम्नं यक्षते दिवि॥
verses.tr: ūrjo napātaṃ subhagaṃ sudīditimagniṃ śreṣṭhaśociṣam sa no mitrasya varuṇasya so apāmā sumnaṃ yakṣate divi
verses.en: The Son of Strength, the blessed, brightly shining One, Agni whose light is excellent. May be by sacrifice win us in heaven the grace of Mitra, Varuna, and the Floods.

verses.sa: यः समिधा य आहुती यो वेदेन ददाश मर्तो अग्नये । यो नमसा स्वध्वरः॥
verses.tr: yaḥ samidhā ya āhutī yo vedena dadāśa marto agnaye yo namasā svadhvaraḥ
verses.en: The mortal who hath ministered to Agni with oblation, fuel, ritual lore, And reverence, skilled in sacrifice.

verses.sa: तस्येदर्वन्तो रंहयन्त आशवस्तस्य द्युम्नितमं यशः । न तमंहो देवकृतं कुतश्चन न मर्त्यकृतं नशत्॥
verses.tr: tasyedarvanto raṃhayanta āśavastasya dyumnitamaṃ yaśaḥ na tamaṃho devakṛtaṃ kutaścana na martyakṛtaṃ naśat
verses.en: Verily swift to run are his fleet-footed steeds, and most resplendent fame is his. No trouble caused by Gods or wrought by mortal man from any side o'ertaketh him.

verses.sa: स्वग्नयो वो अग्निभिः स्याम सूनो सहस ऊर्जां पते । सुवीरस्त्वमस्मयुः॥
verses.tr: svagnayo vo agnibhiḥ syāma sūno sahasa ūrjāṃ pate suvīrastvamasmayuḥ
verses.en: May we by thine own fires be well supplied with fire, O Son of Strength, O Lord of Might: Thou as our Friend hast worthy men.

verses.sa: प्रशंसमानो अतिथिर्न मित्रियोऽग्नी रथो न वेद्यः । त्वे क्षेमासो अपि सन्ति साधवस्त्वं राजा रयीणाम्॥
verses.tr: praśaṃsamāno atithirna mitriyo'gnī ratho na vedyaḥ tve kṣemāso api santi sādhavastvaṃ rājā rayīṇām
verses.en: Agni, who praises like a guest of friendly mind, is as a car that brings us gear. Also in thee is found perfect security thou art the Sovran Lord of wealth.

verses.sa: सो अद्धा दाश्वध्वरोऽग्ने मर्तः सुभग स प्रशंस्यः । स धीभिरस्तु सनिता॥
verses.tr: so addhā dāśvadhvaro'gne martaḥ subhaga sa praśaṃsyaḥ sa dhībhirastu sanitā
verses.en: That man, moreover, merits praise who brings, auspicious Agni, sacrificial gifts May he win riches by his thoughts.

verses.sa:
यस्य त्वमूर्ध्वो अध्वराय तिष्ठसि क्षयद्वीरः स साधते ।
सो अर्वद्भिः सनिता स विपन्युभिः स शूरैः सनिता कृतम्॥
verses.tr: yasya tvamūrdhvo adhvarāya tiṣṭhasi kṣayadvīraḥ sa sādhate so arvadbhiḥ sanitā sa vipanyubhiḥ sa śūraiḥ sanitā kṛtam
verses.en: He for whose sacrifice thou standest up erect is prosperous and rules o'er men. He wins with coursers and with singers killed in song: with heroes he obtains the prize.

verses.sa: यस्याग्निर्वपुर्गृहे स्तोमं चनो दधीत विश्ववार्यः । हव्या वा वेविषद्विषः॥
verses.tr: yasyāgnirvapurgṛhe stomaṃ cano dadhīta viśvavāryaḥ havyā vā veviṣadviṣaḥ
verses.en: He in whose dwelling Agni is chief ornament, and, all-desired, loves his laud well, And zealously tends his offerings-

verses.sa: विप्रस्य वा स्तुवतः सहसो यहो मक्षूतमस्य रातिषु । अवोदेवमुपरिमर्त्यं कृधि वसो विविदुषो वचः॥
verses.tr: viprasya vā stuvataḥ sahaso yaho makṣūtamasya rātiṣu avodevamuparimartyaṃ kṛdhi vaso vividuṣo vacaḥ
verses.en: His, or the lauding sage's word, his, Son of Strength! who Is most prompt with sacred gifts, Set thou beneath the Gods, Vasu, above mankind, the speech of the intelligent.

verses.sa: यो अग्निं हव्यदातिभिर्नमोभिर्वा सुदक्षमाविवासति । गिरा वाजिरशोचिषम्॥
verses.tr: yo agniṃ havyadātibhirnamobhirvā sudakṣamāvivāsati girā vājiraśociṣam
verses.en: He who with sacrificial gifts or homage bringeth very skilful Agni nigh, Or him who flashes fast with song,

verses.sa:
समिधा यो निशिती दाशददितिं धामभिरस्य मर्त्यः ।
विश्वेत्स धीभिः सुभगो जनाँ अति द्युम्नैरुद्न इव तारिषत्॥
verses.tr: samidhā yo niśitī dāśadaditiṃ dhāmabhirasya martyaḥ viśvetsa dhībhiḥ subhago janāṃ ati dyumnairudna iva tāriṣat
verses.en: The mortal who with blazing fuel, as his laws command, adores the Perfect God, Blest with his thoughts in splendour shall exceed all men, as though he overpassed the floods.

verses.sa: तदग्ने द्युम्नमा भर यत्सासहत्सदने कं चिदत्रिणम् । मन्युं जनस्य दूढ्यः॥
verses.tr: tadagne dyumnamā bhara yatsāsahatsadane kaṃ cidatriṇam manyuṃ janasya dūḍhyaḥ
verses.en: Give us the splendour, Agni, which may overcome each greedy fiend in our abode, The wrath of evil-hearted folk.

verses.sa: येन चष्टे वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा येन नासत्या भगः । वयं तत्ते शवसा गातुवित्तमा इन्द्रत्वोता विधेमहि॥
verses.tr: yena caṣṭe varuṇo mitro aryamā yena nāsatyā bhagaḥ vayaṃ tatte śavasā gātuvittamā indratvotā vidhemahi
verses.en: That, wherewith Mitra, Varuna, and Aryaman, the Asvins, Bhaga give us light, That may we, by thy power finding best furtherance, worship, O Indra, helped by thee.

verses.sa: ते घेदग्ने स्वाध्यो३ ये त्वा विप्र निदधिरे नृचक्षसम् । विप्रासो देव सुक्रतुम्॥
verses.tr: te ghedagne svādhyo3 ye tvā vipra nidadhire nṛcakṣasam viprāso deva sukratum
verses.en: O Agni, most devout are they, the sages who have set thee Sage exceeding wise, O God, for men to look upon:

verses.sa: त इद्वेदिं सुभग त आहुतिं ते सोतुं चक्रिरे दिवि । त इद्वाजेभिर्जिग्युर्महद्धनं ये त्वे कामं न्येरिरे॥
verses.tr: ta idvediṃ subhaga ta āhutiṃ te sotuṃ cakrire divi ta idvājebhirjigyurmahaddhanaṃ ye tve kāmaṃ nyerire
verses.en: Who have arranged thine altar Blessed God, at morn brought thine oblation, pressed the juice. They by their deeds of strength have won diem, mighty wealth, who have set all their hope in thee.

verses.sa: भद्रो नो अग्निराहुतो भद्रा रातिः सुभग भद्रो अध्वरः । भद्रा उत प्रशस्तयः॥
verses.tr: bhadro no agnirāhuto bhadrā rātiḥ subhaga bhadro adhvaraḥ bhadrā uta praśastayaḥ
verses.en: May Agni worshipped bring us bliss, may the gift, Blessed One, and sacrifice bring bliss; Yea, may our praises bring us bliss.

verses.sa: भद्रं मनः कृणुष्व वृत्रतूर्ये येना समत्सु सासहः । अव स्थिरा तनुहि भूरि शर्धतां वनेमा ते अभिष्टिभिः॥
verses.tr: bhadraṃ manaḥ kṛṇuṣva vṛtratūrye yenā samatsu sāsahaḥ ava sthirā tanuhi bhūri śardhatāṃ vanemā te abhiṣṭibhiḥ
verses.en: Show forth the mind that brings success in war with fiends, wherewith thou conquerest in fight. Bring down the many firm hopes of our enemies, and let us vanquish with thine aid.

verses.sa: ईळे गिरा मनुर्हितं यं देवा दूतमरतिं न्येरिरे । यजिष्ठं हव्यवाहनम्॥
verses.tr: īḻe girā manurhitaṃ yaṃ devā dūtamaratiṃ nyerire yajiṣṭhaṃ havyavāhanam
verses.en: I praise with song the Friend of man, whom Gods sent down to be herald and messenger, Best worshipper, bearer of our gifts.

verses.sa: तिग्मजम्भाय तरुणाय राजते प्रयो गायस्यग्नये । यः पिंशते सूनृताभिः सुवीर्यमग्निर्घृतेभिराहुतः॥
verses.tr: tigmajambhāya taruṇāya rājate prayo gāyasyagnaye yaḥ piṃśate sūnṛtābhiḥ suvīryamagnirghṛtebhirāhutaḥ
verses.en: Thou unto sharp-toothed Agni, Young and Radiant God, proclaimest with thy song the feast- Agni, who for our sweet strains moulds heroic strength when sacred oil is offered him,

verses.sa: यदी घृतेभिराहुतो वाशीमग्निर्भरत उच्चाव च । असुर इव निर्णिजम्॥
verses.tr: yadī ghṛtebhirāhuto vāśīmagnirbharata uccāva ca asura iva nirṇijam
verses.en: While, served with sacrificial oil, now upward and now downward Agni moves his sword, As doth the Asura his robe.

verses.sa: यो हव्यान्यैरयता मनुर्हितो देव आसा सुगन्धिना । विवासते वार्याणि स्वध्वरो होता देवो अमर्त्यः॥
verses.tr: yo havyānyairayatā manurhito deva āsā sugandhinā vivāsate vāryāṇi svadhvaro hotā devo amartyaḥ
verses.en: The God, the Friend of man, who bears our gifts to heaven, the God with his sweet-smelling mouth, Distributes, skilled in sacrifice, his precious things, Invoking Priest, Immortal God.

verses.sa: यदग्ने मर्त्यस्त्वं स्यामहं मित्रमहो अमर्त्यः । सहसः सूनवाहुत॥
verses.tr: yadagne martyastvaṃ syāmahaṃ mitramaho amartyaḥ sahasaḥ sūnavāhuta
verses.en: Son of Strength, Agni, if thou wert the mortal, bright as Mitra, I worshipped with our gifts! And I were the Immortal God

verses.sa: न त्वा रासीयाभिशस्तये वसो न पापत्वाय सन्त्य । न मे स्तोतामतीवा न दुर्हितः स्यादग्ने न पापया॥
verses.tr: na tvā rāsīyābhiśastaye vaso na pāpatvāya santya na me stotāmatīvā na durhitaḥ syādagne na pāpayā
verses.en: I would not give thee up, Vasu, to calumny, or misery, O Bounteous One. My worshipper should feel no hunger or distress, nor, Agni, should he live in sin.

verses.sa: पितुर्न पुत्रः सुभृतो दुरोण आ देवाँ एतु प्र णो हविः॥
verses.tr: piturna putraḥ subhṛto duroṇa ā devāṃ etu pra ṇo haviḥ
verses.en: Like a son cherished in his father's house, Let our oblation rise unto the Gods.

verses.sa: तवाहमग्न ऊतिभिर्नेदिष्ठाभिः सचेय जोषमा वसो । सदा देवस्य मर्त्यः॥
verses.tr: tavāhamagna ūtibhirnediṣṭhābhiḥ saceya joṣamā vaso sadā devasya martyaḥ
verses.en: With thine immediate aid may I, excellent Agni, ever gain my wish A mortal with a God to help.

verses.sa: तव क्रत्वा सनेयं तव रातिभिरग्ने तव प्रशस्तिभिः । त्वामिदाहुः प्रमतिं वसो ममाऽग्ने हर्षस्व दातवे॥
verses.tr: tava kratvā saneyaṃ tava rātibhiragne tava praśastibhiḥ tvāmidāhuḥ pramatiṃ vaso mamā'gne harṣasva dātave
verses.en: O Agni, by thy wisdom, by thy bounties, by thy leading may I gather wealth. Excellent Agni, thou art called my Providence: delight thou to be liberal.

verses.sa: प्र सो अग्ने तवोतिभिः सुवीराभिस्तिरते वाजभर्मभिः । यस्य त्वं सख्यमावरः॥
verses.tr: pra so agne tavotibhiḥ suvīrābhistirate vājabharmabhiḥ yasya tvaṃ sakhyamāvaraḥ
verses.en: Agni, he conquers by thine aid that brings him store of noble heroes and great strength, Whose bond of friendship is thy choice.

verses.sa:
तव द्रप्सो नीलवान्वाश ऋत्विय इन्धानः सिष्णवा ददे ।
त्वं महीनामुषसामसि प्रियः क्षपो वस्तुषु राजसि॥
verses.tr: tava drapso nīlavānvāśa ṛtviya indhānaḥ siṣṇavā dade tvaṃ mahīnāmuṣasāmasi priyaḥ kṣapo vastuṣu rājasi
verses.en: Thy spark is black and crackling, kindled in due time, O Bounteous, it is taken up. Thou art the dear Friend of the mighty Mornings: thou shinest in glimmerings of the night.

verses.sa: तमागन्म सोभरयः सहस्रमुष्कं स्वभिष्टिमवसे । सम्राजं त्रासदस्यवम्॥
verses.tr: tamāganma sobharayaḥ sahasramuṣkaṃ svabhiṣṭimavase samrājaṃ trāsadasyavam
verses.en: We Sobharis have come to him, for succour, who is good to help with thousand powers, The Sovran, Trasadasyu's Friend.

verses.sa: यस्य ते अग्ने अन्ये अग्नय उपक्षितो वया इव । विपो न द्युम्ना नि युवे जनानां तव क्षत्राणि वर्धयन्॥
verses.tr: yasya te agne anye agnaya upakṣito vayā iva vipo na dyumnā ni yuve janānāṃ tava kṣatrāṇi vardhayan
verses.en: O Agni, thou on whom all other fires depend, as branches on the parent stem, I make the treasures of the folk, like songs, mine own, while I exalt thy sovran might.

verses.sa: यमादित्यासो अद्रुहः पारं नयथ मर्त्यम् । मघोनां विश्वेषां सुदानवः॥
verses.tr: yamādityāso adruhaḥ pāraṃ nayatha martyam maghonāṃ viśveṣāṃ sudānavaḥ
verses.en: The mortal whom, Adityas, ye, Guilelew, lead to the farther bank Of all the princes, Bounteous Ones

verses.sa: यूयं राजानः कं चिच्चर्षणीसहः क्षयन्तं मानुषाँ अनु । वयं ते वो वरुण मित्रार्यमन्त्स्यामेदृतस्य रथ्यः॥
verses.tr: yūyaṃ rājānaḥ kaṃ ciccarṣaṇīsahaḥ kṣayantaṃ mānuṣāṃ anu vayaṃ te vo varuṇa mitrāryamantsyāmedṛtasya rathyaḥ
verses.en: Whoe'er he be, Man-ruling Kings! the Regent of the race of men- May we, O Mitra, Varuna, and Aryaman, like him be furtherers of your law.

verses.sa: अदान्मे पौरुकुत्स्यः पञ्चाशतं त्रसदस्युर्वधूनाम् । मंहिष्ठो अर्यः सत्पतिः॥
verses.tr: adānme paurukutsyaḥ pañcāśataṃ trasadasyurvadhūnām maṃhiṣṭho aryaḥ satpatiḥ
verses.en: A gift of fifty female slaves hath Trasadasyu given me, Purukutsa's son, Most liberal, kind, lord of the brave.

verses.sa: उत मे प्रयियोर्वयियोः सुवास्त्वा अधि तुग्वनि । तिसॄणां सप्ततीनां श्यावः प्रणेता भुवद्वसुर्दियानां पतिः॥
verses.tr: uta me prayiyorvayiyoḥ suvāstvā adhi tugvani tisṝṇāṃ saptatīnāṃ śyāvaḥ praṇetā bhuvadvasurdiyānāṃ patiḥ
verses.en: And Syava too for me led forth a strong steed at Suvastu's ford: A herd of three times seventy kine, good lord of gifts, he gave to me.

verses.sa: आ गन्ता मा रिषण्यत प्रस्थावानो माप स्थाता समन्यवः । स्थिरा चिन्नमयिष्णवः॥
verses.tr: ā gantā mā riṣaṇyata prasthāvāno māpa sthātā samanyavaḥ sthirā cinnamayiṣṇavaḥ
verses.en: Let none, Swift Travellers! check you: come hither, like-spirited, stay not far away, Ye benders even of what is firm.

verses.sa: वीळुपविभिर्मरुत ऋभुक्षण आ रुद्रासः सुदीतिभिः । इषा नो अद्या गता पुरुस्पृहो यज्ञमा सोभरीयवः॥
verses.tr: vīḻupavibhirmaruta ṛbhukṣaṇa ā rudrāsaḥ sudītibhiḥ iṣā no adyā gatā puruspṛho yajñamā sobharīyavaḥ
verses.en: Maruts, Rbhuksans, Rudras come ye with your cars strong-fellied and exceeding bright. Come, ye for whom we long, with food, to sacrifice, come ye with love to Sobbari.

verses.sa: विद्मा हि रुद्रियाणां शुष्ममुग्रं मरुतां शिमीवताम् । विष्णोरेषस्य मीळ्हुषाम्॥
verses.tr: vidmā hi rudriyāṇāṃ śuṣmamugraṃ marutāṃ śimīvatām viṣṇoreṣasya mīḻhuṣām
verses.en: For well we know the vigorous might of Rudra's Sons, the Maruts, who are passing strong, Swift Visnu's band, who send the rain.,

verses.sa: वि द्वीपानि पापतन्तिष्ठद्दुच्छुनोभे युजन्त रोदसी । प्र धन्वान्यैरत शुभ्रखादयो यदेजथ स्वभानवः॥
verses.tr: vi dvīpāni pāpatantiṣṭhadducchunobhe yujanta rodasī pra dhanvānyairata śubhrakhādayo yadejatha svabhānavaḥ
verses.en: Islands are bursting forth and misery is stayed: the heaven and earth are joined in one. Decked with bright rings, ye spread the broad expanses out, when ye, Self. luminous, stirred yourselves.

verses.sa: अच्युता चिद्वो अज्मन्ना नानदति पर्वतासो वनस्पतिः । भूमिर्यामेषु रेजते॥
verses.tr: acyutā cidvo ajmannā nānadati parvatāso vanaspatiḥ bhūmiryāmeṣu rejate
verses.en: Even things immovable shake and reel, the mountains and the forest trees at your approach, And the earth trembles as ye come.

verses.sa: अमाय वो मरुतो यातवे द्यौर्जिहीत उत्तरा बृहत् । यत्रा नरो देदिशते तनूष्वा त्वक्षांसि बाह्वोजसः॥
verses.tr: amāya vo maruto yātave dyaurjihīta uttarā bṛhat yatrā naro dediśate tanūṣvā tvakṣāṃsi bāhvojasaḥ
verses.en: To lend free course, O Maruts, to your furious rush, heaven high and higher still gives way, Where they, the Heroes mighty with their arms, display their gleaming ornaments on their forms.

verses.sa: स्वधामनु श्रियं नरो महि त्वेषा अमवन्तो वृषप्सवः । वहन्ते अह्रुतप्सवः॥
verses.tr: svadhāmanu śriyaṃ naro mahi tveṣā amavanto vṛṣapsavaḥ vahante ahrutapsavaḥ
verses.en: After their Godlike nature they, the bull. like Heroes, dazzling and impetuous, wear Great splendour as they show erect.

verses.sa: गोभिर्वाणो अज्यते सोभरीणां रथे कोशे हिरण्यये । गोबन्धवः सुजातास इषे भुजे महान्तो नः स्परसे नु॥
verses.tr: gobhirvāṇo ajyate sobharīṇāṃ rathe kośe hiraṇyaye gobandhavaḥ sujātāsa iṣe bhuje mahānto naḥ sparase nu
verses.en: The pivot of the Sobharis' chariot within the golden box is balmed with milk. May they the Well-born, Mighty, kindred of the Cow, aid us to food and to delight.

verses.sa: प्रति वो वृषदञ्जयो वृष्णे शर्धाय मारुताय भरध्वम् । हव्या वृषप्रयाव्णे॥
verses.tr: prati vo vṛṣadañjayo vṛṣṇe śardhāya mārutāya bharadhvam havyā vṛṣaprayāvṇe
verses.en: Bring, ye who sprinkle balmy drops. oblations to your vigorous Marut company, To those whose leader is the Bull.

verses.sa: वृषणश्वेन मरुतो वृषप्सुना रथेन वृषनाभिना । आ श्येनासो न पक्षिणो वृथा नरो हव्या नो वीतये गत॥
verses.tr: vṛṣaṇaśvena maruto vṛṣapsunā rathena vṛṣanābhinā ā śyenāso na pakṣiṇo vṛthā naro havyā no vītaye gata
verses.en: Come hither, O ye Mares, on your strong horsed car, solid in look, with solid naves. Lightly like winged falcons, O ye Heroes, come, come to enjoy our offerings.

verses.sa: समानमञ्ज्येषां वि भ्राजन्ते रुक्मासो अधि बाहुषु । दविद्युतत्यृष्टयः॥
verses.tr: samānamañjyeṣāṃ vi bhrājante rukmāso adhi bāhuṣu davidyutatyṛṣṭayaḥ
verses.en: Their decoration is the same: their ornaments of gold are bright upon their arms; Their lances glitter splendidly.

verses.sa: त उग्रासो वृषण उग्रबाहवो नकिष्टनूषु येतिरे । स्थिरा धन्वान्यायुधा रथेषु वोऽनीकेष्वधि श्रियः॥
verses.tr: ta ugrāso vṛṣaṇa ugrabāhavo nakiṣṭanūṣu yetire sthirā dhanvānyāyudhā ratheṣu vo'nīkeṣvadhi śriyaḥ
verses.en: They toil not to defend their bodies from attack, strong Heroes with their mighty arms. Strong are your bows and strong the weapons in your cars, and glory sits on every face.

verses.sa: येषामर्णो न सप्रथो नाम त्वेषं शश्वतामेकमिद्भुजे । वयो न पित्र्यं सहः॥
verses.tr: yeṣāmarṇo na sapratho nāma tveṣaṃ śaśvatāmekamidbhuje vayo na pitryaṃ sahaḥ
verses.en: Whose name extendeth like a sea, alone, resplendent, so that all have joy in it, And life-power like ancestral might.

verses.sa: तान्वन्दस्व मरुतस्ताँ उप स्तुहि तेषां हि धुनीनाम् । अराणां न चरमस्तदेषां दाना मह्ना तदेषाम्॥
verses.tr: tānvandasva marutastāṃ upa stuhi teṣāṃ hi dhunīnām arāṇāṃ na caramastadeṣāṃ dānā mahnā tadeṣām
verses.en: Pay honour to these Maruts and sing praise to them, for of the wheel-spokes of the car Of these loud roarers none is last: this is their power, this moves them to give mighty gifts.

verses.sa: सुभगः स व ऊतिष्वास पूर्वासु मरुतो व्युष्टिषु । यो वा नूनमुतासति॥
verses.tr: subhagaḥ sa va ūtiṣvāsa pūrvāsu maruto vyuṣṭiṣu yo vā nūnamutāsati
verses.en: Blest by your favouring help was he, O Maruts, at the earlier flushings of the morn, And even now shall he be blest.

verses.sa:
यस्य वा यूयं प्रति वाजिनो नर आ हव्या वीतये गथ ।
अभि ष द्युम्नैरुत वाजसातिभिः सुम्ना वो धूतयो नशत्॥
verses.tr: yasya vā yūyaṃ prati vājino nara ā havyā vītaye gatha abhi ṣa dyumnairuta vājasātibhiḥ sumnā vo dhūtayo naśat
verses.en: The strong man to whose sacrifice, O Heroes, ye approach that ye may taste thereof, With glories and with war that winneth spoil shall gain great bliss, ye Shakers of the world.

verses.sa: यथा रुद्रस्य सूनवो दिवो वशन्त्यसुरस्य वेधसः । युवानस्तथेदसत्॥
verses.tr: yathā rudrasya sūnavo divo vaśantyasurasya vedhasaḥ yuvānastathedasat
verses.en: Even as Rudra's Sons, the brood of the Creator Dyaus, the Asura, desire, O Youthful Ones, so shall it be:

verses.sa: ये चार्हन्ति मरुतः सुदानवः स्मन्मीळ्हुषश्चरन्ति ये । अतश्चिदा न उप वस्यसा हृदा युवान आ ववृध्वम्॥
verses.tr: ye cārhanti marutaḥ sudānavaḥ smanmīḻhuṣaścaranti ye ataścidā na upa vasyasā hṛdā yuvāna ā vavṛdhvam
verses.en: And these the bounteous, worthy of the Maruts who move onward pouring down the rain- Even for their sake, O Youthful Ones, with kindest heart take us to you to be your own.

verses.sa: यून ऊ षु नविष्ठया वृष्णः पावकाँ अभि सोभरे गिरा । गाय गा इव चर्कृषत्॥
verses.tr: yūna ū ṣu naviṣṭhayā vṛṣṇaḥ pāvakāṃ abhi sobhare girā gāya gā iva carkṛṣat
verses.en: O Sobhari, with newest song sing out unto the youthful purifying Bulls, Even as a plougher to his steers.

verses.sa:
साहा ये सन्ति मुष्टिहेव हव्यो विश्वासु पृत्सु होतृषु ।
वृष्णश्चन्द्रान्न सुश्रवस्तमान्गिरा वन्दस्व मरुतो अह॥
verses.tr: sāhā ye santi muṣṭiheva havyo viśvāsu pṛtsu hotṛṣu vṛṣṇaścandrānna suśravastamāngirā vandasva maruto aha
verses.en: Who, like a celebrated boxer, overcome the challengers in every fight: They who, like shining bulls, are most illustrious-honour those Maruts with thy song.

verses.sa: गावश्चिद्घा समन्यवः सजात्येन मरुतः सबन्धवः । रिहते ककुभो मिथः॥
verses.tr: gāvaścidghā samanyavaḥ sajātyena marutaḥ sabandhavaḥ rihate kakubho mithaḥ
verses.en: Allied by common ancestry, ye Maruts, even the Cows, alike in energy, Lick, all by turns, each other's head.

verses.sa:
मर्तश्चिद्वो नृतवो रुक्मवक्षस उप भ्रातृत्वमायति ।
अधि नो गात मरुतः सदा हि व आपित्वमस्ति निध्रुवि॥
verses.tr: martaścidvo nṛtavo rukmavakṣasa upa bhrātṛtvamāyati adhi no gāta marutaḥ sadā hi va āpitvamasti nidhruvi
verses.en: Even mortal man, ye Dancers breast adorned with gold, attains to brotherhood with you. Mark ye and notice us, O Maruts; evermore your friendship is secured to us.

verses.sa: मरुतो मारुतस्य न आ भेषजस्य वहता सुदानवः । यूयं सखायः सप्तयः॥
verses.tr: maruto mārutasya na ā bheṣajasya vahatā sudānavaḥ yūyaṃ sakhāyaḥ saptayaḥ
verses.en: O Maruts, rich in noble gifts, bring us a portion of the Maruts' medicine, Ye Coursers who are Friends to us.

verses.sa:
याभिः सिन्धुमवथ याभिस्तूर्वथ याभिर्दशस्यथा क्रिविम् ।
मयो नो भूतोतिभिर्मयोभुवः शिवाभिरसचद्विषः॥
verses.tr: yābhiḥ sindhumavatha yābhistūrvatha yābhirdaśasyathā krivim mayo no bhūtotibhirmayobhuvaḥ śivābhirasacadviṣaḥ
verses.en: Haters of those who serve you not, bliss-bringers, bring us bliss with those auspicious aids Wherewith ye are victorious and guard Sindhu well, and succour Krvi in his need.

verses.sa: यत्सिन्धौ यदसिक्न्यां यत्समुद्रेषु मरुतः सुबर्हिषः । यत्पर्वतेषु भेषजम्॥
verses.tr: yatsindhau yadasiknyāṃ yatsamudreṣu marutaḥ subarhiṣaḥ yatparvateṣu bheṣajam
verses.en: Maruts, who rest on fair trimmed grass, what balm soever Sindhu or Asikni hath, Or mountains or the seas contain.

verses.sa: विश्वं पश्यन्तो बिभृथा तनूष्वा तेना नो अधि वोचत । क्षमा रपो मरुत आतुरस्य न इष्कर्ता विह्रुतं पुनः॥
verses.tr: viśvaṃ paśyanto bibhṛthā tanūṣvā tenā no adhi vocata kṣamā rapo maruta āturasya na iṣkartā vihrutaṃ punaḥ
verses.en: Ye carry on your bodies, ye who see it all: so bless us graciously therewith. Cast, Maruts, to the ground our sick man's malady: replace the dislocated limb.

verses.sa: वयमु त्वामपूर्व्य स्थूरं न कच्चिद्भरन्तोऽवस्यवः । वाजे चित्रं हवामहे॥
verses.tr: vayamu tvāmapūrvya sthūraṃ na kaccidbharanto'vasyavaḥ vāje citraṃ havāmahe
verses.en: We call on thee, O Matchless One! We seeking help, possessing nothing firm ourselves, Call on thee wonderful in fight

verses.sa: उप त्वा कर्मन्नूतये स नो युवोग्रश्चक्राम यो धृषत् । त्वामिद्ध्यवितारं ववृमहे सखाय इन्द्र सानसिम्॥
verses.tr: upa tvā karmannūtaye sa no yuvograścakrāma yo dhṛṣat tvāmiddhyavitāraṃ vavṛmahe sakhāya indra sānasim
verses.en: On thee for aid in sacrifice. This youth of ours, the bold, the mighty, hath gonse forth. We therefore, we thy friends, Indra, have chosen thee, free-giver, as our Guardian God.

verses.sa: आ याहीम इन्दवोऽश्वपते गोपत उर्वरापते । सोमं सोमपते पिब॥
verses.tr: ā yāhīma indavo'śvapate gopata urvarāpate somaṃ somapate piba
verses.en: Come hither, for the drops are here, O Lord of corn-lands. Lord of horses, Lord of kine: Drink thou the Soma, Soma's Lord!

verses.sa:
वयं हि त्वा बन्धुमन्तमबन्धवो विप्रास इन्द्र येमिम ।
या ते धामानि वृषभ तेभिरा गहि विश्वेभिः सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: vayaṃ hi tvā bandhumantamabandhavo viprāsa indra yemima yā te dhāmāni vṛṣabha tebhirā gahi viśvebhiḥ somapītaye
verses.en: For we the kinless singers have drawn hither thee, O Indra, who hast numerous kin. With all the forms thou hast, comic thou of bull-like strength, come near to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa: सीदन्तस्ते वयो यथा गोश्रीते मधौ मदिरे विवक्षणे । अभि त्वामिन्द्र नोनुमः॥
verses.tr: sīdantaste vayo yathā gośrīte madhau madire vivakṣaṇe abhi tvāmindra nonumaḥ
verses.en: Sitting like birds beside thy meath, mingled with milk, that gladdeneth and exalteth thee, Indra, to thee we sing aloud.

verses.sa:
अच्छा च त्वैना नमसा वदामसि किं मुहुश्चिद्वि दीधयः ।
सन्ति कामासो हरिवो ददिष्ट्वं स्मो वयं सन्ति नो धियः॥
verses.tr: acchā ca tvainā namasā vadāmasi kiṃ muhuścidvi dīdhayaḥ santi kāmāso harivo dadiṣṭvaṃ smo vayaṃ santi no dhiyaḥ
verses.en: We speak to thee with this our reverential prayer. Why art thou pondering yet awhile? Here are our wishes; thou art liberal, Lord of Bays: we and our hymns are present here.

verses.sa: नूत्ना इदिन्द्र ते वयमूती अभूम नहि नू ते अद्रिवः । विद्मा पुरा परीणसः॥
verses.tr: nūtnā idindra te vayamūtī abhūma nahi nū te adrivaḥ vidmā purā parīṇasaḥ
verses.en: For not in recent times alone, O Indra, Thunder-armed, have we obtained thine aid. Of old we knew thy plenteous wealth.

verses.sa:
विद्मा सखित्वमुत शूर भोज्य१मा ते ता वज्रिन्नीमहे ।
उतो समस्मिन्ना शिशीहि नो वसो वाजे सुशिप्र गोमति॥
verses.tr: vidmā sakhitvamuta śūra bhojya1mā te tā vajrinnīmahe uto samasminnā śiśīhi no vaso vāje suśipra gomati
verses.en: Hero, we knew thy friendship and thy rich rewards: these, Thunderer, now we crave of thee. O Vasu, for all wealth that cometh of the kine, sharpen our powers, fair-visored God.

verses.sa: यो न इदमिदं पुरा प्र वस्य आनिनाय तमु वः स्तुषे । सखाय इन्द्रमूतये॥
verses.tr: yo na idamidaṃ purā pra vasya ānināya tamu vaḥ stuṣe sakhāya indramūtaye
verses.en: Him who of old hath brought to us this and that blessing, him I magnify for you, Even Indra, O my friends, for help

verses.sa:
हर्यश्वं सत्पतिं चर्षणीसहं स हि ष्मा यो अमन्दत ।
आ तु नः स वयति गव्यमश्व्यं स्तोतृभ्यो मघवा शतम्॥
