verses.tr: haryaśvaṃ satpatiṃ carṣaṇīsahaṃ sa hi ṣmā yo amandata ā tu naḥ sa vayati gavyamaśvyaṃ stotṛbhyo maghavā śatam
verses.en: Borne by Bay Steeds, the Lord of heroes, ruling men, for it is he who takes; delight. May Maghavan bestow on us his worshippers hundreds of cattle and of steeds.

verses.sa: त्वया ह स्विद्युजा वयं प्रति श्वसन्तं वृषभ ब्रुवीमहि । संस्थे जनस्य गोमतः॥
verses.tr: tvayā ha svidyujā vayaṃ prati śvasantaṃ vṛṣabha bruvīmahi saṃsthe janasya gomataḥ
verses.en: Hero, may we, with thee for Friend, withstand the man who pants against us in his wrath, In fight with people rich in kine.

verses.sa: जयेम कारे पुरुहूत कारिणोऽभि तिष्ठेम दूढ्यः । नृभिर्वृत्रं हन्याम शूशुयाम चाऽवेरिन्द्र प्र णो धियः॥
verses.tr: jayema kāre puruhūta kāriṇo'bhi tiṣṭhema dūḍhyaḥ nṛbhirvṛtraṃ hanyāma śūśuyāma cā'verindra pra ṇo dhiyaḥ
verses.en: May we be victors in the singer's battle song, and meet the wicked, Much invoked! With heroes smite the foeman and show forth our strength. O Indra, further thou our thoughts.

verses.sa: अभ्रातृव्यो अना त्वमनापिरिन्द्र जनुषा सनादसि । युधेदापित्वमिच्छसे॥
verses.tr: abhrātṛvyo anā tvamanāpirindra januṣā sanādasi yudhedāpitvamicchase
verses.en: O Indra, from all ancient time rivalless ever and companionless art thou: Thou seekest comradeship in war.

verses.sa: नकी रेवन्तं सख्याय विन्दसे पीयन्ति ते सुराश्वः । यदा कृणोषि नदनुं समूहस्यादित्पितेव हूयसे॥
verses.tr: nakī revantaṃ sakhyāya vindase pīyanti te surāśvaḥ yadā kṛṇoṣi nadanuṃ samūhasyāditpiteva hūyase
verses.en: Thou findest not the wealthy man to be thy friend: those scorn thee who are flown with wine. What time thou thunderest and gatherest, then thou, even as a Father, art invoked.

verses.sa: मा ते अमाजुरो यथा मूरास इन्द्र सख्ये त्वावतः । नि षदाम सचा सुते॥
verses.tr: mā te amājuro yathā mūrāsa indra sakhye tvāvataḥ ni ṣadāma sacā sute
verses.en: O Indra, let us not, like fools who waste their lives at home, with friendship such as thine Sit idly by the poured-out juice.

verses.sa: मा ते गोदत्र निरराम राधस इन्द्र मा ते गृहामहि । दृळ्हा चिदर्यः प्र मृशाभ्या भर न ते दामान आदभे॥
verses.tr: mā te godatra nirarāma rādhasa indra mā te gṛhāmahi dṛḻhā cidaryaḥ pra mṛśābhyā bhara na te dāmāna ādabhe
verses.en: Giver of kine, may we not miss thy gracious gifts: let us not rob thee of thine own. Strip even the strong places of the foe, and bring: thy gifts can never be made vain.

verses.sa: इन्द्रो वा घेदियन्मघं सरस्वती वा सुभगा ददिर्वसु । त्वं वा चित्र दाशुषे॥
verses.tr: indro vā ghediyanmaghaṃ sarasvatī vā subhagā dadirvasu tvaṃ vā citra dāśuṣe
verses.en: Indra or blest Sarasvati alone bestows such wealth, treasure so great, or thou, O Citra, on the worshipper.

verses.sa: चित्र इद्राजा राजका इदन्यके यके सरस्वतीमनु । पर्जन्य इव ततनद्धि वृष्ट्या सहस्रमयुता ददत्॥
verses.tr: citra idrājā rājakā idanyake yake sarasvatīmanu parjanya iva tatanaddhi vṛṣṭyā sahasramayutā dadat
verses.en: Citra is King, and only kinglings are the rest who dwell beside Sarasvati. He, like Parjanya with his rain, hath spread himself with thousand, yea, with myriad gifts.

verses.sa: ओ त्यमह्व आ रथमद्या दंसिष्ठमूतये । यमश्विना सुहवा रुद्रवर्तनी आ सूर्यायै तस्थथुः॥
verses.tr: o tyamahva ā rathamadyā daṃsiṣṭhamūtaye yamaśvinā suhavā rudravartanī ā sūryāyai tasthathuḥ
verses.en: Hitherward have I called to-day, for succour, that most wondrous car Which ye ascended, Asvins, ye whose paths are red, swift to give Car, for Surya's sake.

verses.sa: पूर्वापुषं सुहवं पुरुस्पृहं भुज्युं वाजेषु पूर्व्यम् । सचनावन्तं सुमतिभिः सोभरे विद्वेषसमनेहसम्॥
verses.tr: pūrvāpuṣaṃ suhavaṃ puruspṛhaṃ bhujyuṃ vājeṣu pūrvyam sacanāvantaṃ sumatibhiḥ sobhare vidveṣasamanehasam
verses.en: Car ever young, much longed-for, easily invoked, soon guided, first in deeds of might, Which waits and serves, O Sobhari, with benevolence, without a rival or a foe.

verses.sa: इह त्या पुरुभूतमा देवा नमोभिरश्विना । अर्वाचीना स्ववसे करामहे गन्तारा दाशुषो गृहम्॥
verses.tr: iha tyā purubhūtamā devā namobhiraśvinā arvācīnā svavase karāmahe gantārā dāśuṣo gṛham
verses.en: These Asvins with our homage, these Two Omnipresent Deities Hitherward will we bring for kind help, these who seek the dwelling of the worshipper.

verses.sa:
युवो रथस्य परि चक्रमीयत ईर्मान्यद्वामिषण्यति ।
अस्माँ अच्छा सुमतिर्वां शुभस्पती आ धेनुरिव धावतु॥
verses.tr: yuvo rathasya pari cakramīyata īrmānyadvāmiṣaṇyati asmāṃ acchā sumatirvāṃ śubhaspatī ā dhenuriva dhāvatu
verses.en: One of your chariot wheels is moving swiftly round, one speeds for you its onward course. Like a milch-cow, O Lords of splendour, and with haste let your benevolence come to us.

verses.sa: रथो यो वां त्रिवन्धुरो हिरण्याभीशुरश्विना । परि द्यावापृथिवी भूषति श्रुतस्तेन नासत्या गतम्॥
verses.tr: ratho yo vāṃ trivandhuro hiraṇyābhīśuraśvinā pari dyāvāpṛthivī bhūṣati śrutastena nāsatyā gatam
verses.en: That chariot of yours which hath a triple seat and reins of gold, The famous car that traverseth the heaven and earth, thereon Nasatyas, Asvins, come.

verses.sa: दशस्यन्ता मनवे पूर्व्यं दिवि यवं वृकेण कर्षथः । ता वामद्य सुमतिभिः शुभस्पती अश्विना प्र स्तुवीमहि॥
verses.tr: daśasyantā manave pūrvyaṃ divi yavaṃ vṛkeṇa karṣathaḥ tā vāmadya sumatibhiḥ śubhaspatī aśvinā pra stuvīmahi
verses.en: Ye with your plough, when favouring Manu with your help, ploughed the first harvest in the sky. As such will we exalt you, Lords of splendour, now, O Asvins, with our prayer and praise.

verses.sa: उप नो वाजिनीवसू यातमृतस्य पथिभिः । येभिस्तृक्षिं वृषणा त्रासदस्यवं महे क्षत्राय जिन्वथः॥
verses.tr: upa no vājinīvasū yātamṛtasya pathibhiḥ yebhistṛkṣiṃ vṛṣaṇā trāsadasyavaṃ mahe kṣatrāya jinvathaḥ
verses.en: Come to us, Lords of ample wealth, by paths of everlasting Law, Whereby to high dominion ye with mighty strength raised Trksi, Trasadasyu's son.

verses.sa: अयं वामद्रिभिः सुतः सोमो नरा वृषण्वसू । आ यातं सोमपीतये पिबतं दाशुषो गृहे॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ vāmadribhiḥ sutaḥ somo narā vṛṣaṇvasū ā yātaṃ somapītaye pibataṃ dāśuṣo gṛhe
verses.en: This Soma pressed with stones is yours, ye Heroes, Lords of plenteous wealth. Approach to drink the Soma, come, drink in the worshipper's abode.

verses.sa: आ हि रुहतमश्विना रथे कोशे हिरण्यये वृषण्वसू । युञ्जाथां पीवरीरिषः॥
verses.tr: ā hi ruhatamaśvinā rathe kośe hiraṇyaye vṛṣaṇvasū yuñjāthāṃ pīvarīriṣaḥ
verses.en: O Asvins, mount the chariot, mount the golden seat, ye who are Lords of plenteous wealth, And bring to us abundant food.

verses.sa:
याभिः पक्थमवथो याभिरध्रिगुं याभिर्बभ्रुं विजोषसम् ।
ताभिर्नो मक्षू तूयमश्विना गतं भिषज्यतं यदातुरम्॥
verses.tr: yābhiḥ pakthamavatho yābhiradhriguṃ yābhirbabhruṃ vijoṣasam tābhirno makṣū tūyamaśvinā gataṃ bhiṣajyataṃ yadāturam
verses.en: The aids wherewith ye helped Paktha and Adhrigt;, and Babhru severed from his friends,- With those, O Asvins, come hither with speed and soon, and heal whatever is diseased.

verses.sa: यदध्रिगावो अध्रिगू इदा चिदह्नो अश्विना हवामहे । वयं गीर्भिर्विपन्यवः॥
verses.tr: yadadhrigāvo adhrigū idā cidahno aśvinā havāmahe vayaṃ gīrbhirvipanyavaḥ
verses.en: When we continually invoke the Asvins, the resistless, at this time of day, We lovers of the song, with songs.

verses.sa:
ताभिरा यातं वृषणोप मे हवं विश्वप्सुं विश्ववार्यम् ।
इषा मंहिष्ठा पुरुभूतमा नरा याभिः क्रिविं वावृधुस्ताभिरा गतम्॥
verses.tr: tābhirā yātaṃ vṛṣaṇopa me havaṃ viśvapsuṃ viśvavāryam iṣā maṃhiṣṭhā purubhūtamā narā yābhiḥ kriviṃ vāvṛdhustābhirā gatam
verses.en: Through these, ye Mighty Ones, come hither to my call which brings all blessings, wears all forms,- Through which, All-present Heroes, lavishest of food ye strengthened Krvi, come through these.

verses.sa: ताविदा चिदहानां तावश्विना वन्दमान उप ब्रुवे । ता ऊ नमोभिरीमहे॥
verses.tr: tāvidā cidahānāṃ tāvaśvinā vandamāna upa bruve tā ū namobhirīmahe
verses.en: I speak to both of these as such, these Asvins whom I reverence at this time of day: With homage we entreat them both.

verses.sa:
ताविद्दोषा ता उषसि शुभस्पती ता यामन्रुद्रवर्तनी ।
मा नो मर्ताय रिपवे वाजिनीवसू परो रुद्रावति ख्यतम्॥
verses.tr: tāviddoṣā tā uṣasi śubhaspatī tā yāmanrudravartanī mā no martāya ripave vājinīvasū paro rudrāvati khyatam
verses.en: Ye who are Lords of splendour, ye whose paths are red, at eve, at mom, at sacrifice, Give us not utterly as prey to mortal foe, ye Rudras, Lords of ample wealth.

verses.sa: आ सुग्म्याय सुग्म्यं प्राता रथेनाश्विना वा सक्षणी । हुवे पितेव सोभरी॥
verses.tr: ā sugmyāya sugmyaṃ prātā rathenāśvinā vā sakṣaṇī huve piteva sobharī
verses.en: For bliss I call. the blissful car, at morn the inseparable Asvins with their car I call, like Sobhari our sire.

verses.sa: मनोजवसा वृषणा मदच्युता मक्षुंगमाभिरूतिभिः । आरात्ताच्चिद्भूतमस्मे अवसे पूर्वीभिः पुरुभोजसा॥
verses.tr: manojavasā vṛṣaṇā madacyutā makṣuṃgamābhirūtibhiḥ ārāttāccidbhūtamasme avase pūrvībhiḥ purubhojasā
verses.en: Rapid as thought, and strong, and speeding to the joy, bringing your swiftly-coming help, Be to us a protection even from far away Lords of great wealth, with many aids.'

verses.sa: आ नो अश्वावदश्विना वर्तिर्यासिष्टं मधुपातमा नरा । गोमद्दस्रा हिरण्यवत्॥
verses.tr: ā no aśvāvadaśvinā vartiryāsiṣṭaṃ madhupātamā narā gomaddasrā hiraṇyavat
verses.en: Come, Wonder-Workers, to our home, our home, O Asvins, rich in cattle, steeds, and gold, Chief drinkers of the Soma's juice

verses.sa: सुप्रावर्गं सुवीर्यं सुष्ठु वार्यमनाधृष्टं रक्षस्विना । अस्मिन्ना वामायाने वाजिनीवसू विश्वा वामानि धीमहि॥
verses.tr: suprāvargaṃ suvīryaṃ suṣṭhu vāryamanādhṛṣṭaṃ rakṣasvinā asminnā vāmāyāne vājinīvasū viśvā vāmāni dhīmahi
verses.en: Choice-worthy strength, heroic, firm and excellent, uninjured by the Raksas foe, At this your coming nigh, ye Lords of ample wealth and all good things, may we obtain.

verses.sa: ईळिष्वा हि प्रतीव्यं१ यजस्व जातवेदसम् । चरिष्णुधूममगृभीतशोचिषम्॥
verses.tr: īḻiṣvā hi pratīvyaṃ1 yajasva jātavedasam cariṣṇudhūmamagṛbhītaśociṣam
verses.en: Worship thou Jatavedas, pray to him who willingly accepts, Whose smoke wanders at will, and none may grasp his flame.

verses.sa: दामानं विश्वचर्षणेऽग्निं विश्वमनो गिरा । उत स्तुषे विष्पर्धसो रथानाम्॥
verses.tr: dāmānaṃ viśvacarṣaṇe'gniṃ viśvamano girā uta stuṣe viṣpardhaso rathānām
verses.en: Thou, all men's friend, Visvamanas, exaltest Agni with thy song, The Giver, and his flames with which no cars contend.

verses.sa: येषामाबाध ऋग्मिय इषः पृक्षश्च निग्रभे । उपविदा वह्निर्विन्दते वसु॥
verses.tr: yeṣāmābādha ṛgmiya iṣaḥ pṛkṣaśca nigrabhe upavidā vahnirvindate vasu
verses.en: Whose resolute assault, to win vigour and food, deserves our praise,- Through whose discovering power the priest obtaineth wealth.

verses.sa: उदस्य शोचिरस्थाद्दीदियुषो व्य१जरम् । तपुर्जम्भस्य सुद्युतो गणश्रियः॥
verses.tr: udasya śocirasthāddīdiyuṣo vya1jaram tapurjambhasya sudyuto gaṇaśriyaḥ
verses.en: Up springs the imperishable flame, the flame of the Refulgent One Most bright, with glowing jaws and glory in his train.

verses.sa: उदु तिष्ठ स्वध्वर स्तवानो देव्या कृपा । अभिख्या भासा बृहता शुशुक्वनिः॥
verses.tr: udu tiṣṭha svadhvara stavāno devyā kṛpā abhikhyā bhāsā bṛhatā śuśukvaniḥ
verses.en: Skilled in fair sacrifice, extolled, arise in Godlike loveliness, Shining with lofty splendour, with effulgent light.

verses.sa: अग्ने याहि सुशस्तिभिर्हव्या जुह्वान आनुषक् । यथा दूतो बभूथ हव्यवाहनः॥
verses.tr: agne yāhi suśastibhirhavyā juhvāna ānuṣak yathā dūto babhūtha havyavāhanaḥ
verses.en: Called straight to our oblations, come, O Agni, through our eulogies, As thou hast been our envoy bearing up our gifts.

verses.sa: अग्निं वः पूर्व्यं हुवे होतारं चर्षणीनाम् । तमया वाचा गृणे तमु वः स्तुषे॥
verses.tr: agniṃ vaḥ pūrvyaṃ huve hotāraṃ carṣaṇīnām tamayā vācā gṛṇe tamu vaḥ stuṣe
verses.en: I call your Agni, from of old Invoking Priest of living men: Him with this song I laud and magnify for you.

verses.sa: यज्ञेभिरद्भुतक्रतुं यं कृपा सूदयन्त इत् । मित्रं न जने सुधितमृतावनि॥
verses.tr: yajñebhiradbhutakratuṃ yaṃ kṛpā sūdayanta it mitraṃ na jane sudhitamṛtāvani
verses.en: Whom, wondrous wise, they animate with solemn rites and his fair form, Kind as a friend to men who keep the holy Law.

verses.sa: ऋतावानमृतायवो यज्ञस्य साधनं गिरा । उपो एनं जुजुषुर्नमसस्पदे॥
verses.tr: ṛtāvānamṛtāyavo yajñasya sādhanaṃ girā upo enaṃ jujuṣurnamasaspade
verses.en: Him, true to Law, who perfecteth the sacrifice,. Law-loving ones! Ye with your song have gratified in the place of prayer.

verses.sa: अच्छा नो अङ्गिरस्तमं यज्ञासो यन्तु संयतः । होता यो अस्ति विक्ष्वा यशस्तमः॥
verses.tr: acchā no aṅgirastamaṃ yajñāso yantu saṃyataḥ hotā yo asti vikṣvā yaśastamaḥ
verses.en: May all our sacrifices go to him the truest Angiras, Who is among mankind the most illustrious Priest.

verses.sa: अग्ने तव त्ये अजरेन्धानासो बृहद्भाः । अश्वा इव वृषणस्तविषीयवः॥
verses.tr: agne tava tye ajarendhānāso bṛhadbhāḥ aśvā iva vṛṣaṇastaviṣīyavaḥ
verses.en: Imperishable Agni, thine are all these high enkindled lights, Like horses and like stallions showing forth their strength.

verses.sa: स त्वं न ऊर्जां पते रयिं रास्व सुवीर्यम् । प्राव नस्तोके तनये समत्स्वा॥
verses.tr: sa tvaṃ na ūrjāṃ pate rayiṃ rāsva suvīryam prāva nastoke tanaye samatsvā
verses.en: So give us, Lord of Power and Might, riches combined with hero strength, And guard us with our sons and grand. sons in our frays.

verses.sa: यद्वा उ विश्पतिः शितः सुप्रीतो मनुषो विशि । विश्वेदग्निः प्रति रक्षांसि सेधति॥
verses.tr: yadvā u viśpatiḥ śitaḥ suprīto manuṣo viśi viśvedagniḥ prati rakṣāṃsi sedhati
verses.en: Soon as the eager Lord of men is friendly unto Manti's race, Agni averteth from us all the demon host.

verses.sa: श्रुष्ट्यग्ने नवस्य मे स्तोमस्य वीर विश्पते । नि मायिनस्तपुषा रक्षसो दह॥
verses.tr: śruṣṭyagne navasya me stomasya vīra viśpate ni māyinastapuṣā rakṣaso daha
verses.en: O Hero Agni, Lord of men, on hearing this new laud of mine, Burn down the Raksasas, enchanters, with thy flame.

verses.sa: न तस्य मायया चन रिपुरीशीत मर्त्यः । यो अग्नये ददाश हव्यदातिभिः॥
verses.tr: na tasya māyayā cana ripurīśīta martyaḥ yo agnaye dadāśa havyadātibhiḥ
verses.en: No mortal foe can e'er prevail by arts of magic over him Who serveth Agni well with sacrificial gifts.

verses.sa: व्यश्वस्त्वा वसुविदमुक्षण्युरप्रीणादृषिः । महो राये तमु त्वा समिधीमहि॥
verses.tr: vyaśvastvā vasuvidamukṣaṇyuraprīṇādṛṣiḥ maho rāye tamu tvā samidhīmahi
verses.en: Vyasva the sage, who sought the Bull, hath won thee, finder of good things: As such may we enkindle thee for ample wealth.

verses.sa: उशना काव्यस्त्वा नि होतारमसादयत् । आयजिं त्वा मनवे जातवेदसम्॥
verses.tr: uśanā kāvyastvā ni hotāramasādayat āyajiṃ tvā manave jātavedasam
verses.en: Usana Kavya stablished thee, O Agni, as Invoking Priest: Thee, Jatavedas, Sacrificing Priest for man.

verses.sa: विश्वे हि त्वा सजोषसो देवासो दूतमक्रत । श्रुष्टी देव प्रथमो यज्ञियो भुवः॥
verses.tr: viśve hi tvā sajoṣaso devāso dūtamakrata śruṣṭī deva prathamo yajñiyo bhuvaḥ
verses.en: All Deities of one accord appointed thee their messenger: Thou, God, through hearing, hadst first claim to sacrifice.

verses.sa: इमं घा वीरो अमृतं दूतं कृण्वीत मर्त्यः । पावकं कृष्णवर्तनिं विहायसम्॥
verses.tr: imaṃ ghā vīro amṛtaṃ dūtaṃ kṛṇvīta martyaḥ pāvakaṃ kṛṣṇavartaniṃ vihāyasam
verses.en: Him may the mortal hero make his own immortal messenger. Far-spreading, Purifier, him whose path is black.

verses.sa: तं हुवेम यतस्रुचः सुभासं शुक्रशोचिषम् । विशामग्निमजरं प्रत्नमीड्यम्॥
verses.tr: taṃ huvema yatasrucaḥ subhāsaṃ śukraśociṣam viśāmagnimajaraṃ pratnamīḍyam
verses.en: With lifted ladles let us call him splendid with his brilliant flame, Men's ancient Agni, wasting not, adorable.

verses.sa: यो अस्मै हव्यदातिभिराहुतिं मर्तोऽविधत् । भूरि पोषं स धत्ते वीरवद्यशः॥
verses.tr: yo asmai havyadātibhirāhutiṃ marto'vidhat bhūri poṣaṃ sa dhatte vīravadyaśaḥ
verses.en: The man who pays the worship due to him with sacrificial gifts Obtains both plenteous nourishment and hero fame.

verses.sa: प्रथमं जातवेदसमग्निं यज्ञेषु पूर्व्यम् । प्रति स्रुगेति नमसा हविष्मती॥
verses.tr: prathamaṃ jātavedasamagniṃ yajñeṣu pūrvyam prati srugeti namasā haviṣmatī
verses.en: To Jatavedas Agni, chief in sacrifices, first of all With homage goes the ladle rich with sacred gifts.

verses.sa: आभिर्विधेमाग्नये ज्येष्ठाभिर्व्यश्ववत् । मंहिष्ठाभिर्मतिभिः शुक्रशोचिषे॥
verses.tr: ābhirvidhemāgnaye jyeṣṭhābhirvyaśvavat maṃhiṣṭhābhirmatibhiḥ śukraśociṣe
verses.en: Even as Vyatya did, may we with these most high and liberal hymns Pay worship unto Agni of the splendid flame.

verses.sa: नूनमर्च विहायसे स्तोमेभिः स्थूरयूपवत् । ऋषे वैयश्व दम्यायाग्नये॥
verses.tr: nūnamarca vihāyase stomebhiḥ sthūrayūpavat ṛṣe vaiyaśva damyāyāgnaye
verses.en: Now sing, as Sthurayupa sang, with lands to him who spreadeth far, To Agni of the home, O Rsi, Vyasva's son.

verses.sa: अतिथिं मानुषाणां सूनुं वनस्पतीनाम् । विप्रा अग्निमवसे प्रत्नमीळते॥
verses.tr: atithiṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ sūnuṃ vanaspatīnām viprā agnimavase pratnamīḻate
verses.en: As welcome guest of human kind, as offspring of the forest kings, The sages worship ancient Agni for his aid.

verses.sa: महो विश्वाँ अभि षतो३ऽभि हव्यानि मानुषा । अग्ने नि षत्सि नमसाधि बर्हिषि॥
verses.tr: maho viśvāṃ abhi ṣato3'bhi havyāni mānuṣā agne ni ṣatsi namasādhi barhiṣi
verses.en: For men's oblations brought to him who is the mighty Lord of all, Sit, Agni, mid our homage, on the sacred grass.

verses.sa: वंस्वा नो वार्या पुरु वंस्व रायः पुरुस्पृहः । सुवीर्यस्य प्रजावतो यशस्वतः॥
verses.tr: vaṃsvā no vāryā puru vaṃsva rāyaḥ puruspṛhaḥ suvīryasya prajāvato yaśasvataḥ
verses.en: Grant us abundant. treasures, grant the opulence which many crave, With store of heroes, progeny, and high renown.

verses.sa: त्वं वरो सुषाम्णेऽग्ने जनाय चोदय । सदा वसो रातिं यविष्ठ शश्वते॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ varo suṣāmṇe'gne janāya codaya sadā vaso rātiṃ yaviṣṭha śaśvate
verses.en: Agni, Most Youthful of the Gods, send evermore the gift of wealth Unto Varosusaman and to all his folk.

verses.sa: त्वं हि सुप्रतूरसि त्वं नो गोमतीरिषः । महो रायः सातिमग्ने अपा वृधि॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ hi supratūrasi tvaṃ no gomatīriṣaḥ maho rāyaḥ sātimagne apā vṛdhi
verses.en: A mighty Conqueror art thou, O Agni, so disclose to us Food in our herds of kine and gain of ample wealth.

verses.sa: अग्ने त्वं यशा अस्या मित्रावरुणा वह । ऋतावाना सम्राजा पूतदक्षसा॥
verses.tr: agne tvaṃ yaśā asyā mitrāvaruṇā vaha ṛtāvānā samrājā pūtadakṣasā
verses.en: Thou, Agni, art a glorious God: bring hither Mitra, Varuna, Imperial Sovrans, holy-minded, true to Law.

verses.sa: सखाय आ शिषामहि ब्रह्मेन्द्राय वज्रिणे । स्तुष ऊ षु वो नृतमाय धृष्णवे॥
verses.tr: sakhāya ā śiṣāmahi brahmendrāya vajriṇe stuṣa ū ṣu vo nṛtamāya dhṛṣṇave
verses.en: Companions, let us learn a prayer to Indra, whom the thunder arms, To glorify your bold and most heroic Friend.

verses.sa: शवसा ह्यसि श्रुतो वृत्रहत्येन वृत्रहा । मघैर्मघोनो अति शूर दाशसि॥
verses.tr: śavasā hyasi śruto vṛtrahatyena vṛtrahā maghairmaghono ati śūra dāśasi
verses.en: For thou by slaying Vrtra art the Vrtra-slayer, famed for might. Thou, Hero, in rich gifts surpassest wealthy chiefs.

verses.sa: स नः स्तवान आ भर रयिं चित्रश्रवस्तमम् । निरेके चिद्यो हरिवो वसुर्ददिः॥
verses.tr: sa naḥ stavāna ā bhara rayiṃ citraśravastamam nireke cidyo harivo vasurdadiḥ
verses.en: As such, when glorified, bring us riches of very wondrous fame, Set in the highest rank, Wealth-giver, Lord of Bays!

verses.sa: आ निरेकमुत प्रियमिन्द्र दर्षि जनानाम् । धृषता धृष्णो स्तवमान आ भर॥
verses.tr: ā nirekamuta priyamindra darṣi janānām dhṛṣatā dhṛṣṇo stavamāna ā bhara
verses.en: Yea, Indra, thou disclosest that preeminent dear wealth of men: Boldly, O Bold One, glorified, bring it to us.

verses.sa: न ते सव्यं न दक्षिणं हस्तं वरन्त आमुरः । न परिबाधो हरिवो गविष्टिषु॥
verses.tr: na te savyaṃ na dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ varanta āmuraḥ na paribādho harivo gaviṣṭiṣu
verses.en: The workers of destruction stay neither thy right hand nor thy left: Nor hosts that press about thee, Lord of Bays, in fight.

verses.sa: आ त्वा गोभिरिव व्रजं गीर्भिॠणोम्यद्रिवः । आ स्मा कामं जरितुरा मनः पृण॥
verses.tr: ā tvā gobhiriva vrajaṃ gīrbhiṝṇomyadrivaḥ ā smā kāmaṃ jariturā manaḥ pṛṇa
verses.en: O Thunder-armed, I come with songs to thee as to a stall with kine: Fulfil the wish and thought of him who sings thy praise.

verses.sa: विश्वानि विश्वमनसो धिया नो वृत्रहन्तम । उग्र प्रणेतरधि षू वसो गहि॥
verses.tr: viśvāni viśvamanaso dhiyā no vṛtrahantama ugra praṇetaradhi ṣū vaso gahi
verses.en: Chief Vrtra-slayer, through the hymn of Visvamanas think of all, All that concerneth us, Excellent, Mighty Guide.

verses.sa: वयं ते अस्य वृत्रहन्विद्याम शूर नव्यसः । वसोः स्पार्हस्य पुरुहूत राधसः॥
verses.tr: vayaṃ te asya vṛtrahanvidyāma śūra navyasaḥ vasoḥ spārhasya puruhūta rādhasaḥ
verses.en: May we, O Vrtra-slayer, O Hero, find this thy newest boon, Longed-for, and excellent, thou who art much invoked!

verses.sa: इन्द्र यथा ह्यस्ति तेऽपरीतं नृतो शवः । अमृक्ता रातिः पुरुहूत दाशुषे॥
verses.tr: indra yathā hyasti te'parītaṃ nṛto śavaḥ amṛktā rātiḥ puruhūta dāśuṣe
verses.en: O Indra, Dancer, Much-invoked! as thy great power is unsurpassed, So be thy bounty to the worshipper unchecked.

verses.sa: आ वृषस्व महामह महे नृतम राधसे । दृळ्हश्चिद्दृह्य मघवन्मघत्तये॥
verses.tr: ā vṛṣasva mahāmaha mahe nṛtama rādhase dṛḻhaściddṛhya maghavanmaghattaye
verses.en: Most Mighty, most heroic One, for mighty bounty fill thee full. Though strong, strengthen thyself to win wealth, Maghavan!

verses.sa: नू अन्यत्रा चिदद्रिवस्त्वन्नो जग्मुराशसः । मघवञ्छग्धि तव तन्न ऊतिभिः॥
verses.tr: nū anyatrā cidadrivastvanno jagmurāśasaḥ maghavañchagdhi tava tanna ūtibhiḥ
verses.en: O Thunderer, never have our prayers gone forth to any God but thee: So help us, Maghavan, with thine assistance now.

verses.sa: नह्य१ङ्ग नृतो त्वदन्यं विन्दामि राधसे । राये द्युम्नाय शवसे च गिर्वणः॥
verses.tr: nahya1ṅga nṛto tvadanyaṃ vindāmi rādhase rāye dyumnāya śavase ca girvaṇaḥ
verses.en: For, Dancer, verily I find none else for bounty, saving thee, For splendid wealth and power, thou Lover of the Song.

verses.sa: एन्दुमिन्द्राय सिञ्चत पिबाति सोम्यं मधु । प्र राधसा चोदयाते महित्वना॥
verses.tr: endumindrāya siñcata pibāti somyaṃ madhu pra rādhasā codayāte mahitvanā
verses.en: For Indra pour ye out the drops meath blent with Soma let him drink With bounty and with majesty will he further us.

verses.sa: उपो हरीणां पतिं दक्षं पृञ्चन्तमब्रवम् । नूनं श्रुधि स्तुवतो अश्व्यस्य॥
verses.tr: upo harīṇāṃ patiṃ dakṣaṃ pṛñcantamabravam nūnaṃ śrudhi stuvato aśvyasya
verses.en: I spake to the Bay Coursers' Lord, to him who gives ability: Now hear the son of Asva as he praises thee.

verses.sa: नह्य१ङ्ग पुरा चन जज्ञे वीरतरस्त्वत् । नकी राया नैवथा न भन्दना॥
verses.tr: nahya1ṅga purā cana jajñe vīratarastvat nakī rāyā naivathā na bhandanā
verses.en: Never was any Hero born before thee mightier than thou: None certainly like thee in goodness and in wealth.

verses.sa: एदु मध्वो मदिन्तरं सिञ्च वाध्वर्यो अन्धसः । एवा हि वीरः स्तवते सदावृधः॥
verses.tr: edu madhvo madintaraṃ siñca vādhvaryo andhasaḥ evā hi vīraḥ stavate sadāvṛdhaḥ
verses.en: O ministering priest, pour out of the sweet juice what gladdens most: So is the Hero praised who ever prospers us.

verses.sa: इन्द्र स्थातर्हरीणां नकिष्टे पूर्व्यस्तुतिम् । उदानंश शवसा न भन्दना॥
verses.tr: indra sthātarharīṇāṃ nakiṣṭe pūrvyastutim udānaṃśa śavasā na bhandanā
verses.en: Indra, whom Tawny Coursers bear, praise such as thine, preeminent, None by his power or by his goodness hath attained.

verses.sa: तं वो वाजानां पतिमहूमहि श्रवस्यवः । अप्रायुभिर्यज्ञेभिर्वावृधेन्यम्॥
verses.tr: taṃ vo vājānāṃ patimahūmahi śravasyavaḥ aprāyubhiryajñebhirvāvṛdhenyam
verses.en: We, seeking glory, have invoked this Master of all power and might Who must be glorified by constant sacrifice.

verses.sa: एतो न्विन्द्रं स्तवाम सखायः स्तोम्यं नरम् । कृष्टीर्यो विश्वा अभ्यस्त्येक इत्॥
verses.tr: eto nvindraṃ stavāma sakhāyaḥ stomyaṃ naram kṛṣṭīryo viśvā abhyastyeka it
verses.en: Come, sing we praise to Indra, friends, the Hero who deserves the laud, Him who with none to aid o'ercomes all tribes of men.

verses.sa: अगोरुधाय गविषे द्युक्षाय दस्म्यं वचः । घृतात्स्वादीयो मधुनश्च वोचत॥
verses.tr: agorudhāya gaviṣe dyukṣāya dasmyaṃ vacaḥ ghṛtātsvādīyo madhunaśca vocata
verses.en: To him who wins the kine, who keeps no cattle back, Celestial God, Speak wondrous speech more sweet than butter and than meath.

verses.sa: यस्यामितानि वीर्या३ न राधः पर्येतवे । ज्योतिर्न विश्वमभ्यस्ति दक्षिणा॥
verses.tr: yasyāmitāni vīryā3 na rādhaḥ paryetave jyotirna viśvamabhyasti dakṣiṇā
verses.en: Whose hero powers are measureless, whose bounty ne'er may be surpassed, Whose liberality, like light, is over all.

verses.sa: स्तुहीन्द्रं व्यश्ववदनूर्मिं वाजिनं यमम् । अर्यो गयं मंहमानं वि दाशुषे॥
verses.tr: stuhīndraṃ vyaśvavadanūrmiṃ vājinaṃ yamam aryo gayaṃ maṃhamānaṃ vi dāśuṣe
verses.en: As Vyasva did, praise Indra, praise the Strong unfluctuating Guide, Who gives the foe's possessions to the worshipper.

verses.sa: एवा नूनमुप स्तुहि वैयश्व दशमं नवम् । सुविद्वांसं चर्कृत्यं चरणीनाम्॥
verses.tr: evā nūnamupa stuhi vaiyaśva daśamaṃ navam suvidvāṃsaṃ carkṛtyaṃ caraṇīnām
verses.en: Now, son of Vyasva, praise thou him who to the tenth time still is new, The very Wise, whom living men must glorify

verses.sa: वेत्था हि निॠतीनां वज्रहस्त परिवृजम् । अहरहः शुन्ध्युः परिपदामिव॥
verses.tr: vetthā hi niṝtīnāṃ vajrahasta parivṛjam aharahaḥ śundhyuḥ paripadāmiva
verses.en: Thou knowest, Indra, Thunder-armed, how to avoid destructive powers, As one secure from pitfalls each returning day.

verses.sa: तदिन्द्राव आ भर येना दंसिष्ठ कृत्वने । द्विता कुत्साय शिश्नथो नि चोदय॥
verses.tr: tadindrāva ā bhara yenā daṃsiṣṭha kṛtvane dvitā kutsāya śiśnatho ni codaya
verses.en: O Indra, bring that aid wherewith of old, Most Wondrous! thou didst slay His foes for active Kutsa: send it down to us.

verses.sa: तमु त्वा नूनमीमहे नव्यं दंसिष्ठ सन्यसे । स त्वं नो विश्वा अभिमातीः सक्षणिः॥
verses.tr: tamu tvā nūnamīmahe navyaṃ daṃsiṣṭha sanyase sa tvaṃ no viśvā abhimātīḥ sakṣaṇiḥ
verses.en: So now we seek thee fresh in might, Most Wonderful in act! for gain: For thou art he who conquers all our foes for us.

verses.sa: य ऋक्षादंहसो मुचद्यो वार्यात्सप्त सिन्धुषु । वधर्दासस्य तुविनृम्ण नीनमः॥
verses.tr: ya ṛkṣādaṃhaso mucadyo vāryātsapta sindhuṣu vadhardāsasya tuvinṛmṇa nīnamaḥ
verses.en: Who will set free from ruinous woe, or Arya on the Seven Streams: O valiant Hero, bend the Dasa's weapon down.

verses.sa: यथा वरो सुषाम्णे सनिभ्य आवहो रयिम् । व्यश्वेभ्यः सुभगे वाजिनीवति॥
verses.tr: yathā varo suṣāmṇe sanibhya āvaho rayim vyaśvebhyaḥ subhage vājinīvati
verses.en: As to Varosusaman thou broughtest great riches, for their gain, To Vyasva's sons, Blest Lady, rich in ample wealth!

verses.sa: आ नार्यस्य दक्षिणा व्यश्वाँ एतु सोमिनः । स्थूरं च राधः शतवत्सहस्रवत्॥
verses.tr: ā nāryasya dakṣiṇā vyaśvāṃ etu sominaḥ sthūraṃ ca rādhaḥ śatavatsahasravat
verses.en: Let Narya's sacrificial meed reach Vyasva's Soma-bearing sons: In hundreds and in thousands be the great reward.

verses.sa: यत्त्वा पृच्छादीजानः कुहया कुहयाकृते । एषो अपश्रितो वलो गोमतीमव तिष्ठति॥
verses.tr: yattvā pṛcchādījānaḥ kuhayā kuhayākṛte eṣo apaśrito valo gomatīmava tiṣṭhati
verses.en: If one should ask thee, Where is he who sacrificed? Whither lookest thou? Like Vala he hath passed away and dwelleth now on Gomati.

verses.sa: ता वां विश्वस्य गोपा देवा देवेषु यज्ञिया । ऋतावाना यजसे पूतदक्षसा॥
verses.tr: tā vāṃ viśvasya gopā devā deveṣu yajñiyā ṛtāvānā yajase pūtadakṣasā
verses.en: I WORSHIP you who guard this All, Gods, holiest among the Gods, You, faithful to the Law, whose power is sanctified.

verses.sa: मित्रा तना न रथ्या३ वरुणो यश्च सुक्रतुः । सनात्सुजाता तनया धृतव्रता॥
verses.tr: mitrā tanā na rathyā3 varuṇo yaśca sukratuḥ sanātsujātā tanayā dhṛtavratā
verses.en: So, too, like charioteers are they, Mitra and sapient Varuna, Sons high-born from of old, whose holy laws stand fast.

verses.sa: ता माता विश्ववेदसाऽसुर्याय प्रमहसा । मही जजानादितिॠतावरी॥
verses.tr: tā mātā viśvavedasā'suryāya pramahasā mahī jajānāditiṝtāvarī
verses.en: These Twain, possessors of all wealth, most glorious, for supremest sway Aditi, Mighty Mother, true to Law, brought forth.

verses.sa: महान्ता मित्रावरुणा सम्राजा देवावसुरा । ऋतावानावृतमा घोषतो बृहत्॥
verses.tr: mahāntā mitrāvaruṇā samrājā devāvasurā ṛtāvānāvṛtamā ghoṣato bṛhat
verses.en: Great Varuna and Mitra, Gods, Asuras and imperial Lords, True to Eternal Law proclaim the high decree.

verses.sa: नपाता शवसो महः सूनू दक्षस्य सुक्रतू । सृप्रदानू इषो वास्त्वधि क्षितः॥
verses.tr: napātā śavaso mahaḥ sūnū dakṣasya sukratū sṛpradānū iṣo vāstvadhi kṣitaḥ
verses.en: The offspring of a lofty Power, Daksa's Two Sons exceeding strong, Who, Lords of flowing rain, dwell in the place of food.

verses.sa: सं या दानूनि येमथुर्दिव्याः पार्थिवीरिषः । नभस्वतीरा वां चरन्तु वृष्टयः॥
verses.tr: saṃ yā dānūni yemathurdivyāḥ pārthivīriṣaḥ nabhasvatīrā vāṃ carantu vṛṣṭayaḥ
verses.en: Ye who have gathered up your gifts, celestial and terrestrial food, Let your rain come to us fraught with the mist of heaven.

verses.sa: अधि या बृहतो दिवो३ऽभि यूथेव पश्यतः । ऋतावाना सम्राजा नमसे हिता॥
verses.tr: adhi yā bṛhato divo3'bhi yūtheva paśyataḥ ṛtāvānā samrājā namase hitā
verses.en: The Twain, who from the lofty sky seem to look down on herds below, Holy, imperial Lords, are set to be revered.

verses.sa: ऋतावाना नि षेदतुः साम्राज्याय सुक्रतू । धृतव्रता क्षत्रिया क्षत्रमाशतुः॥
verses.tr: ṛtāvānā ni ṣedatuḥ sāmrājyāya sukratū dhṛtavratā kṣatriyā kṣatramāśatuḥ
verses.en: They, true to Law, exceeding strong, have sat them down for Savran rule: Princes whose laws stand fast, they have obtained their sway.

verses.sa: अक्ष्णश्चिद्गातुवित्तरानुल्बणेन चक्षसा । नि चिन्मिषन्ता निचिरा नि चिक्यतुः॥
verses.tr: akṣṇaścidgātuvittarānulbaṇena cakṣasā ni cinmiṣantā nicirā ni cikyatuḥ
verses.en: Pathfinders even better than the eye, with unobstructed sight, Even when they close their lids, observant, they perceive.

verses.sa: उत नो देव्यदितिरुरुष्यतां नासत्या । उरुष्यन्तु मरुतो वृद्धशवसः॥
verses.tr: uta no devyaditiruruṣyatāṃ nāsatyā uruṣyantu maruto vṛddhaśavasaḥ
verses.en: So may the Goddess Aditi, may the Nasatyas guard us well, The Maruts guard us well endowed with mighty strength.

verses.sa: ते नो नावमुरुष्यत दिवा नक्तं सुदानवः । अरिष्यन्तो नि पायुभिः सचेमहि॥
verses.tr: te no nāvamuruṣyata divā naktaṃ sudānavaḥ ariṣyanto ni pāyubhiḥ sacemahi
verses.en: Do ye, O Bounteous Gods, protect our dwelling lace by day and night: With you for our defenders may we go unharmed.

verses.sa: अघ्नते विष्णवे वयमरिष्यन्तः सुदानवे । श्रुधि स्वयावन्त्सिन्धो पूर्वचित्तये॥
verses.tr: aghnate viṣṇave vayamariṣyantaḥ sudānave śrudhi svayāvantsindho pūrvacittaye
verses.en: May we, unharmed, serve bountiful Visnu, the God who slayeth none: Self-moving Sindhu hear and be the first to mark.

verses.sa: तद्वार्यं वृणीमहे वरिष्ठं गोपयत्यम् । मित्रो यत्पान्ति वरुणो यदर्यमा॥
verses.tr: tadvāryaṃ vṛṇīmahe variṣṭhaṃ gopayatyam mitro yatpānti varuṇo yadaryamā
verses.en: This sure protection we elect, desirable and reaching far, Which Mitra, Varuna, and Aryaman afford.

verses.sa: उत नः सिन्धुरपां तन्मरुतस्तदश्विना । इन्द्रो विष्णुर्मीढ्वांसः सजोषसः॥
verses.tr: uta naḥ sindhurapāṃ tanmarutastadaśvinā indro viṣṇurmīḍhvāṃsaḥ sajoṣasaḥ
verses.en: And may the Sindhu of the floods, the Maruts, and the ASvin Pair, Boon Indra, and boon Visnu have one mind with us.

verses.sa: ते हि ष्मा वनुषो नरोऽभिमातिं कयस्य चित् । तिग्मं न क्षोदः प्रतिघ्नन्ति भूर्णयः॥
verses.tr: te hi ṣmā vanuṣo naro'bhimātiṃ kayasya cit tigmaṃ na kṣodaḥ pratighnanti bhūrṇayaḥ
verses.en: Because these warring Heroes stay the enmity of every foe, As the fierce water-flood repels the furious ones.

verses.sa: अयमेक इत्था पुरूरु चष्टे वि विश्पतिः । तस्य व्रतान्यनु वश्चरामसि॥
verses.tr: ayameka itthā purūru caṣṭe vi viśpatiḥ tasya vratānyanu vaścarāmasi
verses.en: Here this one God, the Lord of men, looks forth exceeding far and wide: And we, for your advantage, keep his holy laws.

verses.sa: अनु पूर्वाण्योक्या साम्राज्यस्य सश्चिम । मित्रस्य व्रता वरुणस्य दीर्घश्रुत्॥
verses.tr: anu pūrvāṇyokyā sāmrājyasya saścima mitrasya vratā varuṇasya dīrghaśrut
verses.en: We keep the old accustomed laws, the statutes of supremacy, The Iong-known laws of Mitra and of Varuna.

verses.sa: परि यो रश्मिना दिवोऽन्तान्ममे पृथिव्याः । उभे आ पप्रौ रोदसी महित्वा॥
verses.tr: pari yo raśminā divo'ntānmame pṛthivyāḥ ubhe ā paprau rodasī mahitvā
verses.en: He who hath measured with his ray the boundaries of heaven and earth, And with his majesty hath filled the two worlds full,

verses.sa: उदु ष्य शरणे दिवो ज्योतिरयंस्त सूर्यः । अग्निर्न शुक्रः समिधान आहुतः॥
verses.tr: udu ṣya śaraṇe divo jyotirayaṃsta sūryaḥ agnirna śukraḥ samidhāna āhutaḥ
verses.en: Surya hath spread his light aloft up to the region of the sky, Like Agni all aflame when gifts are offered him.

verses.sa: वचो दीर्घप्रसद्मनीशे वाजस्य गोमतः । ईशे हि पित्वोऽविषस्य दावने॥
verses.tr: vaco dīrghaprasadmanīśe vājasya gomataḥ īśe hi pitvo'viṣasya dāvane
verses.en: With him who sits afar the word is lord of food that comes from kine, Controller of the gift of unempoisoned food.

verses.sa: तत्सूर्यं रोदसी उभे दोषा वस्तोरुप ब्रुवे । भोजेष्वस्माँ अभ्युच्चरा सदा॥
verses.tr: tatsūryaṃ rodasī ubhe doṣā vastorupa bruve bhojeṣvasmāṃ abhyuccarā sadā
verses.en: So unto Surya, Heaven, and Earth at morning and at eve I speak. Bringing enjoyments ever rise thou up for us.

verses.sa: ऋज्रमुक्षण्यायने रजतं हरयाणे । रथं युक्तमसनाम सुषामणि॥
verses.tr: ṛjramukṣaṇyāyane rajataṃ harayāṇe rathaṃ yuktamasanāma suṣāmaṇi
verses.en: From Uksanyayana a bay, from Harayana a white steed, And from Susaman we obtained a hamessed car.

verses.sa: ता मे अश्व्यानां हरीणां नितोशना । उतो नु कृत्व्यानां नृवाहसा॥
verses.tr: tā me aśvyānāṃ harīṇāṃ nitośanā uto nu kṛtvyānāṃ nṛvāhasā
verses.en: These two shall bring me further gain of troops of tawny-coloured steeds, The carriers shall they be of active men of war.

verses.sa: स्मदभीशू कशावन्ता विप्रा नविष्ठया मती । महो वाजिनावर्वन्ता सचासनम्॥
verses.tr: smadabhīśū kaśāvantā viprā naviṣṭhayā matī maho vājināvarvantā sacāsanam
verses.en: And the two sages have I gained who hold the reins and bear the whip, And the two great strong coursers, with my newest song.

verses.sa:
१६-१९,२१,२५ गायत्री; २० अनुष्टुप् ।
युवोरु षू रथं हुवे सधस्तुत्याय सूरिषु । अतूर्तदक्षा वृषणा वृषण्वसू॥
verses.tr: 16-19,21,25 gāyatrī; 20 anuṣṭup yuvoru ṣū rathaṃ huve sadhastutyāya sūriṣu atūrtadakṣā vṛṣaṇā vṛṣaṇvasū
verses.en: I CALL your chariot to receive united praise mid princely men, Strong Gods who pour down wealth, of never vanquished might!

verses.sa: युवं वरो सुषाम्णे महे तने नासत्या । अवोभिर्याथो वृषणा वृषण्वसू॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ varo suṣāmṇe mahe tane nāsatyā avobhiryātho vṛṣaṇā vṛṣaṇvasū
verses.en: Ye to Varosusaman come, Nasatyas, for this glorious rite. With your protecting aid. Strong Gods, who pour down wealth.

verses.sa: ता वामद्य हवामहे हव्येभिर्वाजिनीवसू । पूर्वीरिष इषयन्तावति क्षपः॥
verses.tr: tā vāmadya havāmahe havyebhirvājinīvasū pūrvīriṣa iṣayantāvati kṣapaḥ
verses.en: So with oblations we invoke you, rich in ample wealth, to-day, When night hath passed, O ye who send us plenteous food.

verses.sa: आ वां वाहिष्ठो अश्विना रथो यातु श्रुतो नरा । उप स्तोमान्तुरस्य दर्शथः श्रिये॥
verses.tr: ā vāṃ vāhiṣṭho aśvinā ratho yātu śruto narā upa stomānturasya darśathaḥ śriye
verses.en: O Asvins, Heroes, let your car, famed, best to travel, come to us, And, for his glory, mark your zealous servant's lauds.

verses.sa: जुहुराणा चिदश्विना ऽऽमन्येथां वृषण्वसू । युवं हि रुद्रा पर्षथो अति द्विषः॥
verses.tr: juhurāṇā cidaśvinā ''manyethāṃ vṛṣaṇvasū yuvaṃ hi rudrā parṣatho ati dviṣaḥ
verses.en: Asvins, who send us precious gifts, even when offended, think of him: For ye, O Rudras, lead us safe beyond our foes.

verses.sa: दस्रा हि विश्वमानुषङ्मक्षूभिः परिदीयथः । धियंजिन्वा मधुवर्णा शुभस्पती॥
verses.tr: dasrā hi viśvamānuṣaṅmakṣūbhiḥ paridīyathaḥ dhiyaṃjinvā madhuvarṇā śubhaspatī
verses.en: For, Wonder-Workers, with fleet steeds ye fly completely round this All, Stirring our thoughts, ye Lords of splendour, honey-hued.

verses.sa: उप नो यातमश्विना राया विश्वपुषा सह । मघवाना सुवीरावनपच्युता॥
verses.tr: upa no yātamaśvinā rāyā viśvapuṣā saha maghavānā suvīrāvanapacyutā
verses.en: With all-sustaining opulence, Asvins, come hitherward to us, Ye rich and noble Heroes, ne'er to be o'erthrown.

verses.sa: आ मे अस्य प्रतीव्य१मिन्द्रनासत्या गतम् । देवा देवेभिरद्य सचनस्तमा॥
verses.tr: ā me asya pratīvya1mindranāsatyā gatam devā devebhiradya sacanastamā
verses.en: To welcome this mine offering, O ye Indra-like Nasatyas, come As Gods of best accord this day with other Gods.

verses.sa: वयं हि वां हवामह उक्षण्यन्तो व्यश्ववत् । सुमतिभिरुप विप्राविहा गतम्॥
verses.tr: vayaṃ hi vāṃ havāmaha ukṣaṇyanto vyaśvavat sumatibhirupa viprāvihā gatam
verses.en: For we, like Vyasva, lifting up our voice like oxen, call on you: With all your loving kindness, Sages, come to us.

verses.sa: अश्विना स्वृषे स्तुहि कुवित्ते श्रवतो हवम् । नेदीयसः कूळयातः पणीँरुत॥
verses.tr: aśvinā svṛṣe stuhi kuvitte śravato havam nedīyasaḥ kūḻayātaḥ paṇīṃruta
verses.en: O Rsi, laud the Asvins well. Will they not listen to thy call? Will they not burn the Panis who are nearer them?

verses.sa: वैयश्वस्य श्रुतं नरोतो मे अस्य वेदथः । सजोषसा वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा॥
verses.tr: vaiyaśvasya śrutaṃ naroto me asya vedathaḥ sajoṣasā varuṇo mitro aryamā
verses.en: O Heroes, listen to the son of Vyasva, and regard me here, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman, of one accord.

verses.sa: युवादत्तस्य धिष्ण्या युवानीतस्य सूरिभिः । अहरहर्वृषण मह्यं शिक्षतम्॥
verses.tr: yuvādattasya dhiṣṇyā yuvānītasya sūribhiḥ aharaharvṛṣaṇa mahyaṃ śikṣatam
verses.en: Gods whom we yearn for, of your gifts, of what ye bring to us, bestow By princes' hands on me, ye Mighty, day by day.

verses.sa: यो वां यज्ञेभिरावृतोऽधिवस्त्रा वधूरिव । सपर्यन्ता शुभे चक्राते अश्विना॥
verses.tr: yo vāṃ yajñebhirāvṛto'dhivastrā vadhūriva saparyantā śubhe cakrāte aśvinā
verses.en: Him whom your sacrifices clothe, even as a woman with her robe, The Asvins help to glory honouring him well.

verses.sa: यो वामुरुव्यचस्तमं चिकेतति नृपाय्यम् । वर्तिरश्विना परि यातमस्मयू॥
verses.tr: yo vāmuruvyacastamaṃ ciketati nṛpāyyam vartiraśvinā pari yātamasmayū
verses.en: Whoso regards your care of men as succour widest in its reach, About his dwelling go, ye Asvins, loving us.

verses.sa: अस्मभ्यं सु वृषण्वसू यातं वर्तिर्नृपाय्यम् । विषुद्रुहेव यज्ञमूहथुर्गिरा॥
verses.tr: asmabhyaṃ su vṛṣaṇvasū yātaṃ vartirnṛpāyyam viṣudruheva yajñamūhathurgirā
verses.en: Come to us ye who pour down wealth, come to the home which men must guard: Like shafts, ye are made meet for sacrifice by song.

verses.sa: वाहिष्ठो वां हवानां स्तोमो दूतो हुवन्नरा । युवाभ्यां भूत्वश्विना॥
verses.tr: vāhiṣṭho vāṃ havānāṃ stomo dūto huvannarā yuvābhyāṃ bhūtvaśvinā
verses.en: Most fetching of all calls, the laud, as envoy, Heroes, called to you Be it your own, O Asvin Pair.

verses.sa: यददो दिवो अर्णव इषो वा मदथो गृहे । श्रुतमिन्मे अमर्त्या॥
verses.tr: yadado divo arṇava iṣo vā madatho gṛhe śrutaminme amartyā
verses.en: Be ye in yonder sea of heaven, or joying in the home of food, Listen to me, Immortal Ones.

verses.sa: उत स्या श्वेतयावरी वाहिष्ठा वां नदीनाम् । सिन्धुर्हिरण्यवर्तनिः॥
verses.tr: uta syā śvetayāvarī vāhiṣṭhā vāṃ nadīnām sindhurhiraṇyavartaniḥ
verses.en: This river with his lucid flow attracts you, more than all the streams,- Even Sindhu with his path of gold.

verses.sa: स्मदेतया सुकीर्त्याऽश्विना श्वेतया धिया । वहेथे शुभ्रयावाना॥
verses.tr: smadetayā sukīrtyā'śvinā śvetayā dhiyā vahethe śubhrayāvānā
verses.en: O Asvins, with that glorious fame come hither, through our brilliant song, Come ye whose ways are marked with light.

verses.sa: युक्ष्वा हि त्वं रथासहा युवस्व पोष्या वसो । आन्नो वायो मधु पिबाऽस्माकं सवना गहि॥
verses.tr: yukṣvā hi tvaṃ rathāsahā yuvasva poṣyā vaso ānno vāyo madhu pibā'smākaṃ savanā gahi
verses.en: Harness the steeds who draw the car, O Vasu, bring the well-fed pair. O Vayu, drink thou of our meath: come unto our drink-offerings.

verses.sa: तव वायवृतस्पते त्वष्टुर्जामातरद्भुत । अवांस्या वृणीमहे॥
verses.tr: tava vāyavṛtaspate tvaṣṭurjāmātaradbhuta avāṃsyā vṛṇīmahe
verses.en: Wonderful Vayu, Lord of Right, thou who art Tvastar's son-in-law, Thy saving succour we elect.

verses.sa: त्वष्टुर्जामातरं वयमीशानं राय ईमहे । सुतावन्तो वायुं द्युम्ना जनासः॥
verses.tr: tvaṣṭurjāmātaraṃ vayamīśānaṃ rāya īmahe sutāvanto vāyuṃ dyumnā janāsaḥ
verses.en: To Tvastar's son-in-law we pray for wealth whereof he hath control: For glory we seek vayu, men with juice effused.

verses.sa: वायो याहि शिवा दिवो वहस्वा सु स्वश्व्यम् । वहस्व महः पृथुपक्षसा रथे॥
verses.tr: vāyo yāhi śivā divo vahasvā su svaśvyam vahasva mahaḥ pṛthupakṣasā rathe
verses.en: From heaven, auspicious Vayu, come drive hither with thy noble steeds: Come on thy mighty car with wide-extending seat.

verses.sa: त्वां हि सुप्सरस्तमं नृषदनेषु हूमहे । ग्रावाणं नाश्वपृष्ठं मंहना॥
verses.tr: tvāṃ hi supsarastamaṃ nṛṣadaneṣu hūmahe grāvāṇaṃ nāśvapṛṣṭhaṃ maṃhanā
verses.en: We call thee to the homes of men, thee wealthiest in noble food, And liberal as a press-stone with a horse's back.

verses.sa: स त्वं नो देव मनसा वायो मन्दानो अग्रियः । कृधि वाजाँ अपो धियः॥
verses.tr: sa tvaṃ no deva manasā vāyo mandāno agriyaḥ kṛdhi vājāṃ apo dhiyaḥ
verses.en: So, glad and joyful in thine heart, do thou, God, Vayu, first of all Vouchsafe us water, strength, and thought.

verses.sa: अग्निरुक्थे पुरोहितो ग्रावाणो बर्हिरध्वरे । ऋचा यामि मरुतो ब्रह्मणस्पतिं देवाँ अवो वरेण्यम्॥
verses.tr: agnirukthe purohito grāvāṇo barhiradhvare ṛcā yāmi maruto brahmaṇaspatiṃ devāṃ avo vareṇyam
verses.en: Cheif Priest is Agni at the laud, as stones and grass at sacrifice: With song I seek the Maruts, Brahmanaspati, Gods for help much to be desired.

verses.sa:
आ पशुं गासि पृथिवीं वनस्पतीनुषासा नक्तमोषधीः ।
विश्वे च नो वसवो विश्ववेदसो धीनां भूत प्रावितारः॥
verses.tr: ā paśuṃ gāsi pṛthivīṃ vanaspatīnuṣāsā naktamoṣadhīḥ viśve ca no vasavo viśvavedaso dhīnāṃ bhūta prāvitāraḥ
verses.en: I sing to cattle and to Earth, to trees, to Dawns, to Night, to plants. O all ye Vasus, ye possessors of all wealth, be ye the furtherers of our thoughts.

verses.sa: प्र सू न एत्वध्वरो३ऽग्ना देवेषु पूर्व्यः । आदित्येषु प्र वरुणे धृतव्रते मरुत्सु विश्वभानुषु॥
verses.tr: pra sū na etvadhvaro3'gnā deveṣu pūrvyaḥ ādityeṣu pra varuṇe dhṛtavrate marutsu viśvabhānuṣu
verses.en: Forth go, with Agni, to the Gods our sacrifice of ancient use, To the Adityas, Varuna whose Law stands fast, and the all-lightening Marut troop.

verses.sa: विश्वे हि ष्मा मनवे विश्ववेदसो भुवन्वृधे रिशादसः । अरिष्टेभिः पायुभिर्विश्ववेदसो यन्ता नोऽवृकं छर्दिः॥
verses.tr: viśve hi ṣmā manave viśvavedaso bhuvanvṛdhe riśādasaḥ ariṣṭebhiḥ pāyubhirviśvavedaso yantā no'vṛkaṃ chardiḥ
verses.en: Lords of all wealth, may they be strengtheners of man, destroyers of his enemies. Lords of all wealth, do ye, with guards which none may harm, preserve our dwelling free from foes.

verses.sa: आ नो अद्य समनसो गन्ता विश्वे सजोषसः । ऋचा गिरा मरुतो देव्यदिते सदने पस्त्ये महि॥
verses.tr: ā no adya samanaso gantā viśve sajoṣasaḥ ṛcā girā maruto devyadite sadane pastye mahi
verses.en: Come to us with one mind to-day, come to us all with one accord, Maruts with holy song, and, Goddess Aditi, Mighty One, to our house and home.

verses.sa:
अभि प्रिया मरुतो या वो अश्व्या हव्या मित्र प्रयाथन ।
आ बर्हिरिन्द्रो वरुणस्तुरा नर आदित्यासः सदन्तु नः॥
verses.tr: abhi priyā maruto yā vo aśvyā havyā mitra prayāthana ā barhirindro varuṇasturā nara ādityāsaḥ sadantu naḥ
verses.en: Send us delightful things, ye Maruts, on your steeds: come ye, O Mitra, to our gifts. Let Indra, Varuna, and the Adityas sit, swift Heroes, on our sacred grass.

verses.sa: वयं वो वृक्तबर्हिषो हितप्रयस आनुषक् । सुतसोमासो वरुण हवामहे मनुष्वदिद्धाग्नयः॥
verses.tr: vayaṃ vo vṛktabarhiṣo hitaprayasa ānuṣak sutasomāso varuṇa havāmahe manuṣvadiddhāgnayaḥ
verses.en: We who have trimmed the grass for you, and set the banquet in array, And pressed the Soma, call you, Varuina, like men, with sacrificial fires aflame.

verses.sa:
आ प्र यात मरुतो विष्णो अश्विना पूषन्माकीनया धिया ।
इन्द्र आ यातु प्रथमः सनिष्युभिर्वृषा यो वृत्रहा गृणे॥
verses.tr: ā pra yāta maruto viṣṇo aśvinā pūṣanmākīnayā dhiyā indra ā yātu prathamaḥ saniṣyubhirvṛṣā yo vṛtrahā gṛṇe
verses.en: O Maruts, Visinu, Asvins, Pusan, haste away with minds turned hitherward to Me. Let the Strong Indra, famed as Vrtra's slayer, come first with the winners of the spoil.

verses.sa: वि नो देवासो अद्रुहोऽच्छिद्रं शर्म यच्छत । न यद्दूराद्वसवो नू चिदन्तितो वरूथमादधर्षति॥
verses.tr: vi no devāso adruho'cchidraṃ śarma yacchata na yaddūrādvasavo nū cidantito varūthamādadharṣati
verses.en: Ye Guileless Gods, bestow on us a refuge strong on every side, A sure protection, Vasus, unassailable from near at hand or from afar.

verses.sa:
अस्ति हि वः सजात्यं रिशादसो देवासो अस्त्याप्यम् ।
प्र णः पूर्वस्मै सुविताय वोचत मक्षू सुम्नाय नव्यसे॥
verses.tr: asti hi vaḥ sajātyaṃ riśādaso devāso astyāpyam pra ṇaḥ pūrvasmai suvitāya vocata makṣū sumnāya navyase
verses.en: Kinship have I with you, and close alliance O ye Gods, destroyers of our foes. Call us to our prosperity of former days, and soon to new felicity.

verses.sa: इदा हि व उपस्तुतिमिदा वामस्य भक्तये । उप वो विश्ववेदसो नमस्युराँ असृक्ष्यन्यामिव॥
verses.tr: idā hi va upastutimidā vāmasya bhaktaye upa vo viśvavedaso namasyurāṃ asṛkṣyanyāmiva
verses.en: For now have I sent forth to you, that I may win a fair reward, Lords of all wealth, with homage, this my song of praise. like a milch-cow that faileth not.

verses.sa: उदु ष्य वः सविता सुप्रणीतयोऽस्थादूर्ध्वो वरेण्यः । नि द्विपादश्चतुष्पादो अर्थिनोऽविश्रन्पतयिष्णवः॥
verses.tr: udu ṣya vaḥ savitā supraṇītayo'sthādūrdhvo vareṇyaḥ ni dvipādaścatuṣpādo arthino'viśranpatayiṣṇavaḥ
verses.en: Excellent Savitar hath mounted up on high for you, ye sure and careful Guides. Bipeds and quadrupeds, with several hopes and aims, and birds have settled to their tasks.

verses.sa: देवंदेवं वोऽवसे देवंदेवमभिष्टये । देवंदेवं हुवेम वाजसातये गृणन्तो देव्या धिया॥
verses.tr: devaṃdevaṃ vo'vase devaṃdevamabhiṣṭaye devaṃdevaṃ huvema vājasātaye gṛṇanto devyā dhiyā
verses.en: Singing their praise with God-like thought let us invoke each God for grace, Each God to bring you help, each God to strengthen you.

verses.sa:
देवासो हि ष्मा मनवे समन्यवो विश्वे साकं सरातयः ।
ते नो अद्य ते अपरं तुचे तु नो भवन्तु वरिवोविदः॥
verses.tr: devāso hi ṣmā manave samanyavo viśve sākaṃ sarātayaḥ te no adya te aparaṃ tuce tu no bhavantu varivovidaḥ
verses.en: For of one spirit are the Gods with mortal man, co-sharers all of gracious gifts. May they increase our strength hereafter and to-day, providing case and ample room.

verses.sa: प्र वः शंसाम्यद्रुहः संस्थ उपस्तुतीनाम् । न तं धूर्तिर्वरुण मित्र मर्त्यं यो वो धामभ्योऽविधत्॥
verses.tr: pra vaḥ śaṃsāmyadruhaḥ saṃstha upastutīnām na taṃ dhūrtirvaruṇa mitra martyaṃ yo vo dhāmabhyo'vidhat
verses.en: I laud you, O ye Guileless Gods, here where we meet to render praise. None, Varuna and Mitra, harms the mortal, man who honours and obeys your laws.

verses.sa: प्र स क्षयं तिरते वि महीरिषो यो वो वराय दाशति । प्र प्रजाभिर्जायते धर्मणस्पर्यरिष्टः सर्व एधते॥
verses.tr: pra sa kṣayaṃ tirate vi mahīriṣo yo vo varāya dāśati pra prajābhirjāyate dharmaṇasparyariṣṭaḥ sarva edhate
verses.en: He makes his house endure, he gathers plenteous food who pays obedience to your will. Born in his sons anew he spreads as Law commands, and prospers every way unharmed.

verses.sa: ऋते स विन्दते युधः सुगेभिर्यात्यध्वनः । अर्यमा मित्रो वरुणः सरातयो यं त्रायन्ते सजोषसः॥
verses.tr: ṛte sa vindate yudhaḥ sugebhiryātyadhvanaḥ aryamā mitro varuṇaḥ sarātayo yaṃ trāyante sajoṣasaḥ
verses.en: E'en without war he gathers wealth, and goes his way on pleasant paths, Whom Mitra, Varuna and Aryaman protect, sharing the gift of one accord.

verses.sa: अज्रे चिदस्मै कृणुथा न्यञ्चनं दुर्गे चिदा सुसरणम् । एषा चिदस्मादशनिः परो नु सास्रेधन्ती वि नश्यतु॥
verses.tr: ajre cidasmai kṛṇuthā nyañcanaṃ durge cidā susaraṇam eṣā cidasmādaśaniḥ paro nu sāsredhantī vi naśyatu
verses.en: E'en on the plain for him ye make a sloping path, an easy way where road is none: And far away from him the ineffectual shaft must vanish, shot at him in vain.

verses.sa: यदद्य सूर्य उद्यति प्रियक्षत्रा ऋतं दध । यन्निम्रुचि प्रबुधि विश्ववेदसो यद्वा मध्यंदिने दिवः॥
verses.tr: yadadya sūrya udyati priyakṣatrā ṛtaṃ dadha yannimruci prabudhi viśvavedaso yadvā madhyaṃdine divaḥ
verses.en: If ye appoint the rite to-day, kind Rulers, when the Sun ascends, Lords of all wealth, at sunset or at waking time, or be it at the noon of day,

verses.sa: यद्वाभिपित्वे असुरा ऋतं यते छर्दिर्येम वि दाशुषे । वयं तद्वो वसवो विश्ववेदस उप स्थेयाम मध्य आ॥
verses.tr: yadvābhipitve asurā ṛtaṃ yate chardiryema vi dāśuṣe vayaṃ tadvo vasavo viśvavedasa upa stheyāma madhya ā
verses.en: Or, Asuras, when ye have sheltered the worshipper who goes to sacrifice, at eve may we, O Vasus, ye possessors of all wealth, come then into the midst of You.

verses.sa: यदद्य सूर उदिते यन्मध्यंदिन आतुचि । वामं धत्थ मनवे विश्ववेदसो जुह्वानाय प्रचेतसे॥
verses.tr: yadadya sūra udite yanmadhyaṃdina ātuci vāmaṃ dhattha manave viśvavedaso juhvānāya pracetase
verses.en: If ye to-day at sunrise, or at noon, or in the gloom of eve, Lords of all riches, give fair treasure to the man, the wise man who hath sacrificed,

verses.sa:
वयं तद्वः सम्राज आ वृणीमहे पुत्रो न बहुपाय्यम् ।
अश्याम तदादित्या जुह्वतो हविर्येन वस्योऽनशामहै॥
verses.tr: vayaṃ tadvaḥ samrāja ā vṛṇīmahe putro na bahupāyyam aśyāma tadādityā juhvato haviryena vasyo'naśāmahai
verses.en: Then we, imperial Rulers, claim of you this boon, your wide protection, as a son. May we, Adityas, offering holy gifts, obtain that which shall bring us greater bliss.

verses.sa: ये त्रिंशति त्रयस्परो देवासो बर्हिरासदन् । विदन्नह द्वितासनन्॥
verses.tr: ye triṃśati trayasparo devāso barhirāsadan vidannaha dvitāsanan
verses.en: The Thirty Gods and Three besides, whose seat hath been the sacred grass, From time of old have found and gained.

verses.sa: वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा स्मद्रातिषाचो अग्नयः । पत्नीवन्तो वषट्कृताः॥
verses.tr: varuṇo mitro aryamā smadrātiṣāco agnayaḥ patnīvanto vaṣaṭkṛtāḥ
verses.en: Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman, Agnis, with Consorts, sending boons, To whom our Vasat! is addressed:

verses.sa: ते नो गोपा अपाच्यास्त उदक्त इत्था न्यक् । पुरस्तात्सर्वया विशा॥
verses.tr: te no gopā apācyāsta udakta itthā nyak purastātsarvayā viśā
verses.en: These are our guardians in the west, and northward here, and in the south, And on the cast, with all the tribe.

verses.sa: यथा वशन्ति देवास्तथेदसत्तदेषां नकिरा मिनत् । अरावा चन मर्त्यः॥
verses.tr: yathā vaśanti devāstathedasattadeṣāṃ nakirā minat arāvā cana martyaḥ
verses.en: Even as the Gods desire so verily shall it be. None diminisheth this power of theirs, No demon, and no mortal

verses.sa: सप्तानां सप्त ऋष्टयः सप्त द्युम्नान्येषाम् । सप्तो अधि श्रियो धिरे॥
verses.tr: saptānāṃ sapta ṛṣṭayaḥ sapta dyumnānyeṣām sapto adhi śriyo dhire
verses.en: The Seven carry seven spears; seven are the splendours they possess, And seven the glories they assume.

verses.sa: बभ्रुरेको विषुणः सूनरो युवाञ्ज्यङ्क्ते हिरण्ययम् ॥
verses.tr: babhrureko viṣuṇaḥ sūnaro yuvāñjyaṅkte hiraṇyayam
verses.en: One is a youth brown, active, manifold he decks the golden one with ornament.

verses.sa: योनिमेक आ ससाद द्योतनोऽन्तर्देवेषु मेधिरः॥
verses.tr: yonimeka ā sasāda dyotano'ntardeveṣu medhiraḥ
verses.en: Another, luminous, occupies the place of sacrifice, Sage, among the Gods.

verses.sa: वाशीमेको बिभर्ति हस्त आयसीमन्तर्देवेषु निध्रुविः ॥
verses.tr: vāśīmeko bibharti hasta āyasīmantardeveṣu nidhruviḥ
verses.en: One brandishes in his hand an iron knife, firm, in his seat amid the Deities.

verses.sa: वज्रमेको बिभर्ति हस्त आहितं तेन वृत्राणि जिघ्नते॥
verses.tr: vajrameko bibharti hasta āhitaṃ tena vṛtrāṇi jighnate
verses.en: Another holds the thunderbolt, wherewith he slays the Vrtras, resting in his hand.

verses.sa: तिग्ममेको बिभर्ति हस्त आयुधं शुचिरुग्रो जलाषभेषजः ॥
verses.tr: tigmameko bibharti hasta āyudhaṃ śucirugro jalāṣabheṣajaḥ
verses.en: Another bears a pointed weapon: bright is he, and strong, with healing medicines.

verses.sa: पथ एकः पीपाय तस्करो यथाँ एष वेद निधीनाम्॥
verses.tr: patha ekaḥ pīpāya taskaro yathāṃ eṣa veda nidhīnām
verses.en: Another, thief-like, watches well the ways, and knows the places where the treasures lie.

verses.sa: त्रीण्येक उरुगायो वि चक्रमे यत्र देवासो मदन्ति ॥
verses.tr: trīṇyeka urugāyo vi cakrame yatra devāso madanti
verses.en: Another with his mighty stride hath made his three steps thither where the Gods rejoice.

verses.sa: विभिर्द्वा चरत एकया सह प्र प्रवासेव वसतः॥
verses.tr: vibhirdvā carata ekayā saha pra pravāseva vasataḥ
verses.en: Two with one Dame ride on with winged steeds, and journey forth like travellers on their way.

verses.sa: सदो द्वा चक्राते उपमा दिवि सम्राजा सर्पिरासुती ॥
verses.tr: sado dvā cakrāte upamā divi samrājā sarpirāsutī
verses.en: Two, highest, in the heavens have set their seat, worshipped with holy oil, imperial Kings.

verses.sa: अर्चन्त एके महि साम मन्वत तेन सूर्यमरोचयन्॥
verses.tr: arcanta eke mahi sāma manvata tena sūryamarocayan
verses.en: Some, singing lauds, conceived the Sama-hymn, great hymn whereby they caused the Sun to shine.

verses.sa: नहि वो अस्त्यर्भको देवासो न कुमारकः । विश्वे सतोमहान्त इत्॥
verses.tr: nahi vo astyarbhako devāso na kumārakaḥ viśve satomahānta it
verses.en: Not one of you, ye Gods, is small, none of you is a feeble child: All of you, verily, are great.

verses.sa: इति स्तुतासो असथा रिशादसो ये स्थ त्रयश्च त्रिंशच्च । मनोर्देवा यज्ञियासः॥
verses.tr: iti stutāso asathā riśādaso ye stha trayaśca triṃśacca manordevā yajñiyāsaḥ
verses.en: Thus be ye lauded, ye destroyers of the foe, ye Three-and-Thirty Deities, The Gods of man, the Holy Ones.

verses.sa: ते नस्त्राध्वं तेऽवत त उ नो अधि वोचत । मा नः पथः पित्र्यान्मानवादधि दूरं नैष्ट परावतः॥
verses.tr: te nastrādhvaṃ te'vata ta u no adhi vocata mā naḥ pathaḥ pitryānmānavādadhi dūraṃ naiṣṭa parāvataḥ
verses.en: As such defend and succour us, with benedictions speak to us: Lead us not from our fathers' and from Manu's path into the distance far away.

verses.sa: ये देवास इह स्थन विश्वे वैश्वानरा उत । अस्मभ्यं शर्म सप्रथो गवेऽश्वाय यच्छत॥
verses.tr: ye devāsa iha sthana viśve vaiśvānarā uta asmabhyaṃ śarma sapratho gave'śvāya yacchata
verses.en: Ye Deities who stay with us, and all ye Gods of all mankind, Give us your wide protection, give shelter for cattle and for steed.

sections.label: Praise of sacrifice and the devoted couple
sections.name: Mandala 8, hymn 31

verses.sa: यो यजाति यजात इत्सुनवच्च पचाति च । ब्रह्मेदिन्द्रस्य चाकनत्॥
verses.tr: yo yajāti yajāta itsunavacca pacāti ca brahmedindrasya cākanat
verses.en: That Brahman pleases Indra well, who worships, sacrifices, pours Libation, and prepares the meal.

verses.sa: पुरोळाशं यो अस्मै सोमं ररत आशिरम् । पादित्तं शक्रो अंहसः॥
verses.tr: puroḻāśaṃ yo asmai somaṃ rarata āśiram pādittaṃ śakro aṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Sakra protects from woe the man who gives him sacrificial cake. And offers Soma blent with milk.

verses.sa: तस्य द्युमाँ असद्रथो देवजूतः स शूशुवत् । विश्वा वन्वन्नमित्रिया॥
verses.tr: tasya dyumāṃ asadratho devajūtaḥ sa śūśuvat viśvā vanvannamitriyā
verses.en: His chariot shall be glorious, sped by Gods, and mighty shall he be, Subduing all hostilities.

verses.sa: अस्य प्रजावती गृहेऽसश्चन्ती दिवेदिवे । इळा धेनुमती दुहे॥
verses.tr: asya prajāvatī gṛhe'saścantī divedive iḻā dhenumatī duhe
verses.en: Each day that passes, in his house flows his libation, rich in milk, Exhaustless, bringing progeny.

verses.sa: या दम्पती समनसा सुनुत आ च धावतः । देवासो नित्ययाशिरा॥
verses.tr: yā dampatī samanasā sunuta ā ca dhāvataḥ devāso nityayāśirā
verses.en: O Gods, with constant draught of milk, husband and wife with one accord Press out and wash the Soma juice.

verses.sa: प्रति प्राशव्याँ इतः सम्यञ्चा बर्हिराशाते । न ता वाजेषु वायतः॥
verses.tr: prati prāśavyāṃ itaḥ samyañcā barhirāśāte na tā vājeṣu vāyataḥ
verses.en: They gain sufficient food: they come united to the sacred grass, And never do they fail in strength.

verses.sa: न देवानामपि ह्नुतः सुमतिं न जुगुक्षतः । श्रवो बृहद्विवासतः॥
verses.tr: na devānāmapi hnutaḥ sumatiṃ na jugukṣataḥ śravo bṛhadvivāsataḥ
verses.en: Never do they deny or seek to hide the favour of the Gods: They win high glory for themselves.

verses.sa: पुत्रिणा ता कुमारिणा विश्वमायुर्व्यश्नुतः । उभा हिरण्यपेशसा॥
verses.tr: putriṇā tā kumāriṇā viśvamāyurvyaśnutaḥ ubhā hiraṇyapeśasā
verses.en: With sons and daughters by their side they reach their full extent of life, Both decked with ornaments of gold.

verses.sa: वीतिहोत्रा कृतद्वसू दशस्यन्तामृताय कम् । समूधो रोमशं हतो देवेषु कृणुतो दुवः॥
verses.tr: vītihotrā kṛtadvasū daśasyantāmṛtāya kam samūdho romaśaṃ hato deveṣu kṛṇuto duvaḥ
verses.en: Serving the Immortal One with gifts of sacrificial meal and wealth, They satisfy the claims of love and pay due honour to the Gods.

verses.sa: आ शर्म पर्वतानां वृणीमहे नदीनाम् । आ विष्णोः सचाभुवः॥
verses.tr: ā śarma parvatānāṃ vṛṇīmahe nadīnām ā viṣṇoḥ sacābhuvaḥ
verses.en: We claim protection from the Hills, we claim protection of the Floods, Of him who stands by Visnu's side.

verses.sa: ऐतु पूषा रयिर्भगः स्वस्ति सर्वधातमः । उरुरध्वा स्वस्तये॥
verses.tr: aitu pūṣā rayirbhagaḥ svasti sarvadhātamaḥ ururadhvā svastaye
verses.en: May Pusan come, and Bhaga, Lord of wealth, All-bounteous, for our weal Broad be the path that leads to bliss:

verses.sa: अरमतिरनर्वणो विश्वो देवस्य मनसा । आदित्यानामनेह इत्॥
verses.tr: aramatiranarvaṇo viśvo devasya manasā ādityānāmaneha it
verses.en: Aramati, and, free from foes, Visva with spirit of a God, And the Adityas' peerless might.

verses.sa: यथा नो मित्रो अर्यमा वरुणः सन्ति गोपाः । सुगा ऋतस्य पन्थाः॥
verses.tr: yathā no mitro aryamā varuṇaḥ santi gopāḥ sugā ṛtasya panthāḥ
verses.en: Seeing that Mitra, Aryaman, and Varuna are guarding us, The paths of Law are fair to tread.

verses.sa: अग्निं वः पूर्व्यं गिरा देवमीळे वसूनाम् । सपर्यन्तः पुरुप्रियं मित्रं न क्षेत्रसाधसम्॥
verses.tr: agniṃ vaḥ pūrvyaṃ girā devamīḻe vasūnām saparyantaḥ purupriyaṃ mitraṃ na kṣetrasādhasam
verses.en: I glorify with song, for wealth, Agni the God, the first of you. We honour as a well-loved Friend the God who prospereth our fields.

verses.sa: मक्षू देववतो रथः शूरो वा पृत्सु कासु चित् । देवानां य इन्मनो यजमान इयक्षत्यभीदयज्वनो भुवत्॥
verses.tr: makṣū devavato rathaḥ śūro vā pṛtsu kāsu cit devānāṃ ya inmano yajamāna iyakṣatyabhīdayajvano bhuvat
verses.en: As in all frays the hero, so swift moves his car whom Gods attend. The man who, sacrificing, strives to win the heart of Deities will conquer those who worship not.

verses.sa: न यजमान रिष्यसि न सुन्वान न देवयो । देवानां य इन्मनो यजमान इयक्षत्यभीदयज्वनो भुवत्॥
verses.tr: na yajamāna riṣyasi na sunvāna na devayo devānāṃ ya inmano yajamāna iyakṣatyabhīdayajvano bhuvat
verses.en: Ne'er are ye injured, worshipper, presser of juice, or pious man. The man who, sacrificing, strives to win the heart of Deities will conquer those who worship not.

verses.sa: नकिष्टं कर्मणा नशन्न प्र योषन्न योषति । देवानां य इन्मनो यजमान इयक्षत्यभीदयज्वनो भुवत्॥
verses.tr: nakiṣṭaṃ karmaṇā naśanna pra yoṣanna yoṣati devānāṃ ya inmano yajamāna iyakṣatyabhīdayajvano bhuvat
verses.en: None in his action equals him, none holds him far or keeps him off. The man who, sacrificing, strives to win the heart of Deities will conquer those who worship not.

verses.sa: असदत्र सुवीर्यमुत त्यदाश्वश्व्यम् । देवानां य इन्मनो यजमान इयक्षत्यभीदयज्वनो भुवत्॥
verses.tr: asadatra suvīryamuta tyadāśvaśvyam devānāṃ ya inmano yajamāna iyakṣatyabhīdayajvano bhuvat
verses.en: Such strength of heroes shall be his, such mastery of fleet-foot steeds. The man who, sacrificing, strives to win the heart of Deities will conquer those who worship not.

verses.sa: प्र कृतान्यृजीषिणः कण्वा इन्द्रस्य गाथया । मदे सोमस्य वोचत॥
verses.tr: pra kṛtānyṛjīṣiṇaḥ kaṇvā indrasya gāthayā made somasya vocata
verses.en: Kanvas, tell forth with song the deeds of Indra, the Impetuous, Wrought in the Soma's wild delight.

verses.sa: यः सृबिन्दमनर्शनिं पिप्रुं दासमहीशुवम् । वधीदुग्रो रिणन्नपः॥
verses.tr: yaḥ sṛbindamanarśaniṃ pipruṃ dāsamahīśuvam vadhīdugro riṇannapaḥ
verses.en: Strong God, he slew Anarsani, Srbinda, Pipru, and the fiend, Ahisuva, and loosed the floods.

verses.sa: न्यर्बुदस्य विष्टपं वर्ष्माणं बृहतस्तिर । कृषे तदिन्द्र पौंस्यम्॥
verses.tr: nyarbudasya viṣṭapaṃ varṣmāṇaṃ bṛhatastira kṛṣe tadindra pauṃsyam
verses.en: Thou broughtest down the dwelling-place, the height of lofty Arbuda. That exploit, Indra, must be famed.

verses.sa: प्रति श्रुताय वो धृषत्तूर्णाशं न गिरेरधि । हुवे सुशिप्रमूतये॥
verses.tr: prati śrutāya vo dhṛṣattūrṇāśaṃ na gireradhi huve suśipramūtaye
verses.en: Bold, to your famous Soma I call the fair-visored God for aid, Down like a torrent from the hill.

verses.sa: स गोरश्वस्य वि व्रजं मन्दानः सोम्येभ्यः । पुरं न शूर दर्षसि॥
verses.tr: sa goraśvasya vi vrajaṃ mandānaḥ somyebhyaḥ puraṃ na śūra darṣasi
verses.en: Rejoicing in the Soma-draughts, Hero, burst open, like a fort, The stall of horses and of kine.

verses.sa: यदि मे रारणः सुत उक्थे वा दधसे चनः । आरादुप स्वधा गहि॥
verses.tr: yadi me rāraṇaḥ suta ukthe vā dadhase canaḥ ārādupa svadhā gahi
verses.en: If my libation gladdens, if thou takest pleasure in my laud, Come with thy Godhead from afar.

verses.sa: वयं घा ते अपि ष्मसि स्तोतार इन्द्र गिर्वणः । त्वं नो जिन्व सोमपाः॥
verses.tr: vayaṃ ghā te api ṣmasi stotāra indra girvaṇaḥ tvaṃ no jinva somapāḥ
verses.en: O Indra, Lover of the Song, the singers of thy praise are we: O Soma-drinker, quicken us.

verses.sa: उत नः पितुमा भर संरराणो अविक्षितम् । मघवन्भूरि ते वसु॥
verses.tr: uta naḥ pitumā bhara saṃrarāṇo avikṣitam maghavanbhūri te vasu
verses.en: And, taking thy delight with us bring us still undiminished food: Great is thy wealth, O Maghavan.

verses.sa: उत नो गोमतस्कृधि हिरण्यवतो अश्विनः । इळाभिः सं रभेमहि॥
verses.tr: uta no gomataskṛdhi hiraṇyavato aśvinaḥ iḻābhiḥ saṃ rabhemahi
verses.en: Make thou us rich in herds of kine, in steeds, in gold: let us exert Our strength in sacrificial gifts.

verses.sa: बृबदुक्थं हवामहे सृप्रकरस्नमूतये । साधु कृण्वन्तमवसे॥
verses.tr: bṛbadukthaṃ havāmahe sṛprakarasnamūtaye sādhu kṛṇvantamavase
verses.en: Let us call him to aid whose hands stretch far, to whom high laud is due. Who worketh well to succour us.

verses.sa: यः संस्थे चिच्छतक्रतुरादीं कृणोति वृत्रहा । जरितृभ्यः पुरूवसुः॥
verses.tr: yaḥ saṃsthe cicchatakraturādīṃ kṛṇoti vṛtrahā jaritṛbhyaḥ purūvasuḥ
verses.en: He, Satakratu, even in fight acts as a Vrtra-slayer still: He gives his worshippers much wealth.

verses.sa: स नः शक्रश्चिदा शकद्दानवाँ अन्तराभरः । इन्द्रो विश्वाभिरूतिभिः॥
verses.tr: sa naḥ śakraścidā śakaddānavāṃ antarābharaḥ indro viśvābhirūtibhiḥ
verses.en: May he, this Aakra, strengthen us, Boon God who satisfies our needs, Indra, with all his saving helps.

verses.sa: यो रायो३ऽवनिर्महान्त्सुपारः सुन्वतः सखा । तमिन्द्रमभि गायत॥
verses.tr: yo rāyo3'vanirmahāntsupāraḥ sunvataḥ sakhā tamindramabhi gāyata
verses.en: To him, the mighty stream of wealth, the Soma-presser's rescuing Friend, To Indra sing your song of praise;

verses.sa: आयन्तारं महि स्थिरं पृतनासु श्रवोजितम् । भूरेरीशानमोजसा॥
verses.tr: āyantāraṃ mahi sthiraṃ pṛtanāsu śravojitam bhūrerīśānamojasā
verses.en: Who bringeth what is great and firm, who winneth glory in his wars, Lord of vast wealth through power and might.

verses.sa: नकिरस्य शचीनां नियन्ता सूनृतानाम् । नकिर्वक्ता न दादिति॥
verses.tr: nakirasya śacīnāṃ niyantā sūnṛtānām nakirvaktā na dāditi
verses.en: There liveth none to cheek or stay his energies and gracious deeds: None who can say, He giveth not.

verses.sa: न नूनं ब्रह्मणामृणं प्राशूनामस्ति सुन्वताम् । न सोमो अप्रता पपे॥
verses.tr: na nūnaṃ brahmaṇāmṛṇaṃ prāśūnāmasti sunvatām na somo apratā pape
verses.en: No debt is due by Brahmans now, by active men who press the juice: Well hath each Soma-draught been paid.

verses.sa: पन्य इदुप गायत पन्य उक्थानि शंसत । ब्रह्मा कृणोत पन्य इत्॥
verses.tr: panya idupa gāyata panya ukthāni śaṃsata brahmā kṛṇota panya it
verses.en: Sing ye to him who must be praised, say lauds to him who must be praised, Bring prayer to him who must be praised.

verses.sa: पन्य आ दर्दिरच्छता सहस्रा वाज्यवृतः । इन्द्रो यो यज्वनो वृधः॥
verses.tr: panya ā dardiracchatā sahasrā vājyavṛtaḥ indro yo yajvano vṛdhaḥ
verses.en: May be, unchecked, strong, meet for praise, bring hundreds, thousands forth to light, Indra who aids the worshipper.

verses.sa: वि षू चर स्वधा अनु कृष्टीनामन्वाहुवः । इन्द्र पिब सुतानाम्॥
verses.tr: vi ṣū cara svadhā anu kṛṣṭīnāmanvāhuvaḥ indra piba sutānām
verses.en: Go with thy God-like nature forth, go where the folk are calling thee: Drink, Indra, of the drops we pour.

verses.sa: पिब स्वधैनवानामुत यस्तुग्र्ये सचा । उतायमिन्द्र यस्तव॥
verses.tr: piba svadhainavānāmuta yastugrye sacā utāyamindra yastava
verses.en: Drink milky draughts which are thine own, this too which was with Tugrya once, This is it, Indra, that is thine.

verses.sa: अतीहि मन्युषाविणं सुषुवांसमुपारणे । इमं रातं सुतं पिब ॥२॥
verses.tr: atīhi manyuṣāviṇaṃ suṣuvāṃsamupāraṇe imaṃ rātaṃ sutaṃ piba 2
verses.en: Pass him who pours libations out in angry mood or after sin: Here drink the juice we offer thee.

verses.sa: इहि तिस्रः परावत इहि पञ्च जनाँ अति । धेना इन्द्रावचाकशत्॥
verses.tr: ihi tisraḥ parāvata ihi pañca janāṃ ati dhenā indrāvacākaśat
verses.en: Over the three great distances, past the Five Peoples go thy way, O Indra, noticing our voice.

verses.sa: सूर्यो रश्मिं यथा सृजा ऽऽत्वा यच्छन्तु मे गिरः । निम्नमापो न सध्र्यक्॥
verses.tr: sūryo raśmiṃ yathā sṛjā ''tvā yacchantu me giraḥ nimnamāpo na sadhryak
verses.en: Send forth thy ray like Surya: let my songs attract thee hitherward, Like waters gathering to the vale.

verses.sa: अध्वर्यवा तु हि षिञ्च सोमं वीराय शिप्रिणे । भरा सुतस्य पीतये॥
verses.tr: adhvaryavā tu hi ṣiñca somaṃ vīrāya śipriṇe bharā sutasya pītaye
verses.en: Now to the Hero fair of cheek, Adhvaryu, pour the Soma forth: Bring of the juice that he may drink

verses.sa: य उद्नः फलिगं भिनन्न्य१क्सिन्धूँरवासृजत् । यो गोषु पक्वं धारयत्॥
verses.tr: ya udnaḥ phaligaṃ bhinannya1ksindhūṃravāsṛjat yo goṣu pakvaṃ dhārayat
verses.en: Who cleft the water-cloud in twain, loosed rivers for their downward flow, And set the ripe milk in the kine.

verses.sa: अहन्वृत्रमृचीषम और्णवाभमहीशुवम् । हिमेनाविध्यदर्बुदम्॥
verses.tr: ahanvṛtramṛcīṣama aurṇavābhamahīśuvam himenāvidhyadarbudam
verses.en: He, meet for praise, slew Vrtra, slew Ahisuva, Urnavabha's son, And pierced through Arbuda with frost.

verses.sa: प्र व उग्राय निष्टुरेऽषाळ्हाय प्रसक्षिणे । देवत्तं ब्रह्म गायत॥
verses.tr: pra va ugrāya niṣṭure'ṣāḻhāya prasakṣiṇe devattaṃ brahma gāyata
verses.en: To him your matchless Mighty One, unconquerable Conqueror, Sing forth the prayer which Gods have given:

verses.sa: यो विश्वान्यभि व्रता सोमस्य मदे अन्धसः । इन्द्रो देवेषु चेतति॥
verses.tr: yo viśvānyabhi vratā somasya made andhasaḥ indro deveṣu cetati
verses.en: Indra, who in the wild delight of Soma juice considers here All holy Laws among the Gods.

verses.sa: इह त्या सधमाद्या हरी हिरण्यकेश्या । वोळ्हामभि प्रयो हितम्॥
verses.tr: iha tyā sadhamādyā harī hiraṇyakeśyā voḻhāmabhi prayo hitam
verses.en: Hither let these thy Bays who share thy banquet, Steeds with golden manes, Convey thee to the feast prepared.

verses.sa: अर्वाञ्चं त्वा पुरुष्टुत प्रियमेधस्तुता हरी । सोमपेयाय वक्षतः॥
verses.tr: arvāñcaṃ tvā puruṣṭuta priyamedhastutā harī somapeyāya vakṣataḥ
verses.en: Hither, O thou whom many laud, the Bays whom Priyamedha praised, Shall bring thee to the Soma-draught.

verses.sa: वयं घ त्वा सुतावन्त आपो न वृक्तबर्हिषः । पवित्रस्य प्रस्रवणेषु वृत्रहन्परि स्तोतार आसते॥
verses.tr: vayaṃ gha tvā sutāvanta āpo na vṛktabarhiṣaḥ pavitrasya prasravaṇeṣu vṛtrahanpari stotāra āsate
verses.en: We compass thee like waters, we whose grass is trimmed and Soma pressed. Here where the filter pours its stream, thy worshippers round thee, O Vrtra-slayer, sit.

verses.sa: स्वरन्ति त्वा सुते नरो वसो निरेक उक्थिनः । कदा सुतं तृषाण ओक आ गम इन्द्र स्वब्दीव वंसगः॥
verses.tr: svaranti tvā sute naro vaso nireka ukthinaḥ kadā sutaṃ tṛṣāṇa oka ā gama indra svabdīva vaṃsagaḥ
verses.en: Men, Vasu! by the Soma, with lauds call thee to the foremost place: When comest thou athirst unto the juice as home, O Indra, like a bellowing bull?

verses.sa: कण्वेभिर्धृष्णवा धृषद्वाजं दर्षि सहस्रिणम् । पिशङ्गरूपं मघवन्विचर्षणे मक्षू गोमन्तमीमहे॥
verses.tr: kaṇvebhirdhṛṣṇavā dhṛṣadvājaṃ darṣi sahasriṇam piśaṅgarūpaṃ maghavanvicarṣaṇe makṣū gomantamīmahe
verses.en: Boldly, Bold Hero, bring us spoil in thousands for the Kanvas' sake. O active Maghavan, with eager prayer we crave the yellow-hued with store ol kine.

verses.sa: पाहि गायान्धसो मद इन्द्राय मेध्यातिथे । यः सम्मिश्लो हर्योर्यः सुते सचा वज्री रथो हिरण्ययः॥
verses.tr: pāhi gāyāndhaso mada indrāya medhyātithe yaḥ sammiślo haryoryaḥ sute sacā vajrī ratho hiraṇyayaḥ
verses.en: Medhyatithi, to Indra sing, drink of the juice to make thee glad. Close-knit to his Bay Steeds, bolt-armed, beside the juice is he: his chariot is of gold.

verses.sa: यः सुषव्यः सुदक्षिण इनो यः सुक्रतुर्गृणे । य आकरः सहस्रा यः शतामघ इन्द्रो यः पूर्भिदारितः॥
verses.tr: yaḥ suṣavyaḥ sudakṣiṇa ino yaḥ sukraturgṛṇe ya ākaraḥ sahasrā yaḥ śatāmagha indro yaḥ pūrbhidāritaḥ
verses.en: He Who is praised as strong of hand both right and left, most wise and hold: Indra who, rich in hundreds, gathers thousands up, honoured as breaker-down of forts.

verses.sa: यो धृषितो योऽवृतो यो अस्ति श्मश्रुषु श्रितः । विभूतद्युम्नश्च्यवनः पुरुष्टुतः क्रत्वा गौरिव शाकिनः॥
verses.tr: yo dhṛṣito yo'vṛto yo asti śmaśruṣu śritaḥ vibhūtadyumnaścyavanaḥ puruṣṭutaḥ kratvā gauriva śākinaḥ
verses.en: The bold of heart whom none provokes, who stands in bearded confidence; Much-lauded, very glorious, overthrowing foes, strong Helper, like a bull with might.

verses.sa: क ईं वेद सुते सचा पिबन्तं कद्वयो दधे । अयं यः पुरो विभिनत्त्योजसा मन्दानः शिप्र्यन्धसः॥
verses.tr: ka īṃ veda sute sacā pibantaṃ kadvayo dadhe ayaṃ yaḥ puro vibhinattyojasā mandānaḥ śipryandhasaḥ
verses.en: Who knows what vital power he wins, drinking beside the flowing juice? This is the fair-checked God who, joying in the draught, breaks down the castles in his strength.

verses.sa: दाना मृगो न वारणः पुरुत्रा चरथं दधे । नकिष्ट्वा नि यमदा सुते गमो महाँश्चरस्योजसा॥
verses.tr: dānā mṛgo na vāraṇaḥ purutrā carathaṃ dadhe nakiṣṭvā ni yamadā sute gamo mahāṃścarasyojasā
verses.en: As a wild elephant rushes on this way and that way, mad with heat,' None may compel thee, yet come hither to the draught: thou movest mighty in thy power.

verses.sa: य उग्रः सन्ननिष्टृतः स्थिरो रणाय संस्कृतः । यदि स्तोतुर्मघवा शृणवद्धवं नेन्द्रो योषत्या गमत्॥
verses.tr: ya ugraḥ sannaniṣṭṛtaḥ sthiro raṇāya saṃskṛtaḥ yadi stoturmaghavā śṛṇavaddhavaṃ nendro yoṣatyā gamat
verses.en: When he, the Mighty, ne'er o'erthrown, steadfast, made ready for the fight, When Indra Maghavan lists to his praiser's call, he will not stand aloof, but come.

verses.sa: सत्यमित्था वृषेदसि वृषजूतिर्नोऽवृतः । वृषा ह्युग्र शृण्विषे परावति वृषो अर्वावति श्रुतः॥
verses.tr: satyamitthā vṛṣedasi vṛṣajūtirno'vṛtaḥ vṛṣā hyugra śṛṇviṣe parāvati vṛṣo arvāvati śrutaḥ
verses.en: Yea, verily, thou art a Bull, with a bull's rush. whom none may stay: Thou Mighty One, art celebrated as a Bull, famed as a Bull both near and far.

verses.sa: वृषणस्ते अभीशवो वृषा कशा हिरण्ययी । वृषा रथो मघवन्वृषणा हरी वृषा त्वं शतक्रतो॥
verses.tr: vṛṣaṇaste abhīśavo vṛṣā kaśā hiraṇyayī vṛṣā ratho maghavanvṛṣaṇā harī vṛṣā tvaṃ śatakrato
verses.en: Thy reins are very bulls in strength, bulls' strength is in thy golden whip. Thy car, O Maghavan, thy Bays are strong as bulls: thou, Satakratu, art a Bull.

verses.sa: वृषा सोता सुनोतु ते वृषन्नृजीपिन्ना भर । वृषा दधन्वे वृषणं नदीष्वा तुभ्यं स्थातर्हरीणाम्॥
verses.tr: vṛṣā sotā sunotu te vṛṣannṛjīpinnā bhara vṛṣā dadhanve vṛṣaṇaṃ nadīṣvā tubhyaṃ sthātarharīṇām
verses.en: Let the strong presser press for thee. Bring hither, thou straight-rushing Bull. The mighty makes the mighty run in flowing streams for thee whom thy Bay Horses bear.

verses.sa: एन्द्र याहि पीतये मधु शविष्ठ सोम्यम् । नायमच्छा मघवा शृणवद्गिरो ब्रह्मोक्था च सुक्रतुः॥
verses.tr: endra yāhi pītaye madhu śaviṣṭha somyam nāyamacchā maghavā śṛṇavadgiro brahmokthā ca sukratuḥ
verses.en: Come, thou most potent Indra, come to drink the savoury Soma juice. Maghavan, very wise, will quickly come to hear the songs, the prayer, the hymns of praise.

verses.sa: वहन्तु त्वा रथेष्ठामा हरयो रथयुजः । तिरश्चिदर्यं सवनानि वृत्रहन्नन्येषां या शतक्रतो॥
verses.tr: vahantu tvā ratheṣṭhāmā harayo rathayujaḥ tiraścidaryaṃ savanāni vṛtrahannanyeṣāṃ yā śatakrato
verses.en: When thou hast mounted on thy car let thy yoked Bay Steeds carry thee, Past other men's libations, Lord of Hundred Powers, thee, Vrtra-slayer, thee our Friend.

verses.sa: अस्माकमद्यान्तमं स्तोमं धिष्व महामह । अस्माकं ते सवना सन्तु शंतमा मदाय द्युक्ष सोमपाः॥
verses.tr: asmākamadyāntamaṃ stomaṃ dhiṣva mahāmaha asmākaṃ te savanā santu śaṃtamā madāya dyukṣa somapāḥ
verses.en: O thou Most Lofty One, accept our laud as nearest to thine heart. May our libations be most sweet to make thee glad, O Soma-drinker, Heavenly Lord.

verses.sa: नहि षस्तव नो मम शास्त्रे अन्यस्य रण्यति । यो अस्मान्वीर आनयत्॥
verses.tr: nahi ṣastava no mama śāstre anyasya raṇyati yo asmānvīra ānayat
verses.en: Neither in thy decree nor mine, but in another's he delights,- The man who brought us unto this.

verses.sa: इन्द्रश्चिद्घा तदब्रवीत्स्त्रिया अशास्यं मनः । उतो अह क्रतुं रघुम्॥
verses.tr: indraścidghā tadabravītstriyā aśāsyaṃ manaḥ uto aha kratuṃ raghum
verses.en: Indra himself hath said, The mind of woman brooks not discipline, Her intellect hath little weight.

verses.sa: सप्ती चिद्घा मदच्युता मिथुना वहतो रथम् । एवेद्धूर्वृष्ण उत्तरा॥
verses.tr: saptī cidghā madacyutā mithunā vahato ratham eveddhūrvṛṣṇa uttarā
verses.en: His pair of horses, rushing on in their wild transport, draw his car: High-lifted is the stallion's yoke.

verses.sa: अधः पश्यस्व मोपरि संतरां पादकौ हर । मा ते कशप्लकौ दृशन्त्स्त्री हि ब्रह्मा बभूविथ॥
verses.tr: adhaḥ paśyasva mopari saṃtarāṃ pādakau hara mā te kaśaplakau dṛśantstrī hi brahmā babhūvitha
verses.en: Cast down thine eyes and look not up. More closely set thy feet. Let none See what thy garment veils, for thou, a Brahman, hast become a dame.

verses.sa: एन्द्र याहि हरिभिरुप कण्वस्य सुष्टुतिम् । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो॥
verses.tr: endra yāhi haribhirupa kaṇvasya suṣṭutim divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso
verses.en: Come hither, Indra, with thy Bays, come thou to Kanva's eulogy. Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven.

verses.sa: आ त्वा ग्रावा वदन्निह सोमी घोषेण यच्छतु । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो॥
verses.tr: ā tvā grāvā vadanniha somī ghoṣeṇa yacchatu divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso
verses.en: May the stone draw thee as it speaks, the Soma-stone with ringing voice. Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven.

verses.sa: अत्रा वि नेमिरेषामुरां न धूनुते वृकः । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो॥
verses.tr: atrā vi nemireṣāmurāṃ na dhūnute vṛkaḥ divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso
verses.en: The stones' rim shakes the Soma here like a wolf worrying a sheep. Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven.

verses.sa: आ त्वा कण्वा इहावसे हवन्ते वाजसातये । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो॥
verses.tr: ā tvā kaṇvā ihāvase havante vājasātaye divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso
verses.en: The Kanvas call thee hitherward for succour and to win the spoil. Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven.

verses.sa: दधामि ते सुतानां वृष्णे न पूर्वपाय्यम् । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो॥
verses.tr: dadhāmi te sutānāṃ vṛṣṇe na pūrvapāyyam divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso
verses.en: I set for thee, as for the Strong, the first draught of the juices shed.

verses.sa: स्मत्पुरंधिर्न आ गहि विश्वतोधीर्न ऊतये । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो॥
verses.tr: smatpuraṃdhirna ā gahi viśvatodhīrna ūtaye divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso
verses.en: Come with abundant blessings, come with perfect care to succour us.

verses.sa: आ नो याहि महेमते सहस्रोते शतामघ । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो॥
verses.tr: ā no yāhi mahemate sahasrote śatāmagha divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso
verses.en: Come, Lord of lofty thought, who hast infinite wealth and countless aids.

verses.sa: आ त्वा होता मनुर्हितो देवत्रा वक्षदीड्यः । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो॥
verses.tr: ā tvā hotā manurhito devatrā vakṣadīḍyaḥ divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso
verses.en: Adorable mid Gods, the Priest good to mankind shall bring thee near.

verses.sa: आ त्वा मदच्युता हरी श्येनं पक्षेव वक्षतः । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो॥
verses.tr: ā tvā madacyutā harī śyenaṃ pakṣeva vakṣataḥ divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso
verses.en: As wings the falcon, so thy Bays rushing in joy shall carry thee.

verses.sa: आ याह्यर्य आ परि स्वाहा सोमस्य पीतये । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो॥
verses.tr: ā yāhyarya ā pari svāhā somasya pītaye divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso
verses.en: Come from the enemy to us, to svaha and the Soma-draught.

verses.sa: आ नो याह्युपश्रुत्युक्थेषु रणया इह । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो॥
verses.tr: ā no yāhyupaśrutyuktheṣu raṇayā iha divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso
verses.en: Come hither with thine car inclined to hear, take pleasure in our lauds.

verses.sa: सरूपैरा सु नो गहि सम्भृतैः सम्भृताश्वः । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो॥
verses.tr: sarūpairā su no gahi sambhṛtaiḥ sambhṛtāśvaḥ divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso
verses.en: Lord of well-nourished Horses, come with well-fed Steeds alike in hue.

verses.sa: आ याहि पर्वतेभ्यः समुद्रस्याधि विष्टपः । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो॥
verses.tr: ā yāhi parvatebhyaḥ samudrasyādhi viṣṭapaḥ divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso
verses.en: Come hither from the mountains, come from regions of the sea of air.

verses.sa: आ नो गव्यान्यश्व्या सहस्रा शूर दर्दृहि । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो॥
verses.tr: ā no gavyānyaśvyā sahasrā śūra dardṛhi divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso
verses.en: Disclose to us O Hero, wealth in thousands both of kine and steeds.

verses.sa: आ नः सहस्रशो भराऽयुतानि शतानि च । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो॥
verses.tr: ā naḥ sahasraśo bharā'yutāni śatāni ca divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso
verses.en: Bring riches hitherward to us in hundreds, thousands, myriads. Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven.

verses.sa: आ यदिन्द्रश्च दद्वहे सहस्रं वसुरोचिषः । ओजिष्ठमश्व्यं पशुम्॥
verses.tr: ā yadindraśca dadvahe sahasraṃ vasurociṣaḥ ojiṣṭhamaśvyaṃ paśum
verses.en: The thousand steeds, the mightiest troop, which we and Indra have received From Vasurocis as a gift,

verses.sa: य ऋज्रा वातरंहसोऽरुषासो रघुष्यदः । भ्राजन्ते सूर्या इव॥
verses.tr: ya ṛjrā vātaraṃhaso'ruṣāso raghuṣyadaḥ bhrājante sūryā iva
verses.en: The brown that match the wind in speed, and bright bay coursers fleet of foot, Like Suns, resplendent are they all.

verses.sa: पारावतस्य रातिषु द्रवच्चक्रेष्वाशुषु । तिष्ठं वनस्य मध्य आ॥
verses.tr: pārāvatasya rātiṣu dravaccakreṣvāśuṣu tiṣṭhaṃ vanasya madhya ā
verses.en: Mid the Pargvata's rich gifts, swift steeds whose wheels run rapidly, I seemed to stand amid a wood.

verses.sa:
अग्निनेन्द्रेण वरुणेन विष्णुनाऽऽदित्यै रुद्रैर्वसुभिः सचाभुवा ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च सोमं पिबतमश्विना॥
verses.tr: agninendreṇa varuṇena viṣṇunā''dityai rudrairvasubhiḥ sacābhuvā sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somaṃ pibatamaśvinā
verses.en: With Agni and with Indra, Visnu, Varuna, with the Adityas, Rudras, Vasus, closely leagued; Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, O Asvins, drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
विश्वाभिर्धीभिर्भुवनेन वाजिना दिवा पृथिव्याद्रिभिः सचाभुवा ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च सोमं पिबतमश्विना॥
