verses.tr: viśvābhirdhībhirbhuvanena vājinā divā pṛthivyādribhiḥ sacābhuvā sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somaṃ pibatamaśvinā
verses.en: With all the Holy Thoughts, all being Mighty Ones! in close alliance wil the Mountains, Heaven, and Earth; Accordant. of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, O Asvins, drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
विश्वैर्देवैस्त्रिभिरेकादशैरिहाऽद्भिर्मरुद्भिर्भृगुभिः सचाभुवा ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च सोमं पिबतमश्विना॥
verses.tr: viśvairdevaistribhirekādaśairihā'dbhirmarudbhirbhṛgubhiḥ sacābhuvā sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somaṃ pibatamaśvinā
verses.en: With all the Deities, three times eleven, here, in close alliance with the Maruts, Bhrgus, Floods; Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, O Asvins, drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
जुषेथां यज्ञं बोधतं हवस्य मे विश्वेह देवौ सवनाव गच्छतम् ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चेषं नो वोळ्हमश्विना॥
verses.tr: juṣethāṃ yajñaṃ bodhataṃ havasya me viśveha devau savanāva gacchatam sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ceṣaṃ no voḻhamaśvinā
verses.en: Accept the sacrifice, attend to this my call: come nigh, O ye Twain Gods, to all libations here. Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, O Asvins, bring us strengthening food.

verses.sa:
स्तोमं जुषेथां युवशेव कन्यनां विश्वेह देवौ सवनाव गच्छतम् ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चेषं नो वोळ्हमश्विना॥
verses.tr: stomaṃ juṣethāṃ yuvaśeva kanyanāṃ viśveha devau savanāva gacchatam sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ceṣaṃ no voḻhamaśvinā
verses.en: Accept our praise-song as a youth accepts a maid. Come nigh, O ye Twain Gods, to all libations here. Accordant, of one mind with Sarya and with Dawn O Asvins, bring us strengthening food.

verses.sa:
गिरो जुषेथामध्वरं जुषेथां विश्वेह देवौ सवनाव गच्छतम् ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चेषं नो वोळ्हमश्विना॥
verses.tr: giro juṣethāmadhvaraṃ juṣethāṃ viśveha devau savanāva gacchatam sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ceṣaṃ no voḻhamaśvinā
verses.en: Accept the songs we sing, accept the solemn rite. Conie nigh, O ye Twain Gods, to all libations here. Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, O Asvins, bring us strengthening food.

verses.sa:
हारिद्रवेव पतथो वनेदुप सोमं सुतं महिषेवाव गच्छथः ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च त्रिर्वर्तिर्यातमश्विना॥
verses.tr: hāridraveva patatho vanedupa somaṃ sutaṃ mahiṣevāva gacchathaḥ sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca trirvartiryātamaśvinā
verses.en: Ye fly as starlings fly unto the forest trees; like buffaloes ye seek the Soma we have shed. Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, come thrice, O Asvins, to our home.

verses.sa:
हंसाविव पतथो अध्वगाविव सोमं सुतं महिषेवाव गच्छथः ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च त्रिर्वर्तिर्यातमश्विना॥
verses.tr: haṃsāviva patatho adhvagāviva somaṃ sutaṃ mahiṣevāva gacchathaḥ sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca trirvartiryātamaśvinā
verses.en: Ye fly like swans, like those who travel on their way; like buffaloes ye seek the Soma we have shed. Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, come thrice, O Asvins, to our home.

verses.sa:
श्येनाविव पतथो हव्यदातये सोमं सुतं महिषेवाव गच्छथः ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च त्रिर्वर्तिर्यातमश्विना॥
verses.tr: śyenāviva patatho havyadātaye somaṃ sutaṃ mahiṣevāva gacchathaḥ sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca trirvartiryātamaśvinā
verses.en: Ye fly to our oblation like a pair of hawks; like buffaloes ye seek the Soma we have shed. Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, come thrice, O Asvins, to our home.

verses.sa:
पिबतं च तृप्णुतं चा च गच्छतं प्रजां च धत्तं द्रविणं च धत्तम् ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चोर्जं नो धत्तमश्विना॥
verses.tr: pibataṃ ca tṛpṇutaṃ cā ca gacchataṃ prajāṃ ca dhattaṃ draviṇaṃ ca dhattam sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa corjaṃ no dhattamaśvinā
verses.en: Come hitherward and drink and satisfy yourselves, bestow upon us progeny and affluence. Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, O Asvins, grant us vigorous strength.

verses.sa:
जयतं च प्र स्तुतं च प्र चावतं प्रजां च धत्तं द्रविणं च धत्तम् ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चोर्जं नो धत्तमश्विना॥
verses.tr: jayataṃ ca pra stutaṃ ca pra cāvataṃ prajāṃ ca dhattaṃ draviṇaṃ ca dhattam sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa corjaṃ no dhattamaśvinā
verses.en: Conquer your foes, protect us, praise your worshippers; bestow upon us progeny and affluence. Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, O Asvins, grant us vigorous strength.

verses.sa:
हतं च शत्रून्यततं च मित्रिणः प्रजां च धत्तं द्रविणं च धत्तम् ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चोर्जं नो धत्तमश्विना॥
verses.tr: hataṃ ca śatrūnyatataṃ ca mitriṇaḥ prajāṃ ca dhattaṃ draviṇaṃ ca dhattam sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa corjaṃ no dhattamaśvinā
verses.en: Slay enemies, animate men whom ye befriend; bestow upon us progeny and affluence. Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, O Asvins, grant us vigorous strength.

verses.sa:
मित्रावरुणवन्ता उत धर्मवन्ता मरुत्वन्ता जरितुर्गच्छथो हवम् ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चाऽऽदित्यैर्यातमश्विना॥
verses.tr: mitrāvaruṇavantā uta dharmavantā marutvantā jariturgacchatho havam sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa cā''dityairyātamaśvinā
verses.en: With Mitra, Varuna, Dharma, and the Maruts in your company approach unto your praiser's call. Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, and with the Adityas, Asvins! come.

verses.sa:
अङ्गिरस्वन्ता उत विष्णुवन्ता मरुत्वन्ता जरितुर्गच्छथो हवम् ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चाऽऽदित्यैर्यातमश्विना॥
verses.tr: aṅgirasvantā uta viṣṇuvantā marutvantā jariturgacchatho havam sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa cā''dityairyātamaśvinā
verses.en: With Visnu and the Angirases attending you, and with the Maruts come unto your praiser's call. Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, and with the Adityas, Asvins! come.

verses.sa:
ऋभुमन्ता वृषणा वाजवन्ता मरुत्वन्ता जरितुर्गच्छथो हवम् ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चाऽऽदित्यैर्यातमश्विना॥
verses.tr: ṛbhumantā vṛṣaṇā vājavantā marutvantā jariturgacchatho havam sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa cā''dityairyātamaśvinā
verses.en: With Rbhus and With Vajas. O ye Mighty Ones, leagued with the Maruts come ye to your praiser's call. Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, and with the Adityas, Asvins! come.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्म जिन्वतमुत जिन्वतं धियो हतं रक्षांसि सेधतममीवाः ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च सोमं सुन्वतो अश्विना॥
verses.tr: brahma jinvatamuta jinvataṃ dhiyo hataṃ rakṣāṃsi sedhatamamīvāḥ sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somaṃ sunvato aśvinā
verses.en: Give spirit to our prayer and animate our thoughts; slay ye the Raksasas and drive away disease. Accordant, of One mind with Surya and with Dawn, -the presser's Soma, Asvins drink.

verses.sa:
क्षत्रं जिन्वतमुत जिन्वतं नॄन्हतं रक्षांसि सेधतममीवाः ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च सोमं सुन्वतो अश्विना॥
verses.tr: kṣatraṃ jinvatamuta jinvataṃ nṝnhataṃ rakṣāṃsi sedhatamamīvāḥ sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somaṃ sunvato aśvinā
verses.en: Strengthen the Ruling Power, strengthen the men of war; slay ye the Raksasas and drive away disease. Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, the presser's Soma, Asvins drink.

verses.sa:
धेनूर्जिन्वतमुत जिन्वतं विशो हतं रक्षांसि सेधतममीवाः ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च सोमं सुन्वतो अश्विना॥
verses.tr: dhenūrjinvatamuta jinvataṃ viśo hataṃ rakṣāṃsi sedhatamamīvāḥ sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somaṃ sunvato aśvinā
verses.en: Give strength unto the milch-kine, give the people strength, slay ye the Raksasas and drive away disease. Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, the presser's Soma, Asvins drink.

verses.sa:
अत्रेरिव शृणुतं पूर्व्यस्तुतिं श्यावाश्वस्य सुन्वतो मदच्युता ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चाश्विना तिरोअह्न्यम्॥
verses.tr: atreriva śṛṇutaṃ pūrvyastutiṃ śyāvāśvasya sunvato madacyutā sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa cāśvinā tiroahnyam
verses.en: As ye heard Atri's earliest eulogy, so hear Syavasva, Soma-presser, ye who reel in joy. Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, drink juice, O Asvins, three days old.

verses.sa:
सर्गाँ इव सृजतं सुष्टुतीरुप श्यावाश्वस्य सुन्वतो मदच्युता ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चाऽश्विना तिरोअह्न्यम्॥
verses.tr: sargāṃ iva sṛjataṃ suṣṭutīrupa śyāvāśvasya sunvato madacyutā sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa cā'śvinā tiroahnyam
verses.en: Further like running streams Syavasva's eulogies who presses out the Soma, ye who reel in joy. Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, drink juice, O Asvins, three days old.

verses.sa:
रश्मीँरिव यच्छतमध्वराँ उप श्यावाश्वस्य सुन्वतो मदच्युता ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चाऽश्विना तिरोअह्न्यम्॥
verses.tr: raśmīṃriva yacchatamadhvarāṃ upa śyāvāśvasya sunvato madacyutā sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa cā'śvinā tiroahnyam
verses.en: Seize, as ye grasp the reins, Syavasva's solemn rites who presses out the Soma, ye who reel in joy. Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, drink juice, O Asvins, three days old.

verses.sa:
अर्वाग्रथं नि यच्छतं पिबतं सोम्यं मधु ।
आ यातमश्विना गतमवस्युर्वामहं हुवे धत्तं रत्नानि दाशुषे॥
verses.tr: arvāgrathaṃ ni yacchataṃ pibataṃ somyaṃ madhu ā yātamaśvinā gatamavasyurvāmahaṃ huve dhattaṃ ratnāni dāśuṣe
verses.en: Drive down your chariot hitherward drink ye the Soma's savoury juice. Approach, ye Asvins, come to us: I call you, eager for your aid. Grant treasures to the worshipper.

verses.sa:
नमोवाके प्रस्थिते अध्वरे नरा विवक्षणस्य पीतये ।
आ यातमश्विना गतमवस्युर्वामहं हुवे धत्तं रत्नानि दाशुषे॥
verses.tr: namovāke prasthite adhvare narā vivakṣaṇasya pītaye ā yātamaśvinā gatamavasyurvāmahaṃ huve dhattaṃ ratnāni dāśuṣe
verses.en: When sacrifice which tells our reverence hath begun. Heroes! to drink the gushing juice, Approach, ye Asvins, come to us: I call you, eager for your aid. Grant treasures to the worshipper.

verses.sa:
स्वाहाकृतस्य तृम्पतं सुतस्य देवावन्धसः ।
आ यातमश्विना गतमवस्युर्वामहं हुवे धत्तं रत्नानि दाशुषे॥
verses.tr: svāhākṛtasya tṛmpataṃ sutasya devāvandhasaḥ ā yātamaśvinā gatamavasyurvāmahaṃ huve dhattaṃ ratnāni dāśuṣe
verses.en: Sate you with consecrated drink, with juice effused, ye Deities. Approach, ye Asvins, come to us: I call you, eager for your aid. Grant treasures to the worshipper.

verses.sa:
अवितासि सुन्वतो वृक्तबर्हिषः पिबा सोमं मदाय कं शतक्रतो ।
यं ते भागमधारयन्विश्वाः सेहानः पृतना उरु ज्रयः समप्सुजिन्मरुत्वाँ इन्द्र सत्पते॥
verses.tr: avitāsi sunvato vṛktabarhiṣaḥ pibā somaṃ madāya kaṃ śatakrato yaṃ te bhāgamadhārayanviśvāḥ sehānaḥ pṛtanā uru jrayaḥ samapsujinmarutvāṃ indra satpate
verses.en: Thou helpest him whose grass is trimmed, who sheds the juice, O Satakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad. The share which they have fixed for thee, thou, Indra, Victor o'er all hosts and space, begirt with Maruts, Lord of Heroes, winner of the floods.

verses.sa:
प्राव स्तोतारं मघवन्नव त्वां पिबा सोमं मदाय कं शतक्रतो ।
यं ते भागमधारयन्विश्वाः सेहानः पृतना उरु ज्रयः समप्सुजिन्मरुत्वाँ इन्द्र सत्पते॥
verses.tr: prāva stotāraṃ maghavannava tvāṃ pibā somaṃ madāya kaṃ śatakrato yaṃ te bhāgamadhārayanviśvāḥ sehānaḥ pṛtanā uru jrayaḥ samapsujinmarutvāṃ indra satpate
verses.en: Maghavan, help thy worshipper: let him help thee. O Satakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad. The share which they have fixed for thee, etc.

verses.sa:
ऊर्जा देवाँ अवस्योजसा त्वां पिबा सोमं मदाय कं शतक्रतो ।
यं ते भागमधारयन्विश्वाः सेहानः पृतना उरु ज्रयः समप्सुजिन्मरुत्वाँ इन्द्र सत्पते॥
verses.tr: ūrjā devāṃ avasyojasā tvāṃ pibā somaṃ madāya kaṃ śatakrato yaṃ te bhāgamadhārayanviśvāḥ sehānaḥ pṛtanā uru jrayaḥ samapsujinmarutvāṃ indra satpate
verses.en: Thou aidest Gods with food, and that with might aidg thee, O Satakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad.

verses.sa:
जनिता दिवो जनिता पृथिव्याः पिबा सोमं मदाय कं शतक्रतो ।
यं ते भागमधारयन्विश्वाः सेहानः पृतना उरु ज्रयः समप्सुजिन्मरुत्वाँ इन्द्र सत्पते॥
verses.tr: janitā divo janitā pṛthivyāḥ pibā somaṃ madāya kaṃ śatakrato yaṃ te bhāgamadhārayanviśvāḥ sehānaḥ pṛtanā uru jrayaḥ samapsujinmarutvāṃ indra satpate
verses.en: Creator of the heaven, creator of the earth, O Satakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad.

verses.sa:
जनिताश्वानां जनिता गवामसि पिबा सोमं मदाय कं शतक्रतो ।
यं ते भागमधारयन्विश्वाः सेहानः पृतना उरु ज्रयः समप्सुजिन्मरुत्वाँ इन्द्र सत्पते॥
verses.tr: janitāśvānāṃ janitā gavāmasi pibā somaṃ madāya kaṃ śatakrato yaṃ te bhāgamadhārayanviśvāḥ sehānaḥ pṛtanā uru jrayaḥ samapsujinmarutvāṃ indra satpate
verses.en: Father of cattle, father of all steeds art thou. O Satakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad.

verses.sa:
अत्रीणां स्तोममद्रिवो महस्कृधि पिबा सोमं मदाय कं शतक्रतो ।
यं ते भागमधारयन्विश्वाः सेहानः पृतना उरु ज्रयः समप्सुजिन्मरुत्वाँ इन्द्र सत्पते॥
verses.tr: atrīṇāṃ stomamadrivo mahaskṛdhi pibā somaṃ madāya kaṃ śatakrato yaṃ te bhāgamadhārayanviśvāḥ sehānaḥ pṛtanā uru jrayaḥ samapsujinmarutvāṃ indra satpate
verses.en: Stone-hurler, glorify the Atris' hymn of praise. O Satakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad.

verses.sa:
श्यावाश्वस्य सुन्वतस्तथा शृणु यथाशृणोरत्रेः कर्माणि कृण्वतः ।
प्र त्रसदस्युमाविथ त्वमेक इन्नृषाह्य इन्द्र ब्रह्माणि वर्धयन्॥
verses.tr: śyāvāśvasya sunvatastathā śṛṇu yathāśṛṇoratreḥ karmāṇi kṛṇvataḥ pra trasadasyumāvitha tvameka innṛṣāhya indra brahmāṇi vardhayan
verses.en: Hear thou Syavagva while he pours to thee, as erst thou heardest Atri when he wrought his holy rites. Indra, thou only gavest Trasadasyu aid in the fierce fight with heroes, strengthening his prayers.

verses.sa:
प्रेदं ब्रह्म वृत्रतूर्येष्वाविथ प्र सुन्वतः शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः ।
माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य पिबा सोमस्य वज्रिवः॥
verses.tr: predaṃ brahma vṛtratūryeṣvāvitha pra sunvataḥ śacīpata indra viśvābhirūtibhiḥ mādhyaṃdinasya savanasya vṛtrahannanedya pibā somasya vajrivaḥ
verses.en: This prayer, and those who shed the juice, in wars with Vrtra thou holpest, Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy succours. O Vrtra-slayer, from libation poured at noon, drink of the Soma juice, thou blameless Thunderer.

verses.sa:
सेहान उग्र पृतना अभि द्रुहः शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः ।
माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य पिबा सोमस्य वज्रिवः॥
verses.tr: sehāna ugra pṛtanā abhi druhaḥ śacīpata indra viśvābhirūtibhiḥ mādhyaṃdinasya savanasya vṛtrahannanedya pibā somasya vajrivaḥ
verses.en: Thou mighty Conqueror of hostile armaments, O Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy saving help.

verses.sa:
एकराळस्य भुवनस्य राजसि शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः ।
माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य पिबा सोमस्य वज्रिवः॥
verses.tr: ekarāḻasya bhuvanasya rājasi śacīpata indra viśvābhirūtibhiḥ mādhyaṃdinasya savanasya vṛtrahannanedya pibā somasya vajrivaḥ
verses.en: Sole Ruler, thou art Sovran of this world of life, O Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy saving help.

verses.sa:
सस्थावाना यवयसि त्वमेक इच्छचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः ।
माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य पिबा सोमस्य वज्रिवः॥
verses.tr: sasthāvānā yavayasi tvameka icchacīpata indra viśvābhirūtibhiḥ mādhyaṃdinasya savanasya vṛtrahannanedya pibā somasya vajrivaḥ
verses.en: Thou only sunderest these two consistent worlds, O Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy saving help.

verses.sa:
क्षेमस्य च प्रयुजश्च त्वमीशिषे शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः ।
माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य पिबा सोमस्य वज्रिवः॥
verses.tr: kṣemasya ca prayujaśca tvamīśiṣe śacīpata indra viśvābhirūtibhiḥ mādhyaṃdinasya savanasya vṛtrahannanedya pibā somasya vajrivaḥ
verses.en: Thou art the Lord supreme o'er rest and energy, O Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy saving help.

verses.sa:
क्षत्राय त्वमवसि न त्वमाविथ शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः ।
माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य पिबा सोमस्य वज्रिवः॥
verses.tr: kṣatrāya tvamavasi na tvamāvitha śacīpata indra viśvābhirūtibhiḥ mādhyaṃdinasya savanasya vṛtrahannanedya pibā somasya vajrivaḥ
verses.en: Thou helpest one to power, and one thou hast not helped, O Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy saving aid.

verses.sa:
श्यावाश्वस्य रेभतस्तथा शृणु यथाशृणोरत्रेः कर्माणि कृण्वतः ।
प्र त्रसदस्युमाविथ त्वमेक इन्नृषाह्य इन्द्र क्षत्राणि वर्धयन्॥
verses.tr: śyāvāśvasya rebhatastathā śṛṇu yathāśṛṇoratreḥ karmāṇi kṛṇvataḥ pra trasadasyumāvitha tvameka innṛṣāhya indra kṣatrāṇi vardhayan
verses.en: Hear thou Syavasva while he sings to thee, as erst thou heardest Atri when he wrought his holy rites. Indra, thou only gavest Trasadasyu aid in the fierce fight with heroes, strengthening his powers.

verses.sa: यज्ञस्य हि स्थ ऋत्विजा सस्नी वाजेषु कर्मसु । इन्द्राग्नी तस्य बोधतम्॥
verses.tr: yajñasya hi stha ṛtvijā sasnī vājeṣu karmasu indrāgnī tasya bodhatam
verses.en: Ye Twain are Priests of sacrifice, winners in war and holy works: Indra and Agni, mark this well.

verses.sa: तोशासा रथयावाना वृत्रहणापराजिता । इन्द्राग्नी तस्य बोधतम्॥
verses.tr: tośāsā rathayāvānā vṛtrahaṇāparājitā indrāgnī tasya bodhatam
verses.en: Ye bounteous riders on the car, ye Vrtra-slayers unsubdued: Indra and Agni, mark this well.

verses.sa: इदं वां मदिरं मध्वधुक्षन्नद्रिभिर्नरः । इन्द्राग्नी तस्य बोधतम्॥
verses.tr: idaṃ vāṃ madiraṃ madhvadhukṣannadribhirnaraḥ indrāgnī tasya bodhatam
verses.en: The men with pressing-stones have pressed this meath of yours which gives delight: Indra, and Agni, mark this well.

verses.sa: जुषेथां यज्ञमिष्टये सुतं सोमं सधस्तुती । इन्द्राग्नी आ गतं नरा॥
verses.tr: juṣethāṃ yajñamiṣṭaye sutaṃ somaṃ sadhastutī indrāgnī ā gataṃ narā
verses.en: Accept our sacrifice for weal, sharers of praise! the Soma shed: Indra and Agni, Heroes, come.

verses.sa: इमा जुषेथां सवना येभिर्हव्यान्यूहथुः । इन्द्राग्नी आ गतं नरा॥
verses.tr: imā juṣethāṃ savanā yebhirhavyānyūhathuḥ indrāgnī ā gataṃ narā
verses.en: Be pleased with these libations which attract you to our sacred gifts Indra and Agni, Heroes, come.

verses.sa: इमां गायत्रवर्तनिं जुषेथां सुष्टुतिं मम । इन्द्राग्नी आ गतं नरा॥
verses.tr: imāṃ gāyatravartaniṃ juṣethāṃ suṣṭutiṃ mama indrāgnī ā gataṃ narā
verses.en: Accept this eulogy of mine whose model is the Gayatri: Indra and Agni, Heroes, Come.

verses.sa: प्रातर्यावभिरा गतं देवेभिर्जेन्यावसू । इन्द्राग्नी सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: prātaryāvabhirā gataṃ devebhirjenyāvasū indrāgnī somapītaye
verses.en: Come with the early-faring Gods, ye who are Lords of genuine wealth: Indra-Agni, to the Soma-draught

verses.sa: श्यावाश्वस्य सुन्वतोऽत्रीणां शृणुतं हवम् । इन्द्राग्नी सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: śyāvāśvasya sunvato'trīṇāṃ śṛṇutaṃ havam indrāgnī somapītaye
verses.en: Hear ye the call of Atris, hear Syavasva as he sheds the juice: Indra-Agni to the Soma-draught

verses.sa: एवा वामह्व ऊतये यथाहुवन्त मेधिराः । इन्द्राग्नी सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: evā vāmahva ūtaye yathāhuvanta medhirāḥ indrāgnī somapītaye
verses.en: Thus have I called you to our aid as sages called on you of old: Indra-Agni to the Soma draught!

verses.sa: आहं सरस्वतीवतोरिन्द्राग्न्योरवो वृणे । याभ्यां गायत्रमृच्यते॥
verses.tr: āhaṃ sarasvatīvatorindrāgnyoravo vṛṇe yābhyāṃ gāyatramṛcyate
verses.en: Indra's and Agni's grace I claim, Sarasvati's associates To whom this psalm of praise is sung.

verses.sa:
अग्निमस्तोष्यृग्मियमग्निमीळा यजध्यै ।
अग्निर्देवाँ अनक्तु न उभे हि विदथे कविरन्तश्चरति दूत्यं१ नभन्तामन्यके समे॥
verses.tr: agnimastoṣyṛgmiyamagnimīḻā yajadhyai agnirdevāṃ anaktu na ubhe hi vidathe kavirantaścarati dūtyaṃ1 nabhantāmanyake same
verses.en: The glorious Agni have I praised, and worshipped with. the sacred food. May Agni deck the Gods for us. Between both gathering-places he goes on his embassy, the Sage. May all the others die away.

verses.sa:
न्यग्ने नव्यसा वचस्तनूषु शंसमेषाम् ।
न्यराती रराव्णां विश्वा अर्यो अरातीरितो युच्छन्त्वामुरो नभन्तामन्यके समे॥
verses.tr: nyagne navyasā vacastanūṣu śaṃsameṣām nyarātī rarāvṇāṃ viśvā aryo arātīrito yucchantvāmuro nabhantāmanyake same
verses.en: Agni, burn down the word within their bodies through our newest speech, All hatreds of the godless, all the wicked man's malignities. Away let the destroyers go. May all the others die away.

verses.sa:
अग्ने मन्मानि तुभ्यं कं घृतं न जुह्व आसनि ।
स देवेषु प्र चिकिद्धि त्वं ह्यसि पूर्व्यः शिवो दूतो विवस्वतो नभन्तामन्यके समे॥
verses.tr: agne manmāni tubhyaṃ kaṃ ghṛtaṃ na juhva āsani sa deveṣu pra cikiddhi tvaṃ hyasi pūrvyaḥ śivo dūto vivasvato nabhantāmanyake same
verses.en: Agni, I offer hymns to thee, like holy oil within thy mouth. Acknowledge them. among the Gods, for thou art the most excellent, the worshipper's blissful messenger. Let all the others die away.

verses.sa:
तत्तदग्निर्वयो दधे यथायथा कृपण्यति ।
ऊर्जाहुतिर्वसूनां शं च योश्च मयो दधे विश्वस्यै देवहूत्यै नभन्तामन्यके समे॥
verses.tr: tattadagnirvayo dadhe yathāyathā kṛpaṇyati ūrjāhutirvasūnāṃ śaṃ ca yośca mayo dadhe viśvasyai devahūtyai nabhantāmanyake same
verses.en: Agni bestows all vital power even as each man supplicates. He brings the Vasus strengthening gifts, and grants delight, in rest and stir, for every calling on the Gods. Let all the others die away.

verses.sa:
स चिकेत सहीयसाऽग्निश्चित्रेण कर्मणा ।
स होता शश्वतीनां दक्षिणाभिरभीवृत इनोति च प्रतीव्यं१ नभन्तामन्यके समे॥
verses.tr: sa ciketa sahīyasā'gniścitreṇa karmaṇā sa hotā śaśvatīnāṃ dakṣiṇābhirabhīvṛta inoti ca pratīvyaṃ1 nabhantāmanyake same
verses.en: Agni hath made himself renowned by wonderful victorious act. He is the Priest of all the tribes, chosen with sacrificial meads. He urges Deities to receive. Let all the others die away.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्जाता देवानामग्निर्वेद मर्तानामपीच्यम् ।
अग्निः स द्रविणोदा अग्निर्द्वारा व्यूर्णुते स्वाहुतो नवीयसा नभन्तामन्यके समे॥
verses.tr: agnirjātā devānāmagnirveda martānāmapīcyam agniḥ sa draviṇodā agnirdvārā vyūrṇute svāhuto navīyasā nabhantāmanyake same
verses.en: Agni knows all that springs from Gods, he knows the mystery of men. Giver of wealth is Agni, he uncloses both the doors to us when worshipped with our newest gift. Let all the others die away.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्देवेषु संवसुः स विक्षु यज्ञियास्वा ।
स मुदा काव्या पुरु विश्वं भूमेव पुष्यति देवो देवेषु यज्ञियो नभन्तामन्यके समे॥
verses.tr: agnirdeveṣu saṃvasuḥ sa vikṣu yajñiyāsvā sa mudā kāvyā puru viśvaṃ bhūmeva puṣyati devo deveṣu yajñiyo nabhantāmanyake same
verses.en: Agni inhabiteth with Gods and men who offer sacrifice. He cherisheth with great delight much wisdom, as all things that be, God among Gods adorable. May all the others die away.

verses.sa:
यो अग्निः सप्तमानुषः श्रितो विश्वेषु सिन्धुषु ।
तमागन्म त्रिपस्त्यं मन्धातुर्दस्युहन्तममग्निं यज्ञेषु पूर्व्यं नभन्तामन्यके समे॥
verses.tr: yo agniḥ saptamānuṣaḥ śrito viśveṣu sindhuṣu tamāganma tripastyaṃ mandhāturdasyuhantamamagniṃ yajñeṣu pūrvyaṃ nabhantāmanyake same
verses.en: Agni who liveth in all streams, Lord of the Sevenfold Race of men, Him dweller in three homes we seek, best slayer of the Dasytis for Mandhatar, first in sacrifice. Let all the others die away.

verses.sa:
अग्निस्त्रीणि त्रिधातून्या क्षेति विदथा कविः ।
स त्रीँरेकादशाँ इह यक्षच्च पिप्रयच्च नो विप्रो दूतः परिष्कृतो नभन्तामन्यके समे॥
verses.tr: agnistrīṇi tridhātūnyā kṣeti vidathā kaviḥ sa trīṃrekādaśāṃ iha yakṣacca piprayacca no vipro dūtaḥ pariṣkṛto nabhantāmanyake same
verses.en: Agni the Wise inhabiteth three gathering-places, triply formed. Decked as our envoy let the Sage bring hither and conciliate the Thrice Eleven Deities. Let all the others die away.

verses.sa:
त्वं नो अग्न आयुषु त्वं देवेषु पूर्व्य वस्व एक इरज्यसि ।
त्वामापः परिस्रुतः परि यन्ति स्वसेतवो नभन्तामन्यके समे॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ no agna āyuṣu tvaṃ deveṣu pūrvya vasva eka irajyasi tvāmāpaḥ parisrutaḥ pari yanti svasetavo nabhantāmanyake same
verses.en: Our Agni, thou art first among the Gods, and first mid living men. Thou only rulest over wealth. Round about thee, as natural dams, circumfluous the waters run. Let all the others die away.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राग्नी युवं सु नः सहन्ता दासथो रयिम् ।
येन दृळ्हा समत्स्वा वीळु चित्साहिषीमह्यग्निर्वनेव वात इन्नभन्तामन्यके समे॥
verses.tr: indrāgnī yuvaṃ su naḥ sahantā dāsatho rayim yena dṛḻhā samatsvā vīḻu citsāhiṣīmahyagnirvaneva vāta innabhantāmanyake same
verses.en: Indra and Agni, surely ye as Conquerors will give us wealth, Whereby in fight we may o'ercome that which is strong and firmly fixed, as Agni burns the woods with wind. Let all the others die away.

verses.sa:
नहि वां वव्रयामहेऽथेन्द्रमिद्यजामहे शविष्ठं नृणां नरम् ।
स नः कदा चिदर्वता गमदा वाजसातये गमदा मेधसातये नभन्तामन्यके समे॥
verses.tr: nahi vāṃ vavrayāmahe'thendramidyajāmahe śaviṣṭhaṃ nṛṇāṃ naram sa naḥ kadā cidarvatā gamadā vājasātaye gamadā medhasātaye nabhantāmanyake same
verses.en: We set no snares to tangle you; Indra we worship and adore, Hero of heroes mightiest. Once may he come unto us with his Steed, come unto us to win us strength, and to complete the sacrifice.

verses.sa:
ता हि मध्यं भराणामिन्द्राग्नी अधिक्षितः ।
ता उ कवित्वना कवी पृच्छ्यमाना सखीयते सं धीतमश्नुतं नरा नभन्तामन्यके समे॥
verses.tr: tā hi madhyaṃ bharāṇāmindrāgnī adhikṣitaḥ tā u kavitvanā kavī pṛcchyamānā sakhīyate saṃ dhītamaśnutaṃ narā nabhantāmanyake same
verses.en: For, famous Indra-Agni, ye are dwellers in the midst of frays. Sages in wisdom, ye are knit to him who seeketh you as friends. Heroes, bestow on him his wish.

verses.sa:
अभ्यर्च नभाकवदिन्द्राग्नी यजसा गिरा ।
ययोर्विश्वमिदं जगदियं द्यौः पृथिवी मह्यु१पस्थे बिभृतो वसु नभन्तामन्यके समे॥
verses.tr: abhyarca nabhākavadindrāgnī yajasā girā yayorviśvamidaṃ jagadiyaṃ dyauḥ pṛthivī mahyu1pasthe bibhṛto vasu nabhantāmanyake same
verses.en: Nabhaka-like, with sacred song Indra's and Agni's praise I sing, Theirs to whom all this world belongs, this heaven and this mighty earth which bear rich treasure in their lap.

verses.sa:
प्र ब्रह्माणि नभाकवदिन्द्राग्निभ्यामिरज्यत ।
या सप्तबुध्नमर्णवं जिह्मबारमपोर्णुत इन्द्र ईशान ओजसा नभन्तामन्यके समे॥
verses.tr: pra brahmāṇi nabhākavadindrāgnibhyāmirajyata yā saptabudhnamarṇavaṃ jihmabāramaporṇuta indra īśāna ojasā nabhantāmanyake same
verses.en: To Indra and to Agni send your prayers, as was Nabhaka's wont,- Who open with sideway opening the sea with its foundations seven-Indra all powerful in his might.

verses.sa:
अपि वृश्च पुराणवद्व्रततेरिव गुष्पितमोजो दासस्य दम्भय ।
वयं तदस्य सम्भृतं वस्विन्द्रेण वि भजेमहि नभन्तामन्यके समे॥
verses.tr: api vṛśca purāṇavadvratateriva guṣpitamojo dāsasya dambhaya vayaṃ tadasya sambhṛtaṃ vasvindreṇa vi bhajemahi nabhantāmanyake same
verses.en: Tear thou asunder, as of old, like tangles of a creeping plant, Demolish thou the Dasa's might. May we with Indra's help divide the treasure he hath gathered up.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्राग्नी जना इमे विह्वयन्ते तना गिरा ।
अस्माकेभिर्नृभिर्वयं सासह्याम पृतन्यतो वनुयाम वनुष्यतो नभन्तामन्यके समे॥
verses.tr: yadindrāgnī janā ime vihvayante tanā girā asmākebhirnṛbhirvayaṃ sāsahyāma pṛtanyato vanuyāma vanuṣyato nabhantāmanyake same
verses.en: What time with this same song these men call Indra-Agni sundry ways, May we with our own heroes quell those who provoke us to the fight, and conquer those who strive with us.

verses.sa:
या नु श्वेताववो दिव उच्चरात उप द्युभिः ।
इन्द्राग्न्योरनु व्रतमुहाना यन्ति सिन्धवो यान्त्सीं बन्धादमुञ्चतां नभन्तामन्यके समे॥
verses.tr: yā nu śvetāvavo diva uccarāta upa dyubhiḥ indrāgnyoranu vratamuhānā yanti sindhavo yāntsīṃ bandhādamuñcatāṃ nabhantāmanyake same
verses.en: The Two refulgent with their beams rise and come downward from the sky. By Indra's and by Agni's behest, flowing away, the rivers, run which they released from their restraint.

verses.sa:
पूर्वीष्ट इन्द्रोपमातयः पूर्वीरुत प्रशस्तयः सूनो हिन्वस्य हरिवः ।
वस्वो वीरस्यापृचो या नु साधन्त नो धियो नभन्तामन्यके समे॥
verses.tr: pūrvīṣṭa indropamātayaḥ pūrvīruta praśastayaḥ sūno hinvasya harivaḥ vasvo vīrasyāpṛco yā nu sādhanta no dhiyo nabhantāmanyake same
verses.en: O Indra, many are thine aids, many thy ways of guiding us, Lord of the Bay Steeds, Hinva's Son. To a Good Hero come our prayers, which soon shall have accomplishment.

verses.sa:
तं शिशीता सुवृक्तिभिस्त्वेषं सत्वानमृग्मियम् ।
उतो नु चिद्य ओजसा शुष्णस्याण्डानि भेदति जेषत्स्वर्वतीरपो नभन्तामन्यके समे॥
verses.tr: taṃ śiśītā suvṛktibhistveṣaṃ satvānamṛgmiyam uto nu cidya ojasā śuṣṇasyāṇḍāni bhedati jeṣatsvarvatīrapo nabhantāmanyake same
verses.en: Inspire him with your holy hymns, the Hero bright and glorious, Him who with might demolisheth even the brood of Susna, and winneth for us the heavenly streams.

verses.sa:
तं शिशीता स्वध्वरं सत्यं सत्वानमृत्वियम् ।
उतो नु चिद्य ओहत आण्डा शुष्णस्य भेदत्यजैः स्वर्वतीरपो नभन्तामन्यके समे॥
verses.tr: taṃ śiśītā svadhvaraṃ satyaṃ satvānamṛtviyam uto nu cidya ohata āṇḍā śuṣṇasya bhedatyajaiḥ svarvatīrapo nabhantāmanyake same
verses.en: Inspire him worshipped with fair rites, the glorious Hero truly brave. He brake in pieces Susna's brood who still expected not the stroke, and won for us the heavenly streams. Let all the others die away.

verses.sa:
एवेन्द्राग्निभ्यां पितृवन्नवीयो मन्धातृवदङ्गिरस्वदवाचि ।
त्रिधातुना शर्मणा पातमस्मान्वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम्॥
verses.tr: evendrāgnibhyāṃ pitṛvannavīyo mandhātṛvadaṅgirasvadavāci tridhātunā śarmaṇā pātamasmānvayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām
verses.en: Thus have we sung anew to Indra-Agni, as sang our sires, Angirases, and Mandhatar. Guard us with triple shelter and preserve us: may we be masters of a store of riches.

verses.sa:
अस्मा ऊ षु प्रभूतये वरुणाय मरुद्भ्योऽर्चा विदुष्टरेभ्यः ।
यो धीता मानुषाणां पश्वो गा इव रक्षति नभन्तामन्यके समे॥
verses.tr: asmā ū ṣu prabhūtaye varuṇāya marudbhyo'rcā viduṣṭarebhyaḥ yo dhītā mānuṣāṇāṃ paśvo gā iva rakṣati nabhantāmanyake same
verses.en: To make this Varuna come forth sing thou a song unto the band of Maruts wiser than thyself,- This Varuna who guardeth well the thoughts of men like herds of kine. Let all the others die away.

verses.sa:
तमू षु समना गिरा पितॄणां च मन्मभिः ।
नाभाकस्य प्रशस्तिभिर्यः सिन्धूनामुपोदये सप्तस्वसा स मध्यमो नभन्तामन्यके समे॥
verses.tr: tamū ṣu samanā girā pitṝṇāṃ ca manmabhiḥ nābhākasya praśastibhiryaḥ sindhūnāmupodaye saptasvasā sa madhyamo nabhantāmanyake same
verses.en: Him altogether praise I with the song and hymns our fathers sang, and with Nabhaka's eulogies,- Him dwelling at the rivers' source, surrounded by his Sisters Seven.

verses.sa:
स क्षपः परि षस्वजे न्यु१स्रो मायया दधे स विश्वं परि दर्शतः ।
तस्य वेनीरनु व्रतमुषस्तिस्रो अवर्धयन्नभन्तामन्यके समे॥
verses.tr: sa kṣapaḥ pari ṣasvaje nyu1sro māyayā dadhe sa viśvaṃ pari darśataḥ tasya venīranu vratamuṣastisro avardhayannabhantāmanyake same
verses.en: The nights he hath encompassed, and stablished the morns with magic art visible over all is he. His dear Ones, following his Law, have prospered the Three Dawns for him.

verses.sa:
यः ककुभो निधारयः पृथिव्यामधि दर्शतः ।
स माता पूर्व्यं पदं तद्वरुणस्य सप्त्यं स हि गोपा इवेर्यो नभन्तामन्यके समे॥
verses.tr: yaḥ kakubho nidhārayaḥ pṛthivyāmadhi darśataḥ sa mātā pūrvyaṃ padaṃ tadvaruṇasya saptyaṃ sa hi gopā iveryo nabhantāmanyake same
verses.en: He, visible o'er all the earth, stablished the quarters of the sky: He measured out the eastern place, that is the fold of Varuna: like a strong herdsman is the God.

verses.sa:
यो धर्ता भुवनानां य उस्राणामपीच्या३ वेद नामानि गुह्या ।
स कविः काव्या पुरु रूपं द्यौरिव पुष्यति नभन्तामन्यके समे॥
verses.tr: yo dhartā bhuvanānāṃ ya usrāṇāmapīcyā3 veda nāmāni guhyā sa kaviḥ kāvyā puru rūpaṃ dyauriva puṣyati nabhantāmanyake same
verses.en: He who supports the worlds of life, he who well knows the hidden names mysterious of the morning beams, He cherishes much wisdom, Sage, as heaven brings forth each varied form.

verses.sa:
यस्मिन्विश्वानि काव्या चक्रे नाभिरिव श्रिता ।
त्रितं जूती सपर्यत व्रजे गावो न संयुजे युजे अश्वाँ अयुक्षत नभन्तामन्यके समे॥
verses.tr: yasminviśvāni kāvyā cakre nābhiriva śritā tritaṃ jūtī saparyata vraje gāvo na saṃyuje yuje aśvāṃ ayukṣata nabhantāmanyake same
verses.en: In whom all wisdom centres, as the nave is set within the wheel. Haste ye to honour Trita, as kine haste to gather in the fold, even as they muster steeds to yoke.

verses.sa:
य आस्वत्क आशये विश्वा जातान्येषाम् ।
परि धामानि मर्मृशद्वरुणस्य पुरो गये विश्वे देवा अनु व्रतं नभन्तामन्यके समे॥
verses.tr: ya āsvatka āśaye viśvā jātānyeṣām pari dhāmāni marmṛśadvaruṇasya puro gaye viśve devā anu vrataṃ nabhantāmanyake same
verses.en: He wraps these regions as a robe; he contemplates the tribes of Gods and all the works of mortal men. Before the home of Varuna all the Gods follow his decree.

verses.sa:
स समुद्रो अपीच्यस्तुरो द्यामिव रोहति नि यदासु यजुर्दधे ।
स माया अर्चिना पदाऽस्तृणान्नाकमारुहन्नभन्तामन्यके समे॥
verses.tr: sa samudro apīcyasturo dyāmiva rohati ni yadāsu yajurdadhe sa māyā arcinā padā'stṛṇānnākamāruhannabhantāmanyake same
verses.en: He is an Ocean far-removed, yet through the heaven to him ascends the worship which these realms possess. With his bright foot he overthrew their magic, and went up to heaven.

verses.sa:
यस्य श्वेता विचक्षणा तिस्रो भूमीरधिक्षितः ।
त्रिरुत्तराणि पप्रतुर्वरुणस्य ध्रुवं सदः स सप्तानामिरज्यति नभन्तामन्यके समे॥
verses.tr: yasya śvetā vicakṣaṇā tisro bhūmīradhikṣitaḥ triruttarāṇi papraturvaruṇasya dhruvaṃ sadaḥ sa saptānāmirajyati nabhantāmanyake same
verses.en: Ruler, whose bright far-seeing rays, pervading all three earths, have filled the three superior realms of heaven. Firm is the seat of Varuna: over the Seven he rules as King.

verses.sa:
यः श्वेताँ अधिनिर्णिजश्चक्रे कृष्णाँ अनु व्रता ।
स धाम पूर्व्यं ममे यः स्कम्भेन वि रोदसी अजो न द्यामधारयन्नभन्तामन्यके समे॥
verses.tr: yaḥ śvetāṃ adhinirṇijaścakre kṛṣṇāṃ anu vratā sa dhāma pūrvyaṃ mame yaḥ skambhena vi rodasī ajo na dyāmadhārayannabhantāmanyake same
verses.en: Who, after his decree, o'erspread the Dark Ones with a robe of light; Who measured out the ancient seat, who pillared both the worlds apart as the Unborn supported heaven. Let all the others die away.

verses.sa:
अस्तभ्नाद्द्यामसुरो विश्ववेदा अमिमीत वरिमाणं पृथिव्याः ।
आसीदद्विश्वा भुवनानि सम्राड्विश्वेत्तानि वरुणस्य व्रतानि॥
verses.tr: astabhnāddyāmasuro viśvavedā amimīta varimāṇaṃ pṛthivyāḥ āsīdadviśvā bhuvanāni samrāḍviśvettāni varuṇasya vratāni
verses.en: Lord of all wealth, the Asura propped the heavens, and measured out the broad earth's wide expanses. He, King supreme, approached all living creatures. All these are Varuna's holy operations.

verses.sa:
एवा वन्दस्व वरुणं बृहन्तं नमस्या धीरममृतस्य गोपाम् ।
स नः शर्म त्रिवरूथं वि यंसत्पातं नो द्यावापृथिवी उपस्थे॥
verses.tr: evā vandasva varuṇaṃ bṛhantaṃ namasyā dhīramamṛtasya gopām sa naḥ śarma trivarūthaṃ vi yaṃsatpātaṃ no dyāvāpṛthivī upasthe
verses.en: So humbly worship Varuna the Mighty revere the wise Guard of World Immortal. May he vouchsafe us triply-barred protection. O Earth and Heaven, within your lap preserve us.

verses.sa:
इमां धियं शिक्षमाणस्य देव क्रतुं दक्षं वरुण सं शिशाधि ।
ययाति विश्वा दुरिता तरेम सुतर्माणमधि नावं रुहेम॥
verses.tr: imāṃ dhiyaṃ śikṣamāṇasya deva kratuṃ dakṣaṃ varuṇa saṃ śiśādhi yayāti viśvā duritā tarema sutarmāṇamadhi nāvaṃ ruhema
verses.en: Sharpen this song of him who strives his utmost, sharpen, God Varuna, his strength and insight; May we ascend the ship that bears us safely, whereby we may pass over all misfortune.

verses.sa: आ वां ग्रावाणो अश्विना धीभिर्विप्रा अचुच्यवुः । नासत्या सोमपीतये नभन्तामन्यके समे॥
verses.tr: ā vāṃ grāvāṇo aśvinā dhībhirviprā acucyavuḥ nāsatyā somapītaye nabhantāmanyake same
verses.en: Asvins, with songs the singer stones have made you hasten hitherward, Nasatyas, to the Soma-draught. Let all the others die away.

verses.sa: यथा वामत्रिरश्विना गीर्भिर्विप्रो अजोहवीत् । नासत्या सोमपीतये नभन्तामन्यके समे॥
verses.tr: yathā vāmatriraśvinā gīrbhirvipro ajohavīt nāsatyā somapītaye nabhantāmanyake same
verses.en: As the sage Atri with his hymns, O Asvins, called you eagerly, Nasatyas, to the Soma-draught. Let all the others die away.

verses.sa: एवा वामह्व ऊतये यथाहुवन्त मेधिराः । नासत्या सोमपीतये नभन्तामन्यके समे॥
verses.tr: evā vāmahva ūtaye yathāhuvanta medhirāḥ nāsatyā somapītaye nabhantāmanyake same
verses.en: So have I called you to our aid, even as the wise have called of old, Nasatyas, to the Soma-draught. Let all the others die away.

verses.sa: इमे विप्रस्य वेधसोऽग्नेरस्तृतयज्वनः । गिरः स्तोमास ईरते॥
verses.tr: ime viprasya vedhaso'gnerastṛtayajvanaḥ giraḥ stomāsa īrate
verses.en: These songs of mine go forth as lauds of Agni, the disposing Sage, Whose worshipper is ne'er o'erthrawn.

verses.sa: अस्मै ते प्रतिहर्यते जातवेदो विचर्षणे । अग्ने जनामि सुष्टुतिम्॥
verses.tr: asmai te pratiharyate jātavedo vicarṣaṇe agne janāmi suṣṭutim
verses.en: Wise Agni Jatavedas, I beget a song of praise for thee. Who willingly receivest it.

verses.sa: आरोका इव घेदह तिग्मा अग्ने तव त्विषः । दद्भिर्वनानि बप्सति॥
verses.tr: ārokā iva ghedaha tigmā agne tava tviṣaḥ dadbhirvanāni bapsati
verses.en: Thy sharpened flames, O Agni, like the gleams of light that glitter through, Devour the forests with their teeth.

verses.sa: हरयो धूमकेतवो वातजूता उप द्यवि । यतन्ते वृथगग्नयः॥
verses.tr: harayo dhūmaketavo vātajūtā upa dyavi yatante vṛthagagnayaḥ
verses.en: Gold-coloured, bannered with the smoke, urged by the wind, aloft to heaven Rise, lightly borne, the flames of fire.

verses.sa: एते त्ये वृथगग्नय इद्धासः समदृक्षत । उषसामिव केतवः॥
verses.tr: ete tye vṛthagagnaya iddhāsaḥ samadṛkṣata uṣasāmiva ketavaḥ
verses.en: These lightly kindled fiery flames are all around made visible, Even as the gleamings of the Dawns.

verses.sa: कृष्णा रजांसि पत्सुतः प्रयाणे जातवेदसः । अग्निर्यद्रोधति क्षमि॥
verses.tr: kṛṣṇā rajāṃsi patsutaḥ prayāṇe jātavedasaḥ agniryadrodhati kṣami
verses.en: As Jatavedas speeds along, the dust is black beneath his feet, When Agni spreads upon the earth.

verses.sa: धासिं कृण्वान ओषधीर्बप्सदग्निर्न वायति । पुनर्यन्तरुणीरपि॥
verses.tr: dhāsiṃ kṛṇvāna oṣadhīrbapsadagnirna vāyati punaryantaruṇīrapi
verses.en: Making the plants his nourishment, Agni devours and wearies not, Seeking the tender shrubs again.

verses.sa: जिह्वाभिरह नन्नमदर्चिषा जञ्जणाभवन् । अग्निर्वनेषु रोचते॥
verses.tr: jihvābhiraha nannamadarciṣā jañjaṇābhavan agnirvaneṣu rocate
verses.en: Bending him down with all his tongues, he flickers with his fiery glow Splendid is Agni in the woods.

verses.sa: अप्स्वग्ने सधिष्टव सौषधीरनु रुध्यसे । गर्भे सञ्जायसे पुनः॥
verses.tr: apsvagne sadhiṣṭava sauṣadhīranu rudhyase garbhe sañjāyase punaḥ
verses.en: Agni, thine home is in the floods: into the plants thou forcest way, And as their Child art born anew.

verses.sa: उदग्ने तव तद्घृतादर्ची रोचत आहुतम् । निंसानं जुह्वो३ मुखे॥
verses.tr: udagne tava tadghṛtādarcī rocata āhutam niṃsānaṃ juhvo3 mukhe
verses.en: Worshipped with offerings shines thy flame, O Agni, from the sacred oil, With kisses on the ladle's mouth.

verses.sa: उक्षान्नाय वशान्नाय सोमपृष्ठाय वेधसे । स्तोमैर्विधेमाग्नये॥
verses.tr: ukṣānnāya vaśānnāya somapṛṣṭhāya vedhase stomairvidhemāgnaye
verses.en: Let us serve Agni with our hymns, Disposer, fed on ox and cow, Who bears the Soma on his back.

verses.sa: उत त्वा नमसा वयं होतर्वरेण्यक्रतो । अग्ने समिद्भिरीमहे॥
verses.tr: uta tvā namasā vayaṃ hotarvareṇyakrato agne samidbhirīmahe
verses.en: Yea, thee, O Agni, do we seek with homage and with fuel, Priest Whose wisdom is most excellent.

verses.sa: उत त्वा भृगुवच्छुचे मनुष्वदग्न आहुत । अङ्गिरस्वद्धवामहे॥
verses.tr: uta tvā bhṛguvacchuce manuṣvadagna āhuta aṅgirasvaddhavāmahe
verses.en: O worshipped with oblations, pure Agni, we call on thee as erst, Did Bhrgu, Manus, Angiras.

verses.sa: त्वं ह्यग्ने अग्निना विप्रो विप्रेण सन्त्सता । सखा सख्या समिध्यसे॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ hyagne agninā vipro vipreṇa santsatā sakhā sakhyā samidhyase
verses.en: For thou, O Agni, by the fire, Sage by the Sage, Good by the Good, Friend by the Friend, art lighted up.

verses.sa: स त्वं विप्राय दाशुषे रयिं देहि सहस्रिणम् । अग्ने वीरवतीमिषम्॥
verses.tr: sa tvaṃ viprāya dāśuṣe rayiṃ dehi sahasriṇam agne vīravatīmiṣam
verses.en: So wealth in thousands, food with store of heroes give thou to the sage, O Agni, to the worshipper.

verses.sa: अग्ने भ्रातः सहस्कृत रोहिदश्व शुचिव्रत । इमं स्तोमं जुषस्व मे॥
verses.tr: agne bhrātaḥ sahaskṛta rohidaśva śucivrata imaṃ stomaṃ juṣasva me
verses.en: O Agni, Brother, made by strength, Lord of red steeds and brilliant sway, Take pleasure in this laud of mine.

verses.sa: उत त्वाग्ने मम स्तुतो वाश्राय प्रतिहर्यते । गोष्ठं गाव इवाशत॥
verses.tr: uta tvāgne mama stuto vāśrāya pratiharyate goṣṭhaṃ gāva ivāśata
verses.en: My praises, Agni, go to thee, as the cows seek the stall to meet, The lowing calf that longs for milk.

verses.sa: तुभ्यं ता अङ्गिरस्तम विश्वाः सुक्षितयः पृथक् । अग्ने कामाय येमिरे॥
verses.tr: tubhyaṃ tā aṅgirastama viśvāḥ sukṣitayaḥ pṛthak agne kāmāya yemire
verses.en: Agni, best Angiras, to thee all people who have pleasant homes, Apart, have turned as to their wish.

verses.sa: अग्निं धीभिर्मनीषिणो मेधिरासो विपश्चितः । अद्मसद्याय हिन्विरे॥
verses.tr: agniṃ dhībhirmanīṣiṇo medhirāso vipaścitaḥ admasadyāya hinvire
verses.en: The sages skilled in holy song and thin. kers with their thoughts have urged Agni to share the sacred feast.

verses.sa: तं त्वामज्मेषु वाजिनं तन्वाना अग्ने अध्वरम् । वह्निं होतारमीळते॥
verses.tr: taṃ tvāmajmeṣu vājinaṃ tanvānā agne adhvaram vahniṃ hotāramīḻate
verses.en: So, Agni, unto thee the Priest, Invoker, strong in forays, pray 'nose who spin out the sacrifice.

verses.sa: पुरुत्रा हि सदृङ्ङसि विशो विश्वा अनु प्रभुः । समत्सु त्वा हवामहे॥
verses.tr: purutrā hi sadṛṅṅasi viśo viśvā anu prabhuḥ samatsu tvā havāmahe
verses.en: In many a place, the same in look art thou, a Prince o'er all the tribes In battles we invoke thine aid.

verses.sa: तमीळिष्व य आहुतोऽग्निर्विभ्राजते घृतैः । इमं नः शृणवद्धवम्॥
verses.tr: tamīḻiṣva ya āhuto'gnirvibhrājate ghṛtaiḥ imaṃ naḥ śṛṇavaddhavam
verses.en: Pray thou to Agni, pray to him who blazes served with sacred oil: Let him give ear to this our call.

verses.sa: तं त्वा वयं हवामहे शृण्वन्तं जातवेदसम् । अग्ने घ्नन्तमप द्विषः॥
verses.tr: taṃ tvā vayaṃ havāmahe śṛṇvantaṃ jātavedasam agne ghnantamapa dviṣaḥ
verses.en: We call on thee as such, as one who hears, as Jatavedas, one, Agni! who beats away our foes.

verses.sa: विशां राजानमद्भुतमध्यक्षं धर्मणामिमम् । अग्निमीळे स उ श्रवत्॥
verses.tr: viśāṃ rājānamadbhutamadhyakṣaṃ dharmaṇāmimam agnimīḻe sa u śravat
verses.en: I pray to Agni, King of men, the Wonderful, the President Of holy Laws: may he give ear.

verses.sa: अग्निं विश्वायुवेपसं मर्यं न वाजिनं हितम् । सप्तिं न वाजयामसि॥
verses.tr: agniṃ viśvāyuvepasaṃ maryaṃ na vājinaṃ hitam saptiṃ na vājayāmasi
verses.en: Him like a bridegroom, him who stirs all people, like a noble horse, Like a fleet steed, we instigate.

verses.sa: घ्नन्मृध्राण्यप द्विषो दहन्रक्षांसि विश्वहा । अग्ने तिग्मेन दीदिहि॥
verses.tr: ghnanmṛdhrāṇyapa dviṣo dahanrakṣāṃsi viśvahā agne tigmena dīdihi
verses.en: Slaying things deadly, burning up foes, Riksasas, on every side, Shine, Agni, with thy sharpened flame.

verses.sa: यं त्वा जनास इन्धते मनुष्वदङ्गिरस्तम । अग्ने स बोधि मे वचः॥
verses.tr: yaṃ tvā janāsa indhate manuṣvadaṅgirastama agne sa bodhi me vacaḥ
verses.en: Thou whom the people kindle even as Manus did, best Angiras! O Agni, mark thou this my speech.

verses.sa: यदग्ने दिविजा अस्यप्सुजा वा सहस्कृत । तं त्वा गीर्भिर्हवामहे॥
verses.tr: yadagne divijā asyapsujā vā sahaskṛta taṃ tvā gīrbhirhavāmahe
verses.en: O Agni, made by strength! be thou born in the heavens or born in floods, As such we call on thee with songs.

verses.sa: तुभ्यं घेत्ते जना इमे विश्वाः सुक्षितयः पृथक् । धासिं हिन्वन्त्यत्तवे॥
verses.tr: tubhyaṃ ghette janā ime viśvāḥ sukṣitayaḥ pṛthak dhāsiṃ hinvantyattave
verses.en: Yea, all the people, all the folk who have good dwellings, each apart, Send food for thee to eat thereof.

verses.sa: ते घेदग्ने स्वाध्योऽहा विश्वा नृचक्षसः । तरन्तः स्याम दुर्गहा॥
verses.tr: te ghedagne svādhyo'hā viśvā nṛcakṣasaḥ tarantaḥ syāma durgahā
verses.en: O Agni, so may we, devout, gazed at by men, throughout our days, Pass lightly over all distress.

verses.sa: अग्निं मन्द्रं पुरुप्रियं शीरं पावकशोचिषम् । हृद्भिर्मन्द्रेभिरीमहे॥
verses.tr: agniṃ mandraṃ purupriyaṃ śīraṃ pāvakaśociṣam hṛdbhirmandrebhirīmahe
verses.en: We venerate with cheerful hearts the cheerful Agni, dear to all, Burning, with purifying flame.

verses.sa: स त्वमग्ने विभावसुः सृजन्त्सूर्यो न रश्मिभिः । शर्धन्तमांसि जिघ्नसे॥
verses.tr: sa tvamagne vibhāvasuḥ sṛjantsūryo na raśmibhiḥ śardhantamāṃsi jighnase
verses.en: So thou, O Agni rich in light, beaming like Surya with thy rays Boldly demolishest the gloom,

verses.sa: तत्ते सहस्व ईमहे दात्रं यन्नोपदस्यति । त्वदग्ने वार्यं वसु॥
verses.tr: tatte sahasva īmahe dātraṃ yannopadasyati tvadagne vāryaṃ vasu
verses.en: We pray to thee for this thy gift, Victor the gift that faileth not, O Agni, choicest wealth from thee.

verses.sa: समिधाग्निं दुवस्यत घृतैर्बोधयतातिथिम् । आस्मिन्हव्या जुहोतन॥
verses.tr: samidhāgniṃ duvasyata ghṛtairbodhayatātithim āsminhavyā juhotana
verses.en: Pay service unto Agni with your fuel, rouse your Guest with oil: In him present your offerings.

verses.sa: अग्ने स्तोमं जुषस्व मे वर्धस्वानेन मन्मना । प्रति सूक्तानि हर्य नः॥
verses.tr: agne stomaṃ juṣasva me vardhasvānena manmanā prati sūktāni harya naḥ
verses.en: Agni, do thou accept my laud, be magnified by this my song: Welcome my sweetly-spoken words.

verses.sa: अग्निं दूतं पुरो दधे हव्यवाहमुप ब्रुवे । देवाँ आ सादयादिह॥
verses.tr: agniṃ dūtaṃ puro dadhe havyavāhamupa bruve devāṃ ā sādayādiha
verses.en: Agni, envoy, I place in front; the oblation-bearer I address: Here let him seat the Deities.

verses.sa: उत्ते बृहन्तो अर्चयः समिधानस्य दीदिवः । अग्ने शुक्रास ईरते॥
verses.tr: utte bṛhanto arcayaḥ samidhānasya dīdivaḥ agne śukrāsa īrate
verses.en: Agni, the lofty flames of' thee enkindled have gone up on high, Thy bright flames, thou Refulgent One.

verses.sa: उप त्वा जुह्वो३ मम घृताचीर्यन्तु हर्यत । अग्ने हव्या जुषस्व नः॥
verses.tr: upa tvā juhvo3 mama ghṛtācīryantu haryata agne havyā juṣasva naḥ
verses.en: Beloved! let my ladles full of sacred oil come near to thee: Agni, accept our offerings.

verses.sa: मन्द्रं होतारमृत्विजं चित्रभानुं विभावसुम् । अग्निमीळे स उ श्रवत्॥
verses.tr: mandraṃ hotāramṛtvijaṃ citrabhānuṃ vibhāvasum agnimīḻe sa u śravat
verses.en: I worship Agni-may he hear!-the cheerful, the Invoker, Priest, Of varied splendour, rich in light.

verses.sa: प्रत्नं होतारमीड्यं जुष्टमग्निं कविक्रतुम् । अध्वराणामभिश्रियम्॥
verses.tr: pratnaṃ hotāramīḍyaṃ juṣṭamagniṃ kavikratum adhvarāṇāmabhiśriyam
verses.en: Ancient Invoker, meet for praise, beloved Agni, wise and strong, The visitant of solemn rites.

verses.sa: जुषाणो अङ्गिरस्तमेमा हव्यान्यानुषक् । अग्ने यज्ञं नय ऋतुथा॥
verses.tr: juṣāṇo aṅgirastamemā havyānyānuṣak agne yajñaṃ naya ṛtuthā
verses.en: Agni, best Angiras, accept straightway these offerings, and guide The seasonable sacrifice.

verses.sa: समिधान उ सन्त्य शुक्रशोच इहा वह । चिकित्वान्दैव्यं जनम्॥
verses.tr: samidhāna u santya śukraśoca ihā vaha cikitvāndaivyaṃ janam
verses.en: Excellent God, with brilliant flames, enkindled bring thou hitherward, Knowing the way, the Heavenly Host.

verses.sa: विप्रं होतारमद्रुहं धूमकेतुं विभावसुम् । यज्ञानां केतुमीमहे॥
verses.tr: vipraṃ hotāramadruhaṃ dhūmaketuṃ vibhāvasum yajñānāṃ ketumīmahe
verses.en: Him, Sage and Herald, void of guile, ensign of sacrifices, him Smoke-bannered, rich in light, we seek.

verses.sa: अग्ने नि पाहि नस्त्वं प्रति ष्म देव रीषतः । भिन्धि द्वेषः सहस्कृत॥
verses.tr: agne ni pāhi nastvaṃ prati ṣma deva rīṣataḥ bhindhi dveṣaḥ sahaskṛta
verses.en: O Agni, be our Guardian thou, God, against those who injure us: Destroy our foes, thou Son of Strength.

verses.sa: अग्निः प्रत्नेन मन्मना शुम्भानस्तन्वं१ स्वाम् । कविर्विप्रेण वावृधे॥
verses.tr: agniḥ pratnena manmanā śumbhānastanvaṃ1 svām kavirvipreṇa vāvṛdhe
verses.en: Making his body beautiful, Agni the Sage hath waxen by The singer and his ancient hymn.

verses.sa: ऊर्जो नपातमा हुवेऽग्निं पावकशोचिषम् । अस्मिन्यज्ञे स्वध्वरे॥
verses.tr: ūrjo napātamā huve'gniṃ pāvakaśociṣam asminyajñe svadhvare
verses.en: I invocate the Child of Strength, Agni with purifying flame, At this well-ordered sacrifice.

verses.sa: स नो मित्रमहस्त्वमग्ने शुक्रेण शोचिषा । देवैरा सत्सि बर्हिषि॥
verses.tr: sa no mitramahastvamagne śukreṇa śociṣā devairā satsi barhiṣi
verses.en: So Agni, rich in many friends, with fiery splendour, seat thyself With Gods upon our sacred grass.

verses.sa: यो अग्निं तन्वो३ दमे देवं मर्तः सपर्यति । तस्मा इद्दीदयद्वसु॥
verses.tr: yo agniṃ tanvo3 dame devaṃ martaḥ saparyati tasmā iddīdayadvasu
verses.en: The mortal man who serves the God Agni within his own abode, For him he causes wealth to shine.

verses.sa: अग्निर्मूर्धा दिवः ककुत्पतिः पृथिव्या अयम् । अपां रेतांसि जिन्वति॥
verses.tr: agnirmūrdhā divaḥ kakutpatiḥ pṛthivyā ayam apāṃ retāṃsi jinvati
verses.en: Agni is head and height of heaven, the Master of the earth is he: He quickeneth the watere seed.

verses.sa: उदग्ने शुचयस्तव शुक्रा भ्राजन्त ईरते । तव ज्योतींष्यर्चयः॥
verses.tr: udagne śucayastava śukrā bhrājanta īrate tava jyotīṃṣyarcayaḥ
verses.en: Upward, O Agni, rise thy flames, pure and resplendent, blazing high, Thy lustres, fair effulgences.

verses.sa: ईशिषे वार्यस्य हि दात्रस्याग्ने स्वर्पतिः । स्तोता स्यां तव शर्मणि॥
verses.tr: īśiṣe vāryasya hi dātrasyāgne svarpatiḥ stotā syāṃ tava śarmaṇi
verses.en: For, Agni, thou as Lord of Light rulest o'er choicest gifts: may I, Thy singer, find defense in thee.

verses.sa: त्वामग्ने मनीषिणस्त्वां हिन्वन्ति चित्तिभिः । त्वां वर्धन्तु नो गिरः॥
verses.tr: tvāmagne manīṣiṇastvāṃ hinvanti cittibhiḥ tvāṃ vardhantu no giraḥ
verses.en: O Agni, they who understand stir thee to action with their thoughts: So let our songs enhance thy might.

verses.sa: अदब्धस्य स्वधावतो दूतस्य रेभतः सदा । अग्नेः सख्यं वृणीमहे॥
verses.tr: adabdhasya svadhāvato dūtasya rebhataḥ sadā agneḥ sakhyaṃ vṛṇīmahe
verses.en: We ever claim the friendship of Agni, the singing messenger, Of God-like nature, void of guile.

verses.sa: अग्निः शुचिव्रततमः शुचिर्विप्रः शुचिः कविः । शुची रोचत आहुतः॥
verses.tr: agniḥ śucivratatamaḥ śucirvipraḥ śuciḥ kaviḥ śucī rocata āhutaḥ
verses.en: Agni who bears most holy sway, the holy Singer, holy Sage, Shines holy when we worship him.

verses.sa: उत त्वा धीतयो मम गिरो वर्धन्तु विश्वहा । अग्ने सख्यस्य बोधि नः॥
verses.tr: uta tvā dhītayo mama giro vardhantu viśvahā agne sakhyasya bodhi naḥ
verses.en: Yea, let my meditations, let my songs exalt thee evermore. Think, Agni, of our friendly bond,

verses.sa: यदग्ने स्यामहं त्वं त्वं वा घा स्या अहम् । स्युष्टे सत्या इहाशिषः॥
verses.tr: yadagne syāmahaṃ tvaṃ tvaṃ vā ghā syā aham syuṣṭe satyā ihāśiṣaḥ
verses.en: If I were thou and thou wert I, O Agni, every prayer of thine Should have its due fulfilment here.

verses.sa: वसुर्वसुपतिर्हि कमस्यग्ने विभावसुः । स्याम ते सुमतावपि॥
verses.tr: vasurvasupatirhi kamasyagne vibhāvasuḥ syāma te sumatāvapi
verses.en: For Excellent and Lord of wealth. art thou O Agni, rich in light: May we enjoy thy favouring grace.

verses.sa: अग्ने धृतव्रताय ते समुद्रायेव सिन्धवः । गिरो वाश्रास ईरते॥
verses.tr: agne dhṛtavratāya te samudrāyeva sindhavaḥ giro vāśrāsa īrate
verses.en: Agni, to thee whose laws stand fast our resonant songs of praise speed forth, As rivers hasten to the sea.

verses.sa: युवानं विश्पतिं कविं विश्वादं पुरुवेपसम् । अग्निं शुम्भामि मन्मभिः॥
verses.tr: yuvānaṃ viśpatiṃ kaviṃ viśvādaṃ puruvepasam agniṃ śumbhāmi manmabhiḥ
verses.en: Agni, the Youthful Lord of men, who stirreth much and eateth all, The Sage, I glorify with hymns.

verses.sa: यज्ञानां रथ्ये वयं तिग्मजम्भाय वीळवे । स्तोमैरिषेमाग्नये॥
verses.tr: yajñānāṃ rathye vayaṃ tigmajambhāya vīḻave stomairiṣemāgnaye
verses.en: To Agni let us haste with lauds, the Guide of sacrificial rites, Armed with sharp teeth, the Mighty One.

verses.sa: अयमग्ने त्वे अपि जरिता भूतु सन्त्य । तस्मै पावक मृळय॥
verses.tr: ayamagne tve api jaritā bhūtu santya tasmai pāvaka mṛḻaya
verses.en: And let this man, good Agni, be with thee the singer of thy praise: Be gracious, Holy One, to him.

verses.sa: धीरो ह्यस्यद्मसद्विप्रो न जागृविः सदा । अग्ने दीदयसि द्यवि॥
verses.tr: dhīro hyasyadmasadvipro na jāgṛviḥ sadā agne dīdayasi dyavi
verses.en: For thou art sharer of our feast, wise, ever watchful as a Sage: Agni, thou shinest in the sky.

verses.sa: पुराग्ने दुरितेभ्यः पुरा मृध्रेभ्यः कवे । प्र ण आयुर्वसो तिर॥
verses.tr: purāgne duritebhyaḥ purā mṛdhrebhyaḥ kave pra ṇa āyurvaso tira
verses.en: O Agni, Sage, before our foes, before misfortunes fall on us, Excellent Lord, prolong our lives.

verses.sa: आ घा ये अग्निमिन्धते स्तृणन्ति बर्हिरानुषक् । येषामिन्द्रो युवा सखा॥
verses.tr: ā ghā ye agnimindhate stṛṇanti barhirānuṣak yeṣāmindro yuvā sakhā
verses.en: Hitherward! they who light flame and straightway trim the sacred grass. Whose Friend is Indra ever young.

verses.sa: बृहन्निदिध्म एषां भूरि शस्तं पृथुः स्वरुः । येषामिन्द्रो युवा सखा॥
verses.tr: bṛhannididhma eṣāṃ bhūri śastaṃ pṛthuḥ svaruḥ yeṣāmindro yuvā sakhā
verses.en: High is their fuel, great their laud, wide is their splinter from the stake, Whose Friend is Indra ever young.

verses.sa: अयुद्ध इद्युधा वृतं शूर आजति सत्वभिः । येषामिन्द्रो युवा सखा॥
verses.tr: ayuddha idyudhā vṛtaṃ śūra ājati satvabhiḥ yeṣāmindro yuvā sakhā
verses.en: Unequalled in fight the hero leads his army with the warrior chiefs. Whose Friend is Indra ever young.

verses.sa: आ बुन्दं वृत्रहा ददे जातः पृच्छद्वि मातरम् । क उग्राः के ह शृण्विरे॥
verses.tr: ā bundaṃ vṛtrahā dade jātaḥ pṛcchadvi mātaram ka ugrāḥ ke ha śṛṇvire
verses.en: The new-born Vrtra-slayer asked his Mother, as he seized his shaft, Who are the fierce? Who are renowned?

verses.sa: प्रति त्वा शवसी वदद्गिरावप्सो न योधिषत् । यस्ते शत्रुत्वमाचके॥
verses.tr: prati tvā śavasī vadadgirāvapso na yodhiṣat yaste śatrutvamācake
verses.en: Savasi answered, He who seeks thine enmity will battle like A stately elephant on a hill.

verses.sa: उत त्वं मघवञ्छृणु यस्ते वष्टि ववक्षि तत् । यद्वीळयासि वीळु तत्॥
verses.tr: uta tvaṃ maghavañchṛṇu yaste vaṣṭi vavakṣi tat yadvīḻayāsi vīḻu tat
verses.en: And hear, O Maghavan; to him who craves of thee thou grantest all Whate'er thou makest firm is firm.

verses.sa: यदाजिं यात्याजिकृदिन्द्रः स्वश्वयुरुप । रथीतमो रथीनाम्॥
verses.tr: yadājiṃ yātyājikṛdindraḥ svaśvayurupa rathītamo rathīnām
verses.en: What time the Warrior Indra goes to battle, borne by noble steeds, Best of all charioteers is he.

verses.sa: वि षु विश्वा अभियुजो वज्रिन्विष्वग्यथा वृह । भवा नः सुश्रवस्तमः॥
verses.tr: vi ṣu viśvā abhiyujo vajrinviṣvagyathā vṛha bhavā naḥ suśravastamaḥ
verses.en: Repel, O Thunder-armed, in all directions all attacks on us: And be our own most glorious God.

verses.sa: अस्माकं सु रथं पुर इन्द्रः कृणोतु सातये । न यं धूर्वन्ति धूर्तयः॥
verses.tr: asmākaṃ su rathaṃ pura indraḥ kṛṇotu sātaye na yaṃ dhūrvanti dhūrtayaḥ
verses.en: May Indra set our car in front, in foremost Place to win the spoil, He whom the wicked injure not.

verses.sa: वृज्याम ते परि द्विषोऽरं ते शक्र दावने । गमेमेदिन्द्र गोमतः॥
verses.tr: vṛjyāma te pari dviṣo'raṃ te śakra dāvane gamemedindra gomataḥ
verses.en: Thine enmity may we escape, and, Gakra, for thy bounty, rich In kine, may we come near to thee

verses.sa: शनैश्चिद्यन्तो अद्रिवोऽश्वावन्तः शतग्विनः । विवक्षणा अनेहसः॥
verses.tr: śanaiścidyanto adrivo'śvāvantaḥ śatagvinaḥ vivakṣaṇā anehasaḥ
verses.en: Softly approaching, Thunder-armed wealthy by hundreds, rich in steeds, Unrivalled, ready with our gifts.

verses.sa: ऊर्ध्वा हि ते दिवेदिवे सहस्रा सूनृता शता । जरितृभ्यो विमंहते॥
verses.tr: ūrdhvā hi te divedive sahasrā sūnṛtā śatā jaritṛbhyo vimaṃhate
verses.en: For thine exalted excellence gives to thy worshippers each day Hundreds and thousands of thy boons.

verses.sa: विद्मा हि त्वा धनंजयमिन्द्र दृळ्हा चिदारुजम् । आदारिणं यथा गयम्॥
verses.tr: vidmā hi tvā dhanaṃjayamindra dṛḻhā cidārujam ādāriṇaṃ yathā gayam
verses.en: Indra, we know thee breaker-down even of strong forts, winner of spoil, A:one who conquers wealth for us.

verses.sa: ककुहं चित्त्वा कवे मन्दन्तु धृष्णविन्दवः । आ त्वा पणिं यदीमहे॥
verses.tr: kakuhaṃ cittvā kave mandantu dhṛṣṇavindavaḥ ā tvā paṇiṃ yadīmahe
verses.en: Though thou art highest, Sage and Bold let the drops cheer thee when we come To thee as to a trafficker.

verses.sa: यस्ते रेवाँ अदाशुरिः प्रममर्ष मघत्तये । तस्य नो वेद आ भर॥
verses.tr: yaste revāṃ adāśuriḥ pramamarṣa maghattaye tasya no veda ā bhara
verses.en: Bring unto us the treasure of the opulent man who, loth to give, Hath slighted thee for gain of wealth.

verses.sa: इम उ त्वा वि चक्षते सखाय इन्द्र सोमिनः । पुष्टावन्तो यथा पशुम्॥
verses.tr: ima u tvā vi cakṣate sakhāya indra sominaḥ puṣṭāvanto yathā paśum
verses.en: Indra, these friends of ours, supplied with Soma, wait and look to thee, As men with fodder to the herd.

verses.sa: उत त्वाबधिरं वयं श्रुत्कर्णं सन्तमूतये । दूरादिह हवामहे॥
verses.tr: uta tvābadhiraṃ vayaṃ śrutkarṇaṃ santamūtaye dūrādiha havāmahe
verses.en: And thee who art not deaf, whose cars are quick to listen, for our aid, We call to us from far away.

verses.sa: यच्छुश्रूया इमं हवं दुर्मर्षं चक्रिया उत । भवेरापिर्नो अन्तमः॥
verses.tr: yacchuśrūyā imaṃ havaṃ durmarṣaṃ cakriyā uta bhaverāpirno antamaḥ
verses.en: When thou hast listened, make our call one which thou never wilt forget, And be our very nearest Friend.

verses.sa: यच्चिद्धि ते अपि व्यथिर्जगन्वांसो अमन्महि । गोदा इदिन्द्र बोधि नः॥
verses.tr: yacciddhi te api vyathirjaganvāṃso amanmahi godā idindra bodhi naḥ
verses.en: When even now, when we have been in trouble, we have thought of thee, O Indra, give us gifts of kine.

verses.sa: आ त्वा रम्भं न जिव्रयो ररभ्मा शवसस्पते । उश्मसि त्वा सधस्थ आ॥
verses.tr: ā tvā rambhaṃ na jivrayo rarabhmā śavasaspate uśmasi tvā sadhastha ā
verses.en: O Lord of Strength, we rest on thee, as old men rest upon a staff: We long to have. thee dwell with us.

verses.sa: स्तोत्रमिन्द्राय गायत पुरुनृम्णाय सत्वने । नकिर्यं वृण्वते युधि॥
verses.tr: stotramindrāya gāyata purunṛmṇāya satvane nakiryaṃ vṛṇvate yudhi
verses.en: To Indra sing a song of praise, Hero of mighty valour, him Whom no one challenges to war.

verses.sa: अभि त्वा वृषभा सुते सुतं सृजामि पीतये । तृम्पा व्यश्नुही मदम्॥
verses.tr: abhi tvā vṛṣabhā sute sutaṃ sṛjāmi pītaye tṛmpā vyaśnuhī madam
verses.en: Hero, the Soma being shed, I pour the juice for thee to drink: Sate thee and finish thy carouse.

verses.sa: मा त्वा मूरा अविष्यवो मोपहस्वान आ दभन् । माकीं ब्रह्मद्विषो वनः॥
verses.tr: mā tvā mūrā aviṣyavo mopahasvāna ā dabhan mākīṃ brahmadviṣo vanaḥ
verses.en: Let not the fools, or those who mock beguile thee when they seek thine aid Love not the enemies of prayer.

verses.sa: इह त्वा गोपरीणसा महे मन्दन्तु राधसे । सरो गौरो यथा पिब॥
verses.tr: iha tvā goparīṇasā mahe mandantu rādhase saro gauro yathā piba
verses.en: Here let them with rich milky draught cheer thee to great munificence: Drink as the wild-bull drinks the lake.

verses.sa: या वृत्रहा परावति सना नवा च चुच्युवे । ता संसत्सु प्र वोचत॥
verses.tr: yā vṛtrahā parāvati sanā navā ca cucyuve tā saṃsatsu pra vocata
verses.en: Proclaim in our assemblies what deeds, new and ancient, far away, The Vrtra-slayer hath achieved.

verses.sa: अपिबत्कद्रुवः सुतमिन्द्रः सहस्रबाह्वे । अत्रादेदिष्ट पौंस्यम्॥
verses.tr: apibatkadruvaḥ sutamindraḥ sahasrabāhve atrādediṣṭa pauṃsyam
verses.en: In battle of a thousand arms Indra drank Kadru's Soma juice: There he displayed his manly might.

verses.sa: सत्यं तत्तुर्वशे यदौ विदानो अह्नवाय्यम् । व्यानट् तुर्वणे शमि॥
verses.tr: satyaṃ tatturvaśe yadau vidāno ahnavāyyam vyānaṭ turvaṇe śami
verses.en: True undeniable strength he found in Yadu and in Turvasa, And conquered through the sacrifice.

verses.sa: तरणिं वो जनानां त्रदं वाजस्य गोमतः । समानमु प्र शंसिषम्॥
verses.tr: taraṇiṃ vo janānāṃ tradaṃ vājasya gomataḥ samānamu pra śaṃsiṣam
verses.en: Him have I magnified, our Lord in, common, Guardian of your folk, Discloser of great wealth in kine;

verses.sa: ऋभुक्षणं न वर्तव उक्थेषु तुग्र्यावृधम् । इन्द्रं सोमे सचा सुते॥
verses.tr: ṛbhukṣaṇaṃ na vartava uktheṣu tugryāvṛdham indraṃ some sacā sute
verses.en: Rbhuksan, not to be restrained, who strengthened Tugra's son in lauds, Indra beside the flowing juice;

verses.sa: यः कृन्तदिद्वि योन्यं त्रिशोकाय गिरिं पृथुम् । गोभ्यो गातुं निरेतवे॥
verses.tr: yaḥ kṛntadidvi yonyaṃ triśokāya giriṃ pṛthum gobhyo gātuṃ niretave
verses.en: Who for Trisoka clave the hill that formed a wide receptacle, So that the cows might issue forth.

verses.sa: यद्दधिषे मनस्यसि मन्दानः प्रेदियक्षसि । मा तत्करिन्द्र मृळय॥
verses.tr: yaddadhiṣe manasyasi mandānaḥ prediyakṣasi mā tatkarindra mṛḻaya
verses.en: Whate'er thy plan or purpose be, whate'er, in transport, thou wouldst do, Do it not, Indra, but be kind.

verses.sa: दभ्रं चिद्धि त्वावतः कृतं शृण्वे अधि क्षमि । जिगात्विन्द्र ते मनः॥
verses.tr: dabhraṃ ciddhi tvāvataḥ kṛtaṃ śṛṇve adhi kṣami jigātvindra te manaḥ
verses.en: But little hath been heard of done upon the earth by one like thee i Let thine heart, Indra, turn to us.

verses.sa: तवेदु ताः सुकीर्तयोऽसन्नुत प्रशस्तयः । यदिन्द्र मृळयासि नः॥
verses.tr: tavedu tāḥ sukīrtayo'sannuta praśastayaḥ yadindra mṛḻayāsi naḥ
verses.en: Thine then shall be this high renown, thine shall these lofty praises be, When, Indra, thou art kind to us.

verses.sa: मा न एकस्मिन्नागसि मा द्वयोरुत त्रिषु । वधीर्मा शूर भूरिषु॥
verses.tr: mā na ekasminnāgasi mā dvayoruta triṣu vadhīrmā śūra bhūriṣu
verses.en: Not for one trespass, not for two, O Hero, slay us, nor for three, Nor yet for many trespasses.

verses.sa: बिभया हि त्वावत उग्रादभिप्रभङ्गिणः । दस्मादहमृतीषहः॥
verses.tr: bibhayā hi tvāvata ugrādabhiprabhaṅgiṇaḥ dasmādahamṛtīṣahaḥ
verses.en: I fear one powerful like thee, the crusher down of enemies, Mighty, repelling all attacks.

verses.sa: मा सख्युः शूनमा विदे मा पुत्रस्य प्रभूवसो । आवृत्वद्भूतु ते मनः॥
verses.tr: mā sakhyuḥ śūnamā vide mā putrasya prabhūvaso āvṛtvadbhūtu te manaḥ
verses.en: O wealthy God, ne'er may I live to see my friend or son in need*: Hitherward let thy heart be turned.

verses.sa: को नु मर्या अमिथितः सखा सखायमब्रवीत् । जहा को अस्मदीषते॥
verses.tr: ko nu maryā amithitaḥ sakhā sakhāyamabravīt jahā ko asmadīṣate
verses.en: What friend, O people, unprovoked, hath ever said unto a friend, He turns and leaves us in distress?

verses.sa: एवारे वृषभा सुतेऽसिन्वन्भूर्यावयः । श्वघ्नीव निवता चरन्॥
verses.tr: evāre vṛṣabhā sute'sinvanbhūryāvayaḥ śvaghnīva nivatā caran
verses.en: Hero, insatiate enjoy this Soma juice so near to thee, Even as a hunter rushing down.

verses.sa: आ त एता वचोयुजा हरी गृभ्णे सुमद्रथा । यदीं ब्रह्मभ्य इद्ददः॥
verses.tr: ā ta etā vacoyujā harī gṛbhṇe sumadrathā yadīṃ brahmabhya iddadaḥ
verses.en: Hither I draw those Bays of thine yoked by our hymn, with splendid car, That thou mayst give unto the priests.

verses.sa: भिन्धि विश्वा अप द्विषः परि बाधो जही मृधः । वसु स्पार्हं तदा भर॥
verses.tr: bhindhi viśvā apa dviṣaḥ pari bādho jahī mṛdhaḥ vasu spārhaṃ tadā bhara
verses.en: Drive all our enemies away, smite down the foes who press around, And bring the wealth for which we long:

verses.sa: यद्वीळाविन्द्र यत्स्थिरे यत्पर्शाने पराभृतम् । वसु स्पार्हं तदा भर॥
verses.tr: yadvīḻāvindra yatsthire yatparśāne parābhṛtam vasu spārhaṃ tadā bhara
verses.en: O Indra, that which is concealed in strong firm place precipitous: Bring us the wealth for which we long

verses.sa: यस्य ते विश्वमानुषो भूरेर्दत्तस्य वेदति । वसु स्पार्हं तदा भर॥
verses.tr: yasya te viśvamānuṣo bhūrerdattasya vedati vasu spārhaṃ tadā bhara
verses.en: Great riches which the world of men shall recognize as sent by thou: Bring us the wealth for which we long.

verses.sa: त्वावतः पुरूवसो वयमिन्द्र प्रणेतः । स्मसि स्थातर्हरीणाम्॥
verses.tr: tvāvataḥ purūvaso vayamindra praṇetaḥ smasi sthātarharīṇām
verses.en: We, Indra, Lord of ample wealth, our Guide, depend on one like thee, Thou driver of the Tawny Steeds.

verses.sa: त्वां हि सत्यमद्रिवो विद्म दातारमिषाम् । विद्म दातारं रयीणाम्॥
verses.tr: tvāṃ hi satyamadrivo vidma dātāramiṣām vidma dātāraṃ rayīṇām
verses.en: For, Hurler of the Bolt, we know thee true, the giver of our food, We know the giver of our wealth.

verses.sa: आ यस्य ते महिमानं शतमूते शतक्रतो । गीर्भिर्गृणन्ति कारवः॥
verses.tr: ā yasya te mahimānaṃ śatamūte śatakrato gīrbhirgṛṇanti kāravaḥ
verses.en: O thou whose majesty the bards celebrate with their songs, thou Lord, Of hundred powers and hundred aids.

verses.sa: सुनीथो घा स मर्त्यो यं मरुतो यमर्यमा । मित्रः पान्त्यद्रुहः॥
verses.tr: sunītho ghā sa martyo yaṃ maruto yamaryamā mitraḥ pāntyadruhaḥ
verses.en: Fair guidance hath the mortal man whom Aryaman, the Marut host, And Mitra, void of guile, protect.

verses.sa: दधानो गोमदश्ववत्सुवीर्यमादित्यजूत एधते । सदा राया पुरुस्पृहा॥
verses.tr: dadhāno gomadaśvavatsuvīryamādityajūta edhate sadā rāyā puruspṛhā
verses.en: Kine, steeds, and hero strength he gains, and prospers, by the Adityas sped, Ever in wealth which all desire.

verses.sa: तमिन्द्रं दानमीमहे शवसानमभीर्वम् । ईशानं राय ईमहे॥
verses.tr: tamindraṃ dānamīmahe śavasānamabhīrvam īśānaṃ rāya īmahe
verses.en: We pray to Indra for his gift, to him the Fearless and the Strong, We pray to him the Lord of wealth.

verses.sa: तस्मिन्हि सन्त्यूतयो विश्वा अभीरवः सचा । तमा वहन्तु सप्तयः पुरूवसुं मदाय हरयः सुतम्॥
verses.tr: tasminhi santyūtayo viśvā abhīravaḥ sacā tamā vahantu saptayaḥ purūvasuṃ madāya harayaḥ sutam
verses.en: For verily combined in him are all the fearless powers of aid. Him, rich in wealth, let swift Steeds bring to us, his Bays, to Soma juice for his carouse:

verses.sa: यस्ते मदो वरेण्यो य इन्द्र वृत्रहन्तमः । य आददिः स्व१र्नृभिर्यः पृतनासु दुष्टरः॥
verses.tr: yaste mado vareṇyo ya indra vṛtrahantamaḥ ya ādadiḥ sva1rnṛbhiryaḥ pṛtanāsu duṣṭaraḥ
verses.en: Yea, that most excellent carouse, Indra, which slays most enemies, With Heroes wins the light of heaven, and is invincible in war:

verses.sa: यो दुष्टरो विश्ववार श्रवाय्यो वाजेष्वस्ति तरुता । स नः शविष्ठ सवना वसो गहि गमेम गोमति व्रजे॥
verses.tr: yo duṣṭaro viśvavāra śravāyyo vājeṣvasti tarutā sa naḥ śaviṣṭha savanā vaso gahi gamema gomati vraje
verses.en: Which merits fame, all-bountiful! and, unsubdued, hath victory in deeds of might. So come to our libations, Strongest! Excellent! May we obtain a stall of kine.

verses.sa: गव्यो षु णो यथा पुराऽश्वयोत रथया । वरिवस्य महामह॥
verses.tr: gavyo ṣu ṇo yathā purā'śvayota rathayā varivasya mahāmaha
verses.en: Responding to our wish for cows, for steeds, and chariots, as of old, Be gracious, Greatest of the Great

verses.sa: नहि ते शूर राधसोऽन्तं विन्दामि सत्रा । दशस्या नो मघवन्नू चिदद्रिवो धियो वाजेभिराविथ॥
verses.tr: nahi te śūra rādhaso'ntaṃ vindāmi satrā daśasyā no maghavannū cidadrivo dhiyo vājebhirāvitha
verses.en: For, Hero, nowhere can I find the bounds of thy munificence. Still do thou favour us, O Bolt-armed Maghavan: with strength hast thou rewarded hymns.

verses.sa: य ऋष्वः श्रावयत्सखा विश्वेत्स वेद जनिमा पुरुष्टुतः । तं विश्वे मानुषा युगेन्द्रं हवन्ते तविषं यतस्रुचः॥
verses.tr: ya ṛṣvaḥ śrāvayatsakhā viśvetsa veda janimā puruṣṭutaḥ taṃ viśve mānuṣā yugendraṃ havante taviṣaṃ yatasrucaḥ
verses.en: High, glorifier of his friend, he knows all generations, he whom many praise. All races of mankind with ladies lifted up invoke that Mighty Indra's aid.

verses.sa: स नो वाजेष्वविता पुरूवसुः पुरस्थाता मघवा वृत्रहा भुवत्॥
verses.tr: sa no vājeṣvavitā purūvasuḥ purasthātā maghavā vṛtrahā bhuvat
verses.en: Be he our Champion and Protector in great deeds, rich in all wealth, the Vrtra-slayer, Maghavan.

verses.sa: अभि वो वीरमन्धसो मदेषु गाय गिरा महा विचेतसम् । इन्द्रं नाम श्रुत्यं शाकिनं वचो यथा॥
verses.tr: abhi vo vīramandhaso madeṣu gāya girā mahā vicetasam indraṃ nāma śrutyaṃ śākinaṃ vaco yathā
verses.en: In the wild raptures of the juice sing to your Hero with high laud, to him the Wise, To Indra, glorious in his name, the Mighty One, even as the hymn alloweth it.

verses.sa: ददी रेक्णस्तन्वे ददिर्वसु ददिर्वाजेषु पुरुहूत वाजिनम् । नूनमथ॥
verses.tr: dadī rekṇastanve dadirvasu dadirvājeṣu puruhūta vājinam nūnamatha
verses.en: Thou givest wealth to me myself, thou givest treasure, Excellent! and the strong steed, O Much-invoked, in deeds of might, yea, even now.

verses.sa: विश्वेषामिरज्यन्तं वसूनां सासह्वांसं चिदस्य वर्पसः । कृपयतो नूनमत्यथ॥
verses.tr: viśveṣāmirajyantaṃ vasūnāṃ sāsahvāṃsaṃ cidasya varpasaḥ kṛpayato nūnamatyatha
verses.en: Him, Sovran Ruler of all precious things, who even hath power o'er this fair form of his, As now it taketh shape, and afterward,

verses.sa:
महः सु वो अरमिषे स्तवामहे मीळ्हुषे अरंगमाय जग्मये ।
यज्ञेभिर्गीर्भिर्विश्वमनुषां मरुतामियक्षसि गाये त्वा नमसा गिरा॥
verses.tr: mahaḥ su vo aramiṣe stavāmahe mīḻhuṣe araṃgamāya jagmaye yajñebhirgīrbhirviśvamanuṣāṃ marutāmiyakṣasi gāye tvā namasā girā
verses.en: We praise, so that the Mighty One may speed to you, Pourer of bounties, Traveller, prepared to go. Thou favourest the Maruts known to all, by song and sacrifice. With song and praise I sing to thee.

verses.sa: ये पातयन्ते अज्मभिर्गिरीणां स्नुभिरेषाम् । यज्ञं महिष्वणीनां सुम्नं तुविष्वणीनां प्राध्वरे॥
verses.tr: ye pātayante ajmabhirgirīṇāṃ snubhireṣām yajñaṃ mahiṣvaṇīnāṃ sumnaṃ tuviṣvaṇīnāṃ prādhvare
verses.en: We in the sacrifice perform their will whose voice is lifted high, The worship of those Thundering Ones who o'er the ridges of these mountains fly in troops.

verses.sa: प्रभङ्गं दुर्मतीनामिन्द्र शविष्ठा भर । रयिमस्मभ्यं युज्यं चोदयन्मते ज्येष्ठं चोदयन्मते॥
verses.tr: prabhaṅgaṃ durmatīnāmindra śaviṣṭhā bhara rayimasmabhyaṃ yujyaṃ codayanmate jyeṣṭhaṃ codayanmate
verses.en: O Indra, Mightiest, bring us that which crushes men of evil minds, Wealth suited to our needs, O Stirrer of the thought, best wealth, O thou who stirrest thought.

verses.sa: सनितः सुसनितरुग्र चित्र चेतिष्ठ सूनृत । प्रासहा सम्राट् सहुरिं सहन्तं भुज्युं वाजेषु पूर्व्यम्॥
verses.tr: sanitaḥ susanitarugra citra cetiṣṭha sūnṛta prāsahā samrāṭ sahuriṃ sahantaṃ bhujyuṃ vājeṣu pūrvyam
verses.en: O Winner, noble winner, strong, wondrous, most splendid, excellent, Sole Lord of victory, bring all-overpowering wealth, joy-giving, chief in deeds of might.

verses.sa: आ स एतु य ईवदाँ अदेवः पूर्तमाददे । यथा चिद्वशो अश्व्यः पृथुश्रवसि कानीते३ऽस्या व्युष्याददे॥
verses.tr: ā sa etu ya īvadāṃ adevaḥ pūrtamādade yathā cidvaśo aśvyaḥ pṛthuśravasi kānīte3'syā vyuṣyādade
verses.en: Now let the godless man approach who hath received reward so great As Vasa, Asvya, when this light of morning dawned, received from Prthusravas, from Kanita's son.

verses.sa:
षष्टिं सहस्राश्व्यस्यायुतासनमुष्ट्रानां विंशतिं शता ।
दश श्यावीनां शता दश त्र्यरुषीणां दश गवां सहस्रा॥
verses.tr: ṣaṣṭiṃ sahasrāśvyasyāyutāsanamuṣṭrānāṃ viṃśatiṃ śatā daśa śyāvīnāṃ śatā daśa tryaruṣīṇāṃ daśa gavāṃ sahasrā
verses.en: Steeds sixty thousand and ten thousand kine, and twenty hundred camels I obtained; Ten hundred brown in hue, and other ten red in three spots: in all, ten thousand kine.

verses.sa: दश श्यावा ऋधद्रयो वीतवारास आशवः । मथ्रा नेमिं नि वावृतुः॥
verses.tr: daśa śyāvā ṛdhadrayo vītavārāsa āśavaḥ mathrā nemiṃ ni vāvṛtuḥ
verses.en: Ten browns that make my wealth increase, fleet steeds whose tails are long and fair, Turn with swift whirl my chariot wheel;

verses.sa: दानासः पृथुश्रवसः कानीतस्य सुराधसः । रथं हिरण्ययं ददन्मंहिष्ठः सूरिरभूद्वर्षिष्ठमकृत श्रवः॥
verses.tr: dānāsaḥ pṛthuśravasaḥ kānītasya surādhasaḥ rathaṃ hiraṇyayaṃ dadanmaṃhiṣṭhaḥ sūrirabhūdvarṣiṣṭhamakṛta śravaḥ
verses.en: The gifts which Prthusravas gave, Kanita's son munificent. He gave a chariot wrought of gold: the prince was passing bountiful, and won himself most lofty fame.

verses.sa: आ नो वायो महे तने याहि मखाय पाजसे । वयं हि ते चकृमा भूरि दावने सद्यश्चिन्महि दावने॥
verses.tr: ā no vāyo mahe tane yāhi makhāya pājase vayaṃ hi te cakṛmā bhūri dāvane sadyaścinmahi dāvane
verses.en: Come thou to this great rite of ours, Vayu! to give us vigorous light. We have served thee that thou mightest give much to us, yea, mightest quickly give great wealth.

verses.sa:
यो अश्वेभिर्वहते वस्त उस्रास्त्रिः सप्त सप्ततीनाम् ।
एभिः सोमेभिः सोमसुद्भिः सोमपा दानाय शुक्रपूतपाः॥
verses.tr: yo aśvebhirvahate vasta usrāstriḥ sapta saptatīnām ebhiḥ somebhiḥ somasudbhiḥ somapā dānāya śukrapūtapāḥ
verses.en: Who with thrice seven times seventy horses comes to us, invested with the rays of morn, Through these our Soma-draughts and those who press, to give, drinker of pure bright Soma Juice.

verses.sa: यो म इमं चिदु त्मनामन्दच्चित्रं दावने । अरट्वे अक्षे नहुषे सुकृत्वनि सुकृत्तराय सुक्रतुः॥
verses.tr: yo ma imaṃ cidu tmanāmandaccitraṃ dāvane araṭve akṣe nahuṣe sukṛtvani sukṛttarāya sukratuḥ
verses.en: Who hath inclined this glorious one, bounteous himself, to give me gifts. Borne on firm chariot with the prosperous Nahup, wise, to a man yet more devout.

verses.sa: उचथ्ये३ वपुषि यः स्वराळुत वायो घृतस्नाः । अश्वेषितं रजेषितं शुनेषितं प्राज्म तदिदं नु तत्॥
verses.tr: ucathye3 vapuṣi yaḥ svarāḻuta vāyo ghṛtasnāḥ aśveṣitaṃ rajeṣitaṃ śuneṣitaṃ prājma tadidaṃ nu tat
verses.en: Sole Lord in beauty meet for praise, O Vayu, dropping fatness down, Hurried along by steeds, by camels, and by hounds, spreads forth thy train: even this it is.

verses.sa: अध प्रियमिषिराय षष्टिं सहस्रासनम् । अश्वानामिन्न वृष्णाम्॥
verses.tr: adha priyamiṣirāya ṣaṣṭiṃ sahasrāsanam aśvānāminna vṛṣṇām
verses.en: So, as a prize dear to the strong, the sixty thousand have I gained, Bulls that resemble vigorous steeds.

verses.sa: गावो न यूथमुप यन्ति वध्रय उप मा यन्ति वध्रयः॥
verses.tr: gāvo na yūthamupa yanti vadhraya upa mā yanti vadhrayaḥ
verses.en: To me come oxen like a herd, yea, unto me the oxen come.

verses.sa: अध यच्चारथे गणे शतमुष्ट्राँ अचिक्रदत् । अध श्वित्नेषु विंशतिं शता॥
verses.tr: adha yaccārathe gaṇe śatamuṣṭrāṃ acikradat adha śvitneṣu viṃśatiṃ śatā
verses.en: And in the grazing herd he made a hundred camels bleat for me, And twenty hundred mid the white.

verses.sa: शतं दासे बल्बूथे विप्रस्तरुक्ष आ ददे । ते ते वायविमे जना मदन्तीन्द्रगोपा मदन्ति देवगोपाः॥
verses.tr: śataṃ dāse balbūthe viprastarukṣa ā dade te te vāyavime janā madantīndragopā madanti devagopāḥ
verses.en: A hundred has the sage received, Dasa Balbutha's and Taruksa's gifts. These are thy people, Vayu, who rejoice with Indra for their guard, rejoice with Gods for guards.

verses.sa: अध स्या योषणा मही प्रतीची वशमश्व्यम् । अधिरुक्मा वि नीयते॥
verses.tr: adha syā yoṣaṇā mahī pratīcī vaśamaśvyam adhirukmā vi nīyate
verses.en: And now to Vasa Asvya here this stately woman is led forth, Adorned with ornaments of gold.

verses.sa:
महि वो महतामवो वरुण मित्र दाशुषे ।
यमादित्या अभि द्रुहो रक्षथा नेमघं नशदनेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः॥
verses.tr: mahi vo mahatāmavo varuṇa mitra dāśuṣe yamādityā abhi druho rakṣathā nemaghaṃ naśadanehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ
verses.en: Great help ye give the worshipper, Varuna, Mitra, Mighty Ones! No sorrow ever reaches him whom ye, Adityas, keep from harm. Yours are incomparable aids, and good the succour they afford.

verses.sa:
विदा देवा अघानामादित्यासो अपाकृतिम् ।
पक्षा वयो यथोपरि व्य१स्मे शर्म यच्छतानेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः॥
verses.tr: vidā devā aghānāmādityāso apākṛtim pakṣā vayo yathopari vya1sme śarma yacchatānehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ
verses.en: O Gods, Adityas, well ye know the way to keep all woes afar. As the birds spread their sheltering wings, spread your protection over us.

verses.sa:
व्य१स्मे अधि शर्म तत्पक्षा वयो न यन्तन ।
विश्वानि विश्ववेदसो वरूथ्या मनामहेऽनेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः॥
verses.tr: vya1sme adhi śarma tatpakṣā vayo na yantana viśvāni viśvavedaso varūthyā manāmahe'nehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ
verses.en: As the birds spread their sheltering wings let your protection cover us. We mean all shelter and defense, ye who have all things for your own.

verses.sa:
यस्मा अरासत क्षयं जीवातुं च प्रचेतसः ।
मनोर्विश्वस्य घेदिम आदित्या राय ईशतेऽनेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः॥
verses.tr: yasmā arāsata kṣayaṃ jīvātuṃ ca pracetasaḥ manorviśvasya ghedima ādityā rāya īśate'nehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ
verses.en: To whomsoever they, Most Wise, have given a home and means of life, O'er the whole riches of this man they, the Adityas, have control.

verses.sa:
परि णो वृणजन्नघा दुर्गाणि रथ्यो यथा ।
स्यामेदिन्द्रस्य शर्मण्यादित्यानामुतावस्यनेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः॥
verses.tr: pari ṇo vṛṇajannaghā durgāṇi rathyo yathā syāmedindrasya śarmaṇyādityānāmutāvasyanehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ
verses.en: As drivers of the car avoid ill roads, let sorrows pass us by. May we be under Indra's guard, in the Adityas' favouring grace.

verses.sa:
परिह्वृतेदना जनो युष्मादत्तस्य वायति ।
देवा अदभ्रमाश वो यमादित्या अहेतनानेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः॥
verses.tr: parihvṛtedanā jano yuṣmādattasya vāyati devā adabhramāśa vo yamādityā ahetanānehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ
verses.en: For verily men sink and faint through loss of wealth which ye have given. Much hath he gained from you, O Gods, whom ye, Adityas, have approached.

verses.sa:
न तं तिग्मं चन त्यजो न द्रासदभि तं गुरु ।
यस्मा उ शर्म सप्रथ आदित्यासो अराध्वमनेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः॥
verses.tr: na taṃ tigmaṃ cana tyajo na drāsadabhi taṃ guru yasmā u śarma sapratha ādityāso arādhvamanehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ
verses.en: On him shall no fierce anger fall, no sore distress shall visit him, To whom, Adityas, ye have lent your shelter that extendeth far.

verses.sa:
युष्मे देवा अपि ष्मसि युध्यन्त इव वर्मसु ।
यूयं महो न एनसो यूयमर्भादुरुष्यतानेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः॥
verses.tr: yuṣme devā api ṣmasi yudhyanta iva varmasu yūyaṃ maho na enaso yūyamarbhāduruṣyatānehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ
verses.en: Resting in you, O Gods, we are like men who fight in coats of mail. Ye guard us from each great offence, ye guard us from each lighter fault.

verses.sa:
अदितिर्न उरुष्यत्वदितिः शर्म यच्छतु ।
माता मित्रस्य रेवतोऽर्यम्णो वरुणस्य चानेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः॥
verses.tr: aditirna uruṣyatvaditiḥ śarma yacchatu mātā mitrasya revato'ryamṇo varuṇasya cānehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ
verses.en: May Aditi defend us, may Aditi guard and shelter us, Mother of wealthy Mitra and of Aryaman and Varuna.

verses.sa:
यद्देवाः शर्म शरणं यद्भद्रं यदनातुरम् ।
त्रिधातु यद्वरूथ्यं१ तदस्मासु वि यन्तनानेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः॥
verses.tr: yaddevāḥ śarma śaraṇaṃ yadbhadraṃ yadanāturam tridhātu yadvarūthyaṃ1 tadasmāsu vi yantanānehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ
verses.en: The shelter, Gods, that is secure, auspicious, free from malady, A sure protection, triply strong, even that do ye extend to us.

verses.sa:
आदित्या अव हि ख्यताधि कूलादिव स्पशः ।
सुतीर्थमर्वतो यथानु नो नेषथा सुगमनेहसो व ऊतयः सुतयो व ऊतयः॥
verses.tr: ādityā ava hi khyatādhi kūlādiva spaśaḥ sutīrthamarvato yathānu no neṣathā sugamanehaso va ūtayaḥ sutayo va ūtayaḥ
verses.en: Look down on us, Adityas, as a guide exploring from the bank. Lead us to pleasant ways as men lead horses to an easy ford.

verses.sa:
नेह भद्रं रक्षस्विने नावयै नोपया उत ।
गवे च भद्रं धेनवे वीराय च श्रवस्यतेऽनेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः॥
verses.tr: neha bhadraṃ rakṣasvine nāvayai nopayā uta gave ca bhadraṃ dhenave vīrāya ca śravasyate'nehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ
verses.en: Ill be it for the demons' friend to find us or come near to us. But for the milch-cow be it well, and for the man who strives for fame.

verses.sa:
यदाविर्यदपीच्यं१ देवासो अस्ति दुष्कृतम् ।
त्रिते तद्विश्वमाप्त्य आरे अस्मद्दधातनानेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः॥
verses.tr: yadāviryadapīcyaṃ1 devāso asti duṣkṛtam trite tadviśvamāptya āre asmaddadhātanānehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ
verses.en: Each evil deed made manifest, and that which is concealed, O Gods, The whole thereof remove from us to Trita Aptya far away.

verses.sa:
यच्च गोषु दुष्ष्वप्न्यं यच्चास्मे दुहितर्दिवः ।
त्रिताय तद्विभावर्याप्त्याय परा वहानेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः॥
verses.tr: yacca goṣu duṣṣvapnyaṃ yaccāsme duhitardivaḥ tritāya tadvibhāvaryāptyāya parā vahānehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ
verses.en: Daughter of Heaven, the dream that bodes evil to us or to our kine, Remove, O Lady of the Light, to Trita Aptya far away.

verses.sa:
निष्कं वा घा कृणवते स्रजं वा दुहितर्दिवः ।
त्रिते दुष्ष्वप्न्यं सर्वमाप्त्ये परि दद्मस्यनेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः॥
verses.tr: niṣkaṃ vā ghā kṛṇavate srajaṃ vā duhitardivaḥ trite duṣṣvapnyaṃ sarvamāptye pari dadmasyanehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ
verses.en: Even if, O Child of Heaven, it make a garland or a chain of gold, The whole bad dream, whate'er it be, to Trita Aptya we consign.

verses.sa:
तदन्नाय तदपसे तं भागमुपसेदुषे ।
त्रिताय च द्विताय चोषो दुष्ष्वप्न्यं वहानेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः॥
verses.tr: tadannāya tadapase taṃ bhāgamupaseduṣe tritāya ca dvitāya coṣo duṣṣvapnyaṃ vahānehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ
verses.en: To him whose food and work is this, who comes to take his share therein, To Trita, and to Dvita, Dawn! bear thou the evil dream away.

verses.sa:
यथा कलां यथा शफं यथ ऋणं संनयामसि ।
एवा दुष्ष्वप्न्यं सर्वमाप्त्ये सं नयामस्यनेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः॥
