verses.tr: yathā kalāṃ yathā śaphaṃ yatha ṛṇaṃ saṃnayāmasi evā duṣṣvapnyaṃ sarvamāptye saṃ nayāmasyanehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ
verses.en: As we collect the utmost debt, even the eighth and sixteenth part, So unto Aptya we transfer together all the evil dream.

verses.sa:
अजैष्माद्यासनाम चाभूमानागसो वयम् ।
उषो यस्माद्दुष्ष्वप्न्यादभैष्माप तदुच्छत्वनेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः॥
verses.tr: ajaiṣmādyāsanāma cābhūmānāgaso vayam uṣo yasmādduṣṣvapnyādabhaiṣmāpa taducchatvanehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ
verses.en: Now have we conquered and obtained, and from our trespasses are free. Shine thou away the evil dream, O Dawn, whereof we are afraid. Yours are incomparable aids, and good the succour they afford.

verses.sa:
स्वादोरभक्षि वयसः सुमेधाः स्वाध्यो वरिवोवित्तरस्य ।
विश्वे यं देवा उत मर्त्यासो मधु ब्रुवन्तो अभि संचरन्ति॥
verses.tr: svādorabhakṣi vayasaḥ sumedhāḥ svādhyo varivovittarasya viśve yaṃ devā uta martyāso madhu bruvanto abhi saṃcaranti
verses.en: Wisely have I enjoyed the savoury viand, religious-thoughted, best to find out treasure, The food to which all Deities and mortals, calling it meath, gather themselves together.

verses.sa:
अन्तश्च प्रागा अदितिर्भवास्यवयाता हरसो दैव्यस्य ।
इन्दविन्द्रस्य सख्यं जुषाणः श्रौष्टीव धुरमनु राय ऋध्याः॥
verses.tr: antaśca prāgā aditirbhavāsyavayātā haraso daivyasya indavindrasya sakhyaṃ juṣāṇaḥ śrauṣṭīva dhuramanu rāya ṛdhyāḥ
verses.en: Thou shalt be Aditi as thou hast entered within, appeaser of celestial anger. Indu, enjoying Indra's friendship, bring us - as a swift steed the car - forward to riches.

verses.sa:
अपाम सोमममृता अभूमागन्म ज्योतिरविदाम देवान् ।
किं नूनमस्मान्कृणवदरातिः किमु धूर्तिरमृत मर्त्यस्य॥
verses.tr: apāma somamamṛtā abhūmāganma jyotiravidāma devān kiṃ nūnamasmānkṛṇavadarātiḥ kimu dhūrtiramṛta martyasya
verses.en: We have drunk Soma and become immortal; we have attained the light, the Gods discovered. Now what may foeman's malice do to harm us? What, O Immortal, mortal man's deception?

verses.sa:
शं नो भव हृद आ पीत इन्दो पितेव सोम सूनवे सुशेवः ।
सखेव सख्य उरुशंस धीरः प्र ण आयुर्जीवसे सोम तारीः॥
verses.tr: śaṃ no bhava hṛda ā pīta indo piteva soma sūnave suśevaḥ sakheva sakhya uruśaṃsa dhīraḥ pra ṇa āyurjīvase soma tārīḥ
verses.en: Absorbed into the heart, be sweet, O Indu, as a kind father to his son, O Soma, As a wise Friend to friend: do thou, wide-ruler, O Soma, lengthen out our days for living.

verses.sa:
इमे मा पीता यशस उरुष्यवो रथं न गावः समनाह पर्वसु ।
ते मा रक्षन्तु विस्रसश्चरित्रादुत मा स्रामाद्यवयन्त्विन्दवः॥
verses.tr: ime mā pītā yaśasa uruṣyavo rathaṃ na gāvaḥ samanāha parvasu te mā rakṣantu visrasaścaritrāduta mā srāmādyavayantvindavaḥ
verses.en: These glorious drops that give me freedom have I drunk. Closely they knit my joints as straps secure a car. Let them protect my foot from slipping on the way: yea, let the drops I drink preserve me from disease.

verses.sa:
अग्निं न मा मथितं सं दिदीपः प्र चक्षय कृणुहि वस्यसो नः ।
अथा हि ते मद आ सोम मन्ये रेवाँ इव प्र चरा पुष्टिमच्छ॥
verses.tr: agniṃ na mā mathitaṃ saṃ didīpaḥ pra cakṣaya kṛṇuhi vasyaso naḥ athā hi te mada ā soma manye revāṃ iva pra carā puṣṭimaccha
verses.en: Make me shine bright like fire produced by friction: give us a clearer sight and make us better. For in carouse I think of thee, O Soma, Shall I, as a rich man, attain to comfort?

verses.sa:
इषिरेण ते मनसा सुतस्य भक्षीमहि पित्र्यस्येव रायः ।
सोम राजन्प्र ण आयूंषि तारीरहानीव सूर्यो वासराणि॥
verses.tr: iṣireṇa te manasā sutasya bhakṣīmahi pitryasyeva rāyaḥ soma rājanpra ṇa āyūṃṣi tārīrahānīva sūryo vāsarāṇi
verses.en: May we enjoy with an enlivened spirit the juice thou givest, like ancestral riches. O Soma, King, prolong thou our existence as Surya makes the shining days grow longer.

verses.sa:
सोम राजन्मृळया नः स्वस्ति तव स्मसि व्रत्या३स्तस्य विद्धि ।
अलर्ति दक्ष उत मन्युरिन्दो मा नो अर्यो अनुकामं परा दाः॥
verses.tr: soma rājanmṛḻayā naḥ svasti tava smasi vratyā3stasya viddhi alarti dakṣa uta manyurindo mā no aryo anukāmaṃ parā dāḥ
verses.en: King Soma, favour us and make us prosper: we are thy devotees; of this be mindful. Spirit and power are fresh in us, O Indu give us not up unto our foeman's pleasure.

verses.sa:
त्वं हि नस्तन्वः सोम गोपा गात्रेगात्रे निषसत्था नृचक्षाः ।
यत्ते वयं प्रमिनाम व्रतानि स नो मृळ सुषखा देव वस्यः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ hi nastanvaḥ soma gopā gātregātre niṣasatthā nṛcakṣāḥ yatte vayaṃ pramināma vratāni sa no mṛḻa suṣakhā deva vasyaḥ
verses.en: For thou hast settled in each joint, O Soma, aim of men's eyes and guardian of our bodies. When we offend against thine holy statutes, as a kind Friend, God, best of all, be gracious.

verses.sa:
ऋदूदरेण सख्या सचेय यो मा न रिष्येद्धर्यश्व पीतः ।
अयं यः सोमो न्यधाय्यस्मे तस्मा इन्द्रं प्रतिरमेम्यायुः॥
verses.tr: ṛdūdareṇa sakhyā saceya yo mā na riṣyeddharyaśva pītaḥ ayaṃ yaḥ somo nyadhāyyasme tasmā indraṃ pratiramemyāyuḥ
verses.en: May I be with the Friend whose heart is tender, who, Lord of Bays! when quaffed will never harm me- This Soma now deposited within me. For this, I pray for longer life to Indra.

verses.sa:
अप त्या अस्थुरनिरा अमीवा निरत्रसन्तमिषीचीरभैषुः ।
आ सोमो अस्माँ अरुहद्विहाया अगन्म यत्र प्रतिरन्त आयुः॥
verses.tr: apa tyā asthuranirā amīvā niratrasantamiṣīcīrabhaiṣuḥ ā somo asmāṃ aruhadvihāyā aganma yatra pratiranta āyuḥ
verses.en: Our maladies have lost their strength and vanished: they feared, and passed away into the darkness. Soma hath risen in us, exceeding mighty, and we are come where men prolong existence.

verses.sa:
यो न इन्दुः पितरो हृत्सु पीतोऽमर्त्यो मर्त्याँ आविवेश ।
तस्मै सोमाय हविषा विधेम मृळीके अस्य सुमतौ स्याम॥
verses.tr: yo na induḥ pitaro hṛtsu pīto'martyo martyāṃ āviveśa tasmai somāya haviṣā vidhema mṛḻīke asya sumatau syāma
verses.en: Fathers, that Indu which our hearts have drunken, Immortal in himself, hath entered mortals. So let us serve this Soma with oblation, and rest securely in his grace and favour.

verses.sa:
त्वं सोम पितृभिः संविदानोऽनु द्यावापृथिवी आ ततन्थ ।
तस्मै त इन्दो हविषा विधेम वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ soma pitṛbhiḥ saṃvidāno'nu dyāvāpṛthivī ā tatantha tasmai ta indo haviṣā vidhema vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām
verses.en: Associate with the Fathers thou, O Soma, hast spread thyself abroad through earth and heaven. So with oblation let us serve thee, Indu, and so let us become the lords of riches,

verses.sa:
त्रातारो देवा अधि वोचता नो मा नो निद्रा ईशत मोत
जल्पिः । वयं सोमस्य विश्वह प्रियासः सुवीरासो विदथमा वदेम॥
verses.tr: trātāro devā adhi vocatā no mā no nidrā īśata mota jalpiḥ vayaṃ somasya viśvaha priyāsaḥ suvīrāso vidathamā vadema
verses.en: Give us your blessing, O ye Gods' preservers. Never may sleep or idle talk control us. But evermore may we, as friends of Soma, speak to the synod with brave sons around us.

verses.sa:
त्वं नः सोम विश्वतो वयोधास्त्वं स्वर्विदा विशा नृचक्षाः ।
त्वं न इन्द ऊतिभिः सजोषाः पाहि पश्चातादुत वा पुरस्तात्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ naḥ soma viśvato vayodhāstvaṃ svarvidā viśā nṛcakṣāḥ tvaṃ na inda ūtibhiḥ sajoṣāḥ pāhi paścātāduta vā purastāt
verses.en: On all sides,. Soma, thou art our life-giver: aim of all eyes, light-finder, come within us. Indu, of one accord with thy protections both from behind and from before preserve us.

verses.sa: अभि प्र वः सुराधसमिन्द्रमर्च यथा विदे । यो जरितृभ्यो मघवा पुरूवसुः सहस्रेणेव शिक्षति॥
verses.tr: abhi pra vaḥ surādhasamindramarca yathā vide yo jaritṛbhyo maghavā purūvasuḥ sahasreṇeva śikṣati
verses.en: To you will I sing Indra's praise who gives good gifts as well we know; The praise of Maghavan who, rich in treasure, aids his singers with wealth thousand fold.

verses.sa:
शतानीकेव प्र जिगाति धृष्णुया हन्ति वृत्राणि दाशुषे ।
गिरेरिव प्र रसा अस्य पिन्विरे दत्राणि पुरुभोजसः॥
verses.tr: śatānīkeva pra jigāti dhṛṣṇuyā hanti vṛtrāṇi dāśuṣe gireriva pra rasā asya pinvire datrāṇi purubhojasaḥ
verses.en: As with a hundred hosts, he rushes boldly on, and for the offerer slays his foes. As from a mountain flow the water-brooks, thus flow his gifts who feedeth many a one.

verses.sa: आ त्वा सुतास इन्दवो मदा य इन्द्र गिर्वणः । आपो न वज्रिन्नन्वोक्यं१ सरः पृणन्ति शूर राधसे॥
verses.tr: ā tvā sutāsa indavo madā ya indra girvaṇaḥ āpo na vajrinnanvokyaṃ1 saraḥ pṛṇanti śūra rādhase
verses.en: The drops effused, the gladdening draughts, O Indra, Lover of the Son As waters seek the lake where they are wont to rest, fill thee, for bounty, Thunderer.

verses.sa: अनेहसं प्रतरणं विवक्षणं मध्वः स्वादिष्ठमीं पिब । आ यथा मन्दसानः किरासि नः प्र क्षुद्रेव त्मना धृषत्॥
verses.tr: anehasaṃ prataraṇaṃ vivakṣaṇaṃ madhvaḥ svādiṣṭhamīṃ piba ā yathā mandasānaḥ kirāsi naḥ pra kṣudreva tmanā dhṛṣat
verses.en: The matchless draught that strengthens and gives eloquence, the sweetest of the meath drink thou, That in thy joy thou may scatter thy gifts o'er us, plenteously, even as the dust.

verses.sa: आ नः स्तोममुप द्रवद्धियानो अश्वो न सोतृभिः । यं ते स्वधावन्त्स्वदयन्ति धेनव इन्द्र कण्वेषु रातयः॥
verses.tr: ā naḥ stomamupa dravaddhiyāno aśvo na sotṛbhiḥ yaṃ te svadhāvantsvadayanti dhenava indra kaṇveṣu rātayaḥ
verses.en: Come quickly to our laud, urged on by Soma-pressers like a horse- Laud, Godlike Indra, which milch-kine make sweet for thee: with Kanva's sons are gifts for thee.

verses.sa: उग्रं न वीरं नमसोप सेदिम विभूतिमक्षितावसुम् । उद्रीव वज्रिन्नवतो न सिञ्चते क्षरन्तीन्द्र धीतयः॥
verses.tr: ugraṃ na vīraṃ namasopa sedima vibhūtimakṣitāvasum udrīva vajrinnavato na siñcate kṣarantīndra dhītayaḥ
verses.en: With homage have we sought thee as a Hero, strong, preeminent, with unfailing wealth. O Thunderer, as a plenteous spring pours forth its stream, so, Indra, flow our songs to thee.

verses.sa: यद्ध नूनं यद्वा यज्ञे यद्वा पृथिव्यामधि । अतो नो यज्ञमाशुभिर्महेमत उग्र उग्रेभिरा गहि॥
verses.tr: yaddha nūnaṃ yadvā yajñe yadvā pṛthivyāmadhi ato no yajñamāśubhirmahemata ugra ugrebhirā gahi
verses.en: If now thou art at sacrifice, or if thou art upon the earth, Come thence, high-thoughted! to our sacrifice with the Swift, come, Mighty with the Mighty Ones.

verses.sa: अजिरासो हरयो ये त आशवो वाता इव प्रसक्षिणः । येभिरपत्यं मनुषः परीयसे येभिर्विश्वं स्वर्दृशे॥
verses.tr: ajirāso harayo ye ta āśavo vātā iva prasakṣiṇaḥ yebhirapatyaṃ manuṣaḥ parīyase yebhirviśvaṃ svardṛśe
verses.en: The active, fleet-foot, tawny Coursers that are thine are swift to victory, like the Wind, Wherewith thou goest round to visit Manus' seed, wherewith all heaven is visible.

verses.sa: एतावतस्त ईमह इन्द्र सुम्नस्य गोमतः । यथा प्रावो मघवन्मेध्यातिथिं यथा नीपातिथिं धने॥
verses.tr: etāvatasta īmaha indra sumnasya gomataḥ yathā prāvo maghavanmedhyātithiṃ yathā nīpātithiṃ dhane
verses.en: Indra, from thee so great we crave prosperity in wealth of kine, As, Maghavan, thou favouredst Medhyatithi, and, in the fight, Nipatithi.

verses.sa: यथा कण्वे मघवन्त्रसदस्यवि यथा पक्थे दशव्रजे । यथा गोशर्ये असनोॠजिश्वनीन्द्र गोमद्धिरण्यवत्॥
verses.tr: yathā kaṇve maghavantrasadasyavi yathā pakthe daśavraje yathā gośarye asanoṝjiśvanīndra gomaddhiraṇyavat
verses.en: As, Maghavan, to Kanva, Trasadasyu, and to Paktha and Dasavraja; As, Indra, to Gosarya and Rjisvan, thou vouchsafedst wealth in kine and gold.

verses.sa: प्र सु श्रुतं सुराधसमर्चा शक्रमभिष्टये । यः सुन्वते स्तुवते काम्यं वसु सहस्रेणेव मंहते॥
verses.tr: pra su śrutaṃ surādhasamarcā śakramabhiṣṭaye yaḥ sunvate stuvate kāmyaṃ vasu sahasreṇeva maṃhate
verses.en: Sakra I praise, to win his aid, far-famed, exceeding bountiful, Who gives, as 'twere in thousands, precious wealth to him who sheds the juice and worships him.

verses.sa:
शतानीका हेतयो अस्य दुष्टरा इन्द्रस्य समिषो महीः ।
गिरिर्न भुज्मा मघवत्सु पिन्वते यदीं सुता अमन्दिषुः॥
verses.tr: śatānīkā hetayo asya duṣṭarā indrasya samiṣo mahīḥ girirna bhujmā maghavatsu pinvate yadīṃ sutā amandiṣuḥ
verses.en: Arrows with hundred points, unconquerable, are this Indra's mighty arms in war. He streams on liberal worshippers like a hill with springs, when juices poured have gladdened him.

verses.sa: यदीं सुतास इन्दवोऽभि प्रियममन्दिषुः । आपो न धायि सवनं म आ वसो दुघा इवोप दाशुषे॥
verses.tr: yadīṃ sutāsa indavo'bhi priyamamandiṣuḥ āpo na dhāyi savanaṃ ma ā vaso dughā ivopa dāśuṣe
verses.en: What time the flowing Soma-drops have gladdened with their taste the Friend, Like water, gracious Lord! were my libations made, like milch-kine to the worshipper.

verses.sa: अनेहसं वो हवमानमूतये मध्वः क्षरन्ति धीतयः । आ त्वा वसो हवमानास इन्दव उप स्तोत्रेषु दधिरे॥
verses.tr: anehasaṃ vo havamānamūtaye madhvaḥ kṣaranti dhītayaḥ ā tvā vaso havamānāsa indava upa stotreṣu dadhire
verses.en: To him the peerless, who is calling you to give you aid, forth flow the drops of pleasant meath. The Soma-drops which call on thee, O gracious Lord, have brought thee to our hymn of praise.

verses.sa: आ नः सोमे स्वध्वर इयानो अत्यो न तोशते । यं ते स्वदावन्त्स्वदन्ति गूर्तयः पौरे छन्दयसे हवम्॥
verses.tr: ā naḥ some svadhvara iyāno atyo na tośate yaṃ te svadāvantsvadanti gūrtayaḥ paure chandayase havam
verses.en: He rushes hurrying like a steed to Soma that adorns our rite, Which hymns make sweet to thee, lover of pleasant food. The call to Paura thou dost love.

verses.sa: प्र वीरमुग्रं विविचिं धनस्पृतं विभूतिं राधसो महः । उद्रीव वज्रिन्नवतो वसुत्वना सदा पीपेथ दाशुषे॥
verses.tr: pra vīramugraṃ viviciṃ dhanaspṛtaṃ vibhūtiṃ rādhaso mahaḥ udrīva vajrinnavato vasutvanā sadā pīpetha dāśuṣe
verses.en: Praise the strong, grasping Hero, winner of the spoil, ruling supreme o'er mighty wealth. Like a full spring, O Thunderer, from thy store hast thou poured on the worshipper evermore.

verses.sa: यद्ध नूनं परावति यद्वा पृथिव्यां दिवि । युजान इन्द्र हरिभिर्महेमत ऋष्व ऋष्वेभिरा गहि॥
verses.tr: yaddha nūnaṃ parāvati yadvā pṛthivyāṃ divi yujāna indra haribhirmahemata ṛṣva ṛṣvebhirā gahi
verses.en: Now whether thou be far away, or in the heavens, or on the earth, O Indra, mighty- thoughted, harnessing thy Bays, come Lofty with the Lofty Ones.

verses.sa: रथिरासो हरयो ये ते अस्रिध ओजो वातस्य पिप्रति । येभिर्नि दस्युं मनुषो निघोषयो येभिः स्वः परीयसे॥
verses.tr: rathirāso harayo ye te asridha ojo vātasya piprati yebhirni dasyuṃ manuṣo nighoṣayo yebhiḥ svaḥ parīyase
verses.en: The Bays who draw thy chariot, Steeds who injure none, surpass the wind's impetuous strength- With whom thou silencest the enemy of man, with whom thou goest round the sky.

verses.sa: एतावतस्ते वसो विद्याम शूर नव्यसः । यथा प्राव एतशं कृत्व्ये धने यथा वशं दशव्रजे॥
verses.tr: etāvataste vaso vidyāma śūra navyasaḥ yathā prāva etaśaṃ kṛtvye dhane yathā vaśaṃ daśavraje
verses.en: O gracious Hero, may we learn anew to know thee as thou art: As in decisive fight thou holpest Etasa, or Vasa 'gainst Dasavraja,

verses.sa:
यथा कण्वे मघवन्मेधे अध्वरे दीर्घनीथे दमूनसि ।
यथा गोशर्ये असिषासो अद्रिवो मयि गोत्रं हरिश्रियम्॥
verses.tr: yathā kaṇve maghavanmedhe adhvare dīrghanīthe damūnasi yathā gośarye asiṣāso adrivo mayi gotraṃ hariśriyam
verses.en: As, Maghavan, to Kanva at the sacred feast, to Dirghanitha thine home-friend, As to Gosarya thou, Stone-darter, gavest wealth, give me a gold-bright stall of kine.

verses.sa: यथा मनौ सांवरणौ सोममिन्द्रापिबः सुतम् । नीपातिथौ मघवन्मेध्यातिथौ पुष्टिगौ श्रुष्टिगौ सचा॥
verses.tr: yathā manau sāṃvaraṇau somamindrāpibaḥ sutam nīpātithau maghavanmedhyātithau puṣṭigau śruṣṭigau sacā
verses.en: As with Manu Samvarani, Indra, thou drankest Soma juice, And, Maghavan, with Nipatithi, Medbyatithi, with Pustigu and Srustigu,-

verses.sa: पार्षद्वाणः प्रस्कण्वं समसादयच्छयानं जिव्रिमुद्धितम् । सहस्राण्यसिषासद्गवामृषिस्त्वोतो दस्यवे वृकः॥
verses.tr: pārṣadvāṇaḥ praskaṇvaṃ samasādayacchayānaṃ jivrimuddhitam sahasrāṇyasiṣāsadgavāmṛṣistvoto dasyave vṛkaḥ
verses.en: The son of Prsadvana was Praskaniva's host, who lay decrepit and forlorn. Aided by thee the Rsi Dasyavevrka strove to obtain thousands of kine.

verses.sa: य उक्थेभिर्न विन्धते चिकिद्य ऋषिचोदनः । इन्द्रं तमच्छा वद नव्यस्या मत्यरिष्यन्तं न भोजसे॥
verses.tr: ya ukthebhirna vindhate cikidya ṛṣicodanaḥ indraṃ tamacchā vada navyasyā matyariṣyantaṃ na bhojase
verses.en: Call hither with thy newest song Indra who lacks not hymns of praise, Him who observes and knows, inspirer of the sage, him who seems eager to enjoy.

verses.sa: यस्मा अर्कं सप्तशीर्षाणमानृचुस्त्रिधातुमुत्तमे पदे । स त्वि१मा विश्वा भुवनानि चिक्रददादिज्जनिष्ट पौंस्यम्॥
verses.tr: yasmā arkaṃ saptaśīrṣāṇamānṛcustridhātumuttame pade sa tvi1mā viśvā bhuvanāni cikradadādijjaniṣṭa pauṃsyam
verses.en: He unto whom they sang the seven-headed hymn, three-parted, in the loftiest place, He sent his thunder down on all these living things, and so displayed heroic might.

verses.sa: यो नो दाता वसूनामिन्द्रं तं हूमहे वयम् । विद्मा ह्यस्य सुमतिं नवीयसीं गमेम गोमति व्रजे॥
verses.tr: yo no dātā vasūnāmindraṃ taṃ hūmahe vayam vidmā hyasya sumatiṃ navīyasīṃ gamema gomati vraje
verses.en: We invocate that Indra who bestoweth precious things on us. Now do we know his newest favour; may we gain a stable that is full of kine.

verses.sa: यस्मै त्वं वसो दानाय शिक्षसि स रायस्पोषमश्नुते । तं त्वा वयं मघवन्निन्द्र गिर्वणः सुतावन्तो हवामहे॥
verses.tr: yasmai tvaṃ vaso dānāya śikṣasi sa rāyaspoṣamaśnute taṃ tvā vayaṃ maghavannindra girvaṇaḥ sutāvanto havāmahe
verses.en: He whom thou aidest, gracious Lord, to give again, obtains great wealth to nourish him. We with our Soma ready, Lover of the Song! call, Indra Maghavan, on thee.

verses.sa: कदा चन स्तरीरसि नेन्द्र सश्चसि दाशुषे । उपोपेन्नु मघवन्भूय इन्नु ते दानं देवस्य पृच्यते॥
verses.tr: kadā cana starīrasi nendra saścasi dāśuṣe upopennu maghavanbhūya innu te dānaṃ devasya pṛcyate
verses.en: Ne'er art thou fruitless, Indra ne'er dost thou desert the worshipper But now, O Maghavan, thy bounty as a God is poured forth ever more and more.

verses.sa: प्र यो ननक्षे अभ्योजसा क्रिविं वधैः शुष्णं निघोषयन् । यदेदस्तम्भीत्प्रथयन्नमूं दिवमादिज्जनिष्ट पार्थिवः॥
verses.tr: pra yo nanakṣe abhyojasā kriviṃ vadhaiḥ śuṣṇaṃ nighoṣayan yadedastambhītprathayannamūṃ divamādijjaniṣṭa pārthivaḥ
verses.en: He who hath. overtaken Krvi with his might, and silenced Susna with deathbolts, When he supported yonder heaven and spread it out, then first the son of earth was born.

verses.sa: यस्यायं विश्व आर्यो दासः शेवधिपा अरिः । तिरश्चिदर्ये रुशमे परीरवि तुभ्येत्सो अज्यते रयिः॥
verses.tr: yasyāyaṃ viśva āryo dāsaḥ śevadhipā ariḥ tiraścidarye ruśame parīravi tubhyetso ajyate rayiḥ
verses.en: Good Lord of wealth is he to whom all Aryas, Dasas here belong. Directly unto thee, the pious Rusama Paviru, is that wealth brought nigh.

verses.sa:
तुरण्यवो मधुमन्तं घृतश्चुतं विप्रासो अर्कमानृचुः ।
अस्मे रयिः पप्रथे वृष्ण्यं शवोऽस्मे सुवानास इन्दवः॥
verses.tr: turaṇyavo madhumantaṃ ghṛtaścutaṃ viprāso arkamānṛcuḥ asme rayiḥ paprathe vṛṣṇyaṃ śavo'sme suvānāsa indavaḥ
verses.en: In zealous haste the singers have sung forth a song distilling oil and rich in sweets. Riches have spread among us and heroic strength, with us are flowing Soma-drops.

verses.sa: यथा मनौ विवस्वति सोमं शक्रापिबः सुतम् । यथा त्रिते छन्द इन्द्र जुजोषस्यायौ मादयसे सचा॥
verses.tr: yathā manau vivasvati somaṃ śakrāpibaḥ sutam yathā trite chanda indra jujoṣasyāyau mādayase sacā
verses.en: As, Sakra, thou with Manu called Vivasvan drankest Soma juice, As, Indra, thou didst love the hymn by Trita's side, so dost thou joy with Ayu now.

verses.sa: पृषध्रे मेध्ये मातरिश्वनीन्द्र सुवाने अमन्दथाः । यथा सोमं दशशिप्रे दशोण्ये स्यूमरश्मावृजूनसि॥
verses.tr: pṛṣadhre medhye mātariśvanīndra suvāne amandathāḥ yathā somaṃ daśaśipre daśoṇye syūmaraśmāvṛjūnasi
verses.en: As thou with Matarisvan, Medhya, Prsadhra, hast cheered thee Indra, with pressed juice, Drunk Soma with Rjunas, Syumarasmi, by Dasonya's Dasasipra's side.

verses.sa: य उक्था केवला दधे यः सोमं धृषितापिबत् । यस्मै विष्णुस्त्रीणि पदा विचक्रम उप मित्रस्य धर्मभिः॥
verses.tr: ya ukthā kevalā dadhe yaḥ somaṃ dhṛṣitāpibat yasmai viṣṇustrīṇi padā vicakrama upa mitrasya dharmabhiḥ
verses.en: 'Tis he who made the lauds his own and boldly drank the Soma juice, He to whom Visnu came striding his three wide steps, as Mitra's statutes ordered it.

verses.sa:
यस्य त्वमिन्द्र स्तोमेषु चाकनो वाजे वाजिञ्छतक्रतो ।
तं त्वा वयं सुदुघामिव गोदुहो जुहूमसि श्रवस्यवः॥
verses.tr: yasya tvamindra stomeṣu cākano vāje vājiñchatakrato taṃ tvā vayaṃ sudughāmiva goduho juhūmasi śravasyavaḥ
verses.en: In whose laud thou didst joy, Indra, at the great deed, O Satakratu, Mighty One! Seeking renown we call thee as the milkers call the cow who yields abundant milk.

verses.sa: यो नो दाता स नः पिता महाँ उग्र ईशानकृत् । अयामन्नुग्रो मघवा पुरूवसुर्गोरश्वस्य प्र दातु नः॥
verses.tr: yo no dātā sa naḥ pitā mahāṃ ugra īśānakṛt ayāmannugro maghavā purūvasurgoraśvasya pra dātu naḥ
verses.en: He is our Sire who gives to us, Great, Mighty, ruling as he wills. Unsought, may he the Strong, Rich, Lord of ample wealth, give us of horses and of kine.

verses.sa: यस्मै त्वं वसो दानाय मंहसे स रायस्पोषमिन्वति । वसूयवो वसुपतिं शतक्रतुं स्तोमैरिन्द्रं हवामहे॥
verses.tr: yasmai tvaṃ vaso dānāya maṃhase sa rāyaspoṣaminvati vasūyavo vasupatiṃ śatakratuṃ stomairindraṃ havāmahe
verses.en: He to whom thou, Good Lord, givest that he may give increases wealth that nourishes. Eager for wealth we call on Indra, Lord of wealth, on Satakratu with our lauds.

verses.sa: कदा चन प्र युच्छस्युभे नि पासि जन्मनी । तुरीयादित्य हवनं त इन्द्रियमा तस्थावमृतं दिवि॥
verses.tr: kadā cana pra yucchasyubhe ni pāsi janmanī turīyāditya havanaṃ ta indriyamā tasthāvamṛtaṃ divi
verses.en: Never art thou neglectful: thou guardest both races with thy care. The call on Indra, fourth Aditya! is thine own. Amrta is stablished in the heavens.

verses.sa:
यस्मै त्वं मघवन्निन्द्र गिर्वणः शिक्षो शिक्षसि दाशुषे ।
अस्माकं गिर उत सुष्टुतिं वसो कण्ववच्छृणुधी हवम्॥
verses.tr: yasmai tvaṃ maghavannindra girvaṇaḥ śikṣo śikṣasi dāśuṣe asmākaṃ gira uta suṣṭutiṃ vaso kaṇvavacchṛṇudhī havam
verses.en: The offerer whom thou, Indra, Lover of the Song, liberal Maghavan, favourest,- As at the call of Kanva so, O gracious Lord, hear, thou our songs and eulogy.

verses.sa: अस्तावि मन्म पूर्व्यं ब्रह्मेन्द्राय वोचत । पूर्वीॠतस्य बृहतीरनूषत स्तोतुर्मेधा असृक्षत॥
verses.tr: astāvi manma pūrvyaṃ brahmendrāya vocata pūrvīṝtasya bṛhatīranūṣata stoturmedhā asṛkṣata
verses.en: Sung is the song of ancient time: to Indra have ye said the prayer. They have sung many a Brhati of sacrifice, poured forth the worshipper's many thoughts.

verses.sa:
समिन्द्रो रायो बृहतीरधूनुत सं क्षोणी समु सूर्यम् ।
सं शुक्रासः शुचयः सं गवाशिरः सोमा इन्द्रममन्दिषुः॥
verses.tr: samindro rāyo bṛhatīradhūnuta saṃ kṣoṇī samu sūryam saṃ śukrāsaḥ śucayaḥ saṃ gavāśiraḥ somā indramamandiṣuḥ
verses.en: Indra hath tossed together mighty stores of wealth, and both the worlds, yea, and the Sun. Pure, brightly-shining, mingled with the milk, the draughts of Soma have made Indra glad.

verses.sa: उपमं त्वा मघोनां ज्येष्ठं च वृषभाणाम् । पूर्भित्तमं मघवन्निन्द्र गोविदमीशानं राय ईमहे॥
verses.tr: upamaṃ tvā maghonāṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ ca vṛṣabhāṇām pūrbhittamaṃ maghavannindra govidamīśānaṃ rāya īmahe
verses.en: As highest of the Maghavans, preeminent among the Bulls, Best breaker-down of forts, kine-winner, Lord of wealth, we seek thee, Indra Maghavan.

verses.sa: य आयुं कुत्समतिथिग्वमर्दयो वावृधानो दिवेदिवे । तं त्वा वयं हर्यश्वं शतक्रतुं वाजयन्तो हवामहे॥
verses.tr: ya āyuṃ kutsamatithigvamardayo vāvṛdhāno divedive taṃ tvā vayaṃ haryaśvaṃ śatakratuṃ vājayanto havāmahe
verses.en: Thou who subduedst Ayu, Kutsa, Atithigva, waxing daily in thy might, As such, rousing thy power, we invocate thee now, thee Satakratu, Lord of Bays.

verses.sa: आ नो विश्वेषां रसं मध्वः सिञ्चन्त्वद्रयः । ये परावति सुन्विरे जनेष्वा ये अर्वावतीन्दवः॥
verses.tr: ā no viśveṣāṃ rasaṃ madhvaḥ siñcantvadrayaḥ ye parāvati sunvire janeṣvā ye arvāvatīndavaḥ
verses.en: The pressing-stones shall pour for us the essence of the meath of all, Drops that have been pressed out afar among the folk, and those that have been pressed near us.

verses.sa:
विश्वा द्वेषांसि जहि चाव चा कृधि विश्वे सन्वन्त्वा वसु ।
शीष्टेषु चित्ते मदिरासो अंशवो यत्रा सोमस्य तृम्पसि॥
verses.tr: viśvā dveṣāṃsi jahi cāva cā kṛdhi viśve sanvantvā vasu śīṣṭeṣu citte madirāso aṃśavo yatrā somasya tṛmpasi
verses.en: Repel all enmities and keep them far away: let all win treasure for their own. Even among Sistas are the stalks that make thee glad, where thou with Soma satest thee.

verses.sa: इन्द्र नेदीय एदिहि मितमेधाभिरूतिभिः । आ शंतम शंतमाभिरभिष्टिभिरा स्वापे स्वापिभिः॥
verses.tr: indra nedīya edihi mitamedhābhirūtibhiḥ ā śaṃtama śaṃtamābhirabhiṣṭibhirā svāpe svāpibhiḥ
verses.en: Come, Indra, very near to us with aids of firmly-based resolve; Come, most auspicious, with thy most auspicious help, good Kinsman, with good kinsmen, come!

verses.sa:
आजितुरं सत्पतिं विश्वचर्षणिं कृधि प्रजास्वाभगम् ।
प्र सू तिरा शचीभिर्ये त उक्थिनः क्रतुं पुनत आनुषक्॥
verses.tr: ājituraṃ satpatiṃ viśvacarṣaṇiṃ kṛdhi prajāsvābhagam pra sū tirā śacībhirye ta ukthinaḥ kratuṃ punata ānuṣak
verses.en: Bless thou with progeny the chief of men, the lord of heroes, victor in the fray. Aid with thy powers the men who sing thee lauds and keep their spirits ever pure and bright.

verses.sa: यस्ते साधिष्ठोऽवसे ते स्याम भरेषु ते । वयं होत्राभिरुत देवहूतिभिः ससवांसो मनामहे॥
verses.tr: yaste sādhiṣṭho'vase te syāma bhareṣu te vayaṃ hotrābhiruta devahūtibhiḥ sasavāṃso manāmahe
verses.en: May we be such in battle as are surest to obtain thy grace: With holy offerings and invocations of the Gods, we mean, that we may win the spoil.

verses.sa: अहं हि ते हरिवो ब्रह्म वाजयुराजिं यामि सदोतिभिः । त्वामिदेव तममे समश्वयुर्गव्युरग्र मथीनाम्॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ hi te harivo brahma vājayurājiṃ yāmi sadotibhiḥ tvāmideva tamame samaśvayurgavyuragra mathīnām
verses.en: Thine, Lord of Bays, am I. Prayer longeth for the spoil. Still with thy help I seek the fight. So, at the raiders' head, I, craving steeds and kine, unite myself with thee alone.

verses.sa: एतत्त इन्द्र वीर्यं गीर्भिर्गृणन्ति कारवः । ते स्तोभन्त ऊर्जमावन्घृतश्चुतं पौरासो नक्षन्धीतिभिः॥
verses.tr: etatta indra vīryaṃ gīrbhirgṛṇanti kāravaḥ te stobhanta ūrjamāvanghṛtaścutaṃ paurāso nakṣandhītibhiḥ
verses.en: Indra, the poets with their hymns extol this hero might of thine: They strengthened, loud in song, thy power that droppeth oil. With hymns the Pauras came to thee.

verses.sa: नक्षन्त इन्द्रमवसे सुकृत्यया येषां सुतेषु मन्दसे । यथा संवर्ते अमदो यथा कृश एवास्मे इन्द्र मत्स्व॥
verses.tr: nakṣanta indramavase sukṛtyayā yeṣāṃ suteṣu mandase yathā saṃvarte amado yathā kṛśa evāsme indra matsva
verses.en: Through piety they came to Indra for his aid, they whose libations give thee joy. As thou with, Krsa and Samvarta hast rejoiced, so, Indra, be thou glad with us.

verses.sa: आ नो विश्वे सजोषसो देवासो गन्तनोप नः । वसवो रुद्रा अवसे न आ गमञ्छृण्वन्तु मरुतो हवम्॥
verses.tr: ā no viśve sajoṣaso devāso gantanopa naḥ vasavo rudrā avase na ā gamañchṛṇvantu maruto havam
verses.en: Agreeing in your spirit, all ye Deities, come nigh to us. Vasus and Rudras shall come near to give us aid, and Maruts listen to our call.

verses.sa: पूषा विष्णुर्हवनं मे सरस्वत्यवन्तु सप्त सिन्धवः । आपो वातः पर्वतासो वनस्पतिः शृणोतु पृथिवी हवम्॥
verses.tr: pūṣā viṣṇurhavanaṃ me sarasvatyavantu sapta sindhavaḥ āpo vātaḥ parvatāso vanaspatiḥ śṛṇotu pṛthivī havam
verses.en: May Pusan, Visnu, and Sarasvati befriend, and the Seven Streams, this call of mine: May Waters, Wind, the Mountains, and the Forest-Lord, and Earth give ear unto my cry.

verses.sa: यदिन्द्र राधो अस्ति ते माघोनं मघवत्तम । तेन नो बोधि सधमाद्यो वृधे भगो दानाय वृत्रहन्॥
verses.tr: yadindra rādho asti te māghonaṃ maghavattama tena no bodhi sadhamādyo vṛdhe bhago dānāya vṛtrahan
verses.en: Indra, with thine own bounteous gift, most liberal of the Mighty Ones, Be our boon benefactor, Vrtra-slayer, be our feast-companion for our weal.

verses.sa: आजिपते नृपते त्वमिद्धि नो वाज आ वक्षि सुक्रतो । वीती होत्राभिरुत देववीतिभिः ससवांसो वि शृण्विरे॥
verses.tr: ājipate nṛpate tvamiddhi no vāja ā vakṣi sukrato vītī hotrābhiruta devavītibhiḥ sasavāṃso vi śṛṇvire
verses.en: Leader of heroes, Lord of battle, lead thou us to combat, thou Most Sapient One. High fame is theirs who win by invocations, feasts and entertainment of the Gods.

verses.sa: सन्ति ह्य१र्य आशिष इन्द्र आयुर्जनानाम् । अस्मान्नक्षस्व मघवन्नुपावसे धुक्षस्व पिप्युषीमिषम्॥
verses.tr: santi hya1rya āśiṣa indra āyurjanānām asmānnakṣasva maghavannupāvase dhukṣasva pipyuṣīmiṣam
verses.en: Our hopes rest on the Faithful One: in Indra is the people's life. O Maghavan, come nigh that thou mayst give us aid: make plenteous food stream forth for us.

verses.sa: वयं त इन्द्र स्तोमेभिर्विधेम त्वमस्माकं शतक्रतो । महि स्थूरं शशयं राधो अह्रयं प्रस्कण्वाय नि तोशय॥
verses.tr: vayaṃ ta indra stomebhirvidhema tvamasmākaṃ śatakrato mahi sthūraṃ śaśayaṃ rādho ahrayaṃ praskaṇvāya ni tośaya
verses.en: Thee would we worship, Indra, with our songs of praise: O Satakratu, be thou ours. Pour down upon Praskanva bounty vast and firm, exuberant, that shall never fail.

verses.sa: भूरीदिन्द्रस्य वीर्यं१ व्यख्यमभ्यायति । राधस्ते दस्यवे वृक॥
verses.tr: bhūrīdindrasya vīryaṃ1 vyakhyamabhyāyati rādhaste dasyave vṛka
verses.en: Great, verily, is Indra's might. I have beheld, and hither comes Thy bounty, Dasyave-vrka!

verses.sa: शतं श्वेतास उक्षणो दिवि तारो न रोचन्ते । मह्ना दिवं न तस्तभुः॥
verses.tr: śataṃ śvetāsa ukṣaṇo divi tāro na rocante mahnā divaṃ na tastabhuḥ
verses.en: A hundred oxen white of hue are shining like the stars in heaven, So tall, they seem to prop the sky.

verses.sa: शतं वेणूञ्छतं शुनः शतं चर्माणि म्लातानि । शतं मे बल्बजस्तुका अरुषीणां चतुःशतम्॥
verses.tr: śataṃ veṇūñchataṃ śunaḥ śataṃ carmāṇi mlātāni śataṃ me balbajastukā aruṣīṇāṃ catuḥśatam
verses.en: Bamboos a hundred, a hundred dogs, a hundred skins of beasts well-tanned, A hundred tufts of Balbaja, four hundred red-hued mares are mine.

verses.sa: सुदेवाः स्थ काण्वायना वयोवयो विचरन्तः । अश्वासो न चङ्क्रमत॥
verses.tr: sudevāḥ stha kāṇvāyanā vayovayo vicarantaḥ aśvāso na caṅkramata
verses.en: Blest by the Gods, Kinvayanas! be ye who spread through life on life: Like horses have ye stridden forth.

verses.sa: आदित्साप्तस्य चर्किरन्नानूनस्य महि श्रवः । श्यावीरतिध्वसन्पथश्चक्षुषा चन संनशे॥
verses.tr: āditsāptasya carkirannānūnasya mahi śravaḥ śyāvīratidhvasanpathaścakṣuṣā cana saṃnaśe
verses.en: Then men extolled the team of seven not yet full-grown, its fame is great. The dark mares rushed along the paths, so that no eye could follow them.

verses.sa: प्रति ते दस्यवे वृक राधो अदर्श्यह्रयम् । द्यौर्न प्रथिना शवः॥
verses.tr: prati te dasyave vṛka rādho adarśyahrayam dyaurna prathinā śavaḥ
verses.en: Thy bounty, Dasyave-vrka, exhaustless hath displayed itself: Its fulness is as broad as heaven.

verses.sa: दश मह्यं पौतक्रतः सहस्रा दस्यवे वृकः । नित्याद्रायो अमंहत॥
verses.tr: daśa mahyaṃ pautakrataḥ sahasrā dasyave vṛkaḥ nityādrāyo amaṃhata
verses.en: Ten thousand Dasyave-vrka, the son of Putakrata, hath From his own wealth bestowed on me.

verses.sa: शतं मे गर्दभानां शतमूर्णावतीनाम् । शतं दासाँ अति स्रजः॥
verses.tr: śataṃ me gardabhānāṃ śatamūrṇāvatīnām śataṃ dāsāṃ ati srajaḥ
verses.en: A hundred asses hath he given, a hundred head of fleecy sheep, A hundred slaves, and wreaths besides.

verses.sa: तत्रो अपि प्राणीयत पूतक्रतायै व्यक्ता । अश्वानामिन्न यूथ्याम्॥
verses.tr: tatro api prāṇīyata pūtakratāyai vyaktā aśvānāminna yūthyām
verses.en: There also was a mare led forth, picked out for Putakrata's sake, Not of the horses of the herd.

verses.sa: अचेत्यग्निश्चिकितुर्हव्यवाट् स सुमद्रथः । अग्निः शुक्रेण शोचिषा बृहत्सूरो अरोचत दिवि सूर्यो अरोचत॥
verses.tr: acetyagniścikiturhavyavāṭ sa sumadrathaḥ agniḥ śukreṇa śociṣā bṛhatsūro arocata divi sūryo arocata
verses.en: Observant Agni hath appeared, oblation-bearer with his car. Agni with his resplendent flame hath shone on high as shines the Sun, hath shone like Surya in the heavens.

verses.sa:
युवं देवा क्रतुना पूर्व्येण युक्ता रथेन तविषं यजत्रा ।
आगच्छतं नासत्या शचीभिरिदं तृतीयं सवनं पिबाथः॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ devā kratunā pūrvyeṇa yuktā rathena taviṣaṃ yajatrā āgacchataṃ nāsatyā śacībhiridaṃ tṛtīyaṃ savanaṃ pibāthaḥ
verses.en: Endowed, O Gods, with your primeval wisdom, come quickly with your chariot, O ye Holy. Come with your mighty powers, O ye Nasatyas; come hither, drink ye this the third libation.

verses.sa:
युवां देवास्त्रय एकादशासः सत्याः सत्यस्य ददृशे पुरस्तात् ।
अस्माकं यज्ञं सवनं जुषाणा पातं सोममश्विना दीद्यग्नी॥
verses.tr: yuvāṃ devāstraya ekādaśāsaḥ satyāḥ satyasya dadṛśe purastāt asmākaṃ yajñaṃ savanaṃ juṣāṇā pātaṃ somamaśvinā dīdyagnī
verses.en: The truthful Deities, the Three-and-Thirty, saw you approach before the Ever-Truthful. Accepting this our worship and libation, O Asvins bright with fire, drink ye the Soma.

verses.sa:
पनाय्यं तदश्विना कृतं वां वृषभो दिवो रजसः पृथिव्याः ।
सहस्रं शंसा उत ये गविष्टौ सर्वाँ इत्ताँ उप याता पिबध्यै॥
verses.tr: panāyyaṃ tadaśvinā kṛtaṃ vāṃ vṛṣabho divo rajasaḥ pṛthivyāḥ sahasraṃ śaṃsā uta ye gaviṣṭau sarvāṃ ittāṃ upa yātā pibadhyai
verses.en: Asvins, that work of yours deserves our wonder,-the Bull of heaven and earth and air's mid region; Yea, and your thousand promises in battle, -to all of these come near and drink beside us.

verses.sa:
अयं वां भागो निहितो यजत्रेमा गिरो नासत्योप यातम् ।
पिबतं सोमं मधुमन्तमस्मे प्र दाश्वांसमवतं शचीभिः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ vāṃ bhāgo nihito yajatremā giro nāsatyopa yātam pibataṃ somaṃ madhumantamasme pra dāśvāṃsamavataṃ śacībhiḥ
verses.en: Here is your portion laid for you, ye Holy: come to these songs of ours, O ye Nasatyas. Drink among us the Soma full of sweetness, and with your powers assist the man who worships.

verses.sa:
यमृत्विजो बहुधा कल्पयन्तः सचेतसो यज्ञमिमं वहन्ति ।
यो अनूचानो ब्राह्मणो युक्त आसीत्का स्वित्तत्र यजमानस्य संवित्॥
verses.tr: yamṛtvijo bahudhā kalpayantaḥ sacetaso yajñamimaṃ vahanti yo anūcāno brāhmaṇo yukta āsītkā svittatra yajamānasya saṃvit
verses.en: He whom the priests in sundry ways arranging the sacrifice, of one accord, bring hither, Who was appointed as a learned Brahman, what is the sacrificer's knowledge of him?

verses.sa:
एक एवाग्निर्बहुधा समिद्ध एकः सूर्यो विश्वमनु प्रभूतः ।
एकैवोषाः सर्वमिदं वि भात्येकं वा इदं वि बभूव सर्वम्॥
verses.tr: eka evāgnirbahudhā samiddha ekaḥ sūryo viśvamanu prabhūtaḥ ekaivoṣāḥ sarvamidaṃ vi bhātyekaṃ vā idaṃ vi babhūva sarvam
verses.en: Kindled in many a spot, still One is Agni; Silrya is One though high o'er all he shineth. Illumining this All, still One is Usas. That which is One hath into All developed.

verses.sa:
ज्योतिष्मन्तं केतुमन्तं त्रिचक्रं सुखं रथं सुषदं भूरिवारम् ।
चित्रामघा यस्य योगेऽधिजज्ञे तं वां हुवे अति रिक्तं पिबध्यै॥
verses.tr: jyotiṣmantaṃ ketumantaṃ tricakraṃ sukhaṃ rathaṃ suṣadaṃ bhūrivāram citrāmaghā yasya yoge'dhijajñe taṃ vāṃ huve ati riktaṃ pibadhyai
verses.en: The chariot bright and radiant, treasure-laden, three-wheeled, with easy seat, and lightly rolling, Which She of Wondrous Wealth was born to harness,-this car of yours I call. Drink what remaineth.

verses.sa:
इमानि वां भागधेयानि सिस्रत इन्द्रावरुणा प्र महे सुतेषु वाम् ।
यज्ञेयज्ञे ह सवना भुरण्यथो यत्सुन्वते यजमानाय शिक्षथः॥
verses.tr: imāni vāṃ bhāgadheyāni sisrata indrāvaruṇā pra mahe suteṣu vām yajñeyajñe ha savanā bhuraṇyatho yatsunvate yajamānāya śikṣathaḥ
verses.en: In offerings poured to you, O Indra-Varuna, these shares of yours stream forth to glorify your state. Ye haste to the libations at each sacrifice when ye assist the worshipper who sheds the juice.

verses.sa:
निष्षिध्वरीरोषधीराप आस्तामिन्द्रावरुणा महिमानमाशत ।
या सिस्रतू रजसः पारे अध्वनो ययोः शत्रुर्नकिरादेव ओहते॥
verses.tr: niṣṣidhvarīroṣadhīrāpa āstāmindrāvaruṇā mahimānamāśata yā sisratū rajasaḥ pāre adhvano yayoḥ śatrurnakirādeva ohate
verses.en: The waters and the plants, O Indra-Varuna, had efficacious vigour, and attained to might: Ye who have gone beyond the path of middle air,-no godless man is worthy to be called your foe.

verses.sa:
सत्यं तदिन्द्रावरुणा कृशस्य वां मध्व ऊर्मिं दुहते सप्त वाणीः ।
ताभिर्दाश्वांसमवतं शुभस्पती यो वामदब्धो अभि पाति चित्तिभिः॥
verses.tr: satyaṃ tadindrāvaruṇā kṛśasya vāṃ madhva ūrmiṃ duhate sapta vāṇīḥ tābhirdāśvāṃsamavataṃ śubhaspatī yo vāmadabdho abhi pāti cittibhiḥ
verses.en: True is your Krsa's word, Indra and Varuna: The seven holy voices pour a wave of meath. For their sake, Lords of splendour! aid the pious man who, unbewildered, keeps you ever in his thoughts.

verses.sa:
घृतप्रुषः सौम्या जीरदानवः सप्त स्वसारः सदन ऋतस्य ।
या ह वामिन्द्रावरुणा घृतश्चुतस्ताभिर्धत्तं यजमानाय शिक्षतम्॥
verses.tr: ghṛtapruṣaḥ saumyā jīradānavaḥ sapta svasāraḥ sadana ṛtasya yā ha vāmindrāvaruṇā ghṛtaścutastābhirdhattaṃ yajamānāya śikṣatam
verses.en: Dropping oil, sweet with Soma, pouring forth their stream, are the Seven Sisters in the seat of sacrifice. These, dropping oil, are yours, O Indra-Varuna: with these enrich with gifts and help the worshipper.

verses.sa:
अवोचाम महते सौभगाय सत्यं त्वेषाभ्यां महिमानमिन्द्रियम् ।
अस्मान्त्स्विन्द्रावरुणा घृतश्चुतस्त्रिभिः साप्तेभिरवतं शुभस्पती॥
verses.tr: avocāma mahate saubhagāya satyaṃ tveṣābhyāṃ mahimānamindriyam asmāntsvindrāvaruṇā ghṛtaścutastribhiḥ sāptebhiravataṃ śubhaspatī
verses.en: To our great happiness have we ascribed to these Two Bright Ones truthfulness, great strength, and majesty. O Lords of splendour, aid us through the Three-times-Seven, as we pour holy oil, O Indra-Varuna.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रावरुणा यदृषिभ्यो मनीषां वाचो मतिं श्रुतमदत्तमग्रे ।
यानि स्थानान्यसृजन्त धीरा यज्ञं तन्वानास्तपसाभ्यपश्यम्॥
verses.tr: indrāvaruṇā yadṛṣibhyo manīṣāṃ vāco matiṃ śrutamadattamagre yāni sthānānyasṛjanta dhīrā yajñaṃ tanvānāstapasābhyapaśyam
verses.en: What ye in time of old Indra and Varuna, gave Rsis revelation, thought, and power of song, And places which the wise made, weaving sacrifice,-these through my spirit's fervid glow have I beheld.,

verses.sa:
इन्द्रावरुणा सौमनसमदृप्तं रायस्पोषं यजमानेषु धत्तम् ।
प्रजां पुष्टिं भूतिमस्मासु धत्तं दीर्घायुत्वाय प्र तिरतं न आयुः॥
verses.tr: indrāvaruṇā saumanasamadṛptaṃ rāyaspoṣaṃ yajamāneṣu dhattam prajāṃ puṣṭiṃ bhūtimasmāsu dhattaṃ dīrghāyutvāya pra tirataṃ na āyuḥ
verses.en: O Indra-Varuna, grant to the worshippers cheerfulness void of pride, and wealth to nourish them.

verses.sa: अग्न आ याह्यग्निभिर्होतारं त्वा वृणीमहे । आ त्वामनक्तु प्रयता हविष्मती यजिष्ठं बर्हिरासदे॥
verses.tr: agna ā yāhyagnibhirhotāraṃ tvā vṛṇīmahe ā tvāmanaktu prayatā haviṣmatī yajiṣṭhaṃ barhirāsade
verses.en: Agni, come hither with thy fires; we choose thee as Invoking Priest. Let the extended ladle full of oil balm thee, best Priest, to sit on sacred grass.

verses.sa: अच्छा हि त्वा सहसः सूनो अङ्गिरः स्रुचश्चरन्त्यध्वरे । ऊर्जो नपातं घृतकेशमीमहेऽग्निं यज्ञेषु पूर्व्यम्॥
verses.tr: acchā hi tvā sahasaḥ sūno aṅgiraḥ srucaścarantyadhvare ūrjo napātaṃ ghṛtakeśamīmahe'gniṃ yajñeṣu pūrvyam
verses.en: For unto thee, O Angiras, O Son of Strength, move ladles in the sacrifice. To Agni, Child of Force, whose locks drop oil, we seek, foremost in sacrificial rites.

verses.sa: अग्ने कविर्वेधा असि होता पावक यक्ष्यः । मन्द्रो यजिष्ठो अध्वरेष्वीड्यो विप्रेभिः शुक्र मन्मभिः॥
verses.tr: agne kavirvedhā asi hotā pāvaka yakṣyaḥ mandro yajiṣṭho adhvareṣvīḍyo viprebhiḥ śukra manmabhiḥ
verses.en: Agni, thou art Disposer, Sage, Herald, bright God! and worshipful, Best offerer, cheerful, to be praised in holy rites, pure Lord! by singers with their hymns.

verses.sa: अद्रोघमा वहोशतो यविष्ठ्य देवाँ अजस्र वीतये । अभि प्रयांसि सुधिता वसो गहि मन्दस्व धीतिभिर्हितः॥
verses.tr: adroghamā vahośato yaviṣṭhya devāṃ ajasra vītaye abhi prayāṃsi sudhitā vaso gahi mandasva dhītibhirhitaḥ
verses.en: Most Youthful and Eternal, bring the longing Gods to me, the guileless, for the feast. Come, Vasu, to the banquet that is well-prepared: rejoice thee, gracious, with our songs.

verses.sa: त्वमित्सप्रथा अस्यग्ने त्रातॠतस्कविः । त्वां विप्रासः समिधान दीदिव आ विवासन्ति वेधसः॥
verses.tr: tvamitsaprathā asyagne trātaṝtaskaviḥ tvāṃ viprāsaḥ samidhāna dīdiva ā vivāsanti vedhasaḥ
verses.en: Famed art thou, Agni, far and wide, Preserver, righteous, and a Sage. The holy singers, O refulgent kindled God! arrangers, call on thee to come -

verses.sa:
शोचा शोचिष्ठ दीदिहि विशे मयो रास्व स्तोत्रे महाँ असि ।
देवानां शर्मन्मम सन्तु सूरयः शत्रूषाहः स्वग्नयः॥
verses.tr: śocā śociṣṭha dīdihi viśe mayo rāsva stotre mahāṃ asi devānāṃ śarmanmama santu sūrayaḥ śatrūṣāhaḥ svagnayaḥ
verses.en: Shine, Most Resplendent! blaze, send bliss unto the folk, and to thy worshipper Great art thou. So may my princes, with good fires, subduing foes, rest in the keeping of the Gods.

verses.sa: यथा चिद्वृद्धमतसमग्ने संजूर्वसि क्षमि । एवा दह मित्रमहो यो अस्मध्रुग्दुर्मन्मा कश्च वेनति॥
verses.tr: yathā cidvṛddhamatasamagne saṃjūrvasi kṣami evā daha mitramaho yo asmadhrugdurmanmā kaśca venati
verses.en: O Agni, as thou burnest down to earth even high-grown underwood, So, bright as Mitra is, burn him who injures us, him who plots ill against thy friend.

verses.sa: मा नो मर्ताय रिपवे रक्षस्विने माघशंसाय रीरधः । अस्रेधद्भिस्तरणिभिर्यविष्ठ्य शिवेभिः पाहि पायुभिः॥
verses.tr: mā no martāya ripave rakṣasvine māghaśaṃsāya rīradhaḥ asredhadbhistaraṇibhiryaviṣṭhya śivebhiḥ pāhi pāyubhiḥ
verses.en: Give us not as a prey to mortal enemy, nor to the wicked friend of fiends. With conquering guards, auspicious, unassailable, protect us, O Most Youthful God.

verses.sa: पाहि नो अग्न एकया पाह्यु१त द्वितीयया । पाहि गीर्भिस्तिसृभिरूर्जां पते पाहि चतसृभिर्वसो॥
verses.tr: pāhi no agna ekayā pāhyu1ta dvitīyayā pāhi gīrbhistisṛbhirūrjāṃ pate pāhi catasṛbhirvaso
verses.en: Protect us, Agni, through the first, protect us through the second hymn, Protect us through three hymns, O Lord of Power and Might, through four hymns, Vasu, guard thou us.

verses.sa: पाहि विश्वस्माद्रक्षसो अराव्णः प्र स्म वाजेषु नोऽव । त्वामिद्धि नेदिष्ठं देवतातय आपिं नक्षामहे वृधे॥
verses.tr: pāhi viśvasmādrakṣaso arāvṇaḥ pra sma vājeṣu no'va tvāmiddhi nediṣṭhaṃ devatātaya āpiṃ nakṣāmahe vṛdhe
verses.en: Preserve us from each fiend who brings the Gods no gift, preserve thou us in deeds of strength: For we possess in thee the nearest Friend of all, for service of the Gods and weal.

verses.sa: आ नो अग्ने वयोवृधं रयिं पावक शंस्यम् । रास्वा च न उपमाते पुरुस्पृहं सुनीती स्वयशस्तरम्॥
verses.tr: ā no agne vayovṛdhaṃ rayiṃ pāvaka śaṃsyam rāsvā ca na upamāte puruspṛhaṃ sunītī svayaśastaram
verses.en: O Holy Agni, give us wealth renowned with men and strengthening life. Bestow on us, O Helper, that which many crave, more glorious still by righteousness;

verses.sa:
येन वंसाम पृतनासु शर्धतस्तरन्तो अर्य आदिशः ।
स त्वं नो वर्ध प्रयसा शचीवसो जिन्वा धियो वसुविदः॥
verses.tr: yena vaṃsāma pṛtanāsu śardhatastaranto arya ādiśaḥ sa tvaṃ no vardha prayasā śacīvaso jinvā dhiyo vasuvidaḥ
verses.en: Wherewith we may o'ercome our rivals in the war, o'erpowering the foe's designs. So wax thou by our food, O Excellent in strength. Quicken our thoughts that find out wealth.

verses.sa: शिशानो वृषभो यथाग्निः शृङ्गे दविध्वत् । तिग्मा अस्य हनवो न प्रतिधृषे सुजम्भः सहसो यहुः॥
verses.tr: śiśāno vṛṣabho yathāgniḥ śṛṅge davidhvat tigmā asya hanavo na pratidhṛṣe sujambhaḥ sahaso yahuḥ
verses.en: Agni is even as a bull who whets and brandishes his horns. Well-sharpened are his jaws which may not be withstood: the Child of Strength hath powerful teeth.

verses.sa: नहि ते अग्ने वृषभ प्रतिधृषे जम्भासो यद्वितिष्ठसे । स त्वं नो होतः सुहुतं हविष्कृधि वंस्वा नो वार्या पुरु॥
verses.tr: nahi te agne vṛṣabha pratidhṛṣe jambhāso yadvitiṣṭhase sa tvaṃ no hotaḥ suhutaṃ haviṣkṛdhi vaṃsvā no vāryā puru
verses.en: Not to be stayed, O Bull, O Agni, are thy teeth when thou art spreading far and wide. Make our oblations duly offered up, O Priest, and give us store of precious things.

verses.sa: शेषे वनेषु मात्रोः सं त्वा मर्तास इन्धते । अतन्द्रो हव्या वहसि हविष्कृत आदिद्देवेषु राजसि॥
verses.tr: śeṣe vaneṣu mātroḥ saṃ tvā martāsa indhate atandro havyā vahasi haviṣkṛta ādiddeveṣu rājasi
verses.en: Thou liest in the wood: from both thy Mothers mortals kindle thee. Unweariedly thou bearest up the offerer's gifts, then shinest bright among the Gods.

verses.sa: सप्त होतारस्तमिदीळते त्वाऽग्ने सुत्यजमह्रयम् । भिनत्स्यद्रिं तपसा वि शोचिषा प्राग्ने तिष्ठ जनाँ अति॥
verses.tr: sapta hotārastamidīḻate tvā'gne sutyajamahrayam bhinatsyadriṃ tapasā vi śociṣā prāgne tiṣṭha janāṃ ati
verses.en: And so the seven priests, O Agni, worship thee, Free-giver, Everlasting One. Thou cleavest through the rock with heat and fervent glow. Agni, rise up above the men.

verses.sa: अग्निमग्निं वो अध्रिगुं हुवेम वृक्तबर्हिषः । अग्निं हितप्रयसः शश्वतीष्वा ऽऽहोतारं चर्षणीनाम्॥
verses.tr: agnimagniṃ vo adhriguṃ huvema vṛktabarhiṣaḥ agniṃ hitaprayasaḥ śaśvatīṣvā ''hotāraṃ carṣaṇīnām
verses.en: For you let us whose grass is trimmed call Agni, Agni, restless God. Let us whose food is offered call to all the tribes Agni the Invoking Priest of men.

verses.sa: केतेन शर्मन्त्सचते सुषामण्यग्ने तुभ्यं चिकित्वना । इषण्यया नः पुरुरूपमा भर वाजं नेदिष्ठमूतये॥
verses.tr: ketena śarmantsacate suṣāmaṇyagne tubhyaṃ cikitvanā iṣaṇyayā naḥ pururūpamā bhara vājaṃ nediṣṭhamūtaye
verses.en: Agni, with noble psalm that tells his wish he dwells, thinking on thee who guardest him. Speedily bring us strength of many varied sorts to be most near to succour us.

verses.sa: अग्ने जरितर्विश्पतिस्तेपानो देव रक्षसः । अप्रोषिवान्गृहपतिर्महाँ असि दिवस्पायुर्दुरोणयुः॥
verses.tr: agne jaritarviśpatistepāno deva rakṣasaḥ aproṣivāngṛhapatirmahāṃ asi divaspāyurduroṇayuḥ
verses.en: Agni, Praise-singer! Lord of men, God burner-up of Raksasas, Mighty art thou, the ever-present Household-Lord, Home-friend and Guardian from the sky.

verses.sa: मा नो रक्ष आ वेशीदाघृणीवसो मा यातुर्यातुमावताम् । परोगव्यूत्यनिरामप क्षुधमग्ने सेध रक्षस्विनः॥
verses.tr: mā no rakṣa ā veśīdāghṛṇīvaso mā yāturyātumāvatām parogavyūtyanirāmapa kṣudhamagne sedha rakṣasvinaḥ
verses.en: Let no fiend come among us, O thou rich in light, no spell of those who deal in spells. To distant pastures drive faint hunger: far away, O Agni, chase the demons' friends.

verses.sa: उभयं शृणवच्च न इन्द्रो अर्वागिदं वचः । सत्राच्या मघवा सोमपीतये धिया शविष्ठ आ गमत्॥
verses.tr: ubhayaṃ śṛṇavacca na indro arvāgidaṃ vacaḥ satrācyā maghavā somapītaye dhiyā śaviṣṭha ā gamat
verses.en: Both boons,-may Indra, hitherward turned, listen to this prayer of ours, And mightiest Maghavan with thought inclined to us come near to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa: तं हि स्वराजं वृषभं तमोजसे धिषणे निष्टतक्षतुः । उतोपमानां प्रथमो नि षीदसि सोमकामं हि ते मनः॥
verses.tr: taṃ hi svarājaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ tamojase dhiṣaṇe niṣṭatakṣatuḥ utopamānāṃ prathamo ni ṣīdasi somakāmaṃ hi te manaḥ
verses.en: For him, strong, independent Ruler, Heaven and Earth have fashioned forth for power and might. Thou seatest thee as first among thy peers in place, for thy soul longs for Soma juice.

verses.sa: आ वृषस्व पुरूवसो सुतस्येन्द्रान्धसः । विद्मा हि त्वा हरिवः पृत्सु सासहिमधृष्टं चिद्दधृष्वणिम्॥
verses.tr: ā vṛṣasva purūvaso sutasyendrāndhasaḥ vidmā hi tvā harivaḥ pṛtsu sāsahimadhṛṣṭaṃ ciddadhṛṣvaṇim
verses.en: Fill thyself full, O Lord of wealth, O Indra, with the juice we shed. We know thee, Lord of Bay Steeds victor in the fight, vanquishing e'en the invincible.

verses.sa: अप्रामिसत्य मघवन्तथेदसदिन्द्र क्रत्वा यथा वशः । सनेम वाजं तव शिप्रिन्नवसा मक्षू चिद्यन्तो अद्रिवः॥
verses.tr: aprāmisatya maghavantathedasadindra kratvā yathā vaśaḥ sanema vājaṃ tava śiprinnavasā makṣū cidyanto adrivaḥ
verses.en: Changeless in truth, O Maghavan Indra, let it be as thou in wisdom willest it. May we, O fair of check, win booty with thine aid, O Thunderer, swiftly seeking it.

verses.sa: शग्ध्यू३ षु शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः । भगं न हि त्वा यशसं वसुविदमनु शूर चरामसि॥
verses.tr: śagdhyū3 ṣu śacīpata indra viśvābhirūtibhiḥ bhagaṃ na hi tvā yaśasaṃ vasuvidamanu śūra carāmasi
verses.en: Indra, with all thy saving helps give us assistance, Lord of power. For after thee we follow even as glorious bliss, thee, Hero, finder-out of wealth.

verses.sa: पौरो अश्वस्य पुरुकृद्गवामस्युत्सो देव हिरण्ययः । नकिर्हि दानं परिमर्धिषत्त्वे यद्यद्यामि तदा भर॥
verses.tr: pauro aśvasya purukṛdgavāmasyutso deva hiraṇyayaḥ nakirhi dānaṃ parimardhiṣattve yadyadyāmi tadā bhara
verses.en: Increaser of our steeds and multiplying kine, a golden well, O God, art thou, For no one may impair the gifts laid up in thee. Bring me whatever thing I ask.

verses.sa: त्वं ह्येहि चेरवे विदा भगं वसुत्तये । उद्वावृषस्व मघवन्गविष्टय उदिन्द्राश्वमिष्टये॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ hyehi cerave vidā bhagaṃ vasuttaye udvāvṛṣasva maghavangaviṣṭaya udindrāśvamiṣṭaye
verses.en: For thou,-come to the worshipper!-wilt find great wealth to make us rich. Fill thyself full, O Maghavan, for gain of kine, full, Indra, for the gain of steeds.

verses.sa: त्वं पुरू सहस्राणि शतानि च यूथा दानाय मंहसे । आ पुरंदरं चकृम विप्रवचस इन्द्रं गायन्तोऽवसे॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ purū sahasrāṇi śatāni ca yūthā dānāya maṃhase ā puraṃdaraṃ cakṛma vipravacasa indraṃ gāyanto'vase
verses.en: Thou as thy gift bestowest many hundred herds, yea, many thousands dost thou give. With singers' hymns have we brought the Fort-render near, singing to Indra for his grace.

verses.sa: अविप्रो वा यदविधद्विप्रो वेन्द्र ते वचः । स प्र ममन्दत्त्वाया शतक्रतो प्राचामन्यो अहंसन॥
verses.tr: avipro vā yadavidhadvipro vendra te vacaḥ sa pra mamandattvāyā śatakrato prācāmanyo ahaṃsana
verses.en: Whether the simple or the sage, Indra, have offered praise to thee, He Satakratu! by his love hath gladdened thee, ambitious! ever pressing on!

verses.sa: उग्रबाहुर्म्रक्षकृत्वा पुरंदरो यदि मे शृणवद्धवम् । वसूयवो वसुपतिं शतक्रतुं स्तोमैरिन्द्रं हवामहे॥
verses.tr: ugrabāhurmrakṣakṛtvā puraṃdaro yadi me śṛṇavaddhavam vasūyavo vasupatiṃ śatakratuṃ stomairindraṃ havāmahe
verses.en: If he the Strong of arm, the breaker-down of forts, the great Destroyer, hear my call, We, seeking riches cry to Indra, Lord of wealth, to Satakratu with our lauds.

verses.sa: न पापासो मनामहे नारायासो न जळ्हवः । यदिन्न्विन्द्रं वृषणं सचा सुते सखायं कृणवामहै॥
verses.tr: na pāpāso manāmahe nārāyāso na jaḻhavaḥ yadinnvindraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ sacā sute sakhāyaṃ kṛṇavāmahai
verses.en: We count not then as sinners, nor as niggardly or foolish men, When with the Soma juice which we have shed we make Indra, the Mighty One, our Friend.

verses.sa: उग्रं युयुज्म पृतनासु सासहिमृणकातिमदाभ्यम् । वेदा भृमं चित्सनिता रथीतमो वाजिनं यमिदू नशत्॥
verses.tr: ugraṃ yuyujma pṛtanāsu sāsahimṛṇakātimadābhyam vedā bhṛmaṃ citsanitā rathītamo vājinaṃ yamidū naśat
verses.en: Him have we yoked in fight, the powerful Conqueror, debt-claimer, not to be deceived. Best charioteer, the Victor marks each fault, he knows the strong to whom he will come near.

verses.sa: यत इन्द्र भयामहे ततो नो अभयं कृधि । मघवञ्छग्धि तव तन्न ऊतिभिर्वि द्विषो वि मृधो जहि॥
verses.tr: yata indra bhayāmahe tato no abhayaṃ kṛdhi maghavañchagdhi tava tanna ūtibhirvi dviṣo vi mṛdho jahi
verses.en: Indra, give us security from that whereof we are afraid. Help us, O Maghavan, let thy succour give us this: drive away foes and enemies.

verses.sa: त्वं हि राधस्पते राधसो महः क्षयस्यासि विधतः । तं त्वा वयं मघवन्निन्द्र गिर्वणः सुतावन्तो हवामहे॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ hi rādhaspate rādhaso mahaḥ kṣayasyāsi vidhataḥ taṃ tvā vayaṃ maghavannindra girvaṇaḥ sutāvanto havāmahe
verses.en: For thou, O liberal Lord of bounty, strengthenest his ample home who worships thee. So Indra, Maghavan, thou Lover of the Song, we with pressed Soma call on thee,

verses.sa: इन्द्रः स्पळुत वृत्रहा परस्पा नो वरेण्यः । स नो रक्षिषच्चरमं स मध्यमं स पश्चात्पातु नः पुरः॥
verses.tr: indraḥ spaḻuta vṛtrahā paraspā no vareṇyaḥ sa no rakṣiṣaccaramaṃ sa madhyamaṃ sa paścātpātu naḥ puraḥ
verses.en: Indra is Vrtra-slayer, guard, our best defender from the foe. May he preserve our last and middlemost, and keep watch from behind us and before.

verses.sa: त्वं नः पश्चादधरादुत्तरात्पुर इन्द्र नि पाहि विश्वतः । आरे अस्मत्कृणुहि दैव्यं भयमारे हेतीरदेवीः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ naḥ paścādadharāduttarātpura indra ni pāhi viśvataḥ āre asmatkṛṇuhi daivyaṃ bhayamāre hetīradevīḥ
verses.en: Defend us from behind, below, above, in front, on all sides, Indra, shield us well. Keep far away from us the terror sent from heaven: keep impious weapons far away.

verses.sa: अद्याद्या श्वःश्व इन्द्र त्रास्व परे च नः । विश्वा च नो जरितॄन्त्सत्पते अहा दिवा नक्तं च रक्षिषः॥
verses.tr: adyādyā śvaḥśva indra trāsva pare ca naḥ viśvā ca no jaritṝntsatpate ahā divā naktaṃ ca rakṣiṣaḥ
verses.en: Protect us, Indra, each to-day, each morrow, and each following day. Our singers, through all days, shalt thou, Lord of the brave, keep safely both by day and night.

verses.sa:
प्रभङ्गी शूरो मघवा तुवीमघः सम्मिश्लो विर्याय कम् ।
उभा ते बाहू वृषणा शतक्रतो नि या वज्रं मिमिक्षतुः॥
verses.tr: prabhaṅgī śūro maghavā tuvīmaghaḥ sammiślo viryāya kam ubhā te bāhū vṛṣaṇā śatakrato ni yā vajraṃ mimikṣatuḥ
verses.en: A crushing Warrior, passing rich is Maghavan, endowed with all heroic might. Thine arms, O Satakratu, are exceeding strong, arms which have grasped the thunderbolt.

verses.sa:
प्रो अस्मा उपस्तुतिं भरता यज्जुजोषति ।
उक्थैरिन्द्रस्य माहिनं वयो वर्धन्ति सोमिनो भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः॥
verses.tr: pro asmā upastutiṃ bharatā yajjujoṣati ukthairindrasya māhinaṃ vayo vardhanti somino bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ
verses.en: Offer ye up as praise to him that wherein Indra takes delight. The Soma-bringers magnify Indra's great energy with hymns. Good are the gifts that Indra gives.

verses.sa: अयुजो असमो नृभिरेकः कृष्टीरयास्यः । पूर्वीरति प्र वावृधे विश्वा जातान्योजसा भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः॥
verses.tr: ayujo asamo nṛbhirekaḥ kṛṣṭīrayāsyaḥ pūrvīrati pra vāvṛdhe viśvā jātānyojasā bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ
verses.en: Sole among chiefs, companionless, impetuous, and peerless, he Hath waxen great o'er many folk, yea., over all things born, in might.

verses.sa: अहितेन चिदर्वता जीरदानुः सिषासति । प्रवाच्यमिन्द्र तत्तव वीर्याणि करिष्यतो भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः॥
verses.tr: ahitena cidarvatā jīradānuḥ siṣāsati pravācyamindra tattava vīryāṇi kariṣyato bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ
verses.en: Lord of swift bounty, he will win e'en with a steed of worthless sort. This, Indra, must be told of thee who wilt perform heroic deeds.

verses.sa:
आ याहि कृणवाम त इन्द्र ब्रह्माणि वर्धना ।
येभिः शविष्ठ चाकनो भद्रमिह श्रवस्यते भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः॥
verses.tr: ā yāhi kṛṇavāma ta indra brahmāṇi vardhanā yebhiḥ śaviṣṭha cākano bhadramiha śravasyate bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ
verses.en: Come to us hither: let us pay devotions that enhance thy might, For which, Most Potent! thou wouldst fain bless the man here who strives for fame.

verses.sa: धृषतश्चिद्धृषन्मनः कृणोषीन्द्र यत्त्वम् । तीव्रैः सोमैः सपर्यतो नमोभिः प्रतिभूषतो भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः॥
verses.tr: dhṛṣataściddhṛṣanmanaḥ kṛṇoṣīndra yattvam tīvraiḥ somaiḥ saparyato namobhiḥ pratibhūṣato bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ
verses.en: For thou, O Indra, makest yet more bold the spirit of the bold Who with strong Soma serveth thee, still ready with his reverent prayers.

verses.sa: अव चष्ट ऋचीषमोऽवताँ इव मानुषः । जुष्ट्वी दक्षस्य सोमिनः सखायं कृणुते युजं भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः॥
verses.tr: ava caṣṭa ṛcīṣamo'vatāṃ iva mānuṣaḥ juṣṭvī dakṣasya sominaḥ sakhāyaṃ kṛṇute yujaṃ bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ
verses.en: Worthy of song, he looketh down as a man looketh into wells. Pleased with the Soma-bringer's skill he maketh him his mate and friend.

verses.sa: विश्वे त इन्द्र वीर्यं देवा अनु क्रतुं ददुः । भुवो विश्वस्य गोपतिः पुरुष्टुत भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः॥
verses.tr: viśve ta indra vīryaṃ devā anu kratuṃ daduḥ bhuvo viśvasya gopatiḥ puruṣṭuta bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ
verses.en: In strength and wisdom all the Gods, Indra, have yielded unto thee. Be thou the Guard of all, O thou whom many praise.

verses.sa: गृणे तदिन्द्र ते शव उपमं देवतातये । यद्धंसि वृत्रमोजसा शचीपते भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः॥
verses.tr: gṛṇe tadindra te śava upamaṃ devatātaye yaddhaṃsi vṛtramojasā śacīpate bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ
verses.en: Praised, Indra, is this might of thine, best for the service of the Gods, That thou with power dost slay Vrtra, O Lord of Strength.

verses.sa: समनेव वपुष्यतः कृणवन्मानुषा युगा । विदे तदिन्द्रश्चेतनमध श्रुतो भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः॥
verses.tr: samaneva vapuṣyataḥ kṛṇavanmānuṣā yugā vide tadindraścetanamadha śruto bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ
verses.en: He makes the races of mankind like synods of the Beauteous One. Indra knows this his manifest deed, and is renowned.

verses.sa: उज्जातमिन्द्र ते शव उत्त्वामुत्तव क्रतुम् । भूरिगो भूरि वावृधुर्मघवन्तव शर्मणि भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः॥
verses.tr: ujjātamindra te śava uttvāmuttava kratum bhūrigo bhūri vāvṛdhurmaghavantava śarmaṇi bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ
verses.en: Thy might, O Indra, at its birth, thee also, and thy mental power, In thy care, Maghavan rich in kine! they have increased exceedingly.

verses.sa:
अहं च त्वं च वृत्रहन्त्सं युज्याव सनिभ्य आ ।
अरातीवा चिदद्रिवोऽनु नौ शूर मंसते भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ ca tvaṃ ca vṛtrahantsaṃ yujyāva sanibhya ā arātīvā cidadrivo'nu nau śūra maṃsate bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ
verses.en: O Vrtra-slayer, thou and I will both combine for winning spoil. Even malignity will consent, O Bolt-armed Hero, unto us.

verses.sa:
सत्यमिद्वा उ तं वयमिन्द्रं स्तवाम नानृतम् ।
महाँ असुन्वतो वधो भूरि ज्योतींषि सुन्वतो भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः॥
verses.tr: satyamidvā u taṃ vayamindraṃ stavāma nānṛtam mahāṃ asunvato vadho bhūri jyotīṃṣi sunvato bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ
verses.en: Let us extol this Indra as truthful and never as untrue. Dire is his death who pours no gifts great light hath he who offers them. Good are the gifts that Indra gives.

verses.sa: स पूर्व्यो महानां वेनः क्रतुभिरानजे । यस्य द्वारा मनुष्पिता देवेषु धिय आनजे॥
verses.tr: sa pūrvyo mahānāṃ venaḥ kratubhirānaje yasya dvārā manuṣpitā deveṣu dhiya ānaje
verses.en: With powers of Mighty Ones hath he, Ancient, Beloved, been equipped, Through whom the Father Manu made prayers efficacious with the Gods.

verses.sa: दिवो मानं नोत्सदन्त्सोमपृष्ठासो अद्रयः । उक्था ब्रह्म च शंस्या॥
verses.tr: divo mānaṃ notsadantsomapṛṣṭhāso adrayaḥ ukthā brahma ca śaṃsyā
verses.en: Him, Maker of the sky, let stones wet with the Soma ne'er forsake, Nor hymns and prayer that must be said.

verses.sa: स विद्वाँ अङ्गिरोभ्य इन्द्रो गा अवृणोदप । स्तुषे तदस्य पौंस्यम्॥
verses.tr: sa vidvāṃ aṅgirobhya indro gā avṛṇodapa stuṣe tadasya pauṃsyam
verses.en: Indra who knew full well disclosed the kine to the Angirases. This his great deed must be extolled.

verses.sa: स प्रत्नथा कविवृध इन्द्रो वाकस्य वक्षणिः । शिवो अर्कस्य होमन्यस्मत्रा गन्त्ववसे॥
verses.tr: sa pratnathā kavivṛdha indro vākasya vakṣaṇiḥ śivo arkasya homanyasmatrā gantvavase
verses.en: Indra, promoter of the song, the sage's Strengthener as of old, Shall come to bless and succour us at presentation of this laud.

verses.sa: आदू नु ते अनु क्रतुं स्वाहा वरस्य यज्यवः । श्वात्रमर्का अनूषतेन्द्र गोत्रस्य दावने॥
verses.tr: ādū nu te anu kratuṃ svāhā varasya yajyavaḥ śvātramarkā anūṣatendra gotrasya dāvane
verses.en: Now after their desire's intent the pious singers with the cry Of Hail! have sung loud hymns to thee, Indra, to gain a stall of kine.

verses.sa: इन्द्रे विश्वानि वीर्या कृतानि कर्त्वानि च । यमर्का अध्वरं विदुः॥
verses.tr: indre viśvāni vīryā kṛtāni kartvāni ca yamarkā adhvaraṃ viduḥ
verses.en: With Indra rest all deeds of might, deeds done and yet to be performed, Whom singers know devoid of guile.

verses.sa: यत्पाञ्चजन्यया विशेन्द्रे घोषा असृक्षत । अस्तृणाद्बर्हणा विपो३ऽर्यो मानस्य स क्षयः॥
verses.tr: yatpāñcajanyayā viśendre ghoṣā asṛkṣata astṛṇādbarhaṇā vipo3'ryo mānasya sa kṣayaḥ
verses.en: When the Five Tribes with all their men to Indra have sent out their voice, And when the priest hath strewn much grass, this is the Friend's own dwelling place.

verses.sa: इयमु ते अनुष्टुतिश्चकृषे तानि पौंस्या । प्रावश्चक्रस्य वर्तनिम्॥
verses.tr: iyamu te anuṣṭutiścakṛṣe tāni pauṃsyā prāvaścakrasya vartanim
verses.en: This praise is verily thine own: thou hast performed these manly deeds, And sped the wheel upon its way.

verses.sa: अस्य वृष्णो व्योदन उरु क्रमिष्ट जीवसे । यवं न पश्व आ ददे॥
verses.tr: asya vṛṣṇo vyodana uru kramiṣṭa jīvase yavaṃ na paśva ā dade
verses.en: At the o'er flowing of this Steer, boldly he strode for life, and took Soma as cattle take their corn.

verses.sa: तद्दधाना अवस्यवो युष्माभिर्दक्षपितरः । स्याम मरुत्वतो वृधे॥
verses.tr: taddadhānā avasyavo yuṣmābhirdakṣapitaraḥ syāma marutvato vṛdhe
verses.en: Receiving this and craving help, we, who with you are Daksa's sons, Would fain exalt the Maruts' Lord.

verses.sa: बळृत्वियाय धाम्न ऋक्वभिः शूर नोनुमः । जेषामेन्द्र त्वया युजा॥
verses.tr: baḻṛtviyāya dhāmna ṛkvabhiḥ śūra nonumaḥ jeṣāmendra tvayā yujā
verses.en: Yea, Hero, with the singers we sing.to the duly-coming Band. Allied with thee may we prevail.

verses.sa:
अस्मे रुद्रा मेहना पर्वतासो वृत्रहत्ये भरहूतौ सजोषाः ।
यः शंसते स्तुवते धायि पज्र इन्द्रज्येष्ठा अस्माँ अवन्तु देवाः॥
verses.tr: asme rudrā mehanā parvatāso vṛtrahatye bharahūtau sajoṣāḥ yaḥ śaṃsate stuvate dhāyi pajra indrajyeṣṭhā asmāṃ avantu devāḥ
verses.en: With us are raining Rudras, clouds accordant in call to battle, at the death of Vrtra, The strong assigned to him who sings and praises. May Gods with Indra at their head protect us.

verses.sa: उत्त्वा मन्दन्तु स्तोमाः कृणुष्व राधो अद्रिवः । अव ब्रह्मद्विषो जहि॥
verses.tr: uttvā mandantu stomāḥ kṛṇuṣva rādho adrivaḥ ava brahmadviṣo jahi
verses.en: May our hymns give thee great delight. Display thy bounty, Thunderer. Drive off the enemies of prayer.

verses.sa: पदा पणीँरराधसो नि बाधस्व महाँ असि । नहि त्वा कश्चन प्रति॥
verses.tr: padā paṇīṃrarādhaso ni bādhasva mahāṃ asi nahi tvā kaścana prati
verses.en: Crush with thy foot the niggard churls who bring no gifts. Mighty art thou There is not one to equal thee.

verses.sa: त्वमीशिषे सुतानामिन्द्र त्वमसुतानाम् । त्वं राजा जनानाम्॥
verses.tr: tvamīśiṣe sutānāmindra tvamasutānām tvaṃ rājā janānām
verses.en: Thou art the Lord of Soma pressed, Soma impressed is also thine. Thou art the Sovran of the folk.

verses.sa: एहि प्रेहि क्षयो दिव्या३घोषञ्चर्षणीनाम् । ओभे पृणासि रोदसी॥
verses.tr: ehi prehi kṣayo divyā3ghoṣañcarṣaṇīnām obhe pṛṇāsi rodasī
verses.en: Come, go thou forth, dwelling in heaven and listening to the prayers of men: Thou fillest both the heavens and earth.

verses.sa: त्यं चित्पर्वतं गिरिं शतवन्तं सहस्रिणम् । वि स्तोतृभ्यो रुरोजिथ॥
verses.tr: tyaṃ citparvataṃ giriṃ śatavantaṃ sahasriṇam vi stotṛbhyo rurojitha
verses.en: Even that hill with rocky heights, with hundreds, thousands, held within. Thou for thy worshippers brakest through.

verses.sa: वयमु त्वा दिवा सुते वयं नक्तं हवामहे । अस्माकं काममा पृण॥
verses.tr: vayamu tvā divā sute vayaṃ naktaṃ havāmahe asmākaṃ kāmamā pṛṇa
verses.en: We call on thee both night and day to taste the flowing Soma juice: Do thou fulfil our heart's desire.

verses.sa: क्व१ स्य वृषभो युवा तुविग्रीवो अनानतः । ब्रह्मा कस्तं सपर्यति॥
verses.tr: kva1 sya vṛṣabho yuvā tuvigrīvo anānataḥ brahmā kastaṃ saparyati
verses.en: Where is that ever-youthful Steer, strong. necked and never yet bent down? What Brahman ministers to him?

verses.sa: कस्य स्वित्सवनं वृषा जुजुष्वाँ अव गच्छति । इन्द्रं क उ स्विदा चके॥
verses.tr: kasya svitsavanaṃ vṛṣā jujuṣvāṃ ava gacchati indraṃ ka u svidā cake
verses.en: To whose libation doth the Steer, betake him with delight therein? Who takes delight in Indra now?

verses.sa: कं ते दाना असक्षत वृत्रहन्कं सुवीर्या । उक्थे क उ स्विदन्तमः॥
verses.tr: kaṃ te dānā asakṣata vṛtrahankaṃ suvīryā ukthe ka u svidantamaḥ
verses.en: Whom, Vrtra-slayer, have thy gift and hero powers accompanied? Who is thy dearest in the laud?

verses.sa: अयं ते मानुषे जने सोमः पूरुषु सूयते । तस्येहि प्र द्रवा पिब॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ te mānuṣe jane somaḥ pūruṣu sūyate tasyehi pra dravā piba
verses.en: For thee among mankind, among the Purus is this Soma shed. Hasten thou hither: drink thereof.

verses.sa: अयं ते शर्यणावति सुषोमायामधि प्रियः । आर्जीकीये मदिन्तमः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ te śaryaṇāvati suṣomāyāmadhi priyaḥ ārjīkīye madintamaḥ
verses.en: This, growing by Soma and by Saryanavan, dear to thee, In Arjikiya, cheers thee best.

verses.sa: तमद्य राधसे महे चारुं मदाय घृष्वये । एहीमिन्द्र द्रवा पिब॥
verses.tr: tamadya rādhase mahe cāruṃ madāya ghṛṣvaye ehīmindra dravā piba
verses.en: Hasten thou hitherward, and drink this for munificence to-day, Delightful for thine eager draught.

verses.sa:
१२  प्रगाथः काण्वः। इन्द्रः । गायत्री ।
यदिन्द्र प्रागपागुदङ्न्यग्वा हूयसे नृभिः । आ याहि तूयमाशुभिः॥
verses.tr: 12 pragāthaḥ kāṇvaḥ indraḥ gāyatrī yadindra prāgapāgudaṅnyagvā hūyase nṛbhiḥ ā yāhi tūyamāśubhiḥ
verses.en: Though, Indra, thou art called by men from east and west, from north and south, Come hither quickly with fleet steeds

verses.sa: यद्वा प्रस्रवणे दिवो मादयासे स्वर्णरे । यद्वा समुद्रे अन्धसः॥
verses.tr: yadvā prasravaṇe divo mādayāse svarṇare yadvā samudre andhasaḥ
verses.en: If in the effluence of heaven, rich in its light, thou takest joy, Or in the sea in Soma juice.

verses.sa: आ त्वा गीर्भिर्महामुरुं हुवे गामिव भोजसे । इन्द्र सोमस्य पीतये॥
verses.tr: ā tvā gīrbhirmahāmuruṃ huve gāmiva bhojase indra somasya pītaye
verses.en: With songs I call thee, Great and Wide, even as a cow to profit us, Indra, to drink the Soma-draught.

verses.sa: आ त इन्द्र महिमानं हरयो देव ते महः । रथे वहन्तु बिभ्रतः॥
verses.tr: ā ta indra mahimānaṃ harayo deva te mahaḥ rathe vahantu bibhrataḥ
verses.en: Hither, O Indra, let thy Bays bear up and, bring upon thy car Thy glory, God! and majesty.

verses.sa: इन्द्र गृणीष उ स्तुषे महाँ उग्र ईशानकृत् । एहि नः सुतं पिब॥
verses.tr: indra gṛṇīṣa u stuṣe mahāṃ ugra īśānakṛt ehi naḥ sutaṃ piba
verses.en: Thou, Indra, wouldst be sung and praised as great, strong, lordly in thy deeds Come hither, drink our Soma juice.

verses.sa: सुतावन्तस्त्वा वयं प्रयस्वन्तो हवामहे । इदं नो बर्हिरासदे॥
verses.tr: sutāvantastvā vayaṃ prayasvanto havāmahe idaṃ no barhirāsade
verses.en: We who have shed the Soma and prepared the feast are calling thee. To sit on this our sacred grass.

verses.sa: यच्चिद्धि शश्वतामसीन्द्र साधारणस्त्वम् । तं त्वा वयं हवामहे॥
verses.tr: yacciddhi śaśvatāmasīndra sādhāraṇastvam taṃ tvā vayaṃ havāmahe
verses.en: As, Indra, thou art evermore the common Lord of all alike, As such we invocate thee now.

verses.sa: इदं ते सोम्यं मध्वधुक्षन्नद्रिभिर्नरः । जुषाण इन्द्र तत्पिब॥
verses.tr: idaṃ te somyaṃ madhvadhukṣannadribhirnaraḥ juṣāṇa indra tatpiba
verses.en: The men with stones have milked for thee this nectar of the Soma juice: Indra, be pleased with it, and drink.

verses.sa: विश्वाँ अर्यो विपश्चितोऽति ख्यस्तूयमा गहि । अस्मे धेहि श्रवो बृहत्॥
verses.tr: viśvāṃ aryo vipaścito'ti khyastūyamā gahi asme dhehi śravo bṛhat
verses.en: Neglect all pious men with skill in sacred song: come hitherward, With speed, and give us high renown.

verses.sa: दाता मे पृषतीनां राजा हिरण्यवीनाम् । मा देवा मघवा रिषत्॥
verses.tr: dātā me pṛṣatīnāṃ rājā hiraṇyavīnām mā devā maghavā riṣat
verses.en: Gods, may the mighty rest unharmed, the King who gives me spotted kine, Kine decked with golden ornaments.

verses.sa: सहस्रे पृषतीनामधि श्चन्द्रं बृहत्पृथु । शुक्रं हिरण्यमा ददे॥
verses.tr: sahasre pṛṣatīnāmadhi ścandraṃ bṛhatpṛthu śukraṃ hiraṇyamā dade
verses.en: Beside a thousand spotted kine I have received a gift of gold, Pure, brilliant, and exceeding great.

verses.sa: नपातो दुर्गहस्य मे सहस्रेण सुराधसः । श्रवो देवेष्वक्रत॥
verses.tr: napāto durgahasya me sahasreṇa surādhasaḥ śravo deveṣvakrata
verses.en: Durgaha's grandsons, giving me a thousand kine, munificent, Have won renown among the Gods.

sections.label: To Indra
sections.name: Mandala 8, hymn 66
intro: The Sanskrit of this hymn is missing from our source, so only the English is given.

verses.en: Loud singing at the sacred rite where Soma flows we priests invoke With haste, that he may help, as the bard's Cherisher, Indra who findeth wealth for you.
Whom with fair helm, in rapture of the juice, the firm resistless slayers hinder not: Giver of glorious wealth to him who sing a his praise, honouring him who toils and pours:
Sakra, who like a curry-comb for horses or a golden goad, Indra, the Vrtra-slayer, urges eagerly the opening of the stall of kine:
Who for the worshipper scatters forth ample wealth, even though buried, piled in heaps: May Indra, Lord of Bay Steeds, fair-helmed Thunderer, act at his pleasure, as he lists.
Hero whom many praise, what thou hast longed for, oven of old, from men. All that we offer unto thee, O Indra, now, sacrifice, laud, effectual speech.
To Soma, Much-invoked, Bolt-armed! for thy carouse, Celestial, Soma-drinker come. Thou to the man who- prays and pours the juice hast been best giver of delightful wealth.
Here, verily, yesterday we let the Thunder-wielder drink his fill. So in like manner offer him the juice today. Now range you by the Glorious One.
Even the wolf, the savage beast that rends the sheep, follows the path of his decrees. So graciously accepting, Indra, this our praise, with wondrous thought come forth to us.
What manly deed of vigour now remains that Indra hath not done? Who hath not heard his glorious title and his fame, the Vrtra-slayer from his birth?
'How great his power resistless! how invincible the Vrtra-slayer's matchless might! Indra excels all usurers who see the day, excels all traffickers in strength.
O Indra, Vrtra-slayer, we, thy very constant worshippers, Bring prayers ne'er heard before to thee, O Much-invoked, O Thunder-armed, to be thy mead.
O thou of mighty acts, the aids that are in thee call forward many an eager hope. Past the drink-offerings, Vasu, even of the good, hear my call, Strongest God, and come.
Verily, Indra, we are thine, we worshippers depend on thee. For there is none but only thou to show us race, O Maghavan, thou much invoked.
From this our misery and famine set us free, from this dire curse deliver us. Succour us with thine help and with thy wondrous thought. Most Mighty, finder of the way.
Now let your Soma juice be poured; be not afraid, O Kali's sons. This darkening sorrow goes away; yea, of itself it vanishes.

sections.label: To Indra
sections.name: Mandala 8, hymn 67
intro: The Sanskrit of this hymn in our source is divided differently, so only the English is given.

verses.en: Now pray we to these Ksatriyas, to the Adityas for their aid, These who are gracious to assist.
May Mitra bear us oer distress, and Varuna and Aryaman, Yea, the Adityas, as they know.
For wonderful and meet for praise is these Adityas' saving help To him who offers and prepares.
The mighty aid of you, the Great, Varuna, Mitra, Aryarnan, We claim to be our sure defence.
Guard us, Adityas, still alive, before the deadly weapon strike: Are ye not they who hear our call?
What sheltering defense ye have for him who toils in pouring gifts, Graciously bless ye us therewith.
Adityas, Gods, from sorrow there is freedom; for the sinless, wealth, O ye in whom no fault is seen.
Let not this fetter bind us fast: may he release us for success; For strong is Indra and renowned.
O Gods who fain would lend your aid, destroy not us as ye destroy Your enemies who go astray.
And thee too, O Great Aditi, thee also, Goddess, I address, Thee very gracious to assist.
Save us in depth and shallow from the foe, thbu Mother of Strong Sons Let no one of our seed be harmed.
Far-spread! wide-ruling! grant that we, unharmed by envy, may expand Grant that our progeny may live.
Those who, the Princes of the folk, in native glory, ne'er deceived, Maintain their statutes, void of guilt-
As such, from mouth of ravening wolves, O ye Adityas, rescue us, Like a bound thief, O Aditi.
Adityas, let this arrow, yea, let this malignity depart From us or e'er it strike us dead.
Fori Bountiful Adityas, we have evermore enjoyed your help, Both now and in die days of old.
To every one, O ye Most Wise, who turneth even from sin to you, Ye Gods vouchsafe that he may live.
May this new mercy profit us, which, ye Adityas, frees like one, Bound from his bonds, O Aditi.
O ye Adityas, this your might is not to be despised by us: So be ye graciously inclined.
Let not Vivasvan's weapon nor the shaft, Adityas, wrought with skill, Destroy us ere old age be nigh.
On every side dispel all sin, Adityas, all hostility, Indigence, and combined attack.

verses.sa: आ त्वा रथं यथोतये सुम्नाय वर्तयामसि । तुविकूर्मिमृतीषहमिन्द्र शविष्ठ सत्पते॥
verses.tr: ā tvā rathaṃ yathotaye sumnāya vartayāmasi tuvikūrmimṛtīṣahamindra śaviṣṭha satpate
verses.en: Even as a car to give us aid, we draw thee hither for our bliss, Strong in thy deeds, checking assault, Lord, Mightiest Indra, of the brave!

verses.sa: तुविशुष्म तुविक्रतो शचीवो विश्वया मते । आ पप्राथ महित्वना॥
verses.tr: tuviśuṣma tuvikrato śacīvo viśvayā mate ā paprātha mahitvanā
verses.en: Great in thy power and wisdom, Strong, with thought that comprehendeth all Thou hast filled full with majesty.

verses.sa: यस्य ते महिना महः परि ज्मायन्तमीयतुः । हस्ता वज्रं हिरण्ययम्॥
verses.tr: yasya te mahinā mahaḥ pari jmāyantamīyatuḥ hastā vajraṃ hiraṇyayam
verses.en: Thou very Mighty One, whose hands by virtue of thy greatness grasp, The golden bolt that breaks its way.

verses.sa: विश्वानरस्य वस्पतिमनानतस्य शवसः । एवैश्च चर्षणीनामूती हुवे रथानाम्॥
verses.tr: viśvānarasya vaspatimanānatasya śavasaḥ evaiśca carṣaṇīnāmūtī huve rathānām
verses.en: Your Lord of might that ne'er hath bent, that ruleth over all mankind, I call, that he, as he is wont, may aid the chariots and the men.

verses.sa: अभिष्टये सदावृधं स्वर्मीळ्हेषु यं नरः । नाना हवन्त ऊतये॥
verses.tr: abhiṣṭaye sadāvṛdhaṃ svarmīḻheṣu yaṃ naraḥ nānā havanta ūtaye
verses.en: Whom, ever furthering, in frays that win the light, in both the hosts Men call to succour and to help.

verses.sa: परोमात्रमृचीषममिन्द्रमुग्रं सुराधसम् । ईशानं चिद्वसूनाम्॥
verses.tr: paromātramṛcīṣamamindramugraṃ surādhasam īśānaṃ cidvasūnām
verses.en: Indra, the Strong, the measureless, worthy of praise, Most Bountiful, Sole Ruler even over wealth.

verses.sa: तंतमिद्राधसे मह इन्द्रं चोदामि पीतये । यः पूर्व्यामनुष्टुतिमीशे कृष्टीनां नृतुः॥
verses.tr: taṃtamidrādhase maha indraṃ codāmi pītaye yaḥ pūrvyāmanuṣṭutimīśe kṛṣṭīnāṃ nṛtuḥ
verses.en: Him, for his ample bounty, him, this Indra do I urge to drink, Who, as his praise was sung of old, the Dancer, is the Lord of men.

verses.sa: न यस्य ते शवसान सख्यमानंश मर्त्यः । नकिः शवांसि ते नशत्॥
verses.tr: na yasya te śavasāna sakhyamānaṃśa martyaḥ nakiḥ śavāṃsi te naśat
verses.en: Thou Mighty One, whose friendship none of mortals ever hath obtained None will attain unto thy might.

verses.sa: त्वोतासस्त्वा युजाऽप्सु सूर्ये महद्धनम् । जयेम पृत्सु वज्रिवः॥
verses.tr: tvotāsastvā yujā'psu sūrye mahaddhanam jayema pṛtsu vajrivaḥ
verses.en: Aided by thee, with thee allied, in frays for water and for sun, Bolt-armed! may we win ample spoil.

verses.sa: तं त्वा यज्ञेभिरीमहे तं गीर्भिर्गिर्वणस्तम । इन्द्र यथा चिदाविथ वाजेषु पुरुमाय्यम्॥
verses.tr: taṃ tvā yajñebhirīmahe taṃ gīrbhirgirvaṇastama indra yathā cidāvitha vājeṣu purumāyyam
verses.en: So seek we thee with sacrifice and songs, chief Lover of the Song, As, in our battles Indra, thou to Purumayya gavest help.

verses.sa: यस्य ते स्वादु सख्यं स्वाद्वी प्रणीतिरद्रिवः । यज्ञो वितन्तसाय्यः॥
verses.tr: yasya te svādu sakhyaṃ svādvī praṇītiradrivaḥ yajño vitantasāyyaḥ
verses.en: O Thunderer, thou whose friendship and whose onward guidance both are sweet, Thy sacrifice must be prepared.

verses.sa: उरु णस्तन्वे३ तन उरु क्षयाय नस्कृधि । उरु णो यन्धि जीवसे॥
verses.tr: uru ṇastanve3 tana uru kṣayāya naskṛdhi uru ṇo yandhi jīvase
verses.en: To us, ourselves, give ample room, give for our dwelling ample room Give ample room to us to live.

verses.sa: उरुं नृभ्य उरुं गव उरुं रथाय पन्थाम् । देववीतिं मनामहे॥
verses.tr: uruṃ nṛbhya uruṃ gava uruṃ rathāya panthām devavītiṃ manāmahe
verses.en: We count the banquet of the Gods a spacious pathway for the men, And for the cattle, and the car.

verses.sa: उप मा षड्द्वाद्वा नरः सोमस्य हर्ष्या । तिष्ठन्ति स्वादुरातयः॥
verses.tr: upa mā ṣaḍdvādvā naraḥ somasya harṣyā tiṣṭhanti svādurātayaḥ
verses.en: Six men, yea, two and two, made glad with Soma juice, come near to me With offerings pleasant to the taste.

verses.sa: ऋज्राविन्द्रोत आ ददे हरी ऋक्षस्य सूनवि । आश्वमेधस्य रोहिता॥
verses.tr: ṛjrāvindrota ā dade harī ṛkṣasya sūnavi āśvamedhasya rohitā
verses.en: Two brown-hued steeds, Indrota's gift, two bays from Rksa's son were mine, From Asvamedha's son two red.

verses.sa: सुरथाँ आतिथिग्वे स्वभीशूँरार्क्षे । आश्वमेधे सुपेशसः॥
verses.tr: surathāṃ ātithigve svabhīśūṃrārkṣe āśvamedhe supeśasaḥ
verses.en: From Atithigva good car-steeds; from Arksa rein-obeying steeds, From Asvamedha beauteous ones.

verses.sa: षळश्वाँ आतिथिग्व इन्द्रोते वधूमतः । सचा पूतक्रतौ सनम्॥
verses.tr: ṣaḻaśvāṃ ātithigva indrote vadhūmataḥ sacā pūtakratau sanam
verses.en: Indrota, Atithigva's son, gave me six horses matched with mares And Patakratu gave besides.

verses.sa: ऐषु चेतद्वृषण्वत्यन्तॠज्रेष्वरुषी । स्वभीशुः कशावती॥
verses.tr: aiṣu cetadvṛṣaṇvatyantaṝjreṣvaruṣī svabhīśuḥ kaśāvatī
verses.en: Marked above all, amid the brown, is the red mare Vrsanvati, Obedient to the rein and whip.

verses.sa: न युष्मे वाजबन्धवो निनित्सुश्चन मर्त्यः । अवद्यमधि दीधरत्॥
verses.tr: na yuṣme vājabandhavo ninitsuścana martyaḥ avadyamadhi dīdharat
verses.en: O bound to me by deeds of might, not even the man who loves to blame. Hath found a single fault in you.

verses.sa:
( उत्तरार्धस्य ) – १२ वरुणः । अनुष्टुप् , २ उष्णिक् ,४-६ गायत्री , ११,१६ पंक्तिः, १७- १८ बृहती ।
प्रप्र वस्त्रिष्टुभमिषं मन्दद्वीरायेन्दवे । धिया वो मेधसातये पुरंध्या विवासति॥
verses.tr: ( uttarārdhasya ) – 12 varuṇaḥ anuṣṭup , 2 uṣṇik ,4-6 gāyatrī , 11,16 paṃktiḥ, 17- 18 bṛhatī prapra vastriṣṭubhamiṣaṃ mandadvīrāyendave dhiyā vo medhasātaye puraṃdhyā vivāsati
verses.en: I SEND you forth the song of praise for Indu, hero-gladdener. With hymn and plenty he invites you to complete the sacrifice.

verses.sa: नदं व ओदतीनां नदं योयुवतीनाम् । पतिं वो अघ्न्यानां धेनूनामिषुध्यसि॥
verses.tr: nadaṃ va odatīnāṃ nadaṃ yoyuvatīnām patiṃ vo aghnyānāṃ dhenūnāmiṣudhyasi
verses.en: Thou wishest for thy kine a bull, for those who long for his approach, For those who turn away from him, lord of thy cows whom none may kill.

verses.sa: ता अस्य सूददोहसः सोमं श्रीणन्ति पृश्नयः । जन्मन्देवानां विशस्त्रिष्वा रोचने दिवः॥
verses.tr: tā asya sūdadohasaḥ somaṃ śrīṇanti pṛśnayaḥ janmandevānāṃ viśastriṣvā rocane divaḥ
verses.en: The dappled kine who stream with milk prepare his draught of Soma juice: Clans in the birth-place of the Gods, in the three luminous realms of heaven.

verses.sa: अभि प्र गोपतिं गिरेन्द्रमर्च यथा विदे । सूनुं सत्यस्य सत्पतिम्॥
verses.tr: abhi pra gopatiṃ girendramarca yathā vide sūnuṃ satyasya satpatim
verses.en: Praise, even as he is known, with song Indra the guardian of the kine, The Son of Truth, Lord of the brave.

verses.sa: आ हरयः ससृज्रिरेऽरुषीरधि बर्हिषि । यत्राभि संनवामहे॥
verses.tr: ā harayaḥ sasṛjrire'ruṣīradhi barhiṣi yatrābhi saṃnavāmahe
verses.en: Hither his Bay Steeds have been sent, red Steeds are on the sacred grass,, Where we in concert sing our songs.

verses.sa: इन्द्राय गाव आशिरं दुदुह्रे वज्रिणे मधु । यत्सीमुपह्वरे विदत्॥
verses.tr: indrāya gāva āśiraṃ duduhre vajriṇe madhu yatsīmupahvare vidat
verses.en: For Indra Thunder-armed the kine have yielded mingled milk and meath, What time he found them in the vault.

verses.sa: उद्यद्ब्रध्नस्य विष्टपं गृहमिन्द्रश्च गन्वहि । मध्वः पीत्वा सचेवहि त्रिः सप्त सख्युः पदे॥
verses.tr: udyadbradhnasya viṣṭapaṃ gṛhamindraśca ganvahi madhvaḥ pītvā sacevahi triḥ sapta sakhyuḥ pade
verses.en: When I and Indra mount on high up to the Bright One's place and home, We, having drunk of meath, will reach his seat whose Friends are three times seven.

verses.sa: अर्चत प्रार्चत प्रियमेधासो अर्चत । अर्चन्तु पुत्रका उत पुरं न धृष्ण्वर्चत॥
verses.tr: arcata prārcata priyamedhāso arcata arcantu putrakā uta puraṃ na dhṛṣṇvarcata
verses.en: Sing, sing ye forth your songs of praise, ye Briyamedhas, sing your songs: Yea, let young children sing their lauds as a strong castle praise ye him.

verses.sa: अव स्वराति गर्गरो गोधा परि सनिष्वणत् । पिङ्गा परि चनिष्कददिन्द्राय ब्रह्मोद्यतम्॥
