verses.tr: ava svarāti gargaro godhā pari saniṣvaṇat piṅgā pari caniṣkadadindrāya brahmodyatam
verses.en: Now loudly let the viol sound, the lute send out its voice with might, Shrill be the music of the string. To Indra is the hymn up-raised.

verses.sa: आ यत्पतन्त्येन्यः सुदुघा अनपस्फुरः । अपस्फुरं गृभायत सोममिन्द्राय पातवे॥
verses.tr: ā yatpatantyenyaḥ sudughā anapasphuraḥ apasphuraṃ gṛbhāyata somamindrāya pātave
verses.en: When hither speed the dappled cows, unflinching, easy to be milked, Seize quickly, as it bursts away, the Soma juice for Indra's drink.

verses.sa: अपादिन्द्रो अपादग्निर्विश्वे देवा अमत्सत । वरुण इदिह क्षयत्तमापो अभ्यनूषत वत्सं संशिश्वरीरिव॥
verses.tr: apādindro apādagnirviśve devā amatsata varuṇa idiha kṣayattamāpo abhyanūṣata vatsaṃ saṃśiśvarīriva
verses.en: Indra hath drunk, Agni hath drunk. all Deities have drunk their fill. Here Varuna shall have his home, to whom the floods have sung aloud as mother kine unto their calves.

verses.sa: सुदेवो असि वरुण यस्य ते सप्त सिन्धवः । अनुक्षरन्ति काकुदं सूर्म्यं सुषिरामिव॥
verses.tr: sudevo asi varuṇa yasya te sapta sindhavaḥ anukṣaranti kākudaṃ sūrmyaṃ suṣirāmiva
verses.en: Thou, Varuna, to whom belong Seven Rivers, art a glorious God. The waters flow into thy throat as 'twere a pipe with ample mouth.

verses.sa: यो व्यतीँरफाणयत्सुयुक्ताँ उप दाशुषे । तक्वो नेता तदिद्वपुरुपमा यो अमुच्यत॥
verses.tr: yo vyatīṃraphāṇayatsuyuktāṃ upa dāśuṣe takvo netā tadidvapurupamā yo amucyata
verses.en: He who hath made the fleet steeds spring, well-harnessed, to the worshipper, He, the swift Guide, is that fair form that loosed the horses near at hand.

verses.sa: अतीदु शक्र ओहत इन्द्रो विश्वा अति द्विषः । भिनत्कनीन ओदनं पच्यमानं परो गिरा॥
verses.tr: atīdu śakra ohata indro viśvā ati dviṣaḥ bhinatkanīna odanaṃ pacyamānaṃ paro girā
verses.en: Indra, the very Mighty, holds his enemies in utter scorn. He, far away, and yet a child, cleft the cloud smitten by his voice.

verses.sa: अर्भको न कुमारकोऽधि तिष्ठन्नवं रथम् । स पक्षन्महिषं मृगं पित्रे मात्रे विभुक्रतुम्॥
verses.tr: arbhako na kumārako'dhi tiṣṭhannavaṃ ratham sa pakṣanmahiṣaṃ mṛgaṃ pitre mātre vibhukratum
verses.en: He, yet a boy exceeding small, mounted his newly-fashioned car. He for his Mother and his Sire cooked the wild mighty buffalo.

verses.sa: आ तू सुशिप्र दम्पते रथं तिष्ठा हिरण्ययम् । अध द्युक्षं सचेवहि सहस्रपादमरुषं स्वस्तिगामनेहसम्॥
verses.tr: ā tū suśipra dampate rathaṃ tiṣṭhā hiraṇyayam adha dyukṣaṃ sacevahi sahasrapādamaruṣaṃ svastigāmanehasam
verses.en: Lord of the home, fair-helmeted, ascend thy chariot wrought of gold. We will attend the Heavenly One, the thousand-footed, red of hue, matchless, who blesses where he goes.

verses.sa: तं घेमित्था नमस्विन उप स्वराजमासते । अर्थं चिदस्य सुधितं यदेतव आवर्तयन्ति दावने॥
verses.tr: taṃ ghemitthā namasvina upa svarājamāsate arthaṃ cidasya sudhitaṃ yadetava āvartayanti dāvane
verses.en: With reverence they come hitherward to him as to. a Sovran lord, That they may bring him near for this man's good success, to prosper and bestow his gifts.

verses.sa: अनु प्रत्नस्यौकसः प्रियमेधास एषाम् । पूर्वामनु प्रयतिं वृक्तबर्हिषो हितप्रयस आशत॥
verses.tr: anu pratnasyaukasaḥ priyamedhāsa eṣām pūrvāmanu prayatiṃ vṛktabarhiṣo hitaprayasa āśata
verses.en: The Priyamedhas have observed the offering of the men of old, Of ancient custom, while they strewed the sacred grass, and spread their sacrificial food.

verses.sa: यो राजा चर्षणीनां याता रथेभिरध्रिगुः । विश्वासां तरुता पृतनानां ज्येष्ठो यो वृत्रहा गृणे॥
verses.tr: yo rājā carṣaṇīnāṃ yātā rathebhiradhriguḥ viśvāsāṃ tarutā pṛtanānāṃ jyeṣṭho yo vṛtrahā gṛṇe
verses.en: He who, as Sovran Lord of men, moves with his chariots unrestrained, The Vrtra-slayer vanquisher, of fighting hosts, preeminent, is praised with song.

verses.sa: इन्द्रं तं शुम्भ पुरुहन्मन्नवसे यस्य द्विता विधर्तरि । हस्ताय वज्रः प्रति धायि दर्शतो महो दिवे न सूर्यः॥
verses.tr: indraṃ taṃ śumbha puruhanmannavase yasya dvitā vidhartari hastāya vajraḥ prati dhāyi darśato maho dive na sūryaḥ
verses.en: Honour that Indra, Puruhanman! for his aid, in whose sustaining hand of old, The splendid bolt of thunder was deposited, as the great Sun was set in heaven.

verses.sa: नकिष्टं कर्मणा नशद्यश्चकार सदावृधम् । इन्द्रं न यज्ञैर्विश्वगूर्तमृभ्वसमधृष्टं धृष्ण्वोजसम्॥
verses.tr: nakiṣṭaṃ karmaṇā naśadyaścakāra sadāvṛdham indraṃ na yajñairviśvagūrtamṛbhvasamadhṛṣṭaṃ dhṛṣṇvojasam
verses.en: No one by deed attains to him who works and strengthens evermore: No, not by sacrifice, to Indra. praised o all, resistless, daring, bold in might.

verses.sa: अषाळ्हमुग्रं पृतनासु सासहिं यस्मिन्महीरुरुज्रयः । सं धेनवो जायमाने अनोनवुर्द्यावः क्षामो अनोनवुः॥
verses.tr: aṣāḻhamugraṃ pṛtanāsu sāsahiṃ yasminmahīrurujrayaḥ saṃ dhenavo jāyamāne anonavurdyāvaḥ kṣāmo anonavuḥ
verses.en: The potent Conqueror, invincible in war, him at whose birth the Mighty Ones, The Kine who spread afar, sent their loud voices out, heavens, earths seat their loud voices out,

verses.sa: यद्द्याव इन्द्र ते शतं शतं भूमीरुत स्युः । न त्वा वज्रिन्त्सहस्रं सूर्या अनु न जातमष्ट रोदसी॥
verses.tr: yaddyāva indra te śataṃ śataṃ bhūmīruta syuḥ na tvā vajrintsahasraṃ sūryā anu na jātamaṣṭa rodasī
verses.en: O Indra, if a hundred heavens and if a hundred earths were thine- No, not a thousand Suns could match thee at thy birth, not both the worlds, O Thunderer.

verses.sa: आ पप्राथ महिना वृष्ण्या वृषन्विश्वा शविष्ठ शवसा । अस्माँ अव मघवन्गोमति व्रजे वज्रिञ्चित्राभिरूतिभिः॥
verses.tr: ā paprātha mahinā vṛṣṇyā vṛṣanviśvā śaviṣṭha śavasā asmāṃ ava maghavangomati vraje vajriñcitrābhirūtibhiḥ
verses.en: Thou, Hero, hast performed thy hero deeds with might, yea, all with strength, O Strongest One. Maghavan, help us to a stable full of kine, O Thunderer, with wondrous aids.

verses.sa: न सीमदेव आपदिषं दीर्घायो मर्त्यः । एतग्वा चिद्य एतशा युयोजते हरी इन्द्रो युयोजते॥
verses.tr: na sīmadeva āpadiṣaṃ dīrghāyo martyaḥ etagvā cidya etaśā yuyojate harī indro yuyojate
verses.en: Let not a godless mortal gain this food, O thou whose life is long! But one who yokes the bright-hued steeds, the Etasas, even Indra yoker of the Bays.

verses.sa: तं वो महो महाय्यमिन्द्रं दानाय सक्षणिम् । यो गाधेषु य आरणेषु हव्यो वाजेष्वस्ति हव्यः॥
verses.tr: taṃ vo maho mahāyyamindraṃ dānāya sakṣaṇim yo gādheṣu ya āraṇeṣu havyo vājeṣvasti havyaḥ
verses.en: Urge ye the Conqueror to give, your Indra greatly to be praised, To be invoked in shallow waters and in depths, to be invoked in deeds of might.

verses.sa: उदू षु णो वसो महे मृशस्व शूर राधसे । उदू षु मह्यै मघवन्मघत्तय उदिन्द्र श्रवसे महे॥
verses.tr: udū ṣu ṇo vaso mahe mṛśasva śūra rādhase udū ṣu mahyai maghavanmaghattaya udindra śravase mahe
verses.en: O Vasu, O thou Hero, raise us up to ample opulence. Raise us to gain of mighty wealth, O Maghavan, O Indra, to sublime renown.

verses.sa: त्वं न इन्द्र ऋतयुस्त्वानिदो नि तृम्पसि । मध्ये वसिष्व तुविनृम्णोर्वोर्नि दासं शिश्नथो हथैः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ na indra ṛtayustvānido ni tṛmpasi madhye vasiṣva tuvinṛmṇorvorni dāsaṃ śiśnatho hathaiḥ
verses.en: Indra, thou justifiest us, and tramplest down thy slanderers. Guard thyself, valiant Hero, in thy vital parts: strike down the Dasa with thy blows.

verses.sa: अन्यव्रतममानुषमयज्वानमदेवयुम् । अव स्वः सखा दुधुवीत पर्वतः सुघ्नाय दस्युं पर्वतः॥
verses.tr: anyavratamamānuṣamayajvānamadevayum ava svaḥ sakhā dudhuvīta parvataḥ sughnāya dasyuṃ parvataḥ
verses.en: The man who brings no sacrifice, inhuman, godless, infidel, Him let his friend the mountain cast to rapid death, the mountain cast the Dasyu down.

verses.sa: त्वं न इन्द्रासां हस्ते शविष्ठ दावने । धानानां न सं गृभायास्मयुर्द्विः सं गृभायास्मयुः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ na indrāsāṃ haste śaviṣṭha dāvane dhānānāṃ na saṃ gṛbhāyāsmayurdviḥ saṃ gṛbhāyāsmayuḥ
verses.en: O Mightiest Indra, loving us, gather thou up, as grains of corn, Within thine hand, of these their kine, to give away, yea, gather twice as loving us.

verses.sa: सखायः क्रतुमिच्छत कथा राधाम शरस्य । उपस्तुतिं भोजः सूरिर्यो अह्रयः॥
verses.tr: sakhāyaḥ kratumicchata kathā rādhāma śarasya upastutiṃ bhojaḥ sūriryo ahrayaḥ
verses.en: O my companions, wish for power. How may we perfect Sara's praise, The liberal princely patron, never to be harmed?

verses.sa: भूरिभिः समह ऋषिभिर्बर्हिष्मद्भिः स्तविष्यसे । यदित्थमेकमेकमिच्छर वत्सान्पराददः॥
verses.tr: bhūribhiḥ samaha ṛṣibhirbarhiṣmadbhiḥ staviṣyase yaditthamekamekamicchara vatsānparādadaḥ
verses.en: By many a sage whose grass is trimmed thou art continually praised, That thou, O Sara, hast bestowed here one and here another calf.

verses.sa: कर्णगृह्या मघवा शौरदेव्यो वत्सं नस्त्रिभ्य आनयत् । अजां सूरिर्न धातवे॥
verses.tr: karṇagṛhyā maghavā śauradevyo vatsaṃ nastribhya ānayat ajāṃ sūrirna dhātave
verses.en: The noble, Suradeva's son, hath brought a calf, led by the car to three of us. As a chief brings a goat to milk.

verses.sa: त्वं नो अग्ने महोभिः पाहि विश्वस्या अरातेः । उत द्विषो मर्त्यस्य॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ no agne mahobhiḥ pāhi viśvasyā arāteḥ uta dviṣo martyasya
verses.en: O AGNI, with thy mighty wealth guard us from all malignity, Yea, from all hate of mortal man.

verses.sa: नहि मन्युः पौरुषेय ईशे हि वः प्रियजात । त्वमिदसि क्षपावान्॥
verses.tr: nahi manyuḥ pauruṣeya īśe hi vaḥ priyajāta tvamidasi kṣapāvān
verses.en: For over thee, O Friend from birth, the wrath of man hath no control: Nay, Guardian of the earth art thou.

verses.sa: स नो विश्वेभिर्देवेभिरूर्जो नपाद्भद्रशोचे । रयिं देहि विश्ववारम्॥
verses.tr: sa no viśvebhirdevebhirūrjo napādbhadraśoce rayiṃ dehi viśvavāram
verses.en: As such, with all the Gods, O Son of Strength, auspicious in thy flame. Give us wealth bringing all things good.

verses.sa: न तमग्ने अरातयो मर्तं युवन्त रायः । यं त्रायसे दाश्वांसम्॥
verses.tr: na tamagne arātayo martaṃ yuvanta rāyaḥ yaṃ trāyase dāśvāṃsam
verses.en: Malignities stay not from wealth the mortal man whom, Agni, thou Protectest while he offers gifts.

verses.sa: यं त्वं विप्र मेधसातावग्ने हिनोषि धनाय । स तवोती गोषु गन्ता॥
verses.tr: yaṃ tvaṃ vipra medhasātāvagne hinoṣi dhanāya sa tavotī goṣu gantā
verses.en: Sage Agni, be whom thou dost urge, in worship of the Gods, to wealth, With thine assistance winneth kine.

verses.sa: त्वं रयिं पुरुवीरमग्ने दाशुषे मर्ताय । प्र णो नय वस्यो अच्छ॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ rayiṃ puruvīramagne dāśuṣe martāya pra ṇo naya vasyo accha
verses.en: Riches with many heroes thou hast for the man who offers gifts: Lead thou us on to higher bliss.

verses.sa: उरुष्या णो मा परा दा अघायते जातवेदः । दुराध्ये३ मर्ताय॥
verses.tr: uruṣyā ṇo mā parā dā aghāyate jātavedaḥ durādhye3 martāya
verses.en: Save us, O Jatavedas, nor abandon us to him who sins, Unto the evil-hearted man.

verses.sa: अग्ने माकिष्टे देवस्य रातिमदेवो युयोत । त्वमीशिषे वसूनाम्॥
verses.tr: agne mākiṣṭe devasya rātimadevo yuyota tvamīśiṣe vasūnām
verses.en: O Agni, let no godless man avert thy bounty as a God: Over all treasures thou art Lord.

verses.sa: स नो वस्व उप मास्यूर्जो नपान्माहिनस्य । सखे वसो जरितृभ्यः॥
verses.tr: sa no vasva upa māsyūrjo napānmāhinasya sakhe vaso jaritṛbhyaḥ
verses.en: So, Son of Strength, thou aidest us to what is great and excellent. Those, Vasu! Friend! who sing thy praise.

verses.sa: अच्छा नः शीरशोचिषं गिरो यन्तु दर्शतम् । अच्छा यज्ञासो नमसा पुरूवसुं पुरुप्रशस्तमूतये॥
verses.tr: acchā naḥ śīraśociṣaṃ giro yantu darśatam acchā yajñāso namasā purūvasuṃ purupraśastamūtaye
verses.en: Let our songs come anear to him beauteous and bright with piercing flame Our offerings, with our homage, to the Lord of wealth, to him whom many praise, for help:

verses.sa: अग्निं सूनुं सहसो जातवेदसं दानाय वार्याणाम् । द्विता यो भूदमृतो मर्त्येष्वा होता मन्द्रतमो विशि॥
verses.tr: agniṃ sūnuṃ sahaso jātavedasaṃ dānāya vāryāṇām dvitā yo bhūdamṛto martyeṣvā hotā mandratamo viśi
verses.en: To Agni Jatavedas, to the Son of Strength, that he may give us precious gifts, Immortal, from of old Priest among mortal men, the most delightful in the house.

verses.sa: अग्निं वो देवयज्ययाऽग्निं प्रयत्यध्वरे । अग्निं धीषु प्रथममग्निमर्वत्यग्निं क्षैत्राय साधसे॥
verses.tr: agniṃ vo devayajyayā'gniṃ prayatyadhvare agniṃ dhīṣu prathamamagnimarvatyagniṃ kṣaitrāya sādhase
verses.en: Agni, made yours by sacrifice, Agni, while holy rites advance; Agni, the first in songs, first with the warrior steed; Agni to win the land for us.

verses.sa: अग्निरिषां सख्ये ददातु न ईशे यो वार्याणाम् । अग्निं तोके तनये शश्वदीमहे वसुं सन्तं तनूपाम्॥
verses.tr: agniriṣāṃ sakhye dadātu na īśe yo vāryāṇām agniṃ toke tanaye śaśvadīmahe vasuṃ santaṃ tanūpām
verses.en: May Agni who is Lord of wealth vouchsafe us food for friendship sake. Agni we ever seek for seed and progeny, the Vasu who protects our lives.

verses.sa: अग्निमीळिष्वावसे गाथाभिः शीरशोचिषम् । अग्निं राये पुरुमीळ्ह श्रुतं नरोऽग्निं सुदीतये छर्दिः॥
verses.tr: agnimīḻiṣvāvase gāthābhiḥ śīraśociṣam agniṃ rāye purumīḻha śrutaṃ naro'gniṃ sudītaye chardiḥ
verses.en: Solicit with your chants, for help, Agni the God with piercing flame, For riches famous Agni, Purumilha and ye men! Agni to light our dwelling well.

verses.sa: अग्निं द्वेषो योतवै नो गृणीमस्यग्निं शं योश्च दातवे । विश्वासु विक्ष्ववितेव हव्यो भुवद्वस्तुॠषूणाम्॥
verses.tr: agniṃ dveṣo yotavai no gṛṇīmasyagniṃ śaṃ yośca dātave viśvāsu vikṣvaviteva havyo bhuvadvastuṝṣūṇām
verses.en: Agni we laud that he may keep our foes afar, Agni to give us health and strength. Let him as Guardian be invoked in all the tribes, the lighter-up of glowing brands.

verses.sa: हविष्कृणुध्वमा गमदध्वर्युर्वनते पुनः । विद्वाँ अस्य प्रशासनम्॥
verses.tr: haviṣkṛṇudhvamā gamadadhvaryurvanate punaḥ vidvāṃ asya praśāsanam
verses.en: Prepare oblation: let him come; and let the minister serve again Who knows the ordering thereof,

verses.sa: नि तिग्ममभ्यं१शुं सीदद्धोता मनावधि । जुषाणो अस्य सख्यम्॥
verses.tr: ni tigmamabhyaṃ1śuṃ sīdaddhotā manāvadhi juṣāṇo asya sakhyam
verses.en: Rejoicing in his friendship, let the priest be seated over man, Beside the shoot of active power.

verses.sa: अन्तरिच्छन्ति तं जने रुद्रं परो मनीषया । गृभ्णन्ति जिह्वया ससम्॥
verses.tr: antaricchanti taṃ jane rudraṃ paro manīṣayā gṛbhṇanti jihvayā sasam
verses.en: Him, glowing bright beyond all thought, they seek among the race of man; With him for tongue they seize the food.

verses.sa: जाम्यतीतपे धनुर्वयोधा अरुहद्वनम् । दृषदं जिह्वयावधीत्॥
verses.tr: jāmyatītape dhanurvayodhā aruhadvanam dṛṣadaṃ jihvayāvadhīt
verses.en: He hath inflamed the twofold plain: lifegiving, he hath climbed the wood, And with his tongue hath struck the rock.

verses.sa: चरन्वत्सो रुशन्निह निदातारं न विन्दते । वेति स्तोतव अम्ब्यम्॥
verses.tr: caranvatso ruśanniha nidātāraṃ na vindate veti stotava ambyam
verses.en: Wandering here the radiant Calf finds none to fetter him, and seeks The Mother to declare his praise.

verses.sa: उतो न्वस्य यन्महदश्वावद्योजनं बृहद् । दामा रथस्य ददृशे॥
verses.tr: uto nvasya yanmahadaśvāvadyojanaṃ bṛhad dāmā rathasya dadṛśe
verses.en: And now that great and mighty team, the team of horses that are his, And traces of his car, are seen.

verses.sa: दुहन्ति सप्तैकामुप द्वा पञ्च सृजतः । तीर्थे सिन्धोरधि स्वरे॥
verses.tr: duhanti saptaikāmupa dvā pañca sṛjataḥ tīrthe sindhoradhi svare
verses.en: The seven milk a single cow; the two set other five to work, On the stream's loud-resounding bank.

verses.sa: आ दशभिर्विवस्वत इन्द्रः कोशमचुच्यवीत् । खेदया त्रिवृता दिवः॥
verses.tr: ā daśabhirvivasvata indraḥ kośamacucyavīt khedayā trivṛtā divaḥ
verses.en: Entreated by Vivasvan's ten, Indra cast down the water-jar With threefold hammer from the sky.

verses.sa: परि त्रिधातुरध्वरं जूर्णिरेति नवीयसी । मध्वा होतारो अञ्जते॥
verses.tr: pari tridhāturadhvaraṃ jūrṇireti navīyasī madhvā hotāro añjate
verses.en: Three times the newly-kindled flame proceeds around the sacrifice: The priests anoint it with the meath.

verses.sa: सिञ्चन्ति नमसावतमुच्चाचक्रं परिज्मानम् । नीचीनबारमक्षितम्॥
verses.tr: siñcanti namasāvatamuccācakraṃ parijmānam nīcīnabāramakṣitam
verses.en: With reverence they drain the fount that circles with its wheel above, Exhaustless, with the mouth below.

verses.sa: अभ्यारमिदद्रयो निषिक्तं पुष्करे मधु । अवतस्य विसर्जने॥
verses.tr: abhyāramidadrayo niṣiktaṃ puṣkare madhu avatasya visarjane
verses.en: The pressing-stones are set at work: the meath is poured into the tank, At the out-shedding of the fount.

verses.sa: गाव उपावतावतं मही यज्ञस्य रप्सुदा । उभा कर्णा हिरण्यया॥
verses.tr: gāva upāvatāvataṃ mahī yajñasya rapsudā ubhā karṇā hiraṇyayā
verses.en: Ye cows, protect the fount: the two Mighty Ones bless the sacrifice. The handles twain are wrought of gold.

verses.sa: आ सुते सिञ्चत श्रियं रोदस्योरभिश्रियम् । रसा दधीत वृषभम्॥
verses.tr: ā sute siñcata śriyaṃ rodasyorabhiśriyam rasā dadhīta vṛṣabham
verses.en: Pour on the juice the ornament which reaches both the heaven and earth Supply the liquid to the Bull.

verses.sa: ते जानत स्वमोक्यं१ सं वत्सासो न मातृभिः । मिथो नसन्त जामिभिः॥
verses.tr: te jānata svamokyaṃ1 saṃ vatsāso na mātṛbhiḥ mitho nasanta jāmibhiḥ
verses.en: These know their own abiding-place: like calves beside the mother cows They meet together with their kin.

verses.sa: उप स्रक्वेषु बप्सतः कृण्वते धरुणं दिवि । इन्द्रे अग्ना नमः स्वः॥
verses.tr: upa srakveṣu bapsataḥ kṛṇvate dharuṇaṃ divi indre agnā namaḥ svaḥ
verses.en: Devouring in their greedy jaws, they make sustaining food in heaven, To Indra, Agni light and prayer.

verses.sa: अधुक्षत्पिप्युषीमिषमूर्जं सप्तपदीमरिः । सूर्यस्य सप्त रश्मिभिः॥
verses.tr: adhukṣatpipyuṣīmiṣamūrjaṃ saptapadīmariḥ sūryasya sapta raśmibhiḥ
verses.en: The Pious One milked out rich food, sustenance dealt in portions seven, Together with the Sun's seven rays.

verses.sa: सोमस्य मित्रावरुणोदिता सूर आ ददे । तदातुरस्य भेषजम्॥
verses.tr: somasya mitrāvaruṇoditā sūra ā dade tadāturasya bheṣajam
verses.en: I took some Soma when the Sun rose up, O Mitra, Varuna. That is the sick man's medicine.

verses.sa: उतो न्वस्य यत्पदं हर्यतस्य निधान्यम् । परि द्यां जिह्वयातनत्॥
verses.tr: uto nvasya yatpadaṃ haryatasya nidhānyam pari dyāṃ jihvayātanat
verses.en: From where oblations must be laid, which is the Well-beloved's home, He with his tongue hath compassed heaven.

verses.sa: उदीराथामृतायते युञ्जाथामश्विना रथम् । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः॥
verses.tr: udīrāthāmṛtāyate yuñjāthāmaśvinā ratham anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ
verses.en: Rouse ye for him who keeps the Law, yoke your steeds, Asvins, to your car Let your protecting help be near.

verses.sa: निमिषश्चिज्जवीयसा रथेना यातमश्विना । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः॥
verses.tr: nimiṣaścijjavīyasā rathenā yātamaśvinā anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ
verses.en: Come, Asvins, with your car more swift than is the twinkling of an eye Let your protecting help be near.

verses.sa: उप स्तृणीतमत्रये हिमेन घर्ममश्विना । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः॥
verses.tr: upa stṛṇītamatraye himena gharmamaśvinā anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ
verses.en: Asvins, ye overlaid with cold the fiery pit for Atri's sake: Let your protecting help be near.

verses.sa: कुह स्थः कुह जग्मथुः कुह श्येनेव पेतथुः । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः॥
verses.tr: kuha sthaḥ kuha jagmathuḥ kuha śyeneva petathuḥ anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ
verses.en: Where are ye? whither are ye gone? whither, like falcons, have ye flown? Let your protecting help be near.

verses.sa: यदद्य कर्हि कर्हि चिच्छुश्रूयातमिमं हवम् । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः॥
verses.tr: yadadya karhi karhi cicchuśrūyātamimaṃ havam anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ
verses.en: If ye at any time this day are listening to this my call, Let your protecting help be near.

verses.sa: अश्विना यामहूतमा नेदिष्ठं याम्याप्यम् । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः॥
verses.tr: aśvinā yāmahūtamā nediṣṭhaṃ yāmyāpyam anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ
verses.en: The Asvins, fust to hear our prayer, for closest kinship I approach: Let your protecting help be near.

verses.sa: अवन्तमत्रये गृहं कृणुतं युवमश्विना । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः॥
verses.tr: avantamatraye gṛhaṃ kṛṇutaṃ yuvamaśvinā anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ
verses.en: For Atri ye, O Asvins, made a dwelling place to shield him well, Let your protecting help be near.

verses.sa: वरेथे अग्निमातपो वदते वल्ग्वत्रये । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः॥
verses.tr: varethe agnimātapo vadate valgvatraye anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ
verses.en: Ye warded off the fervent heat for Atri when he sweetly spake: Let your protecting help be near.

verses.sa: प्र सप्तवध्रिराशसा धारामग्नेरशायत । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः॥
verses.tr: pra saptavadhrirāśasā dhārāmagneraśāyata anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ
verses.en: Erst Saptavadbri by his prayer obtained the trenchant edge of fire: Let your protecting help be near.

verses.sa: इहा गतं वृषण्वसू शृणुतं म इमं हवम् । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः॥
verses.tr: ihā gataṃ vṛṣaṇvasū śṛṇutaṃ ma imaṃ havam anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ
verses.en: Come hither, O ye Lords of wealth, and listen to this call of mine: Let your protecting help be near.

verses.sa: किमिदं वां पुराणवज्जरतोरिव शस्यते । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः॥
verses.tr: kimidaṃ vāṃ purāṇavajjaratoriva śasyate anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ
verses.en: What is this praise told forth of you as Elders in the ancient way? Let your protecting help be near.

verses.sa: समानं वां सजात्यं समानो बन्धुरश्विना । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः॥
verses.tr: samānaṃ vāṃ sajātyaṃ samāno bandhuraśvinā anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ
verses.en: One common brotherhood is yours, Asvins your kindred is the same: Let your protecting help be near.

verses.sa: यो वां रजांस्यश्विना रथो वियाति रोदसी । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः॥
verses.tr: yo vāṃ rajāṃsyaśvinā ratho viyāti rodasī anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ
verses.en: This is your chariot, Asvins, which speeds through the regions, earth and heaven Let your protecting aid be near.

verses.sa: आ नो गव्येभिरश्व्यैः सहस्रैरुप गच्छतम् । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः॥
verses.tr: ā no gavyebhiraśvyaiḥ sahasrairupa gacchatam anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ
verses.en: Approach ye hitherward to us with thousands both of steeds and kine: Let your protecting help be near.

verses.sa: मा नो गव्येभिरश्व्यैः सहस्रेभिरति ख्यतम् । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः॥
verses.tr: mā no gavyebhiraśvyaiḥ sahasrebhirati khyatam anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ
verses.en: Pass us not by, remember us with thousands both of kine aud steeds: Let your protecting help be near.

verses.sa: अरुणप्सुरुषा अभूदकर्ज्योतिॠतावरी । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः॥
verses.tr: aruṇapsuruṣā abhūdakarjyotiṝtāvarī anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ
verses.en: The purple-tinted Dawn hath risen, and true to Law hath made the light Let your protecting help be near.

verses.sa: अश्विना सु विचाकशद्वृक्षं परशुमाँ इव । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः॥
verses.tr: aśvinā su vicākaśadvṛkṣaṃ paraśumāṃ iva anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ
verses.en: He looked upon the Asvins, as an axe armed man upon a tree: Let your protecting help be near.

verses.sa: पुरं न धृष्णवा रुज कृष्णया बाधितो विशा । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः॥
verses.tr: puraṃ na dhṛṣṇavā ruja kṛṣṇayā bādhito viśā anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ
verses.en: By the black band encompassed round, break it down, bold one, like a fort. Let your protecting help be near.

verses.sa: विशोविशो वो अतिथिं वाजयन्तः पुरुप्रियम् । अग्निं वो दुर्यं वचः स्तुषे शूषस्य मन्मभिः॥
verses.tr: viśoviśo vo atithiṃ vājayantaḥ purupriyam agniṃ vo duryaṃ vacaḥ stuṣe śūṣasya manmabhiḥ
verses.en: Exerting all our strength with thoughts of power we glorify in speech Agni your dear familiar Friend, the darling Guest in every home.

verses.sa: यं जनासो हविष्मन्तो मित्रं न सर्पिरासुतिम् । प्रशंसन्ति प्रशस्तिभिः॥
verses.tr: yaṃ janāso haviṣmanto mitraṃ na sarpirāsutim praśaṃsanti praśastibhiḥ
verses.en: Whom, served with sacrificial oil like Mitra, men presenting gifts Eulogize with their songs of praise

verses.sa: पन्यांसं जातवेदसं यो देवतात्युद्यता । हव्यान्यैरयद्दिवि॥
verses.tr: panyāṃsaṃ jātavedasaṃ yo devatātyudyatā havyānyairayaddivi
verses.en: Much-lauded Jatavedas, him who bears oblations up to heaven Prepared in service of the Gods.

verses.sa: आगन्म वृत्रहन्तमं ज्येष्ठमग्निमानवम् । यस्य श्रुतर्वा बृहन्नार्क्षो अनीक एधते॥
verses.tr: āganma vṛtrahantamaṃ jyeṣṭhamagnimānavam yasya śrutarvā bṛhannārkṣo anīka edhate
verses.en: To noblest Agni, Friend of man, best Vrtra-slayer, are we come, Him in whose presence Rksa's son, mighty Srutarvan, waxes great;

verses.sa: अमृतं जातवेदसं तिरस्तमांसि दर्शतम् । घृताहवनमीड्यम्॥
verses.tr: amṛtaṃ jātavedasaṃ tirastamāṃsi darśatam ghṛtāhavanamīḍyam
verses.en: To deathless Jatavedas, meet for praise, adored, with sacred oil, Visible through the gloom of night

verses.sa: सबाधो यं जना इमे३ऽग्निं हव्येभिरीळते । जुह्वानासो यतस्रुचः॥
verses.tr: sabādho yaṃ janā ime3'gniṃ havyebhirīḻate juhvānāso yatasrucaḥ
verses.en: Even Agni whom these priestly men worship with sacrificial gifts, With lifted ladles offering them.

verses.sa: इयं ते नव्यसी मतिरग्ने अधाय्यस्मदा । मन्द्र सुजात सुक्रतोऽमूर दस्मातिथे॥
verses.tr: iyaṃ te navyasī matiragne adhāyyasmadā mandra sujāta sukrato'mūra dasmātithe
verses.en: O Agni, this our newest hymn hath been addressed from us to thee, O cheerful Guest, well-born, most wise, worker of wonders, ne'er deceived.

verses.sa: सा ते अग्ने शंतमा चनिष्ठा भवतु प्रिया । तया वर्धस्व सुष्टुतः॥
verses.tr: sā te agne śaṃtamā caniṣṭhā bhavatu priyā tayā vardhasva suṣṭutaḥ
verses.en: Agni, may it be dear to thee, most grateful, and exceeding sweet: Grow mightier, eulogized therewith.

verses.sa: सा द्युम्नैर्द्युम्निनी बृहदुपोप श्रवसि श्रवः । दधीत वृत्रतूर्ये॥
verses.tr: sā dyumnairdyumninī bṛhadupopa śravasi śravaḥ dadhīta vṛtratūrye
verses.en: Splendid with splendours may it be, and in the battle with the foe Add loftier glory to thy fame.

verses.sa: अश्वमिद्गां रथप्रां त्वेषमिन्द्रं न सत्पतिम् । यस्य श्रवांसि तूर्वथ पन्यम्पन्यं च कृष्टयः॥
verses.tr: aśvamidgāṃ rathaprāṃ tveṣamindraṃ na satpatim yasya śravāṃsi tūrvatha panyampanyaṃ ca kṛṣṭayaḥ
verses.en: Steed, cow, a lord of heroes, bright like Indra, who shall fill the car. Whose high renown ye celebrate, and people praise each glorious deed.

verses.sa: यं त्वा गोपवनो गिरा चनिष्ठदग्ने अङ्गिरः । स पावक श्रुधी हवम्॥
verses.tr: yaṃ tvā gopavano girā caniṣṭhadagne aṅgiraḥ sa pāvaka śrudhī havam
verses.en: Thou whom Gopavana made glad with song, O Agni Angiras, Hear this my call, thou Holy One.

verses.sa: यं त्वा जनास ईळते सबाधो वाजसातये । स बोधि वृत्रतूर्ये॥
verses.tr: yaṃ tvā janāsa īḻate sabādho vājasātaye sa bodhi vṛtratūrye
verses.en: Thou whom the priestly folk implore to aid the gathering of the spoil, Such be thou in the fight with foes.

verses.sa: अहं हुवान आर्क्षे श्रुतर्वणि मदच्युति । शर्धांसीव स्तुकाविनां मृक्षा शीर्षा चतुर्णाम्॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ huvāna ārkṣe śrutarvaṇi madacyuti śardhāṃsīva stukāvināṃ mṛkṣā śīrṣā caturṇām
verses.en: I, called to him who reels with joy, Srutarvan, Rksa's son, shall stroke The heads of four presented steeds, like the long wool of fleecy rams.

verses.sa: मां चत्वार आशवः शविष्ठस्य द्रवित्नवः । सुरथासो अभि प्रयो वक्षन्वयो न तुग्र्यम्॥
verses.tr: māṃ catvāra āśavaḥ śaviṣṭhasya dravitnavaḥ surathāso abhi prayo vakṣanvayo na tugryam
verses.en: Four coursers with a splendid car, Savistha's horses, fleet of foot, Shall bring me to the sacred feast, as flying steeds brought Tugra's son.

verses.sa: सत्यमित्त्वा महेनदि परुष्ण्यव देदिशम् । नेमापो अश्वदातरः शविष्ठादस्ति मर्त्यः॥
verses.tr: satyamittvā mahenadi paruṣṇyava dediśam nemāpo aśvadātaraḥ śaviṣṭhādasti martyaḥ
verses.en: The very truth do I declare to thee, Parusni, mighty flood. Waters! no man is there who gives more horses than Savistha gives.

verses.sa: युक्ष्वा हि देवहूतमाँ अश्वाँ अग्ने रथीरिव । नि होता पूर्व्यः सदः॥
verses.tr: yukṣvā hi devahūtamāṃ aśvāṃ agne rathīriva ni hotā pūrvyaḥ sadaḥ
verses.en: Yoke, Agni, as a charioteer, thy steeds who best invite the Gods: As ancient Herald seat thyself.

verses.sa: उत नो देव देवाँ अच्छा वोचो विदुष्टरः । श्रद्विश्वा वार्या कृधि॥
verses.tr: uta no deva devāṃ acchā voco viduṣṭaraḥ śradviśvā vāryā kṛdhi
verses.en: And, God, as skilfullest of all, call for us hitherward the Gods: Give all our wishes sure effect.

verses.sa: त्वं ह यद्यविष्ठ्य सहसः सूनवाहुत । ऋतावा यज्ञियो भुवः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ ha yadyaviṣṭhya sahasaḥ sūnavāhuta ṛtāvā yajñiyo bhuvaḥ
verses.en: For thou, Most Youthful, Son of Strength, thou to whom sacrifice is paid, Art holy, faithful to the Law.

verses.sa: अयमग्निः सहस्रिणो वाजस्य शतिनस्पतिः । मूर्धा कवी रयीणाम्॥
verses.tr: ayamagniḥ sahasriṇo vājasya śatinaspatiḥ mūrdhā kavī rayīṇām
verses.en: This Agni, Lord of wealth and spoil hundredfold, thousand fold, is head And chief of riches and a Sage.

verses.sa: तं नेमिमृभवो यथा ऽऽनमस्व सहूतिभिः । नेदीयो यज्ञमङ्गिरः॥
verses.tr: taṃ nemimṛbhavo yathā ''namasva sahūtibhiḥ nedīyo yajñamaṅgiraḥ
verses.en: As craftsmen bend the felly, so bend at our general call: come nigh, Angiras, to the sacrifice.

verses.sa: तस्मै नूनमभिद्यवे वाचा विरूप नित्यया । वृष्णे चोदस्व सुष्टुतिम्॥
verses.tr: tasmai nūnamabhidyave vācā virūpa nityayā vṛṣṇe codasva suṣṭutim
verses.en: Now, O Virupa, rouse for him, Strong God who shines at early morn, Fair praise with voice that ceases not.

verses.sa: कमु ष्विदस्य सेनयाग्नेरपाकचक्षसः । पणिं गोषु स्तरामहे॥
verses.tr: kamu ṣvidasya senayāgnerapākacakṣasaḥ paṇiṃ goṣu starāmahe
verses.en: With missile of this Agni, his who looks afar, will we lay low The thief in combat for the kine.

verses.sa: मा नो देवानां विशः प्रस्नातीरिवोस्राः । कृशं न हासुरघ्न्याः॥
verses.tr: mā no devānāṃ viśaḥ prasnātīrivosrāḥ kṛśaṃ na hāsuraghnyāḥ
verses.en: Let not the Companies of Gods fail us, like Dawns that float away, Like cows who leave the niggardly.

verses.sa: मा नः समस्य दूढ्य१ः परिद्वेषसो अंहतिः । ऊर्मिर्न नावमा वधीत्॥
verses.tr: mā naḥ samasya dūḍhya1ḥ paridveṣaso aṃhatiḥ ūrmirna nāvamā vadhīt
verses.en: Let not the sinful tyranny of any fiercely hating foe Smite us, as billows smite a ship.

verses.sa: नमस्ते अग्न ओजसे गृणन्ति देव कृष्टयः । अमैरमित्रमर्दय॥
verses.tr: namaste agna ojase gṛṇanti deva kṛṣṭayaḥ amairamitramardaya
verses.en: O Agni, God, the people sing reverent praise to thee for strength: With terrors trouble thou the foe.

verses.sa: कुवित्सु नो गविष्टयेऽग्ने संवेषिषो रयिम् । उरुकृदुरु णस्कृधि॥
verses.tr: kuvitsu no gaviṣṭaye'gne saṃveṣiṣo rayim urukṛduru ṇaskṛdhi
verses.en: Wilt thou not, Agni, lend us aid in winning cattle, winning wealth? Maker of room, make room for us.

verses.sa: मा नो अस्मिन्महाधने परा वर्ग्भारभृद्यथा । संवर्गं सं रयिं जय॥
verses.tr: mā no asminmahādhane parā vargbhārabhṛdyathā saṃvargaṃ saṃ rayiṃ jaya
verses.en: In this great battle cast us not aside as one who bears a load: Snatch up the wealth and win it all.

verses.sa: अन्यमस्मद्भिया इयमग्ने सिषक्तु दुच्छुना । वर्धा नो अमवच्छवः॥
verses.tr: anyamasmadbhiyā iyamagne siṣaktu ducchunā vardhā no amavacchavaḥ
verses.en: O Agni, let this plague pursue and fright another and not us: Make our impetuous strength more strong.

verses.sa: यस्याजुषन्नमस्विनः शमीमदुर्मखस्य वा । तं घेदग्निर्वृधावति॥
verses.tr: yasyājuṣannamasvinaḥ śamīmadurmakhasya vā taṃ ghedagnirvṛdhāvati
verses.en: The reverent or unwearied man whose holy labour he accepts, Him Agni favours with success.

verses.sa: परस्या अधि संवतोऽवराँ अभ्या तर । यत्राहमस्मि ताँ अव॥
verses.tr: parasyā adhi saṃvato'varāṃ abhyā tara yatrāhamasmi tāṃ ava
verses.en: Abandoning the foeman's host pass hither to this company: Assist the men with whom I stand.

verses.sa: विद्मा हि ते पुरा वयमग्ने पितुर्यथावसः । अधा ते सुम्नमीमहे॥
verses.tr: vidmā hi te purā vayamagne pituryathāvasaḥ adhā te sumnamīmahe
verses.en: As we have known thy gracious help, as of a Father, long ago, So now we pray to thee for bliss.

verses.sa: इमं नु मायिनं हुव इन्द्रमीशानमोजसा । मरुत्वन्तं न वृञ्जसे॥
verses.tr: imaṃ nu māyinaṃ huva indramīśānamojasā marutvantaṃ na vṛñjase
verses.en: Not to forsake me, I invoke this Indra girt by Maruts, Lord Of magic power who rules with might.

verses.sa: अयमिन्द्रो मरुत्सखा वि वृत्रस्याभिनच्छिरः । वज्रेण शतपर्वणा॥
verses.tr: ayamindro marutsakhā vi vṛtrasyābhinacchiraḥ vajreṇa śataparvaṇā
verses.en: This Indra with his Marut Friends clave into pieces Vrtra's bead With hundred-knotted thunderbolt.

verses.sa: वावृधानो मरुत्सखेन्द्रो वि वृत्रमैरयत् । सृजन्त्समुद्रिया अपः॥
verses.tr: vāvṛdhāno marutsakhendro vi vṛtramairayat sṛjantsamudriyā apaḥ
verses.en: Indra, with Marut Friends grown strong, hath rent asunder Vrtra, and Released the waters of the sea.

verses.sa: अयं ह येन वा इदं स्वर्मरुत्वता जितम् । इन्द्रेण सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ ha yena vā idaṃ svarmarutvatā jitam indreṇa somapītaye
verses.en: This is that Indra who, begirt by Maruts, won the light of heaven That he might drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa: मरुत्वन्तमृजीषिणमोजस्वन्तं विरप्शिनम् । इन्द्रं गीर्भिर्हवामहे॥
verses.tr: marutvantamṛjīṣiṇamojasvantaṃ virapśinam indraṃ gīrbhirhavāmahe
verses.en: Mighty, impetuous, begirt by Maruts, him who loudly roars, Indra we invocate with songs.

verses.sa: इन्द्रं प्रत्नेन मन्मना मरुत्वन्तं हवामहे । अस्य सोमस्य पीतये॥
verses.tr: indraṃ pratnena manmanā marutvantaṃ havāmahe asya somasya pītaye
verses.en: Indra begirt by Maruts we invoke after the ancient plan, That he may drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa: मरुत्वाँ इन्द्र मीढ्वः पिबा सोमं शतक्रतो । अस्मिन्यज्ञे पुरुष्टुत॥
verses.tr: marutvāṃ indra mīḍhvaḥ pibā somaṃ śatakrato asminyajñe puruṣṭuta
verses.en: O liberal Indra, Marut-girt, much-lauded Satakratu, drink The Soma at this sacrifice.

verses.sa: तुभ्येदिन्द्र मरुत्वते सुताः सोमासो अद्रिवः । हृदा हूयन्त उक्थिनः॥
verses.tr: tubhyedindra marutvate sutāḥ somāso adrivaḥ hṛdā hūyanta ukthinaḥ
verses.en: To thee, O Indra, Marut-girt, these Soma juices, Thunderer! Are offered from the heart with lauds.

verses.sa: पिबेदिन्द्र मरुत्सखा सुतं सोमं दिविष्टिषु । वज्रं शिशान ओजसा॥
verses.tr: pibedindra marutsakhā sutaṃ somaṃ diviṣṭiṣu vajraṃ śiśāna ojasā
verses.en: Drink, Indra, with thy Marut Friends, pressed Soma at the morning rites, Whetting thy thunderbolt with strength.

verses.sa: उत्तिष्ठन्नोजसा सह पीत्वी शिप्रे अवेपयः । सोममिन्द्र चमू सुतम्॥
verses.tr: uttiṣṭhannojasā saha pītvī śipre avepayaḥ somamindra camū sutam
verses.en: Arising in thy might, thy jaws thou shookest, Indra, having quaffed The Soma which the mortar pressed.

verses.sa: अनु त्वा रोदसी उभे क्रक्षमाणमकृपेताम् । इन्द्र यद्दस्युहाभवः॥
verses.tr: anu tvā rodasī ubhe krakṣamāṇamakṛpetām indra yaddasyuhābhavaḥ
verses.en: Indra, both worlds complained to thee when uttering thy fearful roar, What time thou smotest Dasyus dead.

verses.sa: वाचमष्टापदीमहं नवस्रक्तिमृतस्पृशम् । इन्द्रात्परि तन्वं ममे॥
verses.tr: vācamaṣṭāpadīmahaṃ navasraktimṛtaspṛśam indrātpari tanvaṃ mame
verses.en: From Indra have I measured out a song eight-footed with nine parts, Delicate, faithful. to the Law.

verses.sa: जज्ञानो नु शतक्रतुर्वि पृच्छदिति मातरम् । क उग्राः के ह शृण्विरे॥
verses.tr: jajñāno nu śatakraturvi pṛcchaditi mātaram ka ugrāḥ ke ha śṛṇvire
verses.en: Scarcely was Satakratu, born when of his Mother he inquired, Who are the mighty? Who are famed?

verses.sa: आदीं शवस्यब्रवीदौर्णवाभमहीशुवम् । ते पुत्र सन्तु निष्टुरः॥
verses.tr: ādīṃ śavasyabravīdaurṇavābhamahīśuvam te putra santu niṣṭuraḥ
verses.en: Then Savassi declared to him Aurnavabha, Ahisuva: Son, these be they thou must o'erthrow

verses.sa: समित्तान्वृत्रहाखिदत्खे अराँ इव खेदया । प्रवृद्धो दस्युहाभवत्॥
verses.tr: samittānvṛtrahākhidatkhe arāṃ iva khedayā pravṛddho dasyuhābhavat
verses.en: The Vrtra-slayer smote them all as spokes are hammered into naves: The Dasyu-killer waxed in might.

verses.sa: एकया प्रतिधापिबत्साकं सरांसि त्रिंशतम् । इन्द्रः सोमस्य काणुका॥
verses.tr: ekayā pratidhāpibatsākaṃ sarāṃsi triṃśatam indraḥ somasya kāṇukā
verses.en: Then Indra at a single draught drank the contents of thirty pails, Pails that were filled with Soma juice.

verses.sa: अभि गन्धर्वमतृणदबुध्नेषु रजस्स्वा । इन्द्रो ब्रह्मभ्य इद्वृधे॥
verses.tr: abhi gandharvamatṛṇadabudhneṣu rajassvā indro brahmabhya idvṛdhe
verses.en: Indra in groundless realms of space pierced the Gandharva through, that he Might make Brahmans' strength increase.

verses.sa: निराविध्यद्गिरिभ्य आ धारयत्पक्वमोदनम् । इन्द्रो बुन्दं स्वाततम्॥
verses.tr: nirāvidhyadgiribhya ā dhārayatpakvamodanam indro bundaṃ svātatam
verses.en: Down from the mountains Indra shot hither his well-directed shaft: He gained the ready brew of rice.

verses.sa: शतब्रध्न इषुस्तव सहस्रपर्ण एक इत् । यमिन्द्र चकृषे युजम्॥
verses.tr: śatabradhna iṣustava sahasraparṇa eka it yamindra cakṛṣe yujam
verses.en: One only is that shaft of thine, with thousand feathers, hundred barbs, Which, Indra, thou hast made thy friend.

verses.sa: तेन स्तोतृभ्य आ भर नृभ्यो नारिभ्यो अत्तवे । सद्यो जात ऋभुष्ठिर॥
verses.tr: tena stotṛbhya ā bhara nṛbhyo nāribhyo attave sadyo jāta ṛbhuṣṭhira
verses.en: Strong as the Gbhus at thy birth, therewith to those who praise thee, men, And women, bring thou food to eat.

verses.sa: एता च्यौत्नानि ते कृता वर्षिष्ठानि परीणसा । हृदा वीड्वधारयः॥
verses.tr: etā cyautnāni te kṛtā varṣiṣṭhāni parīṇasā hṛdā vīḍvadhārayaḥ
verses.en: By thee these exploits were achieved, the mightiest deeds, abundantly: Firm in thy heart thou settest them.

verses.sa: विश्वेत्ता विष्णुराभरदुरुक्रमस्त्वेषितः । शतं महिषान्क्षीरपाकमोदनं वराहमिन्द्र एमुषम्॥
verses.tr: viśvettā viṣṇurābharadurukramastveṣitaḥ śataṃ mahiṣānkṣīrapākamodanaṃ varāhamindra emuṣam
verses.en: All these things Visnu brought, the Lord of ample stride whom thou hadst sent- A hundred buffaloes, a brew of rice and milk: and Indra, slew the ravening boar

verses.sa: तुविक्षं ते सुकृतं सूमयं धनुः साधुर्बुन्दो हिरण्ययः । उभा ते बाहू रण्या सुसंस्कृत ऋदूपे चिदृदूवृधा॥
verses.tr: tuvikṣaṃ te sukṛtaṃ sūmayaṃ dhanuḥ sādhurbundo hiraṇyayaḥ ubhā te bāhū raṇyā susaṃskṛta ṛdūpe cidṛdūvṛdhā
verses.en: Most deadly is thy bow, successful, fashioned well: good is thine arrow, decked with gold. Warlike and well equipped thine arms are, which increase sweetness for him who drinks the sweet.

verses.sa: पुरोळाशं नो अन्धस इन्द्र सहस्रमा भर । शता च शूर गोनाम्॥
verses.tr: puroḻāśaṃ no andhasa indra sahasramā bhara śatā ca śūra gonām
verses.en: Bring us a thousand, Indra, as our guerdon for the Soma juice: Hundreds of kine, O Hero, bring.

verses.sa: आ नो भर व्यञ्जनं गामश्वमभ्यञ्जनम् । सचा मना हिरण्यया॥
verses.tr: ā no bhara vyañjanaṃ gāmaśvamabhyañjanam sacā manā hiraṇyayā
verses.en: Bring cattle, bring us ornament, bring us embellishment and steeds, Give us, besides, two rings of gold.

verses.sa: उत नः कर्णशोभना पुरूणि धृष्णवा भर । त्वं हि शृण्विषे वसो॥
verses.tr: uta naḥ karṇaśobhanā purūṇi dhṛṣṇavā bhara tvaṃ hi śṛṇviṣe vaso
verses.en: And, Bold One, bring in ample store rich jewels to adorn this ear, For thou, Good Lord, art far renowned.

verses.sa: नकीं वृधीक इन्द्र ते न सुषा न सुदा उत । नान्यस्त्वच्छूर वाघतः॥
verses.tr: nakīṃ vṛdhīka indra te na suṣā na sudā uta nānyastvacchūra vāghataḥ
verses.en: None other is there for the priest, Hero! but thou, to give him gifts, To win much spoil and prosper him.

verses.sa: नकीमिन्द्रो निकर्तवे न शक्रः परिशक्तवे । विश्वं शृणोति पश्यति॥
verses.tr: nakīmindro nikartave na śakraḥ pariśaktave viśvaṃ śṛṇoti paśyati
verses.en: Indra can never be brought low, Sakra can never be subdued: He heareth and beholdeth all.

verses.sa: स मन्युं मर्त्यानामदब्धो नि चिकीषते । पुरा निदश्चिकीषते॥
verses.tr: sa manyuṃ martyānāmadabdho ni cikīṣate purā nidaścikīṣate
verses.en: He spieth out the wrath of man, he who can never be deceived: Ere blame can come he marketh it.

verses.sa: क्रत्व इत्पूर्णमुदरं तुरस्यास्ति विधतः । वृत्रघ्नः सोमपाव्नः॥
verses.tr: kratva itpūrṇamudaraṃ turasyāsti vidhataḥ vṛtraghnaḥ somapāvnaḥ
verses.en: He hath his stomach full of might, the Vrtra-slayer, Conqueror, The Soma-drinker, ordering all.

verses.sa: त्वे वसूनि संगता विश्वा च सोम सौभगा । सुदात्वपरिह्वृता॥
verses.tr: tve vasūni saṃgatā viśvā ca soma saubhagā sudātvaparihvṛtā
verses.en: In thee all treasures are combined, Soma all blessed things in thee, Uninjured, easy to bestow.

verses.sa: त्वामिद्यवयुर्मम कामो गव्युर्हिरण्ययुः । त्वामश्वयुरेषते॥
verses.tr: tvāmidyavayurmama kāmo gavyurhiraṇyayuḥ tvāmaśvayureṣate
verses.en: To thee speeds forth my hope that craves the gift of corn, and kine and gold, Yea, craving horses, speeds to thee.

verses.sa: तवेदिन्द्राहमाशसा हस्ते दात्रं चना ददे । दिनस्य वा मघवन्त्सम्भृतस्य वा पूर्धि यवस्य काशिना॥
verses.tr: tavedindrāhamāśasā haste dātraṃ canā dade dinasya vā maghavantsambhṛtasya vā pūrdhi yavasya kāśinā
verses.en: Indra, through hope in thee alone even this sickle do I grasp. Fill my hand, Maghavan, with all that it can hold of barley cut or gathered up.

verses.sa: अयं कृत्नुरगृभीतो विश्वजिदुद्भिदित्सोमः । ऋषिर्विप्रः काव्येन॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ kṛtnuragṛbhīto viśvajidudbhiditsomaḥ ṛṣirvipraḥ kāvyena
verses.en: This here is Soma, ne'er restrained, active, all-conquering bursting forth, Rsi and Sage by sapience,

verses.sa: अभ्यूर्णोति यन्नग्नं भिषक्ति विश्वं यत्तुरम् । प्रेमन्धः ख्यन्निः श्रोणो भूत्॥
verses.tr: abhyūrṇoti yannagnaṃ bhiṣakti viśvaṃ yatturam premandhaḥ khyanniḥ śroṇo bhūt
verses.en: All that is bare he covers o'er, all that is sick he medicines; The blind man sees, the cripple walks.

verses.sa: त्वं सोम तनूकृद्भ्यो द्वेषोभ्योऽन्यकृतेभ्यः । उरु यन्तासि वरूथम्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ soma tanūkṛdbhyo dveṣobhyo'nyakṛtebhyaḥ uru yantāsi varūtham
verses.en: Thou, Soma, givest wide defense against the hate of alien men, Hatreds that waste and weaken us.

verses.sa: त्वं चित्ती तव दक्षैर्दिव आ पृथिव्या ऋजीषिन् । यावीरघस्य चिद्द्वेषः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ cittī tava dakṣairdiva ā pṛthivyā ṛjīṣin yāvīraghasya ciddveṣaḥ
verses.en: Thou by thine insight and thy skill, Impetuous One, from heaven and earth Drivest the sinner's enmity.

verses.sa: अर्थिनो यन्ति चेदर्थं गच्छानिद्ददुषो रातिम् । ववृज्युस्तृष्यतः कामम्॥
verses.tr: arthino yanti cedarthaṃ gacchāniddaduṣo rātim vavṛjyustṛṣyataḥ kāmam
verses.en: When to their task they come with zeal, may they obtain the Giver's grace, And satisfy his wish who thirsts.

verses.sa: विदद्यत्पूर्व्यं नष्टमुदीमृतायुमीरयत् । प्रेमायुस्तारीदतीर्णम्॥
verses.tr: vidadyatpūrvyaṃ naṣṭamudīmṛtāyumīrayat premāyustārīdatīrṇam
verses.en: So may he find what erst was lost, so may be speed the pious man, And lengthen his remaining life.

verses.sa: सुशेवो नो मृळयाकुरदृप्तक्रतुरवातः । भवा नः सोम शं हृदे॥
verses.tr: suśevo no mṛḻayākuradṛptakraturavātaḥ bhavā naḥ soma śaṃ hṛde
verses.en: Gracious, displaying tender love, unconquered, gentle in thy thoughts, Be sweet, O Soma, to our heart.

verses.sa: मा नः सोम सं वीविजो मा वि बीभिषथा राजन् । मा नो हार्दि त्विषा वधीः॥
verses.tr: mā naḥ soma saṃ vīvijo mā vi bībhiṣathā rājan mā no hārdi tviṣā vadhīḥ
verses.en: O Soma, terrify us not; strike us not with alarm, O King: Wound not our heart with dazzling flame.

verses.sa: अव यत्स्वे सधस्थे देवानां दुर्मतीरीक्षे । राजन्नप द्विषः सेध मीढ्वो अप स्रिधः सेध॥
verses.tr: ava yatsve sadhasthe devānāṃ durmatīrīkṣe rājannapa dviṣaḥ sedha mīḍhvo apa sridhaḥ sedha
verses.en: When in my dwelling-place I see the wicked enemies of Gods, King, chase their hatred far away, thou Bounteous One, dispel our foes.

verses.sa: नह्य१न्यं बळाकरं मर्डितारं शतक्रतो । त्वं न इन्द्र मृळय॥
verses.tr: nahya1nyaṃ baḻākaraṃ marḍitāraṃ śatakrato tvaṃ na indra mṛḻaya
verses.en: O Sarakratu! truely I have made none else my Comforter. Indra; be gracious unto us.

verses.sa: यो नः शश्वत्पुराविथाऽमृध्रो वाजसातये । स त्वं न इन्द्र मृळय॥
verses.tr: yo naḥ śaśvatpurāvithā'mṛdhro vājasātaye sa tvaṃ na indra mṛḻaya
verses.en: Thou who hast ever aided us kindly of old to win the spoil, As such, O Indra, favour us.

verses.sa: किमङ्ग रध्रचोदनः सुन्वानस्यावितेदसि । कुवित्स्विन्द्र णः शकः॥
verses.tr: kimaṅga radhracodanaḥ sunvānasyāvitedasi kuvitsvindra ṇaḥ śakaḥ
verses.en: What now? As prompter of the poor thou helpest him who sheds the juice. Wilt thou not, Indra, strengthen us?

verses.sa: इन्द्र प्र णो रथमव पश्चाच्चित्सन्तमद्रिवः । पुरस्तादेनं मे कृधि॥
verses.tr: indra pra ṇo rathamava paścāccitsantamadrivaḥ purastādenaṃ me kṛdhi
verses.en: O Indra, help our chariot on, yea, Thunderer, though it lag behind: Give this my car the foremost place.

verses.sa: हन्तो नु किमाससे प्रथमं नो रथं कृधि । उपमं वाजयु श्रवः॥
verses.tr: hanto nu kimāsase prathamaṃ no rathaṃ kṛdhi upamaṃ vājayu śravaḥ
verses.en: Ho there! why sittest thou at case? Make thou my chariot to be first And bring the fame of victory near.

verses.sa: अवा नो वाजयुं रथं सुकरं ते किमित्परि । अस्मान्त्सु जिग्युषस्कृधि॥
verses.tr: avā no vājayuṃ rathaṃ sukaraṃ te kimitpari asmāntsu jigyuṣaskṛdhi
verses.en: Assist our car that seeks the prize. What can be easier for thee? So make thou us victorious.

verses.sa: इन्द्र दृह्यस्व पूरसि भद्रा त एति निष्कृतम् । इयं धीॠत्वियावती॥
verses.tr: indra dṛhyasva pūrasi bhadrā ta eti niṣkṛtam iyaṃ dhīṝtviyāvatī
verses.en: Indra, be firm: a fort art thou. To thine appointed place proceeds The auspicious hymn in season due.

verses.sa: मा सीमवद्य आ भागुर्वी काष्ठा हितं धनम् । अपावृक्ता अरत्नयः॥
verses.tr: mā sīmavadya ā bhāgurvī kāṣṭhā hitaṃ dhanam apāvṛktā aratnayaḥ
verses.en: Let not our portion be disgrace. Broad is the course, the prize is set, The barriers are opened wide.

verses.sa: तुरीयं नाम यज्ञियं यदा करस्तदुश्मसि । आदित्पतिर्न ओहसे॥
verses.tr: turīyaṃ nāma yajñiyaṃ yadā karastaduśmasi āditpatirna ohase
verses.en: This thing we wish. that thou mayst take thy fourth, thy sacrificial name. So art thou held to be our Lord.

verses.sa:
अवीवृधद्वो अमृता अमन्दीदेकद्यूर्देवा उत याश्च देवीः ।
तस्मा उ राधः कृणुत प्रशस्तं प्रातर्मक्षू धियावसुर्जगम्यात्॥
verses.tr: avīvṛdhadvo amṛtā amandīdekadyūrdevā uta yāśca devīḥ tasmā u rādhaḥ kṛṇuta praśastaṃ prātarmakṣū dhiyāvasurjagamyāt
verses.en: Ekadyu hath exalted you, Immortals: both Goddesses and Gods hath he delighted. Bestow upon him bounty meet for praises. May he, enriched with prayer, come soon and early.

verses.sa: आ तू न इन्द्र क्षुमन्तं चित्रं ग्राभं सं गृभाय । महाहस्ती दक्षिणेन॥
verses.tr: ā tū na indra kṣumantaṃ citraṃ grābhaṃ saṃ gṛbhāya mahāhastī dakṣiṇena
verses.en: Indra, God of the mighty arm, gather for us with thy right hand Manifold and nutritious spoil.

verses.sa: विद्मा हि त्वा तुविकूर्मिं तुविदेष्णं तुवीमघम् । तुविमात्रमवोभिः॥
verses.tr: vidmā hi tvā tuvikūrmiṃ tuvideṣṇaṃ tuvīmagham tuvimātramavobhiḥ
verses.en: We know thee mighty in thy deeds, of mighty bounty, mighty wealth, Mighty in measure, prompt to aid.

verses.sa: नहि त्वा शूर देवा न मर्तासो दित्सन्तम् । भीमं न गां वारयन्ते॥
verses.tr: nahi tvā śūra devā na martāso ditsantam bhīmaṃ na gāṃ vārayante
verses.en: Hero, when thou art fain to give, neither may Gods nor mortal men Restrain thee like a fearful Bull.

verses.sa: एतो न्विन्द्रं स्तवामेशानं वस्वः स्वराजम् । न राधसा मर्धिषन्नः॥
verses.tr: eto nvindraṃ stavāmeśānaṃ vasvaḥ svarājam na rādhasā mardhiṣannaḥ
verses.en: Come, let us glorify Indra, Lord supreme of wealth, Self-ruling King: In bounty may he harm us not.

verses.sa: प्र स्तोषदुप गासिषच्छ्रवत्साम गीयमानम् । अभि राधसा जुगुरत्॥
verses.tr: pra stoṣadupa gāsiṣacchravatsāma gīyamānam abhi rādhasā jugurat
verses.en: Let prelude sound and following chant so let him hear the Saman sung, And with his bounty answer us.

verses.sa: आ नो भर दक्षिणेनाऽभि सव्येन प्र मृश । इन्द्र मा नो वसोर्निर्भाक्॥
verses.tr: ā no bhara dakṣiṇenā'bhi savyena pra mṛśa indra mā no vasornirbhāk
verses.en: O Indra, with thy right hand bring, and with thy left remember us. Let us not lose our share of wealth.

verses.sa: उप क्रमस्वा भर धृषता धृष्णो जनानाम् । अदाशूष्टरस्य वेदः॥
verses.tr: upa kramasvā bhara dhṛṣatā dhṛṣṇo janānām adāśūṣṭarasya vedaḥ
verses.en: Come nigh, O Bold One, boldly bring hither the riches of the churl Who giveth least of all the folk.

verses.sa: इन्द्र य उ नु ते अस्ति वाजो विप्रेभिः सनित्वः । अस्माभिः सु तं सनुहि॥
verses.tr: indra ya u nu te asti vājo viprebhiḥ sanitvaḥ asmābhiḥ su taṃ sanuhi
verses.en: Indra, the booty which thou hast with holy singers to receive, Even that booty win with us.

verses.sa: सद्योजुवस्ते वाजा अस्मभ्यं विश्वश्चन्द्राः । वशैश्च मक्षू जरन्ते॥
verses.tr: sadyojuvaste vājā asmabhyaṃ viśvaścandrāḥ vaśaiśca makṣū jarante
verses.en: Indra, thy swiftly-coming spoil, the booty which rejoices all, Sounds quick in concert with our hopes.

verses.sa: आ प्र द्रव परावतोऽर्वावतश्च वृत्रहन् । मध्वः प्रति प्रभर्मणि॥
verses.tr: ā pra drava parāvato'rvāvataśca vṛtrahan madhvaḥ prati prabharmaṇi
verses.en: Haste forward to us from afar, or, Vrtra-slayer, from anear, To meet the offering to the meath.

verses.sa: तीव्राः सोमास आ गहि सुतासो मादयिष्णवः । पिबा दधृग्यथोचिषे॥
verses.tr: tīvrāḥ somāsa ā gahi sutāso mādayiṣṇavaḥ pibā dadhṛgyathociṣe
verses.en: Strong are the Soma-draughts; come nigh: the juices fill thee with delight: Drink boldly even as thou art wont'.

verses.sa: इषा मन्दस्वादु तेऽरं वराय मन्यवे । भुवत्त इन्द्र शं हृदे॥
verses.tr: iṣā mandasvādu te'raṃ varāya manyave bhuvatta indra śaṃ hṛde
verses.en: Joy, Indra, in the strengthening food et it content thy wish and thought, And be delightful to thine heart.

verses.sa: आ त्वशत्रवा गहि न्यु१क्थानि च हूयसे । उपमे रोचने दिवः॥
verses.tr: ā tvaśatravā gahi nyu1kthāni ca hūyase upame rocane divaḥ
verses.en: Come to us thou who hast no foe: we call thee down to hymns of praise, In heaven's sublimest realm of light.

verses.sa: तुभ्यायमद्रिभिः सुतो गोभिः श्रीतो मदाय कम् । प्र सोम इन्द्र हूयते॥
verses.tr: tubhyāyamadribhiḥ suto gobhiḥ śrīto madāya kam pra soma indra hūyate
verses.en: This Soma here expressed with stones and dressed with milk for thy carouse, Indra, is offered up to thee.

verses.sa: इन्द्र श्रुधि सु मे हवमस्मे सुतस्य गोमतः । वि पीतिं तृप्तिमश्नुहि॥
verses.tr: indra śrudhi su me havamasme sutasya gomataḥ vi pītiṃ tṛptimaśnuhi
verses.en: Graciously, Indra, hear my call. Come and obtain the draught, and sate Thyself with juices blent with milk.

verses.sa: य इन्द्र चमसेष्वा सोमश्चमूषु ते सुतः । पिबेदस्य त्वमीशिषे॥
verses.tr: ya indra camaseṣvā somaścamūṣu te sutaḥ pibedasya tvamīśiṣe
verses.en: The Soma, Indra, which is shed in chalices and vats for thee, Drink thou, for thou art Lord thereof.

verses.sa: यो अप्सु चन्द्रमा इव सोमश्चमूषु ददृशे । पिबेदस्य त्वमीशिषे॥
verses.tr: yo apsu candramā iva somaścamūṣu dadṛśe pibedasya tvamīśiṣe
verses.en: The Soma seen within the mats, as in the flood the Moon is seen, Drink thou, for thou art Lord thereof.

verses.sa: यं ते श्येनः पदाभरत्तिरो रजांस्यस्पृतम् । पिबेदस्य त्वमीशिषे॥
verses.tr: yaṃ te śyenaḥ padābharattiro rajāṃsyaspṛtam pibedasya tvamīśiṣe
verses.en: That which the Hawk brought in his claw, inviolate, through the air to thee, Drink thou, for thou art Lord thereof.

verses.sa: देवानामिदवो महत्तदा वृणीमहे वयम् । वृष्णामस्मभ्यमूतये॥
verses.tr: devānāmidavo mahattadā vṛṇīmahe vayam vṛṣṇāmasmabhyamūtaye
verses.en: We choose unto ourselves that high protection of the Mighty Gods That it may help and succour us.

verses.sa: ते नः सन्तु युजः सदा वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा । वृधासश्च प्रचेतसः॥
verses.tr: te naḥ santu yujaḥ sadā varuṇo mitro aryamā vṛdhāsaśca pracetasaḥ
verses.en: May they be ever our allies, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman, Far-seeing Gods who prosper us.

verses.sa: अति नो विष्पिता पुरु नौभिरपो न पर्षथ । यूयमृतस्य रथ्यः॥
verses.tr: ati no viṣpitā puru naubhirapo na parṣatha yūyamṛtasya rathyaḥ
verses.en: Ye furtherers of holy Law, transport us safe o'er many woes, As over water-floods in ships.

verses.sa: वामं नो अस्त्वर्यमन्वामं वरुण शंस्यम् । वामं ह्यावृणीमहे॥
verses.tr: vāmaṃ no astvaryamanvāmaṃ varuṇa śaṃsyam vāmaṃ hyāvṛṇīmahe
verses.en: Dear wealth be Aryaman to us, Varuna dear wealth meet for praise: Dear wealth we choose unto ourselves.

verses.sa: वामस्य हि प्रचेतस ईशानाशो रिशादसः । नेमादित्या अघस्य यत्॥
verses.tr: vāmasya hi pracetasa īśānāśo riśādasaḥ nemādityā aghasya yat
verses.en: For Sovrans of dear wealth are ye, Adityas, not of sinner's wealth, Ye sapient Gods who slay the foe.

verses.sa: वयमिद्वः सुदानवः क्षियन्तो यान्तो अध्वन्ना । देवा वृधाय हूमहे॥
verses.tr: vayamidvaḥ sudānavaḥ kṣiyanto yānto adhvannā devā vṛdhāya hūmahe
verses.en: We in our homes, ye Baunteous Ones, and while we journey on the road, Invoke you, Gods, to prosper us.

verses.sa: अधि न इन्द्रैषां विष्णो सजात्यानाम् । इता मरुतो अश्विना॥
verses.tr: adhi na indraiṣāṃ viṣṇo sajātyānām itā maruto aśvinā
verses.en: Regard us, Indra, Visnu, here, ye Asvins and the Marut host, Us who are kith and kin to you.

verses.sa: प्र भ्रातृत्वं सुदानवोऽध द्विता समान्या । मातुर्गर्भे भरामहे॥
verses.tr: pra bhrātṛtvaṃ sudānavo'dha dvitā samānyā māturgarbhe bharāmahe
verses.en: Ye Bounteous Ones, from time of old we here set forth our brotherhood, Our kinship in. the Mother's womb.

verses.sa: यूयं हि ष्ठा सुदानव इन्द्रज्येष्ठा अभिद्यवः । अधा चिद्व उत ब्रुवे॥
verses.tr: yūyaṃ hi ṣṭhā sudānava indrajyeṣṭhā abhidyavaḥ adhā cidva uta bruve
verses.en: Then come with Indra for your chief, as early day, ye Bounteous Gods Yea, 1 address you now for this.

verses.sa: प्रेष्ठं वो अतिथिं स्तुषे मित्रमिव प्रियम् । अग्निं रथं न वेद्यम्॥
verses.tr: preṣṭhaṃ vo atithiṃ stuṣe mitramiva priyam agniṃ rathaṃ na vedyam
verses.en: Agni, your dearest Guest, I laud, him who is loving as a friend, Who brings us riches like a car.

verses.sa: कविमिव प्रचेतसं यं देवासो अध द्विता । नि मर्त्येष्वादधुः॥
verses.tr: kavimiva pracetasaṃ yaṃ devāso adha dvitā ni martyeṣvādadhuḥ
verses.en: Whom as a far-foreseeing Sage the Gods have, from the olden time, Established among mortal men.

verses.sa: त्वं यविष्ठ दाशुषो नॄँः पाहि शृणुधी गिरः । रक्षा तोकमुत त्मना॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ yaviṣṭha dāśuṣo nṝṃḥ pāhi śṛṇudhī giraḥ rakṣā tokamuta tmanā
verses.en: Do thou, Most Youthful God, protect the men who offer, hear their songs, And of thyself preserve their seed.

verses.sa: कया ते अग्ने अङ्गिर ऊर्जो नपादुपस्तुतिम् । वराय देव मन्यवे॥
verses.tr: kayā te agne aṅgira ūrjo napādupastutim varāya deva manyave
verses.en: What is the praise wherewith, O God, Aigiras, Agni, Son of Strength, We, after thine own wish and thought,

verses.sa: दाशेम कस्य मनसा यज्ञस्य सहसो यहो । कदु वोच इदं नमः॥
verses.tr: dāśema kasya manasā yajñasya sahaso yaho kadu voca idaṃ namaḥ
verses.en: May serve thee, O thou Child of Power, and with what sacrifice's plan? What prayer shall I now speak to thee?

verses.sa: अधा त्वं हि नस्करो विश्वा अस्मभ्यं सुक्षितीः । वाजद्रविणसो गिरः॥
verses.tr: adhā tvaṃ hi naskaro viśvā asmabhyaṃ sukṣitīḥ vājadraviṇaso giraḥ
verses.en: Our God, make all of us to dwell in happy habitations, and Reward our songs with spoil and wealth.

verses.sa: कस्य नूनं परीणसो धियो जिन्वसि दम्पते । गोषाता यस्य ते गिरः॥
verses.tr: kasya nūnaṃ parīṇaso dhiyo jinvasi dampate goṣātā yasya te giraḥ
verses.en: Lord of the house, what plenty fills the songs which thou inspirest now, Thou whose hymn helps to win the kine?

verses.sa: तं मर्जयन्त सुक्रतुं पुरोयावानमाजिषु । स्वेषु क्षयेषु वाजिनम्॥
verses.tr: taṃ marjayanta sukratuṃ puroyāvānamājiṣu sveṣu kṣayeṣu vājinam
verses.en: Him Wise and Strong they glorify, the foremost Champion in the fray, And mighty in his dwelling-place.

verses.sa: क्षेति क्षेमेभिः साधुभिर्नकिर्यं घ्नन्ति हन्ति यः । अग्ने सुवीर एधते॥
verses.tr: kṣeti kṣemebhiḥ sādhubhirnakiryaṃ ghnanti hanti yaḥ agne suvīra edhate
verses.en: Agni, he dwells in rest and peace who smites and no one smites again: With hero sons he prospers well

verses.sa: आ मे हवं नासत्याऽश्विना गच्छतं युवम् । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये॥
verses.tr: ā me havaṃ nāsatyā'śvinā gacchataṃ yuvam madhvaḥ somasya pītaye
verses.en: To this mine invocation, O ye Asvins, ye Nasatyas, come, To drink the savoury Soma juice.

verses.sa: इमं मे स्तोममश्विनेमं मे शृणुतं हवम् । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये॥
verses.tr: imaṃ me stomamaśvinemaṃ me śṛṇutaṃ havam madhvaḥ somasya pītaye
verses.en: This laud of mine, ye Asvins Twain, and this mine invitation hear, To drink the savoury Soma juice.

verses.sa: अयं वां कृष्णो अश्विना हवते वाजिनीवसू । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ vāṃ kṛṣṇo aśvinā havate vājinīvasū madhvaḥ somasya pītaye
verses.en: Here Krsna is invoking you, O Asvins, Lords of ample wealth. To drink the savoury Soma juice.

verses.sa: शृणुतं जरितुर्हवं कृष्णस्य स्तुवतो नरा । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये॥
verses.tr: śṛṇutaṃ jariturhavaṃ kṛṣṇasya stuvato narā madhvaḥ somasya pītaye
verses.en: List, Heroes, to the singer's call, the call of Krsna lauding you, To drink the savoury Soma juice.

verses.sa: छर्दिर्यन्तमदाभ्यं विप्राय स्तुवते नरा । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये॥
verses.tr: chardiryantamadābhyaṃ viprāya stuvate narā madhvaḥ somasya pītaye
verses.en: Chiefs, to the sage who sings your praise grant an inviolable home, To drink the savoury Soma juice.

verses.sa: गच्छतं दाशुषो गृहमित्था स्तुवतो अश्विना । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये॥
verses.tr: gacchataṃ dāśuṣo gṛhamitthā stuvato aśvinā madhvaḥ somasya pītaye
verses.en: Come to the worshipper's abode, Asvins, who here is lauding you, To drink the savoury Soma juice.

verses.sa: युञ्जाथां रासभं रथे वीड्वङ्गे वृषण्वसू । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये॥
verses.tr: yuñjāthāṃ rāsabhaṃ rathe vīḍvaṅge vṛṣaṇvasū madhvaḥ somasya pītaye
verses.en: Yoke to the firmly jointed car the ass which draws you, Lords of wealth. To drink the savoury Soma juice.

verses.sa: त्रिवन्धुरेण त्रिवृता रथेना यातमश्विना । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये॥
verses.tr: trivandhureṇa trivṛtā rathenā yātamaśvinā madhvaḥ somasya pītaye
verses.en: Come hither, Asvins, on your car of triple form with triple seat, To drink the savoury Soma juice.

verses.sa: नू मे गिरो नासत्याऽश्विना प्रावतं युवम् । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये॥
verses.tr: nū me giro nāsatyā'śvinā prāvataṃ yuvam madhvaḥ somasya pītaye
verses.en: O Asvins, O Nasatyas, now accept with favouring grace my songs, To drink the savoury Soma juice.

verses.sa:
उभा हि दस्रा भिषजा मयोभुवोभा दक्षस्य वचसो बभूवथुः ।
ता वां विश्वको हवते तनूकृथे मा नो वि यौष्टं सख्या मुमोचतम्॥
verses.tr: ubhā hi dasrā bhiṣajā mayobhuvobhā dakṣasya vacaso babhūvathuḥ tā vāṃ viśvako havate tanūkṛthe mā no vi yauṣṭaṃ sakhyā mumocatam
verses.en: Ye Twain are wondrous strong, well-skilled in arts that heal, both bringers of delight, ye both won Daksa's praise. Visvaka calls on you as such to save his life. Break ye not off our friendship, come and set me free.

verses.sa:
कथा नूनं वां विमना उप स्तवद्युवं धियं ददथुर्वस्यइष्टये ।
ता वां विश्वको हवते तनूकृथे मा नो वि यौष्टं सख्या मुमोचतम्॥
verses.tr: kathā nūnaṃ vāṃ vimanā upa stavadyuvaṃ dhiyaṃ dadathurvasyaiṣṭaye tā vāṃ viśvako havate tanūkṛthe mā no vi yauṣṭaṃ sakhyā mumocatam
verses.en: How shall he praise you now who is distraught in mind? Ye Twain give wisdom for the gainof what is good. Visvaka calls on you as such to save his life. Break ye not off our friendship, come and set me free.

verses.sa:
युवं हि ष्मा पुरुभुजेममेधतुं विष्णाप्वे ददथुर्वस्यइष्टये ।
ता वां विश्वको हवते तनूकृथे मा नो वि यौष्टं सख्या मुमोचतम्॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ hi ṣmā purubhujemamedhatuṃ viṣṇāpve dadathurvasyaiṣṭaye tā vāṃ viśvako havate tanūkṛthe mā no vi yauṣṭaṃ sakhyā mumocatam
verses.en: Already have ye Twain, possessors of great wealth, prospered Visnapu thus for gain of what is good. Visvaka calls on you as such to save his life. Break ye not off our friendship, come and set me free.

verses.sa:
उत त्यं वीरं धनसामृजीषिणं दूरे चित्सन्तमवसे हवामहे ।
यस्य स्वादिष्ठा सुमतिः पितुर्यथा मा नो वि यौष्टं सख्या मुमोचतम्॥
verses.tr: uta tyaṃ vīraṃ dhanasāmṛjīṣiṇaṃ dūre citsantamavase havāmahe yasya svādiṣṭhā sumatiḥ pituryathā mā no vi yauṣṭaṃ sakhyā mumocatam
verses.en: And that Impetuous Hero, winner of the spoil, though he is far away, we call to succour us, Whose gracious favour, like a father's, is most sweet. Break ye not off our friendship, come and set me free.

verses.sa:
ऋतेन देवः सविता शमायत ऋतस्य शृङ्गमुर्विया वि पप्रथे ।
ऋतं सासाह महि चित्पृतन्यतो मा नो वि यौष्टं सख्या मुमोचतम्॥
verses.tr: ṛtena devaḥ savitā śamāyata ṛtasya śṛṅgamurviyā vi paprathe ṛtaṃ sāsāha mahi citpṛtanyato mā no vi yauṣṭaṃ sakhyā mumocatam
verses.en: About the holy Law toils Savitar the God the horn of holy Law hath he spread far and wide. The holy Law hath quelled even mighty men of war. Break ye not off our ftiendship, come and act me free.

verses.sa: द्युम्नी वां स्तोमो अश्विना क्रिविर्न सेक आ गतम् । मध्वः सुतस्य स दिवि प्रियो नरा पातं गौराविवेरिणे॥
verses.tr: dyumnī vāṃ stomo aśvinā krivirna seka ā gatam madhvaḥ sutasya sa divi priyo narā pātaṃ gaurāviveriṇe
verses.en: Splendid, O Asvins, is your praise. Come fountain-like, to pour the stream. Of the sweet juice effused-dear is it, Chiefs, in heaven-drink like two wild bulls at a pool.

verses.sa: पिबतं घर्मं मधुमन्तमश्विना ऽऽबर्हिः सीदतं नरा । ता मन्दसाना मनुषो दुरोण आ नि पातं वेदसा वयः॥
verses.tr: pibataṃ gharmaṃ madhumantamaśvinā ''barhiḥ sīdataṃ narā tā mandasānā manuṣo duroṇa ā ni pātaṃ vedasā vayaḥ
verses.en: Drink the libation rich in sweets, O Asvins Twain: sit. Heroes, on the sacred grass. Do ye with joyful heart in the abode of man preserve his life by means of wealth.

verses.sa: आ वां विश्वाभिरूतिभिः प्रियमेधा अहूषत । ता वर्तिर्यातमुप वृक्तबर्हिषो जुष्टं यज्ञं दिविष्टिषु॥
verses.tr: ā vāṃ viśvābhirūtibhiḥ priyamedhā ahūṣata tā vartiryātamupa vṛktabarhiṣo juṣṭaṃ yajñaṃ diviṣṭiṣu
verses.en: The Priyamedhas bid you come with all the succours that are yours. Come to his house whose holy grass is trimmed, to dear sacrifice at the morning rites.

verses.sa:
पिबतं सोमं मधुमन्तमश्विना ऽऽबर्हिः सीदतं सुमत् ।
ता वावृधाना उप सुष्टुतिं दिवो गन्तं गौराविवेरिणम्॥
verses.tr: pibataṃ somaṃ madhumantamaśvinā ''barhiḥ sīdataṃ sumat tā vāvṛdhānā upa suṣṭutiṃ divo gantaṃ gaurāviveriṇam
verses.en: Drink ye the Soma rich in meath, ye Asvins Twain: sit gladly on the sacred grass. So, waxen mighty, to our eulogy from heaven come ye as wild-bulls to the pool.

verses.sa: आ नूनं यातमश्विनाऽश्वेभिः प्रुषितप्सुभिः । दस्रा हिरण्यवर्तनी शुभस्पती पातं सोममृतावृधा॥
verses.tr: ā nūnaṃ yātamaśvinā'śvebhiḥ pruṣitapsubhiḥ dasrā hiraṇyavartanī śubhaspatī pātaṃ somamṛtāvṛdhā
verses.en: Come to us, O ye Asvins, now with steeds of many a varied hue, Ye Lords of splendour, wondrous, borne on paths of gold, drink Soma, ye who strengthen Law.

verses.sa: वयं हि वां हवामहे विपन्यवो विप्रासो वाजसातये । ता वल्गू दस्रा पुरुदंससा धियाऽश्विना श्रुष्ट्या गतम्॥
verses.tr: vayaṃ hi vāṃ havāmahe vipanyavo viprāso vājasātaye tā valgū dasrā purudaṃsasā dhiyā'śvinā śruṣṭyā gatam
verses.en: For we the priestly singers, fain to hymn your praise, invoke you for the gain of strength. So, wondrous, fair, and famed for great deeds come to us, through our hymn, Asvins, when ye hear.

verses.sa: तं वो दस्ममृतीषहं वसोर्मन्दानमन्धसः । अभि वत्सं न स्वसरेषु धेनव इन्द्रं गीर्भिर्नवामहे॥
verses.tr: taṃ vo dasmamṛtīṣahaṃ vasormandānamandhasaḥ abhi vatsaṃ na svasareṣu dhenava indraṃ gīrbhirnavāmahe
verses.en: As cows low to their calves in stalls, so with our songs we glorify This Indra, even your Wondrous God who checks attack, who joys in the delicious juice.

verses.sa: द्युक्षं सुदानुं तविषीभिरावृतं गिरिं न पुरुभोजसम् । क्षुमन्तं वाजं शतिनं सहस्रिणं मक्षू गोमन्तमीमहे॥
verses.tr: dyukṣaṃ sudānuṃ taviṣībhirāvṛtaṃ giriṃ na purubhojasam kṣumantaṃ vājaṃ śatinaṃ sahasriṇaṃ makṣū gomantamīmahe
verses.en: Celestial, bounteous Giver, girt about with might, rich, mountain-like, in precious things, Him swift we seek. for foodful booty rich in kine, brought hundredfold and thousandfold.

verses.sa: न त्वा बृहन्तो अद्रयो वरन्त इन्द्र वीळवः । यद्दित्ससि स्तुवते मावते वसु नकिष्टदा मिनाति ते॥
verses.tr: na tvā bṛhanto adrayo varanta indra vīḻavaḥ yadditsasi stuvate māvate vasu nakiṣṭadā mināti te
verses.en: Indra, the strong and lofty hills are powerless to bar thy way. None stay that act of thine when thou wouldst fain give wealth to one like me who sings thy praise.

verses.sa:
योद्धासि क्रत्वा शवसोत दंसना विश्वा जाताभि मज्मना ।
आ त्वायमर्क ऊतये ववर्तति यं गोतमा अजीजनन्॥
verses.tr: yoddhāsi kratvā śavasota daṃsanā viśvā jātābhi majmanā ā tvāyamarka ūtaye vavartati yaṃ gotamā ajījanan
verses.en: A Warrior thou by strength, wisdom, and wondrous deed, in might excellest all that is. Hither may this our hymn attract thee to our help, the hymn which Gotamas have made.

verses.sa: प्र हि रिरिक्ष ओजसा दिवो अन्तेभ्यस्परि । न त्वा विव्याच रज इन्द्र पार्थिवमनु स्वधां ववक्षिथ॥
verses.tr: pra hi ririkṣa ojasā divo antebhyaspari na tvā vivyāca raja indra pārthivamanu svadhāṃ vavakṣitha
verses.en: For in thy might thou stretchest out beyond the boundaries of heaven. The earthly region, Indra, comprehends thee not. After thy Godhead hast thou waxed.

verses.sa: नकिः परिष्टिर्मघवन्मघस्य ते यद्दाशुषे दशस्यसि । अस्माकं बोध्युचथस्य चोदिता मंहिष्ठो वाजसातये॥
verses.tr: nakiḥ pariṣṭirmaghavanmaghasya te yaddāśuṣe daśasyasi asmākaṃ bodhyucathasya coditā maṃhiṣṭho vājasātaye
verses.en: When, Maghavan, thou honourest the worshipper, no one is there to stay thy wealth. Most liberal Giver thou, do thou inspire our song of praise, that we may win the spoil.

verses.sa: बृहदिन्द्राय गायत मरुतो वृत्रहन्तमम् । येन ज्योतिरजनयन्नृतावृधो देवं देवाय जागृवि॥
verses.tr: bṛhadindrāya gāyata maruto vṛtrahantamam yena jyotirajanayannṛtāvṛdho devaṃ devāya jāgṛvi
verses.en: To Indra sing the lofty hymn, Maruts that slays the Vrtras best. Whereby the Holy Ones created for the God the light divine that ever wakes.

verses.sa: अपाधमदभिशस्तीरशस्तिहाऽथेन्द्रो द्युम्न्याभवत् । देवास्त इन्द्र सख्याय येमिरे बृहद्भानो मरुद्गण॥
verses.tr: apādhamadabhiśastīraśastihā'thendro dyumnyābhavat devāsta indra sakhyāya yemire bṛhadbhāno marudgaṇa
verses.en: Indra who quells the curse blew curses far away, and then in splendour came to us. Indra, refulgent with thy Marut host! the Gods strove eagerly to win thy love.

verses.sa: प्र व इन्द्राय बृहते मरुतो ब्रह्मार्चत । वृत्रं हनति वृत्रहा शतक्रतुर्वज्रेण शतपर्वणा॥
verses.tr: pra va indrāya bṛhate maruto brahmārcata vṛtraṃ hanati vṛtrahā śatakraturvajreṇa śataparvaṇā
verses.en: Sing to your lofty Indra, sing, Maruts, a holy hymn of praise. Let Satakratu, Vrtra-slayer, kill the foe with hundred-knotted thunderbolt.

verses.sa: अभि प्र भर धृषता धृषन्मनः श्रवश्चित्ते असद्बृहत् । अर्षन्त्वापो जवसा वि मातरो हनो वृत्रं जया स्वः॥
verses.tr: abhi pra bhara dhṛṣatā dhṛṣanmanaḥ śravaścitte asadbṛhat arṣantvāpo javasā vi mātaro hano vṛtraṃ jayā svaḥ
verses.en: Aim and fetch boldly forth, O thou whose heart is bold: great glory will be thine thereby. In rapid torrent let the mother waters spread. Slay Vrtra, win the light of heaven.

verses.sa: यज्जायथा अपूर्व्य मघवन्वृत्रहत्याय । तत्पृथिवीमप्रथयस्तदस्तभ्ना उत द्याम्॥
verses.tr: yajjāyathā apūrvya maghavanvṛtrahatyāya tatpṛthivīmaprathayastadastabhnā uta dyām
verses.en: When thou, unequalled Maghavan, wast born to smite the Vrtras dead, Thou spreadest out the spacious earth and didst support and prop the heavens.

verses.sa: तत्ते यज्ञो अजायत तदर्क उत हस्कृतिः । तद्विश्वमभिभूरसि यज्जातं यच्च जन्त्वम्॥
verses.tr: tatte yajño ajāyata tadarka uta haskṛtiḥ tadviśvamabhibhūrasi yajjātaṃ yacca jantvam
verses.en: There was the sacrifice produced for thee, the laud, and song of joy, Thou in thy might surpassest all, all that now is and yet shall be.

verses.sa: आमासु पक्वमैरय आ सूर्यं रोहयो दिवि । घर्मं न सामन्तपता सुवृक्तिभिर्जुष्टं गिर्वणसे बृहत्॥
verses.tr: āmāsu pakvamairaya ā sūryaṃ rohayo divi gharmaṃ na sāmantapatā suvṛktibhirjuṣṭaṃ girvaṇase bṛhat
verses.en: Raw kine thou filledst with ripe milk. Thou madest Surya rise to heaven., Heat him as milk is heated with pure Sama hymns, great joy to him who loves the song.

verses.sa: आ नो विश्वासु हव्य इन्द्रः समत्सु भूषतु । उप ब्रह्माणि सवनानि वृत्रहा परमज्या ऋचीषमः॥
verses.tr: ā no viśvāsu havya indraḥ samatsu bhūṣatu upa brahmāṇi savanāni vṛtrahā paramajyā ṛcīṣamaḥ
verses.en: May Indra, who in every fight must be invoked, be near to us. May the most mighty Vrtra-slayer, meet for praise, come to libations and to hymns.

verses.sa: त्वं दाता प्रथमो राधसामस्यसि सत्य ईशानकृत् । तुविद्युम्नस्य युज्या वृणीमहे पुत्रस्य शवसो महः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ dātā prathamo rādhasāmasyasi satya īśānakṛt tuvidyumnasya yujyā vṛṇīmahe putrasya śavaso mahaḥ
verses.en: Thou art the best of all in sending bounteous gifts, true art thou, lordly in thine act. We claim alliance with the very Glorious One, yea, with the Mighty Son of Strength.

verses.sa: ब्रह्मा त इन्द्र गिर्वणः क्रियन्ते अनतिद्भुता । इमा जुषस्व हर्यश्व योजनेन्द्र या ते अमन्महि॥
verses.tr: brahmā ta indra girvaṇaḥ kriyante anatidbhutā imā juṣasva haryaśva yojanendra yā te amanmahi
verses.en: Prayers unsurpassed are offered up to thee the Lover of the Song. Indra, Lord of Bay Steeds, accept these fitting hymns, hymns which we have thought out for thee.

verses.sa: त्वं हि सत्यो मघवन्ननानतो वृत्रा भूरि न्यृञ्जसे । स त्वं शविष्ठ वज्रहस्त दाशुषेऽर्वाञ्चं रयिमा कृधि॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ hi satyo maghavannanānato vṛtrā bhūri nyṛñjase sa tvaṃ śaviṣṭha vajrahasta dāśuṣe'rvāñcaṃ rayimā kṛdhi
verses.en: For thou, O Maghavan, art truthful, ne'er subdued and bringest many a Vrtra low. As such, O Mightiest Lord, Wielder of Thunder, send wealth hither to the worshipper.

verses.sa: त्वमिन्द्र यशा अस्यृजीषी शवसस्पते । त्वं वृत्राणि हंस्यप्रतीन्येक इदनुत्ता चर्षणीधृता॥
verses.tr: tvamindra yaśā asyṛjīṣī śavasaspate tvaṃ vṛtrāṇi haṃsyapratīnyeka idanuttā carṣaṇīdhṛtā
verses.en: O Indra, thou art far-renowned, impetuous, O Lord of Strength. Alone thou slayest with the guardian of mankind resistless never-conquered foes.

verses.sa: तमु त्वा नूनमसुर प्रचेतसं राधो भागमिवेमहे । महीव कृत्तिः शरणा त इन्द्र प्र ते सुम्ना नो अश्नवन्॥
verses.tr: tamu tvā nūnamasura pracetasaṃ rādho bhāgamivemahe mahīva kṛttiḥ śaraṇā ta indra pra te sumnā no aśnavan
verses.en: As such we seek thee now, O Asura, thee most wise, craving thy bounty as our share. Thy sheltering defense is like a mighty cloak. So may thy glories reach to us.

verses.sa: कन्या३ वारवायती सोममपि स्रुताविदत् । अस्तं भरन्त्यब्रवीदिन्द्राय सुनवै त्वा शक्राय सुनवै त्वा॥
verses.tr: kanyā3 vāravāyatī somamapi srutāvidat astaṃ bharantyabravīdindrāya sunavai tvā śakrāya sunavai tvā
verses.en: Down to the stream a maiden came, and found the Soma by the way. Bearing it to her home she said, For Indra will I press thee out, for Sakra will I press thee out.

verses.sa: असौ य एषि वीरको गृहंगृहं विचाकशद् । इमं जम्भसुतं पिब धानावन्तं करम्भिणमपूपवन्तमुक्थिनम्॥
verses.tr: asau ya eṣi vīrako gṛhaṃgṛhaṃ vicākaśad imaṃ jambhasutaṃ piba dhānāvantaṃ karambhiṇamapūpavantamukthinam
verses.en: Thou roaming yonder, little man, beholding every house in turn, Drink thou this Soma pressed with teeth, accompanied with grain and curds, with cake of meal and song of praise.

verses.sa: आ चन त्वा चिकित्सामोऽधि चन त्वा नेमसि । शनैरिव शनकैरिवेन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव॥
verses.tr: ā cana tvā cikitsāmo'dhi cana tvā nemasi śanairiva śanakairivendrāyendo pari srava
verses.en: Fain would we learn to know thee well, nor yet can we attain to thee. Still slowly and in gradual drops, O Indu, unto Indra flow.

verses.sa: कुविच्छकत्कुवित्करत्कुविन्नो वस्यसस्करत् । कुवित्पतिद्विषो यतीरिन्द्रेण संगमामहै॥
verses.tr: kuvicchakatkuvitkaratkuvinno vasyasaskarat kuvitpatidviṣo yatīrindreṇa saṃgamāmahai
verses.en: Will he not help and work for us? Will he not make us wealthier? Shall we not, hostile to our lord, unite ourselves to Indra now?

verses.sa: इमानि त्रीणि विष्टपा तानीन्द्र वि रोहय । शिरस्ततस्योर्वरामादिदं म उपोदरे॥
verses.tr: imāni trīṇi viṣṭapā tānīndra vi rohaya śirastatasyorvarāmādidaṃ ma upodare
verses.en: O Indra, cause to sprout again three places, these which I declare,- My father's head, his cultured field, and this the part below my waist.

verses.sa: असौ च या न उर्वरादिमां तन्वं१ मम । अथो ततस्य यच्छिरः सर्वा ता रोमशा कृधि॥
verses.tr: asau ca yā na urvarādimāṃ tanvaṃ1 mama atho tatasya yacchiraḥ sarvā tā romaśā kṛdhi
verses.en: Make all of these grow crops of hair, you cultivated field of ours, My body, and my father's head.

verses.sa: खे रथस्य खेऽनसः खे युगस्य शतक्रतो । अपालामिन्द्र त्रिष्पूत्व्यकृणोः सूर्यत्वचम्॥
verses.tr: khe rathasya khe'nasaḥ khe yugasya śatakrato apālāmindra triṣpūtvyakṛṇoḥ sūryatvacam
verses.en: Cleansing Apala, Indra! thrice, thou gavest sunlike skin to her, Drawn, Satakratu! through the hole of car, of wagon, and of yoke.

verses.sa: पान्तमा वो अन्धस इन्द्रमभि प्र गायत । विश्वासाहं शतक्रतुं मंहिष्ठं चर्षणीनाम्॥
verses.tr: pāntamā vo andhasa indramabhi pra gāyata viśvāsāhaṃ śatakratuṃ maṃhiṣṭhaṃ carṣaṇīnām
verses.en: Invite ye Indra with a song to drink your draught of Soma juice, All-conquering Satakratu, most munificent of all who live.

verses.sa: पुरुहूतं पुरुष्टुतं गाथान्यं१ सनश्रुतम् । इन्द्र इति ब्रवीतन॥
verses.tr: puruhūtaṃ puruṣṭutaṃ gāthānyaṃ1 sanaśrutam indra iti bravītana
verses.en: Lauded by many, much-invoked, leader of song, renowned of old: His name is Indra, tell it forth.

verses.sa: इन्द्र इन्नो महानां दाता वाजानां नृतुः । महाँ अभिज्ञ्वा यमत्॥
verses.tr: indra inno mahānāṃ dātā vājānāṃ nṛtuḥ mahāṃ abhijñvā yamat
verses.en: Indra the Dancer be to us the giver of abundant strength: May he, the mighty, bring it near.

verses.sa: अपादु शिप्र्यन्धसः सुदक्षस्य प्रहोषिणः । इन्दोरिन्द्रो यवाशिरः॥
verses.tr: apādu śipryandhasaḥ sudakṣasya prahoṣiṇaḥ indorindro yavāśiraḥ
verses.en: Indra whose jaws are strong hath drunk of worshipping Sudaksa's draught, The Soma juice with barley mixt.

verses.sa: तम्वभि प्रार्चतेन्द्रं सोमस्य पीतये । तदिद्ध्यस्य वर्धनम्॥
verses.tr: tamvabhi prārcatendraṃ somasya pītaye tadiddhyasya vardhanam
verses.en: Call Indra loudly with your songs of praise to drink the Soma juice. For this is what augments his strength.

verses.sa: अस्य पीत्वा मदानां देवो देवस्यौजसा । विश्वाभि भुवना भुवत्॥
verses.tr: asya pītvā madānāṃ devo devasyaujasā viśvābhi bhuvanā bhuvat
verses.en: When he hath drank its gladdening drops, the God with vigour of a God Hath far surpassed all things that are.

verses.sa: त्यमु वः सत्रासाहं विश्वासु गीर्ष्वायतम् । आ च्यावयस्यूतये॥
verses.tr: tyamu vaḥ satrāsāhaṃ viśvāsu gīrṣvāyatam ā cyāvayasyūtaye
verses.en: Thou speedest down to succour us this ever-conquering God of yours, Him who is drawn to all our songs

verses.sa: युध्मं सन्तमनर्वाणं सोमपामनपच्युतम् । नरमवार्यक्रतुम्॥
verses.tr: yudhmaṃ santamanarvāṇaṃ somapāmanapacyutam naramavāryakratum
verses.en: The Warrior not to he restrained, the Soma-drinker ne'er o'erthrown, The Chieftain of resistless might.

verses.sa: शिक्षा ण इन्द्र राय आ पुरु विद्वाँ ऋचीषम । अवा नः पार्ये धने॥
verses.tr: śikṣā ṇa indra rāya ā puru vidvāṃ ṛcīṣama avā naḥ pārye dhane
verses.en: O Indra, send us riches, thou Omniscient, worthy of our praise: Help us in the decisive fray.

verses.sa: अतश्चिदिन्द्र ण उपा ऽऽयाहि शतवाजया । इषा सहस्रवाजया॥
verses.tr: ataścidindra ṇa upā ''yāhi śatavājayā iṣā sahasravājayā
verses.en: Even thence, O 1ndra, come to us with food that gives a hundred powers, With food that gives a thousand powers.

verses.sa: अयाम धीवतो धियोऽर्वद्भिः शक्र गोदरे । जयेम पृत्सु वज्रिवः॥
verses.tr: ayāma dhīvato dhiyo'rvadbhiḥ śakra godare jayema pṛtsu vajrivaḥ
verses.en: We sought the wisdom of the wise. Sakra, Kine-giver, Thunder-armed! May we with steeds o'ercome in fight.

verses.sa: वयमु त्वा शतक्रतो गावो न यवसेष्वा । उक्थेषु रणयामसि॥
verses.tr: vayamu tvā śatakrato gāvo na yavaseṣvā uktheṣu raṇayāmasi
verses.en: We make thee, Satakratu, find enjoyment in the songs we sing. Like cattle in the pasture lands.

verses.sa: विश्वा हि मर्त्यत्वनाऽनुकामा शतक्रतो । अगन्म वज्रिन्नाशसः॥
verses.tr: viśvā hi martyatvanā'nukāmā śatakrato aganma vajrinnāśasaḥ
verses.en: For, Satakratu, Thunder-armed, all that we craved, as men are wont, All that we hoped, have we attained.

verses.sa: त्वे सु पुत्र शवसोऽवृत्रन्कामकातयः । न त्वामिन्द्राति रिच्यते॥
verses.tr: tve su putra śavaso'vṛtrankāmakātayaḥ na tvāmindrāti ricyate
verses.en: Those, Son of Strength, are come to thee who cherish wishes in their hearts O Indra, none excelleth thee.

verses.sa: स नो वृषन्त्सनिष्ठया सं घोरया द्रवित्न्वा । धियाविड्ढि पुरंध्या॥
verses.tr: sa no vṛṣantsaniṣṭhayā saṃ ghorayā dravitnvā dhiyāviḍḍhi puraṃdhyā
verses.en: So, Hero, guard us with thy care, with thy most liberal providence, Speedy, and terrible to foes.

verses.sa: यस्ते नूनं शतक्रतविन्द्र द्युम्नितमो मदः । तेन नूनं मदे मदेः॥
verses.tr: yaste nūnaṃ śatakratavindra dyumnitamo madaḥ tena nūnaṃ made madeḥ
verses.en: O Satakratu Indra, now rejoice with that carouse of thine Which is most splendid of them all

verses.sa: यस्ते चित्रश्रवस्तमो य इन्द्र वृत्रहन्तमः । य ओजोदातमो मदः॥
verses.tr: yaste citraśravastamo ya indra vṛtrahantamaḥ ya ojodātamo madaḥ
verses.en: Even, Indra, that carouse which slays the Vrtras best, most widely famed, Best giver of thy power and might.

verses.sa: विद्मा हि यस्ते अद्रिवस्त्वादत्तः सत्य सोमपाः । विश्वासु दस्म कृष्टिषु॥
verses.tr: vidmā hi yaste adrivastvādattaḥ satya somapāḥ viśvāsu dasma kṛṣṭiṣu
verses.en: For that which is thy gift we know, true Soma-drinker, Thunder-armed, Mighty One, amid all the folk.

verses.sa: इन्द्राय मद्वने सुतं परि ष्टोभन्तु नो गिरः । अर्कमर्चन्तु कारवः॥
verses.tr: indrāya madvane sutaṃ pari ṣṭobhantu no giraḥ arkamarcantu kāravaḥ
verses.en: For Indra, Lover of Carouse, loud be our songs about the juice: Let poets sing the song of praise.

verses.sa: यस्मिन्विश्वा अधि श्रियो रणन्ति सप्त संसदः । इन्द्रं सुते हवामहे॥
verses.tr: yasminviśvā adhi śriyo raṇanti sapta saṃsadaḥ indraṃ sute havāmahe
verses.en: We summon Indra to the draught, in whom all glories rest, in whom The seven communities rejoice.

verses.sa: त्रिकद्रुकेषु चेतनं देवासो यज्ञमत्नत । तमिद्वर्धन्तु नो गिरः॥
verses.tr: trikadrukeṣu cetanaṃ devāso yajñamatnata tamidvardhantu no giraḥ
verses.en: At the Trikadrukas the Gods span sacrifice that stirs the mind: Let our songs aid and prosper it.

verses.sa: आ त्वा विशन्त्विन्दवः समुद्रमिव सिन्धवः । न त्वामिन्द्राति रिच्यते॥
verses.tr: ā tvā viśantvindavaḥ samudramiva sindhavaḥ na tvāmindrāti ricyate
verses.en: Let the drops pass within thee as the rivers flow into the sea: O Indra, naught excelleth thee.

verses.sa: विव्यक्थ महिना वृषन्भक्षं सोमस्य जागृवे । य इन्द्र जठरेषु ते॥
verses.tr: vivyaktha mahinā vṛṣanbhakṣaṃ somasya jāgṛve ya indra jaṭhareṣu te
verses.en: Thou, wakeful Hero, by thy might hast taken food of Soma juice, Which, Indra, is within thee now.

verses.sa: अरं त इन्द्र कुक्षये सोमो भवतु वृत्रहन् । अरं धामभ्य इन्दवः॥
verses.tr: araṃ ta indra kukṣaye somo bhavatu vṛtrahan araṃ dhāmabhya indavaḥ
verses.en: O Indra, Vrtra-slayer, let Soma be ready for thy maw, The drops be ready for thy forms.

verses.sa: अरमश्वाय गायति श्रुतकक्षो अरं गवे । अरमिन्द्रस्य धाम्ने॥
verses.tr: aramaśvāya gāyati śrutakakṣo araṃ gave aramindrasya dhāmne
verses.en: Now Srutakaksa sings his song that cattle and the steed may come, That Indra's very self may come.

verses.sa: अरं हि ष्म सुतेषु णः सोमेष्विन्द्र भूषसि । अरं ते शक्र दावने॥
verses.tr: araṃ hi ṣma suteṣu ṇaḥ someṣvindra bhūṣasi araṃ te śakra dāvane
verses.en: Here, Indra, thou art ready by our Soma juices shed for thee, Sakra, at hand that thou mayst give.

verses.sa: पराकात्ताच्चिदद्रिवस्त्वां नक्षन्त नो गिरः । अरं गमाम ते वयम्॥
verses.tr: parākāttāccidadrivastvāṃ nakṣanta no giraḥ araṃ gamāma te vayam
verses.en: Even from far away our songs reach thee, O Caster of the Stone: May we come very close to thee.

verses.sa: एवा ह्यसि वीरयुरेवा शूर उत स्थिरः । एवा ते राध्यं मनः॥
verses.tr: evā hyasi vīrayurevā śūra uta sthiraḥ evā te rādhyaṃ manaḥ
verses.en: For so thou art the hero's Friend, a Hero, too, art thou, and strong: So may thine heart be won to us.

verses.sa: एवा रातिस्तुवीमघ विश्वेभिर्धायि धातृभिः । अधा चिदिन्द्र मे सचा॥
verses.tr: evā rātistuvīmagha viśvebhirdhāyi dhātṛbhiḥ adhā cidindra me sacā
verses.en: So hath the offering, wealthiest Lord, been paid by all the worshippers: So dwell thou, Indra, even with me.

verses.sa: मो षु ब्रह्मेव तन्द्रयुर्भुवो वाजानां पते । मत्स्वा सुतस्य गोमतः॥
verses.tr: mo ṣu brahmeva tandrayurbhuvo vājānāṃ pate matsvā sutasya gomataḥ
verses.en: Be not thou like a sloth fed priest, O Lord of spoil and wealth: rejoice In the pressed Soma blent with milk.

verses.sa: मा न इन्द्राभ्या३दिशः सूरो अक्तुष्वा यमन् । त्वा युजा वनेम तत्॥
verses.tr: mā na indrābhyā3diśaḥ sūro aktuṣvā yaman tvā yujā vanema tat
verses.en: O Indra, let not ill designs surround us in the sunbeams' light: This may we gain with thee for Friend.

verses.sa: त्वयेदिन्द्र युजा वयं प्रति ब्रुवीमहि स्पृधः । त्वमस्माकं तव स्मसि॥
verses.tr: tvayedindra yujā vayaṃ prati bruvīmahi spṛdhaḥ tvamasmākaṃ tava smasi
