verses.en: With thee to help us, Indra, let us answer all our enemies: For thou art ours and we are thine.

verses.sa: त्वामिद्धि त्वायवोऽनुनोनुवतश्चरान् । सखाय इन्द्र कारवः॥
verses.tr: tvāmiddhi tvāyavo'nunonuvataścarān sakhāya indra kāravaḥ
verses.en: Indra, the poets and thy friends, faithful to thee, shall loudly sing Thy praises as they follow thee.

verses.sa: उद्घेदभि श्रुतामघं वृषभं नर्यापसम् । अस्तारमेषि सूर्य॥
verses.tr: udghedabhi śrutāmaghaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ naryāpasam astārameṣi sūrya
verses.en: Surya, thou mountest up to meet the Hero famous for his wealth, Who hurls the bolt and works for man

verses.sa: नव यो नवतिं पुरो बिभेद बाह्वोजसा । अहिं च वृत्रहावधीत्॥
verses.tr: nava yo navatiṃ puro bibheda bāhvojasā ahiṃ ca vṛtrahāvadhīt
verses.en: Him who with might of both his arms brake nine-and-ninety castles down, Slew Vrtra and smote Ahi dead.

verses.sa: स न इन्द्रः शिवः सखाऽश्वावद्गोमद्यवमत् । उरुधारेव दोहते॥
verses.tr: sa na indraḥ śivaḥ sakhā'śvāvadgomadyavamat urudhāreva dohate
verses.en: This Indra is our gracious Friend. He sends us in a full broad stream Riches in horses, kine, and corn.

verses.sa: यदद्य कच्च वृत्रहन्नुदगा अभि सूर्य । सर्वं तदिन्द्र ते वशे॥
verses.tr: yadadya kacca vṛtrahannudagā abhi sūrya sarvaṃ tadindra te vaśe
verses.en: Whatever, Vrtra-slayer! thou, Surya, hast risen upon to-day, That, Indra, all is in thy power.

verses.sa: यद्वा प्रवृद्ध सत्पते न मरा इति मन्यसे । उतो तत्सत्यमित्तव॥
verses.tr: yadvā pravṛddha satpate na marā iti manyase uto tatsatyamittava
verses.en: When, Mighty One, Lord of the brave, thou thinkest thus, I shall not die, That thought of thine is true indeed.

verses.sa: ये सोमासः परावति ये अर्वावति सुन्विरे । सर्वाँस्ताँ इन्द्र गच्छसि॥
verses.tr: ye somāsaḥ parāvati ye arvāvati sunvire sarvāṃstāṃ indra gacchasi
verses.en: Thou, Indra, goest unto all Soma libations shed for thee, Both far away and near at hand.

verses.sa: तमिन्द्रं वाजयामसि महे वृत्राय हन्तवे । स वृषा वृषभो भुवत्॥
verses.tr: tamindraṃ vājayāmasi mahe vṛtrāya hantave sa vṛṣā vṛṣabho bhuvat
verses.en: We make this Indra very strong to strike the mighty Vrtra dead: A vigorous Hero shall he be.

verses.sa: इन्द्रः स दामने कृत ओजिष्ठः स मदे हितः । द्युम्नी श्लोकी स सोम्यः॥
verses.tr: indraḥ sa dāmane kṛta ojiṣṭhaḥ sa made hitaḥ dyumnī ślokī sa somyaḥ
verses.en: Indra was made for giving, set, most mighty, o'er the joyous draught. Bright, meet for Soma, famed in song.

verses.sa: गिरा वज्रो न सम्भृतः सबलो अनपच्युतः । ववक्ष ऋष्वो अस्तृतः॥
verses.tr: girā vajro na sambhṛtaḥ sabalo anapacyutaḥ vavakṣa ṛṣvo astṛtaḥ
verses.en: By song as 'twere, the powerful bolt which none may parry was prepared Lofty, invincible he grew.

verses.sa: दुर्गे चिन्नः सुगं कृधि गृणान इन्द्र गिर्वणः । त्वं च मघवन्वशः॥
verses.tr: durge cinnaḥ sugaṃ kṛdhi gṛṇāna indra girvaṇaḥ tvaṃ ca maghavanvaśaḥ
verses.en: Indra, Song-lover, lauded, make even in the wilds fair ways for us, Whenever, Maghavan, thou wilt.

verses.sa: यस्य ते नू चिदादिशं न मिनन्ति स्वराज्यम् । न देवो नाध्रिगुर्जनः॥
verses.tr: yasya te nū cidādiśaṃ na minanti svarājyam na devo nādhrigurjanaḥ
verses.en: Thou whose commandment and behest of sovran sway none disregards, Neither audacious man nor God.

verses.sa: अधा ते अप्रतिष्कुतं देवी शुष्मं सपर्यतः । उभे सुशिप्र रोदसी॥
verses.tr: adhā te apratiṣkutaṃ devī śuṣmaṃ saparyataḥ ubhe suśipra rodasī
verses.en: And both these Goddesses, Earth, Heaven, Lord of the beauteous helm! revere Thy might which no one may resist.

verses.sa: त्वमेतदधारयः कृष्णासु रोहिणीषु च । परुष्णीषु रुशत्पयः॥
verses.tr: tvametadadhārayaḥ kṛṣṇāsu rohiṇīṣu ca paruṣṇīṣu ruśatpayaḥ
verses.en: Thou in the black cows and the red and in the cows with spotted skin This white milk hast deposited.

verses.sa: वि यदहेरध त्विषो विश्वे देवासो अक्रमुः । विदन्मृगस्य ताँ अमः॥
verses.tr: vi yadaheradha tviṣo viśve devāso akramuḥ vidanmṛgasya tāṃ amaḥ
verses.en: When in their terror all the Gods shrank from the Dragon's furious might, Fear of the monster fell on them.

verses.sa: आदु मे निवरो भुवद्वृत्रहादिष्ट पौंस्यम् । अजातशत्रुरस्तृतः॥
verses.tr: ādu me nivaro bhuvadvṛtrahādiṣṭa pauṃsyam ajātaśatrurastṛtaḥ
verses.en: Then he was my Defender, then, Invincible, whose foe is not, The Vrtra-slayer showed his might.

verses.sa: श्रुतं वो वृत्रहन्तमं प्र शर्धं चर्षणीनाम् । आ शुषे राधसे महे॥
verses.tr: śrutaṃ vo vṛtrahantamaṃ pra śardhaṃ carṣaṇīnām ā śuṣe rādhase mahe
verses.en: Him your best Vrtra-slayer, him the famous Champion of mankind I urge to great munificence,

verses.sa: अया धिया च गव्यया पुरुणामन्पुरुष्टुत । यत्सोमेसोम आभवः॥
verses.tr: ayā dhiyā ca gavyayā puruṇāmanpuruṣṭuta yatsomesoma ābhavaḥ
verses.en: To come, Much-lauded! Many-named with this same thought that longs for milk, Whene'er the Soma juice is shed.

verses.sa: बोधिन्मना इदस्तु नो वृत्रहा भूर्यासुतिः । शृणोतु शक्र आशिषम्॥
verses.tr: bodhinmanā idastu no vṛtrahā bhūryāsutiḥ śṛṇotu śakra āśiṣam
verses.en: Much-honoured by libations, may the Vrtra-slayer wake for us: May Sakra listen to our prayers.

verses.sa: कया त्वं न ऊत्याऽभि प्र मन्दसे वृषन् । कया स्तोतृभ्य आ भर॥
verses.tr: kayā tvaṃ na ūtyā'bhi pra mandase vṛṣan kayā stotṛbhya ā bhara
verses.en: O Hero, with that aid dost thou delight us, with what succour bring Riches to those who worship thee?

verses.sa: कस्य वृषा सुते सचा नियुत्वान्वृषभो रणत् । वृत्रहा सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: kasya vṛṣā sute sacā niyutvānvṛṣabho raṇat vṛtrahā somapītaye
verses.en: With whose libation joys the Strong, the Hero with his team who quells The foe, to drink the Soma juice?

verses.sa: अभी षु णस्त्वं रयिं मन्दसानः सहस्रिणम् । प्रयन्ता बोधि दाशुषे॥
verses.tr: abhī ṣu ṇastvaṃ rayiṃ mandasānaḥ sahasriṇam prayantā bodhi dāśuṣe
verses.en: Rejoicing in thy spirit bring thousand fold opulence to us: Enrich thy votary with gifts.

verses.sa: पत्नीवन्तः सुता इम उशन्तो यन्ति वीतये । अपां जग्मिर्निचुम्पुणः॥
verses.tr: patnīvantaḥ sutā ima uśanto yanti vītaye apāṃ jagmirnicumpuṇaḥ
verses.en: These juices with their wedded wives flow to enjoyment lovingly: To waters speeds the restless one.

verses.sa: इष्टा होत्रा असृक्षतेन्द्रं वृधासो अध्वरे । अच्छावभृथमोजसा॥
verses.tr: iṣṭā hotrā asṛkṣatendraṃ vṛdhāso adhvare acchāvabhṛthamojasā
verses.en: Presented strengthening gifts have sent Indra away at sacrifice, With might, onto the cleansing bath.

verses.sa: इह त्या सधमाद्या हरी हिरण्यकेश्या । वोळ्हामभि प्रयो हितम्॥
verses.tr: iha tyā sadhamādyā harī hiraṇyakeśyā voḻhāmabhi prayo hitam
verses.en: These two who share his feast, Bay Steeds with golden manes, shall bring him to The banquet that is laid for him.

verses.sa: तुभ्यं सोमाः सुता इमे स्तीर्णं बर्हिर्विभावसो । स्तोतृभ्य इन्द्रमा वह॥
verses.tr: tubhyaṃ somāḥ sutā ime stīrṇaṃ barhirvibhāvaso stotṛbhya indramā vaha
verses.en: For thee, O Lord of Light, are shed these Soma-drops, and grass is strewn Bring Indra to his worshippers.

verses.sa: आ ते दक्षं वि रोचना दधद्रत्ना वि दाशुषे । स्तोतृभ्य इन्द्रमर्चत॥
verses.tr: ā te dakṣaṃ vi rocanā dadhadratnā vi dāśuṣe stotṛbhya indramarcata
verses.en: May Indra give thee skill, and lights of heaven, wealth to his votary And priests who praise him: laud ye him.

verses.sa: आ ते दधामीन्द्रियमुक्था विश्वा शतक्रतो । स्तोतृभ्य इन्द्र मृळय॥
verses.tr: ā te dadhāmīndriyamukthā viśvā śatakrato stotṛbhya indra mṛḻaya
verses.en: O Satakratu, wondrous strength and all our lauds I bring to thee: Be gracious to thy worshippers.

verses.sa: भद्रम्भद्रं न आ भरेषमूर्जं शतक्रतो । यदिन्द्र मृळयासि नः॥
verses.tr: bhadrambhadraṃ na ā bhareṣamūrjaṃ śatakrato yadindra mṛḻayāsi naḥ
verses.en: Bring to us all things excellent, O Satakratu, food and strength: For, Indra, thou art kind to us.

verses.sa: स नो विश्वान्या भर सुवितानि शतक्रतो । यदिन्द्र मृळयासि नः॥
verses.tr: sa no viśvānyā bhara suvitāni śatakrato yadindra mṛḻayāsi naḥ
verses.en: O Satakratu, bring to us all blessings, all felicity: Fbr, Indra, thou art kind to us.

verses.sa: त्वामिद्वृत्रहन्तम सुतावन्तो हवामहे । यदिन्द्र मृळयासि नः॥
verses.tr: tvāmidvṛtrahantama sutāvanto havāmahe yadindra mṛḻayāsi naḥ
verses.en: Bearing the Soma juice we call, best Vrtra-slayer, unto thee: For, Indra, thou art kind to us.

verses.sa: उप नो हरिभिः सुतं याहि मदानां पते । उप नो हरिभिः सुतम्॥
verses.tr: upa no haribhiḥ sutaṃ yāhi madānāṃ pate upa no haribhiḥ sutam
verses.en: Come, Lord of rapturous, joys, to our libation with thy Bay Steeds, come To our libation with thy Steeds.

verses.sa: द्विता यो वृत्रहन्तमो विद इन्द्रः शतक्रतुः । उप नो हरिभिः सुतम्॥
verses.tr: dvitā yo vṛtrahantamo vida indraḥ śatakratuḥ upa no haribhiḥ sutam
verses.en: Known as best Vrtra-slayer erst, as Indra Satakratu, come With Bay Steeds to the juice we shed.

verses.sa: त्वं हि वृत्रहन्नेषां पाता सोमानामसि । उप नो हरिभिः सुतम्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ hi vṛtrahanneṣāṃ pātā somānāmasi upa no haribhiḥ sutam
verses.en: O Vrtra-slayer, thou art he who drinks these drops of Soma: come With Bay Steeds to the juice we shed.

verses.sa: इन्द्र इषे ददातु न ऋभुक्षणमृभुं रयिम् । वाजी ददातु वाजिनम्॥
verses.tr: indra iṣe dadātu na ṛbhukṣaṇamṛbhuṃ rayim vājī dadātu vājinam
verses.en: May Indra give, to aid us, wealth handy that rules the Skilful Ones: Yea, may the Strong give potent wealth.

verses.sa: गौर्धयति मरुतां श्रवस्युर्माता मघोनाम् । युक्ता वह्नी रथानाम्॥
verses.tr: gaurdhayati marutāṃ śravasyurmātā maghonām yuktā vahnī rathānām
verses.en: The Cow, the famous Mother of the wealthy Maruts, pours her milk: Both horses of the cars are yoked,-

verses.sa: यस्या देवा उपस्थे व्रता विश्वे धारयन्ते । सूर्यामासा दृशे कम्॥
verses.tr: yasyā devā upasthe vratā viśve dhārayante sūryāmāsā dṛśe kam
verses.en: She in whose bosom all the Gods, and Sun and Moon for men to see, Maintain their everlasting Laws.

verses.sa: तत्सु नो विश्वे अर्य आ सदा गृणन्ति कारवः । मरुतः सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: tatsu no viśve arya ā sadā gṛṇanti kāravaḥ marutaḥ somapītaye
verses.en: This all the pious sing to us, and sacred poets evermore: The Maruts to the Soma-draught

verses.sa: अस्ति सोमो अयं सुतः पिबन्त्यस्य मरुतः । उत स्वराजो अश्विना॥
verses.tr: asti somo ayaṃ sutaḥ pibantyasya marutaḥ uta svarājo aśvinā
verses.en: Here is the Soma ready pressed of this the Maruts drink, of this Self-luminous the Asvins drink.

verses.sa: पिबन्ति मित्रो अर्यमा तना पूतस्य वरुणः । त्रिषधस्थस्य जावतः॥
verses.tr: pibanti mitro aryamā tanā pūtasya varuṇaḥ triṣadhasthasya jāvataḥ
verses.en: Of this, moreover, purified, set in three places, procreant, Drink Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman.

verses.sa: उतो न्वस्य जोषमाँ इन्द्रः सुतस्य गोमतः । प्रातर्होतेव मत्सति॥
verses.tr: uto nvasya joṣamāṃ indraḥ sutasya gomataḥ prātarhoteva matsati
verses.en: And Indra, like the Herald Priest, desirous of the milky juice, At early morn will quaff thereof.

verses.sa: कदत्विषन्त सूरयस्तिर आप इव स्रिधः । अर्षन्ति पूतदक्षसः॥
verses.tr: kadatviṣanta sūrayastira āpa iva sridhaḥ arṣanti pūtadakṣasaḥ
verses.en: When have the Princes gleamed and shone through waters as through troops of foes'? When hasten they whose might is pure?

verses.sa: कद्वो अद्य महानां देवानामवो वृणे । त्मना च दस्मवर्चसाम्॥
verses.tr: kadvo adya mahānāṃ devānāmavo vṛṇe tmanā ca dasmavarcasām
verses.en: What favour do I claim this day of you great Deities, you who are Wondrously splendid in yourselves?

verses.sa: आ ये विश्वा पार्थिवानि पप्रथन्रोचना दिवः । मरुतः सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: ā ye viśvā pārthivāni paprathanrocanā divaḥ marutaḥ somapītaye
verses.en: 1 call, to drink the Soma, those Maruts who spread all realms of earth And luminous regions of the sky.

verses.sa: त्यान्नु पूतदक्षसो दिवो वो मरुतो हुवे । अस्य सोमस्य पीतये॥
verses.tr: tyānnu pūtadakṣaso divo vo maruto huve asya somasya pītaye
verses.en: You, even such, pure in your might, you, O ye Maruts, I invoke From heaven to drink this Soma juice.

verses.sa: त्यान्नु ये वि रोदसी तस्तभुर्मरुतो हुवे । अस्य सोमस्य पीतये॥
verses.tr: tyānnu ye vi rodasī tastabhurmaruto huve asya somasya pītaye
verses.en: The Maruts, those who have sustained and propped the heavens and earth apart, I call to drink this Soma juice.

verses.sa: त्यं नु मारुतं गणं गिरिष्ठां वृषणं हुवे । अस्य सोमस्य पीतये॥
verses.tr: tyaṃ nu mārutaṃ gaṇaṃ giriṣṭhāṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ huve asya somasya pītaye
verses.en: That vigorous band of Maruts that abideth in the mountains, I Invoke to drink this Soma juice.

verses.sa: आ त्वा गिरो रथीरिवाऽस्थुः सुतेषु गिर्वणः । अभि त्वा समनूषतेन्द्र वत्सं न मातरः॥
verses.tr: ā tvā giro rathīrivā'sthuḥ suteṣu girvaṇaḥ abhi tvā samanūṣatendra vatsaṃ na mātaraḥ
verses.en: Song-LOVER! like a charioteer come songs to thee when Soma flows. O Indra, they have called to thee as mother-kine unto their calves.

verses.sa: आ त्वा शुक्रा अचुच्यवुः सुतास इन्द्र गिर्वणः । पिबा त्व१स्यान्धस इन्द्र विश्वासु ते हितम्॥
verses.tr: ā tvā śukrā acucyavuḥ sutāsa indra girvaṇaḥ pibā tva1syāndhasa indra viśvāsu te hitam
verses.en: Bright juices hitherward have sped thee, Indra, Lover of the Song. Drink, Indra, of this flowing sap: in every house 'tis set for thee.

verses.sa: पिबा सोमं मदाय कमिन्द्र श्येनाभृतं सुतम् । त्वं हि शश्वतीनां पती राजा विशामसि॥
verses.tr: pibā somaṃ madāya kamindra śyenābhṛtaṃ sutam tvaṃ hi śaśvatīnāṃ patī rājā viśāmasi
verses.en: Drink Soma to inspirit thee, juice, Indra, which the Falcon brought: For thou art King and Sovran Lord of all the families of men.

verses.sa: श्रुधी हवं तिरश्च्या इन्द्र यस्त्वा सपर्यति । सुवीर्यस्य गोमतो रायस्पूर्धि महाँ असि॥
verses.tr: śrudhī havaṃ tiraścyā indra yastvā saparyati suvīryasya gomato rāyaspūrdhi mahāṃ asi
verses.en: O Indra, hear Tirasci's call, the call of him who serveth thee. Satisfy him with wealth of kine and valiant offspring: Great art thou.

verses.sa: इन्द्र यस्ते नवीयसीं गिरं मन्द्रामजीजनत् । चिकित्विन्मनसं धियं प्रत्नामृतस्य पिप्युषीम्॥
verses.tr: indra yaste navīyasīṃ giraṃ mandrāmajījanat cikitvinmanasaṃ dhiyaṃ pratnāmṛtasya pipyuṣīm
verses.en: For he, O Indra, hath produced for thee the newest gladdening song, A hymn that springs from careful thought, ancient, and full of sacred truth.

verses.sa: तमु ष्टवाम यं गिर इन्द्रमुक्थानि वावृधुः । पुरूण्यस्य पौंस्या सिषासन्तो वनामहे॥
verses.tr: tamu ṣṭavāma yaṃ gira indramukthāni vāvṛdhuḥ purūṇyasya pauṃsyā siṣāsanto vanāmahe
verses.en: That Indra will we laud whom songs and hymns of praise have magnified. Striving to win, we celebrate his many deeds of hero might.

verses.sa: एतो न्विन्द्रं स्तवाम शुद्धं शुद्धेन साम्ना । शुद्धैरुक्थैर्वावृध्वांसं शुद्ध आशीर्वान्ममत्तु॥
verses.tr: eto nvindraṃ stavāma śuddhaṃ śuddhena sāmnā śuddhairukthairvāvṛdhvāṃsaṃ śuddha āśīrvānmamattu
verses.en: Come now and let us glorify pure Indra with pure Sama hymns. Let the pure milky draught delight him strengthened by pure songs of praise.

verses.sa: इन्द्र शुद्धो न आ गहि शुद्धः शुद्धाभिरूतिभिः । शुद्धो रयिं नि धारय शुद्धो ममद्धि सोम्यः॥
verses.tr: indra śuddho na ā gahi śuddhaḥ śuddhābhirūtibhiḥ śuddho rayiṃ ni dhāraya śuddho mamaddhi somyaḥ
verses.en: O Indra, come thou pure to us, with pure assistance, pure thyself. Pure, send thou riches down to us, and, meet for Soma, pure, be glad.

verses.sa: इन्द्र शुद्धो हि नो रयिं शुद्धो रत्नानि दाशुषे । शुद्धो वृत्राणि जिघ्नसे शुद्धो वाजं सिषाससि॥
verses.tr: indra śuddho hi no rayiṃ śuddho ratnāni dāśuṣe śuddho vṛtrāṇi jighnase śuddho vājaṃ siṣāsasi
verses.en: O Indra, pure, vouchsafe us wealth, and, pure, enrich the worshipper. Pure, thou dost strike the Vrtras dead, and strivest, pure, to win the spoil.

verses.sa:
अस्मा उषास आतिरन्त याममिन्द्राय नक्तमूर्म्याः सुवाचः ।
अस्मा आपो मातरः सप्त तस्थुर्नृभ्यस्तराय सिन्धवः सुपाराः॥
verses.tr: asmā uṣāsa ātiranta yāmamindrāya naktamūrmyāḥ suvācaḥ asmā āpo mātaraḥ sapta tasthurnṛbhyastarāya sindhavaḥ supārāḥ
verses.en: For him the Mornings made their courses longer, and Nights with pleasant voices spake to Indra. For him the Floods stood still, the Seven Mothers, Streams easy for the heroes to pass over.

verses.sa:
अतिविद्धा विथुरेणा चिदस्त्रा त्रिः सप्त सानु संहिता गिरीणाम् ।
न तद्देवो न मर्त्यस्तुतुर्याद्यानि प्रवृद्धो वृषभश्चकार॥
verses.tr: atividdhā vithureṇā cidastrā triḥ sapta sānu saṃhitā girīṇām na taddevo na martyastuturyādyāni pravṛddho vṛṣabhaścakāra
verses.en: The Darter penetrated, though in trouble, thrice-seven close-pressed ridges of the mountains. Neither might God nor mortal man accomplish what the Strong Hero wrought in full-grown vigour.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य वज्र आयसो निमिश्ल इन्द्रस्य बाह्वोर्भूयिष्ठमोजः ।
शीर्षन्निन्द्रस्य क्रतवो निरेक आसन्नेषन्त श्रुत्या उपाके॥
verses.tr: indrasya vajra āyaso nimiśla indrasya bāhvorbhūyiṣṭhamojaḥ śīrṣannindrasya kratavo nireka āsanneṣanta śrutyā upāke
verses.en: The mightiest force is Indra's bolt of iron when firmly grasped in both the arms of Indra. His head and mouth have powers that pass all others, and all his people hasten near to listen.

verses.sa:
मन्ये त्वा यज्ञियं यज्ञियानां मन्ये त्वा च्यवनमच्युतानाम् ।
मन्ये त्वा सत्वनामिन्द्र केतुं मन्ये त्वा वृषभं चर्षणीनाम्॥
verses.tr: manye tvā yajñiyaṃ yajñiyānāṃ manye tvā cyavanamacyutānām manye tvā satvanāmindra ketuṃ manye tvā vṛṣabhaṃ carṣaṇīnām
verses.en: 1 count thee as the Holiest of the Holy, the caster-down of what hath ne'er been shaken. I count thee as the Banner of the heroes, I count thee as the Chief of all men living.

verses.sa:
आ यद्वज्रं बाह्वोरिन्द्र धत्से मदच्युतमहये हन्तवा उ ।
प्र पर्वता अनवन्त प्र गावः प्र ब्रह्माणो अभिनक्षन्त इन्द्रम्॥
verses.tr: ā yadvajraṃ bāhvorindra dhatse madacyutamahaye hantavā u pra parvatā anavanta pra gāvaḥ pra brahmāṇo abhinakṣanta indram
verses.en: What time, O Indra, in thine arms thou tookest thy wildly rushing bolt to Slay the Dragon, The mountains roared, the cattle loudly bellowed, the Brahmans with their hymns drew nigh to Indra.

verses.sa:
तमु ष्टवाम य इमा जजान विश्वा जातान्यवराण्यस्मात् ।
इन्द्रेण मित्रं दिधिषेम गीर्भिरुपो नमोभिर्वृषभं विशेम॥
verses.tr: tamu ṣṭavāma ya imā jajāna viśvā jātānyavarāṇyasmāt indreṇa mitraṃ didhiṣema gīrbhirupo namobhirvṛṣabhaṃ viśema
verses.en: Let us praise him who made these worlds and creatures, all things that after him sprang into being. May we win Mitra with our songs, and Indra, and. wait upon our Lord with adoration.

verses.sa:
वृत्रस्य त्वा श्वसथादीषमाणा विश्वे देवा अजहुर्ये सखायः ।
मरुद्भिरिन्द्र सख्यं ते अस्त्वथेमा विश्वाः पृतना जयासि॥
verses.tr: vṛtrasya tvā śvasathādīṣamāṇā viśve devā ajahurye sakhāyaḥ marudbhirindra sakhyaṃ te astvathemā viśvāḥ pṛtanā jayāsi
verses.en: Flying in terror from the snort of Vrtra, all Deities who were thy friends forsook thee. So, Indra, be thy friendship with the Maruts: in all these battles thou shalt be the victor.

verses.sa:
त्रिः षष्टिस्त्वा मरुतो वावृधाना उस्रा इव राशयो यज्ञियासः ।
उप त्वेमः कृधि नो भागधेयं शुष्मं त एना हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr: triḥ ṣaṣṭistvā maruto vāvṛdhānā usrā iva rāśayo yajñiyāsaḥ upa tvemaḥ kṛdhi no bhāgadheyaṃ śuṣmaṃ ta enā haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: Thrice-sixty Maruts, waxing strong, were with thee, like piles of beaming light, worthy of worship. We come to thee: grant us a happy portion. Let us adore thy might with this oblation.

verses.sa:
तिग्ममायुधं मरुतामनीकं कस्त इन्द्र प्रति वज्रं दधर्ष ।
अनायुधासो असुरा अदेवाश्चक्रेण ताँ अप वप ऋजीषिन्॥
verses.tr: tigmamāyudhaṃ marutāmanīkaṃ kasta indra prati vajraṃ dadharṣa anāyudhāso asurā adevāścakreṇa tāṃ apa vapa ṛjīṣin
verses.en: A sharpened weapon is the host of Maruts. Who, Indra, dares withstand thy bolt of thunder? Weaponless are the Asuras, the godless: scatter them with thy wheel, Impetuous Hero.

verses.sa:
मह उग्राय तवसे सुवृक्तिं प्रेरय शिवतमाय पश्वः ।
गिर्वाहसे गिर इन्द्राय पूर्वीर्धेहि तन्वे कुविदङ्ग वेदत्॥
verses.tr: maha ugrāya tavase suvṛktiṃ preraya śivatamāya paśvaḥ girvāhase gira indrāya pūrvīrdhehi tanve kuvidaṅga vedat
verses.en: To him the Strong and Mighty, most auspicious, send up the beauteous hymn for sake of cattle. Lay oa his body many songs for Indra invoked with song, for will not he regard. them?

verses.sa:
उक्थवाहसे विभ्वे मनीषां द्रुणा न पारमीरया नदीनाम् ।
नि स्पृश धिया तन्वि श्रुतस्य जुष्टतरस्य कुविदङ्ग वेदत्॥
verses.tr: ukthavāhase vibhve manīṣāṃ druṇā na pāramīrayā nadīnām ni spṛśa dhiyā tanvi śrutasya juṣṭatarasya kuvidaṅga vedat
verses.en: To him, the Mighty, who accepts laudation, send forth thy thought as by a boat o'er rivers, Stir with thy hymn the body of the Famous and Dearest One, for will not he regard it?

verses.sa:
तद्विविड्ढि यत्त इन्द्रो जुजोषत्स्तुहि सुष्टुतिं नमसा विवास ।
उप भूष जरितर्मा रुवण्यः श्रावया वाचं कुविदङ्ग वेदत्॥
verses.tr: tadviviḍḍhi yatta indro jujoṣatstuhi suṣṭutiṃ namasā vivāsa upa bhūṣa jaritarmā ruvaṇyaḥ śrāvayā vācaṃ kuvidaṅga vedat
verses.en: Serve him with gifts of thine which Indra welcomes: praise with fair praise, invite him with thine homage. Draw near, O singer, and refrain from outcry. Make thy voice heard, for will not he regard it?

verses.sa:
अव द्रप्सो अंशुमतीमतिष्ठदियानः कृष्णो दशभिः सहस्रैः ।
आवत्तमिन्द्रः शच्या धमन्तमप स्नेहितीर्नृमणा अधत्त॥
verses.tr: ava drapso aṃśumatīmatiṣṭhadiyānaḥ kṛṣṇo daśabhiḥ sahasraiḥ āvattamindraḥ śacyā dhamantamapa snehitīrnṛmaṇā adhatta
verses.en: The Black Drop sank in Amsumati's bosom, advancing with ten thousand round about it. Indra with might longed for it as it panted: the hero-hearted laid aside his weapons.

verses.sa:
द्रप्समपश्यं विषुणे चरन्तमुपह्वरे नद्यो अंशुमत्याः ।
नभो न कृष्णमवतस्थिवांसमिष्यामि वो वृषणो युध्यताजौ॥
verses.tr: drapsamapaśyaṃ viṣuṇe carantamupahvare nadyo aṃśumatyāḥ nabho na kṛṣṇamavatasthivāṃsamiṣyāmi vo vṛṣaṇo yudhyatājau
verses.en: 1 saw the Drop in the far distance moving, on the slope bank of Amsumati's river, Like a black cloud that sank into the water. Heroes, I send you forth. Go, fight in battle.

verses.sa:
अध द्रप्सो अंशुमत्या उपस्थेऽधारयत्तन्वं तित्विषाणः ।
विशो अदेवीरभ्या३चरन्तीर्बृहस्पतिना युजेन्द्रः ससाहे॥
verses.tr: adha drapso aṃśumatyā upasthe'dhārayattanvaṃ titviṣāṇaḥ viśo adevīrabhyā3carantīrbṛhaspatinā yujendraḥ sasāhe
verses.en: And then the Drop in Amsumati's bosom, splendid with light, assumed its proper body; And Indra, with Brhaspati to aid him, conquered the godless tribes that came against him.

verses.sa:
त्वं ह त्यत्सप्तभ्यो जायमानोऽशत्रुभ्यो अभवः शत्रुरिन्द्र ।
गूळ्हे द्यावापृथिवी अन्वविन्दो विभुमद्भ्यो भुवनेभ्यो रणं धाः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ ha tyatsaptabhyo jāyamāno'śatrubhyo abhavaḥ śatrurindra gūḻhe dyāvāpṛthivī anvavindo vibhumadbhyo bhuvanebhyo raṇaṃ dhāḥ
verses.en: Then, at thy birth, thou wast the foeman, Indra, of those the seven who ne'er had met a rival. The hidden Pair, the Heaven and Earth, thou foundest, and to the mighty worlds thou gavest pleasure.

verses.sa:
त्वं ह त्यदप्रतिमानमोजो वज्रेण वज्रिन्धृषितो जघन्थ ।
त्वं शुष्णस्यावातिरो वधत्रैस्त्वं गा इन्द्र शच्येदविन्दः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ ha tyadapratimānamojo vajreṇa vajrindhṛṣito jaghantha tvaṃ śuṣṇasyāvātiro vadhatraistvaṃ gā indra śacyedavindaḥ
verses.en: So, Thunder-armed! thou with thy bolt of thunder didst boldly smite that power which none might equal; With weapons broughtest low the might of Susna, and, Indra, foundest by thy strength the cattle.

verses.sa:
त्वं ह त्यद्वृषभ चर्षणीनां घनो वृत्राणां तविषो बभूथ ।
त्वं सिन्धूँरसृजस्तस्तभानान्त्वमपो अजयो दासपत्नीः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ ha tyadvṛṣabha carṣaṇīnāṃ ghano vṛtrāṇāṃ taviṣo babhūtha tvaṃ sindhūṃrasṛjastastabhānāntvamapo ajayo dāsapatnīḥ
verses.en: Then wast thou, Chieftain of all living mortals, the very mighty slayer of the Vrtras. Then didst thou set the obstructed rivers flowing, and win the floods that were enthralled by Dasas.

verses.sa:
स सुक्रतू रणिता यः सुतेष्वनुत्तमन्युर्यो अहेव रेवान् ।
य एक इन्नर्यपांसि कर्ता स वृत्रहा प्रतीदन्यमाहुः॥
verses.tr: sa sukratū raṇitā yaḥ suteṣvanuttamanyuryo aheva revān ya eka innaryapāṃsi kartā sa vṛtrahā pratīdanyamāhuḥ
verses.en: Most wise is he, rejoicing in libations, splendid as day, resistless in his anger. He only doth great deeds, the only Hero, sole Vrtra-slayer he, with none beside him.

verses.sa:
स वृत्रहेन्द्रश्चर्षणीधृत्तं सुष्टुत्या हव्यं हुवेम ।
स प्राविता मघवा नोऽधिवक्ता स वाजस्य श्रवस्यस्य दाता॥
verses.tr: sa vṛtrahendraścarṣaṇīdhṛttaṃ suṣṭutyā havyaṃ huvema sa prāvitā maghavā no'dhivaktā sa vājasya śravasyasya dātā
verses.en: Indra is Vrtra's slayer, man's sustainer: he must be called; with fair praise let us call him. Maghavan is our Helper, our Protector, giver of spoil and wealth to make us famous.

verses.sa:
स वृत्रहेन्द्र ऋभुक्षाः सद्यो जज्ञानो हव्यो बभूव ।
कृण्वन्नपांसि नर्या पुरूणि सोमो न पीतो हव्यः सखिभ्यः॥
verses.tr: sa vṛtrahendra ṛbhukṣāḥ sadyo jajñāno havyo babhūva kṛṇvannapāṃsi naryā purūṇi somo na pīto havyaḥ sakhibhyaḥ
verses.en: This Indra, Vrtra-slayer, this Rbhuksan, even at his birth, was meet for invocation. Doer of many deeds for man's advantage, like Soma quaffed, for friends we must invoke him.

verses.sa: या इन्द्र भुज आभरः स्वर्वाँ असुरेभ्यः । स्तोतारमिन्मघवन्नस्य वर्धय ये च त्वे वृक्तबर्हिषः॥
verses.tr: yā indra bhuja ābharaḥ svarvāṃ asurebhyaḥ stotāraminmaghavannasya vardhaya ye ca tve vṛktabarhiṣaḥ
verses.en: O INDRA, Lord of Light, what joys thou broughtest from the Asuras, Prosper therewith, O Maghavan, him who lauds that deed, and those whose grass is trimmed for thee.

verses.sa: यमिन्द्र दधिषे त्वमश्वं गां भागमव्ययम् । यजमाने सुन्वति दक्षिणावति तस्मिन्तं धेहि मा पणौ॥
verses.tr: yamindra dadhiṣe tvamaśvaṃ gāṃ bhāgamavyayam yajamāne sunvati dakṣiṇāvati tasmintaṃ dhehi mā paṇau
verses.en: The unwasting share of steeds and kine which, Indra, thou hast fast secured, Grant to the worshipper who presses Soma and gives guerdon, not unto the churl.

verses.sa: य इन्द्र सस्त्यव्रतोऽनुष्वापमदेवयुः । स्वैः ष एवैर्मुमुरत्पोष्यं रयिं सनुतर्धेहि तं ततः॥
verses.tr: ya indra sastyavrato'nuṣvāpamadevayuḥ svaiḥ ṣa evairmumuratpoṣyaṃ rayiṃ sanutardhehi taṃ tataḥ
verses.en: The riteless, godless man who sleeps, O Indra, his unbroken steep,- May he by following his own devices die. Hide from him wealth that nourishes.

verses.sa: यच्छक्रासि परावति यदर्वावति वृत्रहन् । अतस्त्वा गीर्भिर्द्युगदिन्द्र केशिभिः सुतावाँ आ विवासति॥
verses.tr: yacchakrāsi parāvati yadarvāvati vṛtrahan atastvā gīrbhirdyugadindra keśibhiḥ sutāvāṃ ā vivāsati
verses.en: Whether, O Sakra, thou be far, or, Vrtra-slayer, near at hand, Thence by heaven-reaching songs he who hath pressed the juice invites thee with thy long-maned Steeds.

verses.sa: यद्वासि रोचने दिवः समुद्रस्याधि विष्टपि । यत्पार्थिवे सदने वृत्रहन्तम यदन्तरिक्ष आ गहि॥
verses.tr: yadvāsi rocane divaḥ samudrasyādhi viṣṭapi yatpārthive sadane vṛtrahantama yadantarikṣa ā gahi
verses.en: Whether thou art in heaven's bright sphere, or in the basin of the sea; Whether, chief Vrtra-slayer, in some place on earth, or in the firmament, approach.

verses.sa: स नः सोमेषु सोमपाः सुतेषु शवसस्पते । मादयस्व राधसा सूनृतावतेन्द्र राया परीणसा॥
verses.tr: sa naḥ someṣu somapāḥ suteṣu śavasaspate mādayasva rādhasā sūnṛtāvatendra rāyā parīṇasā
verses.en: Thou Soma-drinker, Lord of Strength, beside our flowing Soma juice Delight us with thy bounty rich in pleasantness, O Indra, with abundant wealth.

verses.sa: मा न इन्द्र परा वृणग्भवा नः सधमाद्यः । त्वं न ऊती त्वमिन्न आप्यं मा न इन्द्र परा वृणक्॥
verses.tr: mā na indra parā vṛṇagbhavā naḥ sadhamādyaḥ tvaṃ na ūtī tvaminna āpyaṃ mā na indra parā vṛṇak
verses.en: O Indra, turn us not away: be the companion of our feast. For thou art our protection, yea, thou art our kin: O Indra, turn us not away.

verses.sa: अस्मे इन्द्र सचा सुते नि षदा पीतये मधु । कृधी जरित्रे मघवन्नवो महदस्मे इन्द्र सचा सुते॥
verses.tr: asme indra sacā sute ni ṣadā pītaye madhu kṛdhī jaritre maghavannavo mahadasme indra sacā sute
verses.en: Sit down with us, O Indra, sit beside the juice to drink the meath. Show forth great favour to the Singer, Maghavan; Indra, with us, beside the juice.

verses.sa: न त्वा देवास आशत न मर्त्यासो अद्रिवः । विश्वा जातानि शवसाभिभूरसि न त्वा देवास आशत॥
verses.tr: na tvā devāsa āśata na martyāso adrivaḥ viśvā jātāni śavasābhibhūrasi na tvā devāsa āśata
verses.en: O Caster of the Stone, nor Gods nor mortals have attained to thee. Thou in thy might surpassest all that hath been made: the Gods have not attained to thee.

verses.sa:
विश्वाः पृतना अभिभूतरं नरं सजूस्ततक्षुरिन्द्रं जजनुश्च राजसे ।
क्रत्वा वरिष्ठं वर आमुरिमुतोग्रमोजिष्ठं तवसं तरस्विनम्॥
verses.tr: viśvāḥ pṛtanā abhibhūtaraṃ naraṃ sajūstatakṣurindraṃ jajanuśca rājase kratvā variṣṭhaṃ vara āmurimutogramojiṣṭhaṃ tavasaṃ tarasvinam
verses.en: Of one accord they made and formed for kingship Indra, the Hero who in all encounters overcometh, Most eminent for power, destroyer in the conflict, fierce and exceeding strong, stalwart and full of vigour.

verses.sa: समीं रेभासो अस्वरन्निन्द्रं सोमस्य पीतये । स्वर्पतिं यदीं वृधे धृतव्रतो ह्योजसा समूतिभिः॥
verses.tr: samīṃ rebhāso asvarannindraṃ somasya pītaye svarpatiṃ yadīṃ vṛdhe dhṛtavrato hyojasā samūtibhiḥ
verses.en: Bards joined in song to Indra so that he might drink the Soma juice, The Lord of Light, that he whose laws stand fast might aid with power and with the help he gives.

verses.sa: नेमिं नमन्ति चक्षसा मेषं विप्रा अभिस्वरा । सुदीतयो वो अद्रुहोऽपि कर्णे तरस्विनः समृक्वभिः॥
verses.tr: nemiṃ namanti cakṣasā meṣaṃ viprā abhisvarā sudītayo vo adruho'pi karṇe tarasvinaḥ samṛkvabhiḥ
verses.en: The holy sages form a ring, looking and singing to the Ram. Inciters, full of vigour, not to he deceived, are with the chanters, nigh to bear.

verses.sa:
तमिन्द्रं जोहवीमि मघवानमुग्रं सत्रा दधानमप्रतिष्कुतं शवांसि ।
मंहिष्ठो गीर्भिरा च यज्ञियो ववर्तद्राये नो विश्वा सुपथा कृणोतु वज्री॥
verses.tr: tamindraṃ johavīmi maghavānamugraṃ satrā dadhānamapratiṣkutaṃ śavāṃsi maṃhiṣṭho gīrbhirā ca yajñiyo vavartadrāye no viśvā supathā kṛṇotu vajrī
verses.en: Loudly I call that Indra, Maghavan the Mighty, who evermore possesses power, ever resistless. Holy, most liberal, may he lead us on to riches, and, Thunder-armed, make all our pathways pleasant for us.

verses.sa:
त्वं पुर इन्द्र चिकिदेना व्योजसा शविष्ठ शक्र नाशयध्यै ।
त्वद्विश्वानि भुवनानि वज्रिन्द्यावा रेजेते पृथिवी च भीषा॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ pura indra cikidenā vyojasā śaviṣṭha śakra nāśayadhyai tvadviśvāni bhuvanāni vajrindyāvā rejete pṛthivī ca bhīṣā
verses.en: Thou knowest well, O Sakra, thou Most Potent, with thy strength, Indra, to destroy these castles. Before thee, Thunder-armed! all beings tremble: the heavens and earth before thee shake with terror,

verses.sa:
तन्म ऋतमिन्द्र शूर चित्र पात्वपो न वज्रिन्दुरिताति पर्षि भूरि ।
कदा न इन्द्र राय आ दशस्येर्विश्वप्स्न्यस्य स्पृहयाय्यस्य राजन्॥
verses.tr: tanma ṛtamindra śūra citra pātvapo na vajrinduritāti parṣi bhūri kadā na indra rāya ā daśasyerviśvapsnyasya spṛhayāyyasya rājan
verses.en: May thy truth, Indra, Wondrous Hero be my guard: bear me o'er much woe, Thunderer! as over floods. When, Indra, wilt thou honour us with opulence, all-nourishing and much-to-be. desired, O King?

verses.sa: इन्द्राय साम गायत विप्राय बृहते बृहत् । धर्मकृते विपश्चिते पनस्यवे॥
verses.tr: indrāya sāma gāyata viprāya bṛhate bṛhat dharmakṛte vipaścite panasyave
verses.en: To Indra sing a Sama hymn, a lofty song to Lofty Sage, To him who guards the Law, inspired, and fain for praise.

verses.sa: त्वमिन्द्राभिभूरसि त्वं सूर्यमरोचयः । विश्वकर्मा विश्वदेवो महाँ असि॥
verses.tr: tvamindrābhibhūrasi tvaṃ sūryamarocayaḥ viśvakarmā viśvadevo mahāṃ asi
verses.en: Thou, Indra, art the Conqueror: thou gavest splendour to the Sun. Maker of all things, thou art Mighty and All-God.

verses.sa: विभ्राजञ्ज्योतिषा स्व१रगच्छो रोचनं दिवः । देवास्त इन्द्र सख्याय येमिरे॥
verses.tr: vibhrājañjyotiṣā sva1ragaccho rocanaṃ divaḥ devāsta indra sakhyāya yemire
verses.en: Radiant with light thou wentest to the sky, the luminous realm of heaven. ne Deities, Indra strove to win thee for their Friend.

verses.sa: एन्द्र नो गधि प्रियः सत्राजिदगोह्यः । गिरिर्न विश्वतस्पृथुः पतिर्दिवः॥
verses.tr: endra no gadhi priyaḥ satrājidagohyaḥ girirna viśvataspṛthuḥ patirdivaḥ
verses.en: Come unto us, O Indra, dear, still conquering, unconcealable, Vast as a mountain spread on all sides, Lord of Heaven.

verses.sa: अभि हि सत्य सोमपा उभे बभूथ रोदसी । इन्द्रासि सुन्वतो वृधः पतिर्दिवः॥
verses.tr: abhi hi satya somapā ubhe babhūtha rodasī indrāsi sunvato vṛdhaḥ patirdivaḥ
verses.en: O truthful Soma-drinker, thou art mightier than both the worlds. Thou strengthenest him who pours libation, Lord of Heaven.

verses.sa: त्वं हि शश्वतीनामिन्द्र दर्ता पुरामसि । हन्ता दस्योर्मनोर्वृधः पतिर्दिवः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ hi śaśvatīnāmindra dartā purāmasi hantā dasyormanorvṛdhaḥ patirdivaḥ
verses.en: For thou art he, O Indra, who stormeth all castles of the foe, Slayer of Dasyus, man's Supporter, Lord of Heaven.

verses.sa: अधा हीन्द्र गिर्वण उप त्वा कामान्महः ससृज्महे । उदेव यन्त उदभिः॥
verses.tr: adhā hīndra girvaṇa upa tvā kāmānmahaḥ sasṛjmahe udeva yanta udabhiḥ
verses.en: Now have we, Indra, Friend of Song, sent our great wishes forth to thee, Coming like floods that follow floods.

verses.sa: वार्ण त्वा यव्याभिर्वर्धन्ति शूर ब्रह्माणि । वावृध्वांसं चिदद्रिवो दिवेदिवे॥
verses.tr: vārṇa tvā yavyābhirvardhanti śūra brahmāṇi vāvṛdhvāṃsaṃ cidadrivo divedive
verses.en: As rivers swell the ocean, so, Hero, our prayers increase thy might, Though of thyself, O Thunderer, waxing day by day.

verses.sa: युञ्जन्ति हरी इषिरस्य गाथयोरौ रथ उरुयुगे । इन्द्रवाहा वचोयुजा॥
verses.tr: yuñjanti harī iṣirasya gāthayorau ratha uruyuge indravāhā vacoyujā
verses.en: With holy song may bind to the broad wide-yoked car the Bay Steeds of the rapid God, Bearers of Indra, yoked by word.

verses.sa: त्वं न इन्द्रा भरँ ओजो नृम्णं शतक्रतो विचर्षणे । आ वीरं पृतनाषहम्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ na indrā bharaṃ ojo nṛmṇaṃ śatakrato vicarṣaṇe ā vīraṃ pṛtanāṣaham
verses.en: O Indra, bring great strength to us, bring valour, Satakratu, thou most active, bring A hero conquering in war.

verses.sa: त्वं हि नः पिता वसो त्वं माता शतक्रतो बभूविथ । अधा ते सुम्नमीमहे॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ hi naḥ pitā vaso tvaṃ mātā śatakrato babhūvitha adhā te sumnamīmahe
verses.en: For, gracious Satakratu, thou hast ever been a Mother and a Sire to us, So now for bliss we pray to thee.

verses.sa: त्वां शुष्मिन्पुरुहूत वाजयन्तमुप ब्रुवे शतक्रतो । स नो रास्व सुवीर्यम्॥
verses.tr: tvāṃ śuṣminpuruhūta vājayantamupa bruve śatakrato sa no rāsva suvīryam
verses.en: To thee, Strong, Much-invoked, who showest forth thy strength, O Satakratu, do I speak: So grant thou us heroic strength.

verses.sa: त्वामिदा ह्यो नरोऽपीप्यन्वज्रिन्भूर्णयः । स इन्द्र स्तोमवाहसामिह श्रुध्युप स्वसरमा गहि॥
verses.tr: tvāmidā hyo naro'pīpyanvajrinbhūrṇayaḥ sa indra stomavāhasāmiha śrudhyupa svasaramā gahi
verses.en: O THUNDERER, zealous worshippers gave thee drink this time yesterday. So, Indra, listen here to those who bring the laud: come near unto our dwelling place.

verses.sa: मत्स्वा सुशिप्र हरिवस्तदीमहे त्वे आ भूषन्ति वेधसः । तव श्रवांस्युपमान्युक्थ्या सुतेष्विन्द्र गिर्वणः॥
verses.tr: matsvā suśipra harivastadīmahe tve ā bhūṣanti vedhasaḥ tava śravāṃsyupamānyukthyā suteṣvindra girvaṇaḥ
verses.en: Lord of Bay Steeds, fair-helmed, rejoice thee: this we crave. Here the disposers wait on thee. Thy loftiest glories claim our lauds beside the juice, O Indra, Lover of the Song.

verses.sa: श्रायन्त इव सूर्यं विश्वेदिन्द्रस्य भक्षत । वसूनि जाते जनमान ओजसा प्रति भागं न दीधिम॥
verses.tr: śrāyanta iva sūryaṃ viśvedindrasya bhakṣata vasūni jāte janamāna ojasā prati bhāgaṃ na dīdhima
verses.en: Turning, as 'twere, to meet the Sun, enjoy from Indra all good things. When he who will be born is born with power we look to treasures as our heritage.

verses.sa:
अनर्शरातिं वसुदामुप स्तुहि भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ।
सो अस्य कामं विधतो न रोषति मनो दानाय चोदयन्॥
verses.tr: anarśarātiṃ vasudāmupa stuhi bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ so asya kāmaṃ vidhato na roṣati mano dānāya codayan
verses.en: Praise him who sends us wealth, whose bounties injure none: good are the gifts which Indra. grants. He is not worth with one who satisfies his wish: he turns his mind to giving boons.

verses.sa: त्वमिन्द्र प्रतूर्तिष्वभि विश्वा असि स्पृधः । अशस्तिहा जनिता विश्वतूरसि त्वं तूर्य तरुष्यतः॥
verses.tr: tvamindra pratūrtiṣvabhi viśvā asi spṛdhaḥ aśastihā janitā viśvatūrasi tvaṃ tūrya taruṣyataḥ
verses.en: Thou in thy battles, Indra, art subduer of all hostile bands. Father art thou, all-conquering, cancelling the curse, thou victor of the vanquisher.

verses.sa:
अनु ते शुष्मं तुरयन्तमीयतुः क्षोणी शिशुं न मातरा ।
विश्वास्ते स्पृधः श्नथयन्त मन्यवे वृत्रं यदिन्द्र तूर्वसि॥
verses.tr: anu te śuṣmaṃ turayantamīyatuḥ kṣoṇī śiśuṃ na mātarā viśvāste spṛdhaḥ śnathayanta manyave vṛtraṃ yadindra tūrvasi
verses.en: The Earth and Heaven clung close to thy victorious might as to their calf two mother-cows. When thou attackest Vrtra all the hostile bands shrink and faint, Indra, at thy wrath.

verses.sa: इत ऊती वो अजरं प्रहेतारमप्रहितम् । आशुं जेतारं हेतारं रथीतममतूर्तं तुग्र्यावृधम्॥
verses.tr: ita ūtī vo ajaraṃ prahetāramaprahitam āśuṃ jetāraṃ hetāraṃ rathītamamatūrtaṃ tugryāvṛdham
verses.en: Bring to your aid the Eternal One, who shoots and none may shoot at him, Inciter, swift, victorious, best of Charioteers. Tugrya's unvanquished Strengthener;

verses.sa: इष्कर्तारमनिष्कृतं सहस्कृतं शतमूतिं शतक्रतुम् । समानमिन्द्रमवसे हवामहे वसवानं वसूजुवम्॥
verses.tr: iṣkartāramaniṣkṛtaṃ sahaskṛtaṃ śatamūtiṃ śatakratum samānamindramavase havāmahe vasavānaṃ vasūjuvam
verses.en: Arranger of things unarranged, e'en Satakratu, source of might, Indra, the Friend of all, for succour we invoke, Guardian of treasure, sending wealth.

verses.sa:
अयं त एमि तन्वा पुरस्ताद्विश्वे देवा अभि मा यन्ति पश्चात् ।
यदा मह्यं दीधरो भागमिन्द्राऽऽदिन्मया कृणवो वीर्याणि॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ ta emi tanvā purastādviśve devā abhi mā yanti paścāt yadā mahyaṃ dīdharo bhāgamindrā''dinmayā kṛṇavo vīryāṇi
verses.en: I MOVE before thee here present in person, and all the Deities follow behind me. When, Indra, thou securest me my portion, with me thou shalt perform heroic actions.

verses.sa:
दधामि ते मधुनो भक्षमग्रे हितस्ते भागः सुतो अस्तु सोमः ।
असश्च त्वं दक्षिणतः सखा मेऽधा वृत्राणि जङ्घनाव भूरि॥
verses.tr: dadhāmi te madhuno bhakṣamagre hitaste bhāgaḥ suto astu somaḥ asaśca tvaṃ dakṣiṇataḥ sakhā me'dhā vṛtrāṇi jaṅghanāva bhūri
verses.en: The food of meath in foremost place I give thee, thy Soma shall be pressed, thy share appointed. Thou on my right shalt be my friend and comrade: then shall we two smite dead full many a foeman.

verses.sa:
प्र सु स्तोमं भरत वाजयन्त इन्द्राय सत्यं यदि सत्यमस्ति ।
नेन्द्रो अस्तीति नेम उ त्व आह क ईं ददर्श कमभि ष्टवाम॥
verses.tr: pra su stomaṃ bharata vājayanta indrāya satyaṃ yadi satyamasti nendro astīti nema u tva āha ka īṃ dadarśa kamabhi ṣṭavāma
verses.en: Striving for strength bring forth a laud to Indra, a truthful hymn if he in truth existeth. One and another say, There is no Indra. Who hath beheld him? Whom then shall we honour?

verses.sa:
अयमस्मि जरितः पश्य मेह विश्वा जातान्यभ्यस्मि मह्ना ।
ऋतस्य मा प्रदिशो वर्धयन्त्यादर्दिरो भुवना दर्दरीमि॥
verses.tr: ayamasmi jaritaḥ paśya meha viśvā jātānyabhyasmi mahnā ṛtasya mā pradiśo vardhayantyādardiro bhuvanā dardarīmi
verses.en: Here am I, look upon me here, O singer. All that existeth 1 surpass in greatness. The Holy Law's commandments make me mighty. Rending with strength I rend the worlds asunder.

verses.sa:
आ यन्मा वेना अरुहन्नृतस्यँ एकमासीनं हर्यतस्य पृष्ठे ।
मनश्चिन्मे हृद आ प्रत्यवोचदचिक्रदञ्छिशुमन्तः सखायः॥
verses.tr: ā yanmā venā aruhannṛtasyaṃ ekamāsīnaṃ haryatasya pṛṣṭhe manaścinme hṛda ā pratyavocadacikradañchiśumantaḥ sakhāyaḥ
verses.en: When the Law's lovers mounted and approached me as 1 sate lone upon the dear sky's summit. Then spake my spirit to the heart within me, My friends have cried unto me with their children.

verses.sa:
विश्वेत्ता ते सवनेषु प्रवाच्या या चकर्थ मघवन्निन्द्र सुन्वते ।
पारावतं यत्पुरुसम्भृतं वस्वपावृणोः शरभाय ऋषिबन्धवे॥
verses.tr: viśvettā te savaneṣu pravācyā yā cakartha maghavannindra sunvate pārāvataṃ yatpurusambhṛtaṃ vasvapāvṛṇoḥ śarabhāya ṛṣibandhave
verses.en: All these thy deeds must be declared at Soma-feasts, wrought, Indra, Bounteous Lord, for him who sheds the juice, When thou didst open wealth heaped up by many, brought from far away to Sarablia, the Rsi's kin.

verses.sa: प्र नूनं धावता पृथङ्नेह यो वो अवावरीत् । नि षीं वृत्रस्य मर्मणि वज्रमिन्द्रो अपीपतत्॥
verses.tr: pra nūnaṃ dhāvatā pṛthaṅneha yo vo avāvarīt ni ṣīṃ vṛtrasya marmaṇi vajramindro apīpatat
verses.en: Now run ye forth your several ways: he is not here who kept you back. For hath not Indra sunk his bolt deep down in Vrtra's vital part?

verses.sa: मनोजवा अयमान आयसीमतरत्पुरम् । दिवं सुपर्णो गत्वाय सोमं वज्रिण आभरत्॥
verses.tr: manojavā ayamāna āyasīmataratpuram divaṃ suparṇo gatvāya somaṃ vajriṇa ābharat
verses.en: On-rushing with the speed of thought within the iron fort he pressed: The Falcon went to heaven and brought the Soma to the Thunderer.

verses.sa: समुद्रे अन्तः शयत उद्ना वज्रो अभीवृतः । भरन्त्यस्मै संयतः पुरःप्रस्रवणा बलिम्॥
verses.tr: samudre antaḥ śayata udnā vajro abhīvṛtaḥ bharantyasmai saṃyataḥ puraḥprasravaṇā balim
verses.en: Deep in the ocean lies the bolt with waters compassed round about, And in continuous onward flow the floods their tribute bring to it.

verses.sa:
यद्वाग्वदन्त्यविचेतनानि राष्ट्री देवानां निषसाद मन्द्रा ।
चतस्र ऊर्जं दुदुहे पयांसि क्व स्विदस्याः परमं जगाम॥
verses.tr: yadvāgvadantyavicetanāni rāṣṭrī devānāṃ niṣasāda mandrā catasra ūrjaṃ duduhe payāṃsi kva svidasyāḥ paramaṃ jagāma
verses.en: When, uttering words which no one comprehended, Vak, Queen of Gods, the Gladdener, was seated, The heaven's four regions drew forth drink and vigour: now whither hath her noblest portion vanished?

verses.sa:
देवीं वाचमजनयन्त देवास्तां विश्वरूपाः पशवो वदन्ति ।
सा नो मन्द्रेषमूर्जं दुहाना धेनुर्वागस्मानुप सुष्टुतैतु॥
verses.tr: devīṃ vācamajanayanta devāstāṃ viśvarūpāḥ paśavo vadanti sā no mandreṣamūrjaṃ duhānā dhenurvāgasmānupa suṣṭutaitu
verses.en: The Deities generated Vak the Goddess, and animals of every figure speak her. May she, the Gladdener, yielding food and vigour, the Milch-cow Vak, approach us meetly lauded.

verses.sa:
सखे विष्णो वितरं वि क्रमस्व द्यौर्देहि लोकं वज्राय विष्कभे ।
हनाव वृत्रं रिणचाव सिन्धूनिन्द्रस्य यन्तु प्रसवे विसृष्टाः॥
verses.tr: sakhe viṣṇo vitaraṃ vi kramasva dyaurdehi lokaṃ vajrāya viṣkabhe hanāva vṛtraṃ riṇacāva sindhūnindrasya yantu prasave visṛṣṭāḥ
verses.en: Step forth with wider stride, my comrade Visnu; make room, Dyaus, for the leaping of the lightning. Let us slay Vrtra, let us free the rivers let them flow loosed at the command of Indra.

verses.sa: ऋधगित्था स मर्त्यः शशमे देवतातये । यो नूनं मित्रावरुणावभिष्टय आचक्रे हव्यदातये॥
verses.tr: ṛdhagitthā sa martyaḥ śaśame devatātaye yo nūnaṃ mitrāvaruṇāvabhiṣṭaya ācakre havyadātaye
verses.en: Yea, specially that mortal man hath toiled for service of the Gods, Who quickly hath brought near Mitra and Varuna. to share his sacrificial gifts.

verses.sa: वर्षिष्ठक्षत्रा उरुचक्षसा नरा राजाना दीर्घश्रुत्तमा । ता बाहुता न दंसना रथर्यतः साकं सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिः॥
verses.tr: varṣiṣṭhakṣatrā urucakṣasā narā rājānā dīrghaśruttamā tā bāhutā na daṃsanā ratharyataḥ sākaṃ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ
verses.en: Supreme in sovran power, far-sighted, Chiefs and Kings, most swift to hear from far away, Both, wondrously, set them in motion as with arms, in company with Surya's beams.

verses.sa: प्र यो वां मित्रावरुणाऽजिरो दूतो अद्रवत् । अयःशीर्षा मदेरघुः॥
verses.tr: pra yo vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā'jiro dūto adravat ayaḥśīrṣā maderaghuḥ
verses.en: The rapid messenger who runs before you, Mitra-Varuna, with iron head, swift to the draught,

verses.sa: न यः सम्पृच्छे न पुनर्हवीतवे न संवादाय रमते । तस्मान्नो अद्य समृतेरुरुष्यतं बाहुभ्यां न उरुष्यतम्॥
verses.tr: na yaḥ sampṛcche na punarhavītave na saṃvādāya ramate tasmānno adya samṛteruruṣyataṃ bāhubhyāṃ na uruṣyatam
verses.en: He whom no man may question, none may summon back, who stands not still for colloquy,- From hostile clash with him keep ye us safe this day: keep us in safety with your arms.

verses.sa: प्र मित्राय प्रार्यम्णे सचथ्यमृतावसो । वरूथ्यं१ वरुणे छन्द्यं वचः स्तोत्रं राजसु गायत॥
verses.tr: pra mitrāya prāryamṇe sacathyamṛtāvaso varūthyaṃ1 varuṇe chandyaṃ vacaḥ stotraṃ rājasu gāyata
verses.en: To Aryaman and Mitra sing a reverent song, O pious one, A pleasant hymn that shall protect to Varuna: sing forth a laud unto the Kings.

verses.sa: ते हिन्विरे अरुणं जेन्यं वस्वेकं पुत्रं तिसॄणाम् । ते धामान्यमृता मर्त्यानामदब्धा अभि चक्षते॥
verses.tr: te hinvire aruṇaṃ jenyaṃ vasvekaṃ putraṃ tisṝṇām te dhāmānyamṛtā martyānāmadabdhā abhi cakṣate
verses.en: The true, Red Treasure they have sent, one only Son born of the Three. They, the Immortal Ones, never deceived, survey the families of mortal men.

verses.sa: आ मे वचांस्युद्यता द्युमत्तमानि कर्त्वा । उभा यातं नासत्या सजोषसा प्रति हव्यानि वीतये॥
verses.tr: ā me vacāṃsyudyatā dyumattamāni kartvā ubhā yātaṃ nāsatyā sajoṣasā prati havyāni vītaye
verses.en: My songs are lifted up, and acts most splendid are to be performed. Come hither, ye Nasatyas, with accordant mind, to meet and to enjoy my gifts.

verses.sa: रातिं यद्वामरक्षसं हवामहे युवाभ्यां वाजिनीवसू । प्राचीं होत्रां प्रतिरन्तावितं नरा गृणाना जमदग्निना॥
verses.tr: rātiṃ yadvāmarakṣasaṃ havāmahe yuvābhyāṃ vājinīvasū prācīṃ hotrāṃ pratirantāvitaṃ narā gṛṇānā jamadagninā
verses.en: Lords of great wealth, when we invoke your bounty which no demon checks, Both of you, furthering our eastward-offered praise, come, Chiefs whom Jamadagni lauds!

verses.sa: आ नो यज्ञं दिविस्पृशं वायो याहि सुमन्मभिः । अन्तः पवित्र उपरि श्रीणानो३ऽयं शुक्रो अयामि ते॥
verses.tr: ā no yajñaṃ divispṛśaṃ vāyo yāhi sumanmabhiḥ antaḥ pavitra upari śrīṇāno3'yaṃ śukro ayāmi te
verses.en: Come, Vayu, drawn by fair hymns, to our sacrifice that reaches heaven. Poured on the middle of the straining cloth, and cooked, this bright drink hath been offered chalice.

verses.sa:
वेत्यध्वर्युः पथिभी रजिष्ठैः प्रति हव्यानि वीतये ।
अधा नियुत्व उभयस्य नः पिब शुचिं सोमं गवाशिरम्॥
verses.tr: vetyadhvaryuḥ pathibhī rajiṣṭhaiḥ prati havyāni vītaye adhā niyutva ubhayasya naḥ piba śuciṃ somaṃ gavāśiram
verses.en: He comes by straightest paths, as ministering Priest, to taste the sacrificial gifts. Then, Lord of harnessed teams I drink of the twofold draught, bright Soma mingled with the milk.

verses.sa: बण्महाँ असि सूर्य बळादित्य महाँ असि । महस्ते सतो महिमा पनस्यतेऽद्धा देव महाँ असि॥
verses.tr: baṇmahāṃ asi sūrya baḻāditya mahāṃ asi mahaste sato mahimā panasyate'ddhā deva mahāṃ asi
verses.en: Verily, Surya, thou art great; truly, Aditya, thou art great. As thou art great indeed, thy greatness is admired: yea, verily, thou, God, art great.

verses.sa: बट् सूर्य श्रवसा महाँ असि सत्रा देव महाँ असि । मह्ना देवानामसुर्यः पुरोहितो विभु ज्योतिरदाभ्यम्॥
verses.tr: baṭ sūrya śravasā mahāṃ asi satrā deva mahāṃ asi mahnā devānāmasuryaḥ purohito vibhu jyotiradābhyam
verses.en: Yea, Surya, thou art great in fame thou evermore, O God, art great. Thou by thy greatness art the Gods' High Priest, divine, far-spread unconquerable light.

verses.sa: इयं या नीच्यर्किणी रूपा रोहिण्या कृता । चित्रेव प्रत्यदर्श्यायत्य१न्तर्दशसु बाहुषु॥
verses.tr: iyaṃ yā nīcyarkiṇī rūpā rohiṇyā kṛtā citreva pratyadarśyāyatya1ntardaśasu bāhuṣu
verses.en: She yonder, bending lowly down, clothed in red hues and rich in rays, Is seen, advancing as it were with various tints, amid the ten surrounding arms.

verses.sa:
प्रजा ह तिस्रो अत्यायमीयुर्न्य१न्या अर्कमभितो विविश्रे ।
बृहद्ध तस्थौ भुवनेष्वन्तः पवमानो हरित आ विवेश॥
verses.tr: prajā ha tisro atyāyamīyurnya1nyā arkamabhito viviśre bṛhaddha tasthau bhuvaneṣvantaḥ pavamāno harita ā viveśa
verses.en: Past and gone are three mortal generations: the fourth and last into the Sun hath entered. He mid the worlds his lofty place hath taken. Into green plants is gone the Purifying.

verses.sa:
माता रुद्राणां दुहिता वसूनां स्वसादित्यानाममृतस्य नाभिः ।
प्र नु वोचं चिकितुषे जनाय मा गामनागामदितिं वधिष्ट॥
verses.tr: mātā rudrāṇāṃ duhitā vasūnāṃ svasādityānāmamṛtasya nābhiḥ pra nu vocaṃ cikituṣe janāya mā gāmanāgāmaditiṃ vadhiṣṭa
verses.en: The Rudras' Mother, Daughter of the Vasus, centre of nectar, the Adityas' Sister- To folk who understand will 1 proclaim it-injure not Aditi, the Cow, the sinless.

verses.sa:
वचोविदं वाचमुदीरयन्तीं विश्वाभिर्धीभिरुपतिष्ठमानाम् ।
देवीं देवेभ्यः पर्येयुषीं गामा मावृक्त मर्त्यो दभ्रचेताः॥
verses.tr: vacovidaṃ vācamudīrayantīṃ viśvābhirdhībhirupatiṣṭhamānām devīṃ devebhyaḥ paryeyuṣīṃ gāmā māvṛkta martyo dabhracetāḥ
verses.en: Weak-minded men have as a cow adopted me who came hither from the Gods, a Goddess, Who, skilled in eloquence, her voice uplifteth, who standeth near at hand with all devotions.

verses.sa: त्वमग्ने बृहद्वयो दधासि देव दाशुषे । कविर्गृहपतिर्युवा॥
verses.tr: tvamagne bṛhadvayo dadhāsi deva dāśuṣe kavirgṛhapatiryuvā
verses.en: Lord of the house, Sage, ever young, high power of life, O Agni, God, Thou givest to thy worshipper.

verses.sa: स न ईळानया सह देवाँ अग्ने दुवस्युवा । चिकिद्विभानवा वह॥
verses.tr: sa na īḻānayā saha devāṃ agne duvasyuvā cikidvibhānavā vaha
verses.en: So with our song that prays and serves, attentive, Lord of spreading light, Agni, bring hitherward the Gods.

verses.sa: त्वया ह स्विद्युजा वयं चोदिष्ठेन यविष्ठ्य । अभि ष्मो वाजसातये॥
verses.tr: tvayā ha svidyujā vayaṃ codiṣṭhena yaviṣṭhya abhi ṣmo vājasātaye
verses.en: For, Ever-Youthful One, with thee, best Furtherer, as our ally, We overcome, to win the spoil.

verses.sa: और्वभृगुवच्छुचिमप्नवानवदा हुवे । अग्निं समुद्रवाससम्॥
verses.tr: aurvabhṛguvacchucimapnavānavadā huve agniṃ samudravāsasam
verses.en: As Aurva Bhrgu used, as Apnavana used, I call the pure Agni who clothes him with the sea.

verses.sa: हुवे वातस्वनं कविं पर्जन्यक्रन्द्यं सहः । अग्निं समुद्रवाससम्॥
verses.tr: huve vātasvanaṃ kaviṃ parjanyakrandyaṃ sahaḥ agniṃ samudravāsasam
verses.en: 1 call the Sage who sounds like wind, the Might that like Parjanya roars, Agni who clothes him with the sea.

verses.sa: आ सवं सवितुर्यथा भगस्येव भुजिं हुवे । अग्निं समुद्रवाससम्॥
verses.tr: ā savaṃ savituryathā bhagasyeva bhujiṃ huve agniṃ samudravāsasam
verses.en: As Savitar's productive Power, as him who sends down bliss, I call Agni who clothes him with the sea.

verses.sa: अग्निं वो वृधन्तमध्वराणां पुरूतमम् । अच्छा नप्त्रे सहस्वते॥
verses.tr: agniṃ vo vṛdhantamadhvarāṇāṃ purūtamam acchā naptre sahasvate
verses.en: Hither, for powerful kinship, I call Agni, him Who prospers you, Most frequent at our solemn rites

verses.sa: अयं यथा न आभुवत्त्वष्टा रूपेव तक्ष्या । अस्य क्रत्वा यशस्वतः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ yathā na ābhuvattvaṣṭā rūpeva takṣyā asya kratvā yaśasvataḥ
verses.en: That through this famed One's power, he may stand by us even as Tvastar comes Unto the forms that must he shaped.

verses.sa: अयं विश्वा अभि श्रियोऽग्निर्देवेषु पत्यते । आ वाजैरुप नो गमत्॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ viśvā abhi śriyo'gnirdeveṣu patyate ā vājairupa no gamat
verses.en: This Agni is the Lord supreme above all glories mid the Gods: May he come nigh to us with strength.

verses.sa: विश्वेषामिह स्तुहि होतॄणां यशस्तमम् । अग्निं यज्ञेषु पूर्व्यम्॥
verses.tr: viśveṣāmiha stuhi hotṝṇāṃ yaśastamam agniṃ yajñeṣu pūrvyam
verses.en: Here praise ye him the most renowned of all the ministering Priests, Agni, the Chief at sacrifice;

verses.sa: शीरं पावकशोचिषं ज्येष्ठो यो दमेष्वा । दीदाय दीर्घश्रुत्तमः॥
verses.tr: śīraṃ pāvakaśociṣaṃ jyeṣṭho yo dameṣvā dīdāya dīrghaśruttamaḥ
verses.en: Piercing, with purifying flame, enkindled in our homes, most high, Swiftest to hear from far away.

verses.sa: तमर्वन्तं न सानसिं गृणीहि विप्र शुष्मिणम् । मित्रं न यातयज्जनम्॥
verses.tr: tamarvantaṃ na sānasiṃ gṛṇīhi vipra śuṣmiṇam mitraṃ na yātayajjanam
verses.en: Sage, laud the Mighty One who wins the spoil of victory like a steed, And, Mitra like, unites the folk.

verses.sa: उप त्वा जामयो गिरो देदिशतीर्हविष्कृतः । वायोरनीके अस्थिरन्॥
verses.tr: upa tvā jāmayo giro dediśatīrhaviṣkṛtaḥ vāyoranīke asthiran
verses.en: Still turning to their aim in thee, the oblation-bearer's sister hymns Have come to thee before the wind.

verses.sa: यस्य त्रिधात्ववृतं बर्हिस्तस्थावसंदिनम् । आपश्चिन्नि दधा पदम्॥
verses.tr: yasya tridhātvavṛtaṃ barhistasthāvasaṃdinam āpaścinni dadhā padam
verses.en: The waters find their place in him, for whom the threefold sacred grass Is spread unbound, unlimited.

verses.sa: पदं देवस्य मीळ्हुषोऽनाधृष्टाभिरूतिभिः । भद्रा सूर्य इवोपदृक्॥
verses.tr: padaṃ devasya mīḻhuṣo'nādhṛṣṭābhirūtibhiḥ bhadrā sūrya ivopadṛk
verses.en: The station of the Bounteous God hath, through his aid which none impair, A pleasant aspect like the Sun.

verses.sa: अग्ने घृतस्य धीतिभिस्तेपानो देव शोचिषा । आ देवान्वक्षि यक्षि च॥
verses.tr: agne ghṛtasya dhītibhistepāno deva śociṣā ā devānvakṣi yakṣi ca
verses.en: Blazing with splendour, Agni, God, through pious gifts of sacred oil, Bring thou the Gods and worship them.

verses.sa: तं त्वाजनन्त मातरः कविं देवासो अङ्गिरः । हव्यवाहममर्त्यम्॥
verses.tr: taṃ tvājananta mātaraḥ kaviṃ devāso aṅgiraḥ havyavāhamamartyam
verses.en: The Gods as mothers brought thee forth, the Immortal Sage, O Angiras, The bearer of our gifts to heaven.

verses.sa: प्रचेतसं त्वा कवेऽग्ने दूतं वरेण्यम् । हव्यवाहं नि षेदिरे॥
verses.tr: pracetasaṃ tvā kave'gne dūtaṃ vareṇyam havyavāhaṃ ni ṣedire
verses.en: Wise Agni, Gods established thee, the Seer, noblest messenger, As bearer of our sacred gifts.

verses.sa: नहि मे अस्त्यघ्न्या न स्वधितिर्वनन्वति । अथैतादृग्भरामि ते॥
verses.tr: nahi me astyaghnyā na svadhitirvananvati athaitādṛgbharāmi te
verses.en: No cow have I to call mine own, no axe at hand wherewith to work, Yet what is here I bring to thee.

verses.sa: यदग्ने कानि कानि चिदा ते दारूणि दध्मसि । ता जुषस्व यविष्ठ्य॥
verses.tr: yadagne kāni kāni cidā te dārūṇi dadhmasi tā juṣasva yaviṣṭhya
verses.en: O Agni, whatsoever be the fuel that we lay for thee, Be pleased therewith, Most Youthful God

verses.sa: यदत्त्युपजिह्विका यद्वम्रो अतिसर्पति । सर्वं तदस्तु ते घृतम्॥
verses.tr: yadattyupajihvikā yadvamro atisarpati sarvaṃ tadastu te ghṛtam
verses.en: That which the white-ant cats away, that over which the emmet crawls- May all of this be oil to thee.

verses.sa: अग्निमिन्धानो मनसा धियं सचेत मर्त्यः । अग्निमीधे विवस्वभिः॥
verses.tr: agnimindhāno manasā dhiyaṃ saceta martyaḥ agnimīdhe vivasvabhiḥ
verses.en: When he enkindles Agni, man should with his heart attend the song: I with the priests have kindled him.

verses.sa: अदर्शि गातुवित्तमो यस्मिन्व्रतान्यादधुः । उपो षु जातमार्यस्य वर्धनमग्निं नक्षन्त नो गिरः॥
verses.tr: adarśi gātuvittamo yasminvratānyādadhuḥ upo ṣu jātamāryasya vardhanamagniṃ nakṣanta no giraḥ
verses.en: That noblest Furtherer hath appeared, to whom men bring their holy works. Our songs of praise have risen aloft to Agni who was barn to give the Arya strength.

verses.sa: प्र दैवोदासो अग्निर्देवाँ अच्छा न मज्मना । अनु मातरं पृथिवीं वि वावृते तस्थौ नाकस्य सानवि॥
verses.tr: pra daivodāso agnirdevāṃ acchā na majmanā anu mātaraṃ pṛthivīṃ vi vāvṛte tasthau nākasya sānavi
verses.en: Agni of Divodasa turned, as 'twere in majesty, to the Gods. Onward he sped along the mother earth, and took his station in the height of heaven.

verses.sa: यस्माद्रेजन्त कृष्टयश्चर्कृत्यानि कृण्वतः । सहस्रसां मेधसाताविव त्मनाऽग्निं धीभिः सपर्यत॥
verses.tr: yasmādrejanta kṛṣṭayaścarkṛtyāni kṛṇvataḥ sahasrasāṃ medhasātāviva tmanā'gniṃ dhībhiḥ saparyata
verses.en: Him before whom the people shrink when he performs his glorious deeds, Him who wins thousands at the worship of the Gods, himself, that Agni, serve with son s.

verses.sa: प्र यं राये निनीषसि मर्तो यस्ते वसो दाशत् । स वीरं धत्ते अग्न उक्थशंसिनं त्मना सहस्रपोषिणम्॥
verses.tr: pra yaṃ rāye ninīṣasi marto yaste vaso dāśat sa vīraṃ dhatte agna ukthaśaṃsinaṃ tmanā sahasrapoṣiṇam
verses.en: The mortal man whom thou wouldst lead to opulence, O Vasu, he who brings thee gifts. He, Agni, wins himself a hero singing lauds, yea, one who feeds a thousand men.

verses.sa:
स दृळ्हे चिदभि तृणत्ति वाजमर्वता स धत्ते अक्षिति श्रवः ।
त्वे देवत्रा सदा पुरूवसो विश्वा वामानि धीमहि॥
verses.tr: sa dṛḻhe cidabhi tṛṇatti vājamarvatā sa dhatte akṣiti śravaḥ tve devatrā sadā purūvaso viśvā vāmāni dhīmahi
verses.en: He with the steed wins spoil even in the fenced fort, and gains imperishable fame. In thee, O Lord of wealth, continually we lay all precious offerings to the Gods.

verses.sa: यो विश्वा दयते वसु होता मन्द्रो जनानाम् । मधोर्न पात्रा प्रथमान्यस्मै प्र स्तोमा यन्त्यग्नये॥
verses.tr: yo viśvā dayate vasu hotā mandro janānām madhorna pātrā prathamānyasmai pra stomā yantyagnaye
verses.en: To him who dealeth out all wealth, who is the cheerful Priest of men, To him, like the first vessels filled with savoury juice, to Agni go the songs of praise.

verses.sa: अश्वं न गीर्भी रथ्यं सुदानवो मर्मृज्यन्ते देवयवः । उभे तोके तनये दस्म विश्पते पर्षि राधो मघोनाम्॥
verses.tr: aśvaṃ na gīrbhī rathyaṃ sudānavo marmṛjyante devayavaḥ ubhe toke tanaye dasma viśpate parṣi rādho maghonām
verses.en: Votaries, richly-gifted, deck him with their songs, even as the steed who draws the car. On both, Strong Lord of men! on child and grandson pour the bounties which our nobles give.

verses.sa: प्र मंहिष्ठाय गायत ऋताव्ने बृहते शुक्रशोचिषे । उपस्तुतासो अग्नये॥
verses.tr: pra maṃhiṣṭhāya gāyata ṛtāvne bṛhate śukraśociṣe upastutāso agnaye
verses.en: Sing forth to him, the Holy, most munificent, sublime with his refulgent glow, To Agni, ye Upastutas.

verses.sa: आ वंसते मघवा वीरवद्यशः समिद्धो द्युम्न्याहुतः । कुविन्नो अस्य सुमतिर्नवीयस्यच्छा वाजेभिरागमत्॥
verses.tr: ā vaṃsate maghavā vīravadyaśaḥ samiddho dyumnyāhutaḥ kuvinno asya sumatirnavīyasyacchā vājebhirāgamat
verses.en: Worshipped with gifts, enkindled, splendid, Maghavan shall win himself heroic fame. And will not his most newly shown benevolence come to us with abundant strength?

verses.sa: प्रेष्ठमु प्रियाणां स्तुह्यासावातिथिम् । अग्निं रथानां यमम्॥
verses.tr: preṣṭhamu priyāṇāṃ stuhyāsāvātithim agniṃ rathānāṃ yamam
verses.en: Priest, presser of the juice! praise now the dearest Guest of all our friends, Agni, the driver of the cars.

verses.sa: उदिता यो निदिता वेदिता वस्वा यज्ञियो ववर्तति । दुष्टरा यस्य प्रवणे नोर्मयो धिया वाज  सिषासतः॥
verses.tr: uditā yo niditā veditā vasvā yajñiyo vavartati duṣṭarā yasya pravaṇe normayo dhiyā vāja siṣāsataḥ
verses.en: Who, finder-out of treasures open and concealed, bringeth them hither, Holy One; Whose waves, as in a cataract, are hard to pass, when he, through song, would win him strength.

verses.sa: मा नो हृणीतामतिथिर्वसुरग्निः पुरुप्रशस्त एषः । यः सुहोता स्वध्वरः॥
verses.tr: mā no hṛṇītāmatithirvasuragniḥ purupraśasta eṣaḥ yaḥ suhotā svadhvaraḥ
verses.en: Let not the noble Guest, Agni, be wroth with us: by many a man his praise is sung, Good Herald, skilled in sacrifice.

verses.sa: मो ते रिषन्ये अच्छोक्तिभिर्वसोऽग्ने केभिश्चिदेवैः । कीरिश्चिद्धि त्वामीट्टे दूत्याय रातहव्यः स्वध्वरः॥
verses.tr: mo te riṣanye acchoktibhirvaso'gne kebhiścidevaiḥ kīriściddhi tvāmīṭṭe dūtyāya rātahavyaḥ svadhvaraḥ
verses.en: O Vasu, Agni, let not them be harmed who come in any way with lauds to thee. Even the lowly, skilled in rites, with offered gifts, seeketh thee for the envoy's task.

verses.sa: आग्ने याहि मरुत्सखा रुद्रेभिः सोमपीतये । सोभर्या उप सुष्टुतिं मादयस्व स्वर्णरे॥
verses.tr: āgne yāhi marutsakhā rudrebhiḥ somapītaye sobharyā upa suṣṭutiṃ mādayasva svarṇare
verses.en: Friend of the Maruts, Agni, come with Rudras to the Soma-draught, To Sobhar's fair song of praise, and be thou joyful in the light. VALAKHILYA
